abstract.text: This research examines how teenage drug and alcohol use responds to changes in the economy. In contrast to the recent literature confirming pro-cyclical alcohol use among adults, this research offers strong evidence that a weaker economy leads to greater teenage marijuana and hard-drug use and some evidence that a weaker economy also leads to higher teenage alcohol use. The findings are based on logistic models with state and year fixed effects, using teenagers from the NLSY-1997. The evidence also indicates that teenagers are more likely to sell drugs in weaker economies. This suggests one mechanism for counter-cyclical drug use - that access to illicit drugs is easier when the economy is weaker. These results also suggest that the strengthening economy in the 1990s mitigated what would otherwise have been much larger increases in teenage drug use.

10.1002/hec.1132.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了青少年药物与酒精使用如何响应经济变化。与近期文献中证实成年人酒精使用具有顺周期性相反，本研究提供了强有力的证据，表明经济疲软会导致青少年大麻和硬性毒品使用增加，同时也表明经济疲软会导致青少年酒精使用增加。研究结果基于包含州和年份固定效应的逻辑模型，使用的是NLSY-1997中的青少年数据。研究还表明，在经济疲软时期，青少年更有可能贩卖毒品。这提示了一种反周期性药物使用的机制——在经济疲软时，获取非法药物的难度较低。这些结果还表明，20世纪90年代经济的强劲发展缓解了原本可能导致的青少年药物使用大幅增加。

abstract.text: Resource scarcity is the raison d'être for the discipline of economics. Thus, the primary purpose of economic analysis is to help decision-makers when addressing problems arising due to the scarcity problem. The research reported here was concerned with how cost-effectiveness information is used by the National Institute for Health & Clinical Excellence (NICE) in national technology coverage decisions in the UK, and how its impact might be increased. The research followed a qualitative case study methodology with semi-structured interviews, supported by observation and analysis of secondary sources. Our research highlights that the technology appraisal function of NICE represents an important progression for the UK health economics community: new cost-effectiveness work is commissioned for each technology and that work directly informs national health policy. However, accountability in policy decisions necessitates that the information upon which decisions are based (including cost-effectiveness analysis, CEA) is accessible. This was found to be a serious problem and represents one of the main ongoing challenges. Other issues highlighted include perceived weaknesses in analysis methods and the poor alignment between the health maximisation objectives assumed in economic analyses and the range of other objectives facing decision-makers in reality.

10.1002/hec.1133.abstractZh: 资源稀缺性是经济学学科存在的根本原因。因此，经济分析的主要目的就是帮助决策者解决因资源稀缺问题而产生的各种问题。本文研究关注的是英国国家健康与临床卓越研究所（NICE）在国家级技术覆盖决策中如何利用成本效益信息，以及如何提升其影响力度。研究采用了定性案例研究方法，通过半结构化访谈，并结合观察与二手资料分析。我们的研究指出，NICE的技术评估职能为英国健康经济学领域带来了重要进展：每项技术都会开展新的成本效益分析，而这些分析结果直接影响着国家健康政策。然而，政策决策中的问责制要求决策所依据的信息（包括成本效益分析）必须易于获取。这一直是一个严重的问题，也是当前面临的主要挑战之一。其他值得关注的问题还包括分析方法的不足，以及经济分析中所假设的优化健康目标与现实中决策者面临的其他目标之间的不匹配。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to decompose cross-national differences in self-reported general health into parts explained by differences in 'true' health, measured by diagnosed conditions and measurements, and parts explained by cross-cultural differences in response styles. The data used were drawn from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe 2004 (SHARE), using information from 22 731 individuals aged 50 and over from 10 European countries. Self-rated general health shows large cross-country variations. According to their self-reports, the healthiest respondents live in the Scandinavian countries and the least healthy live in Southern Europe. Counterfactual self-reported health distributions that assume identical response styles in each country show much less variation in self-reports than factual self-reports. Danish and Swedish respondents tend to largely over-rate their health (relative to the average) whereas Germans tend to under-rate their health. If differences in reporting styles are taken into account, cross-country variations in general health are reduced but not eliminated. Failing to account for differences in reporting styles may yield misleading results.

10.1002/hec.1134.abstractZh: 本文旨在将各国在自我报告的一般健康状况上的差异分解为两部分：一部分是由“真实”健康状况的差异所解释，这种差异通过诊断出的疾病和各项指标来衡量；另一部分则是由跨文化差异导致的报告方式差异所解释。研究数据来自2004年欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE），涉及来自10个欧洲国家的22,731名50岁及以上的个体。自我报告的一般健康状况表现出显著的跨国差异。根据他们的自我报告，最健康的受访者居住在斯堪的纳维亚国家，而最不健康的受访者则居住在南欧国家。假设每个国家的报告方式相同的情况下，实际健康状况的分布与自我报告的情况相比，差异要小得多。丹麦和瑞典的受访者往往高估了自己的健康状况（相对于平均水平），而德国人的情况则相反，他们往往低估了自己的健康状况。如果考虑到报告方式的差异，虽然一般健康状况的跨国差异有所减少，但并未完全消除。未能考虑报告方式的差异可能会导致误导性的结果。

abstract.text: This article focuses on the modelling and prediction of costs due to disease accrued over time, to inform the planning of future services and budgets. It is well documented that the modelling of cost data is often problematic due to the distribution of such data; for example, strongly right skewed with a significant percentage of zero-cost observations. An additional problem associated with modelling costs over time is that cost observations measured on the same individual at different time points will usually be correlated. In this study we compare the performance of four different multilevel/hierarchical models (which allow for both the within-subject and between-subject variability) for analysing healthcare costs in a cohort of individuals with early inflammatory polyarthritis (IP) who were followed-up annually over a 5-year time period from 1990/1991. The hierarchical models fitted included linear regression models and two-part models with log-transformed costs, and two-part model with gamma regression and a log link. The cohort was split into a learning sample, to fit the different models, and a test sample to assess the predictive ability of these models. To obtain predicted costs on the original cost scale (rather than the log-cost scale) two different retransformation factors were applied. All analyses were carried out using Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulation methods.

10.1002/hec.1141.abstractZh: 本文重点研究随时间累积的疾病成本建模与预测，以指导未来服务的规划和预算制定。有充分证据表明，由于成本数据的分布特性，成本数据的建模往往存在困难；例如，数据呈严重右偏分布，且零成本观测值占很大比例。此外，随时间建模成本时还存在一个问题，即同一个体在不同时间点的成本观测值通常具有相关性。本研究比较了四种不同的多层次/层次模型在分析早期炎症性多关节炎患者群体中的医疗成本方面的性能，这些患者从1990/1991年开始，在5年的时间内每年进行一次随访。所使用的层次模型包括线性回归模型、采用对数变换的成本两部分模型，以及采用伽马回归和对数链接的两部分模型。研究将样本分为学习样本和测试样本，分别用于拟合不同模型并评估这些模型的预测能力。为了获得原始成本规模上的预测成本（而非对数成本规模），采用了两种不同的重新转换方法。所有分析均使用贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛模拟方法进行。

abstract.text: A positive relationship between income and child outcomes has been observed in data from numerous countries. A key question concerns the extent to which this association represents a causal relationship as opposed to unobserved heterogeneity. We use data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Children and Youth to implement a series of empirical strategies for estimating the existence and size of the effect of income on behavioural-emotional outcomes. We also examine the role of parenting style. Our results indicate that there is little evidence of an effect of income on behavioural-emotional scores. The exclusion of parenting style from the models was found to not bias the estimated income effect, but parenting style was found to have a consistent impact on child outcomes.

10.1002/hec.1142.abstractZh: 在多个国家的数据中观察到收入与儿童结果之间存在正相关关系。一个关键问题是，这种关联是否代表了因果关系，还是由于未观察到的异质性所致。我们利用《全国儿童和青少年纵向调查》的数据，采用了一系列实证策略来估计收入对行为-情感结果的影响及其大小。我们还研究了育儿方式的作用。我们的研究结果表明，几乎没有证据表明收入对行为-情感评分有显著影响。将育儿方式排除在模型之外并未导致对收入影响的估计产生偏差，而育儿方式被发现对儿童结果有持续的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper we attempt to identify behavioral differences between public and private not-for-profit hospitals, by exploiting the introduction of the DRG-based payment system in the Italian NHS during the second half of the 1990s. We estimate the technical efficiency of a sample of hospitals for the period 1995-2000 considering an output distance function, and adopting both parametric (COLS and SF) and nonparametric (DEA) approaches. Our results show a convergence of mean efficiency scores between not-for-profit and public hospitals, and seem to suggest that differences in economic performances between competing ownership forms are more the result of the institutional settings in which they operate than the effect of the incentive structures embedded in the different proprietary forms. We also observe a decline in technical efficiency, probably due to policies aimed at reducing hospitalization rates.

10.1002/hec.1143.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们试图通过利用1990年代下半叶意大利国家卫生服务体系引入的DRG支付系统，来识别公立与非营利性医院之间的行为差异。我们采用输出距离函数，并采用参数化方法（COLS和SF）与非参数化方法（DEA），对1995-2000年期间部分医院的技术效率进行了评估。研究结果表明，非营利性医院与公立医院的效率得分趋于一致，这表明不同所有权形式之间的经济表现差异更多是由其运营所处的制度环境所决定，而非不同所有权形式内部激励结构的效应。此外，我们还观察到技术效率的下降，这可能是由于旨在降低住院率的政策所导致的。

abstract.text: In this paper, we provide a detailed investigation into the quitting behaviour of nurses in the British National Health Service (NHS), using a recently constructed longitudinal survey. We fit both single and competing risks duration models that enable us to establish the characteristics of those nurses who leave the public sector, distinguish the importance of pay in this decision and document the destinations that nurses move to. Contrary to expectations, we find that the hourly wage received by nurses outside of the NHS is around 20% lower than in the NHS, and that hours of work are about the same. However, while the effect of wages is found to be statistically significant, the predicted impact of an increase in nurses' pay on retention rates is small. The current nurse retention problem in the NHS is therefore unlikely to be eliminated through substantially increased pay.

10.1002/hec.1144.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过对英国国家健康服务系统（NHS）中护士离职行为的详细调查，利用最近构建的纵向调查数据，对这一现象进行了深入研究。我们采用了单风险模型和竞争风险持续时间模型，以了解那些离开公共部门的护士的特征，分析薪酬在决定离职中的重要性，并记录护士的离职去向。与预期相反，我们发现护士在NHS之外工作的时薪比在NHS内低约20%，而工作小时数则大致相同。尽管薪酬的影响具有统计学意义，但护士薪酬增加对保留率的影响却很小。因此，通过大幅提高薪酬不太可能解决NHS中护士的保留问题。

abstract.text: The study integrates two methodologies so that income-related inequality in general health can be decomposed into contributions from socio-demographic characteristics to each of the dimensions defining general health. It is found that these relative contributions vary substantially across dimensions. For policy purposes such information is valuable as it indicates at which population groups and at which aspects of health efforts to reduce inequalities in health should be targeted.

10.1002/hec.1145.abstractZh: 该研究整合了两种研究方法，以便将与健康相关的收入不平等分解为社会人口特征对各个健康维度的贡献。研究发现，这些相对贡献在不同维度之间存在显著差异。对于政策制定而言，这些信息非常有价值，因为它能够指出应该针对哪些人群以及哪些健康方面来减少不平等。

abstract.text: Long waiting times for inpatient treatment in the UK National Health Service have been a source of popular and political concern, and therefore a target for policy initiatives. In the London Patient Choice Project, patients at risk of breaching inpatient waiting time targets were offered the choice of an alternative hospital with a guaranteed shorter wait. This paper develops a simple theoretical model of the effect of greater patient choice on waiting times. It then uses a difference in difference econometric methodology to estimate the impact of the London choice project on ophthalmology waiting times. In line with the model predictions, the project led to shorter average waiting times in the London region and a convergence in waiting times amongst London hospitals.

10.1002/hec.1146.abstractZh: 英国国家卫生服务系统中，住院治疗的等待时间过长，已成为公众和政界关注的热点问题，因此也成为政策改革的重点对象。在伦敦患者选择项目中，那些面临超过等待时间目标的患者可以选择另一家医院，该医院承诺提供更短的等待时间。本文建立了一个简单的理论模型，探讨患者选择增多对等待时间的影响。随后，采用差异估计方法，评估伦敦选择项目对眼科治疗等待时间的影响。根据模型预测，该项目使得伦敦地区的平均等待时间缩短，并且伦敦各医院的等待时间趋于一致。

abstract.text: Equal access for poor populations to health services is a comprehensive objective for any health reform. The Colombian health reform addressed this issue through a segmented progressive social health insurance approach. The strategy was to assure universal coverage expanding the population covered through payroll linked insurance, and implementing a subsidized insurance program for the poorest populations, those not affiliated through formal employment. A prospective study was performed to follow-up health service utilization and out-of-pocket expenses using a cohort design. It was representative of four Colombian cities (Cendex Health Services Use and Expenditure Study, 2001). A four part econometric model was applied. The model related medical service utilization and medication with different socioeconomic, geographic, and risk associated variables. Results showed that subsidized health insurance improves health service utilization and reduces the financial burden for the poorest, as compared to those non-insured. Other social health insurance schemes preserved high utilization with variable out-of-pocket expenditures. Family and age conditions have significant effect on medical service utilization. Geographic variables play a significant role in hospital inpatient service utilization. Both, geographic and income variables also have significant impact on out-of-pocket expenses. Projected utilization rates and a simulation favor a dual policy for two-stage income segmented insurance to progress towards the universal insurance goal.

10.1002/hec.1147.abstractZh: 让贫困人群能够平等获得医疗服务是任何医疗改革的一个全面目标。哥伦比亚的医疗改革通过一种分段式的渐进式社会医疗保险方案来解决这一问题。该策略旨在实现全民覆盖，通过工资挂钩保险扩大保险覆盖人群，并为那些没有正式就业渠道的最贫困人群实施补贴保险计划。一项前瞻性研究采用队列设计，跟踪了医疗服务利用情况和个人支出情况。这项研究涵盖了哥伦比亚四个城市的数据（Cendex医疗服务利用与支出研究，2001年）。研究采用了四部分经济计量模型，将医疗服务利用和药物使用与不同的社会经济、地理和风险相关变量联系起来。研究结果表明，与未投保人群相比，补贴医疗保险提高了医疗服务利用率，并减轻了最贫困人群的财务负担。其他社会医疗保险方案则保持了较高的服务利用率，但个人支出有所不同。家庭状况和年龄因素对医疗服务利用有显著影响。地理变量在住院服务利用中起着重要作用。地理和收入变量也对个人支出有显著影响。预测利用率和模拟分析表明，采用分段式双阶段收入保险政策是朝着全民保险目标迈进的有效途径。

abstract.text: This paper examines the determinants of GP visiting in Ireland, using panel data from the Living in Ireland Survey from 1995-2001. While cross-sectional studies provide important information on GP visiting patterns at a certain point in time, with panel data we can also control for unobserved individual heterogeneity, as well as identify whether it is the same individuals who consistently visit their GP year on year, or whether there is more mobility in visiting. We therefore estimate dynamic models of GP utilisation, and attempt to decompose the observed variation in GP visiting into components attributable to observed individual characteristics, unobserved individual heterogeneity and state dependence.

10.1002/hec.1149.abstractZh: 本文利用1995-2001年《在爱尔兰生活调查》的面板数据，探讨了全科医生访问爱尔兰的决定因素。虽然横截面研究能够提供某一时间点上全科医生访问模式的重要信息，但使用面板数据我们可以控制未观察到的个体异质性，并识别是相同个体每年都持续访问全科医生，还是访问频率存在较大变动。因此，我们建立了动态模型来研究全科医生的利用情况，并试图将观察到的全科医生访问变化分解为由个体特征、未观察到的个体异质性和状态依赖性等因素导致的部分。

abstract.text: For equity, preferences used in cost-effectiveness analyses (CEAs) should yield similar values for different groups with similar health states. We used data from the US 2000 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, including socio-demographics, EQ-5D Index and EQ Visual Analog Scale (EQ VAS) scores, to examine whether EQ-5D Index (representing community preferences) and EQ VAS (representing personal preferences) scores differed systematically by socio-demographic group. Differences between EQ-5D Index and EQ VAS scores by socio-demographic group were small and mostly not statistically significant. These preliminary findings suggest that using the EQ-5D Index in CEAs may not contribute to socio-demographic inequities.

10.1002/hec.1152.abstractZh: 在成本效益分析（CEAs）中，用于评估公平性的偏好应能够为具有相似健康状况的不同群体产生相似的结果。我们使用了美国2000年医疗支出调查的数据，其中包括社会人口统计信息、EQ-5D指数以及EQ视觉模拟量表（EQ VAS）的得分，以研究EQ-5D指数（代表社区偏好）与EQ VAS得分是否因社会人口统计群体而存在系统性差异。结果发现，EQ-5D指数与EQ VAS得分在社会人口统计群体间的差异较小，且大多不具有统计学意义。这些初步发现表明，在CEAs中使用EQ-5D指数可能不会加剧社会人口统计方面的不平等。

abstract.text: National priorities and performance management regimes in the National Health Services of England and Wales diverged following devolution, most notably with respect to the use of waiting time targets, which have been progressively strengthened in England but were abandoned in Wales in the immediate post-devolution period. We analyse routine data collected over a six-year period from three English and one Welsh hospital trust close to the English-Welsh border to ascertain whether: (a) there is evidence of differential performance over time that relates to the country where the hospital is located; (b) within each hospital, there is evidence that English and Welsh patients faced different waiting times. Over the period the English hospitals recorded increased levels of activity, undertook proportionately more day case activity, and mortality rates fell. Activity levels remained constant in Wales, the proportion of day case activity fell, proportionately more non-elective patients were admitted, and mortality rates rose. There is partial evidence that English patients faced lower waiting times than their Welsh counterparts and were more likely to be admitted within a target waiting period. The stronger performance management regime operating in England appears to have contributed to higher levels of performance in the English hospitals over the period.

10.1002/hec.1153.abstractZh: 英格兰和威尔士国家卫生服务系统的国家优先事项和绩效管理制度在权力下放后出现了差异，尤其是在等待时间目标的使用上。在英格兰，这些目标得到了逐步加强，而在威尔士，在权力下放后的初期阶段则被放弃了。我们分析了在六年间从靠近英格兰-威尔士边界的三家英格兰医院和一家威尔士医院收集的数据，以了解以下情况：(a)是否存在与医院所在国家相关的绩效差异；(b)在每家医院内，英格兰和威尔士患者是否面临不同的等待时间。在这段时间内，英格兰医院的活跃度有所提高，日间手术的比例也相应增加，死亡率则有所下降。而威尔士的活跃度保持不变，日间手术的比例有所下降，非必要手术的患者比例有所增加，死亡率则有所上升。有部分证据表明，英格兰患者的等待时间比威尔士患者短，并且更有可能在规定的等待时间内被收治。在英格兰实施的更严格的绩效管理制度似乎有助于提高英格兰医院的绩效水平。

abstract.text: One of the limitations of cross-country health expenditure analysis refers to the fact that the financing, the internal organization and political restraints of health care decision-making are country-specific and heterogeneous. Yet, a way through is to examine the influence of such effects in those countries that have undertaken decentralization processes. In such a setting, it is possible to examine potential expenditure spillovers across the geography of a country as well as the influence of the political ideology of regional incumbents and institutional factors on public health expenditure. This paper examines the determinants of public health expenditure within Spanish region-states (Autonomous Communities, ACs), most of them subject to similar financing structures although exhibiting significant heterogeneity as a result of the increasing decentralization, region-specific political factors along with different use of health care inputs, economic dimension and spatial interactions.

10.1002/hec.1154.abstractZh: 跨国卫生支出分析的一个局限性在于，卫生决策的资金来源、内部组织结构和政治约束因国家而异且存在差异。不过，一个解决方法是考察那些已经实施权力下放进程的国家中这些因素的影响。在这样的背景下，可以研究不同地理区域之间的潜在支出溢出效应，以及地区现任政府的政治意识形态和制度因素对公共卫生支出的影响。本文探讨了西班牙地区-州（自治社区）公共卫生支出的决定因素，这些地区虽然面临相似的融资结构，但由于权力下放程度的增加、地区特定的政治因素以及卫生资源使用的差异、经济层面和空间互动等因素，仍表现出显著的异质性。

abstract.text: In a previous paper, the reliability of willingness-to-pay (WTP) values was found to be an increasing function of the size of WTP expressed. Here, the results of a qualitative exercise conducted alongside this quantitative study are presented. The results of this exercise suggest that higher WTP values may require more thought from the respondent which, in turn, gives them greater stability. At low levels of WTP, values appear to be taken from a 'discretionary account', where expenditure is more volatile. Caveats to this result, and suggestions for future research, are considered in the discussion.

10.1002/hec.1155.abstractZh: 在之前的一篇论文中，发现支付意愿（WTP）值的可靠性与所表达的支付意愿的大小呈正相关。本文则展示了与这项定量研究同步进行的定性研究的结果。该定性研究的结果表明，较高的支付意愿值可能需要受访者更多的思考，这反过来又使得支付意愿值更加稳定。在支付意愿较低的情况下，支付意愿值似乎来自“自由支配账户”，因此支出更为不稳定。讨论部分还考虑了这一结果的局限性，并提出了未来研究的建议。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationship between height-adjusted weight and economic conditions in Finland, using individual microdata for the period 1978-2002. If anything, the results reveal that an improvement in regional economic conditions measured by the employment rate produces a decrease in BMI, other things being equal. The Finnish evidence presented does not support the conclusions reported for the USA, according to which temporary economic slowdowns are good for health. In contrast, at least BMI seems to increase during slumps.

10.1002/hec.1156.abstractZh: 本文利用1978至2002年的个体微观数据，探讨了芬兰身高调整后的体重与经济状况之间的关系。研究结果表明，在其他条件不变的情况下，区域经济状况的改善（以就业率衡量）会导致BMI的下降。芬兰的研究结果并不支持美国的研究结论，即暂时的经济衰退对健康有益。相反，至少在经济衰退期间，BMI似乎会上升。

abstract.text: This paper provides econometric evidence linking a country's per capita government health expenditures and per capita income to two health outcomes: under-five mortality and maternal mortality. Using instrumental variables techniques (GMM-H2SL), we estimate the elasticity of these outcomes with respect to government health expenditures and income while treating both variables as endogenous. Consequently, our elasticity estimates are larger in magnitude than those reported in literature, which may be biased up. The elasticity of under-five mortality with respect to government expenditures ranges from -0.25 to -0.42 with a mean value of -0.33. For maternal mortality the elasticity ranges from -0.42 to -0.52 with a mean value of -0.50. For developing countries, our results imply that while economic growth is certainly an important contributor to health outcomes, government spending on health is just as important a factor.

10.1002/hec.1157.abstractZh: 本文提供了计量经济学证据，将一个国家人均政府卫生支出与人均收入与两个健康结果联系起来：五岁以下儿童死亡率和孕产妇死亡率。通过使用工具变量技术（GMM-H2SL），我们估计了这些结果与政府卫生支出和收入之间的弹性，同时将这两个变量视为内生变量。因此，我们的弹性估计值比文献中报道的更大，可能存在偏差。五岁以下儿童死亡率对政府支出的弹性范围为-0.25至-0.42，平均值为-0.33。对于孕产妇死亡率，弹性范围为-0.42至-0.52，平均值为-0.50。对于发展中国家而言，我们的结果表明，虽然经济增长无疑是健康结果的重要贡献因素，但政府卫生支出同样是一个重要的因素。

abstract.text: In the stated preference method called graded pairs comparisons respondents are asked to rate the intensity of their preference for their preferred alternative in a pairwise comparison of alternatives. Econometricians anticipate that the additional information will improve statistical efficiency compared to the standard DCE format. However, this paper reveals that added information inherent in graded pairs scale does not provide smaller standard deviations for the WTP estimated. Secondly, the ordered-response regression models employing the full range of the graded pairs data tend to overestimate WTP, which presumably is caused by the inherent tendency of the ordered-response models to 'predict to the extremes'.

10.1002/hec.1159.abstractZh: 在所谓的偏好评分法中，受访者被要求对各个备选方案之间的偏好强度进行成对比较。计量经济学家认为，额外的信息会比标准的DCE格式提高统计效率。然而，本文发现，分级成对数据所包含的额外信息并不会使WTP估计的标准差变小。其次，采用完整分级成对数据的有序响应回归模型往往高估了WTP，这可能是由于有序响应模型本身具有“预测极端值”的倾向所致。

abstract.text: The primary objective of this paper is to evaluate the impact of Taiwan's National Health Insurance program (NHI), established in 1995, on improving elderly access to care and health status. Further, we estimate the extent to which NHI reduces gaps in access and health across income groups. Using data from a longitudinal survey, we adopt a difference-in-difference methodology to estimate the causal effect of Taiwan's NHI. Our results show that Taiwan's NHI has significantly increased utilization of both outpatient and inpatient care among the elderly, and such effects were more salient for people in the low- or middle-income groups. Our findings also reveal that although Taiwan's NHI greatly increased the utilization of both outpatient and inpatient services, this increased utilization of health services did not reduce mortality or lead to better self-perceived general health status for Taiwanese elderly. Measures more sensitive than mortality and self-perceived general health may be necessary for discerning the health effects of NHI. Alternatively, the lack of NHI effects on health may reflect other quality and efficiency problems inherent in the system not yet addressed by NHI.

10.1002/hec.1160.abstractZh: 本文的主要目标是评估台湾于1995年建立的国民健康保险计划对改善老年人就医和健康状况的影响。此外，我们进一步估计了国民健康保险计划在缩小不同收入群体之间就医机会和健康状况差距方面的效果。通过一项纵向调查的数据，我们采用了差异分解方法来计算台湾国民健康保险计划的因果效应。研究结果表明，台湾国民健康保险计划显著提高了老年人对门诊和住院服务的利用，且这种效应在低收入或中等收入群体中更为明显。研究还发现，尽管台湾国民健康保险计划大大增加了老年人对医疗服务的利用，但这种增加并未降低死亡率或改善老年人对自身健康状况的认知。为了准确评估国民健康保险计划对健康的实际影响，可能需要使用比死亡率和自身健康状况认知更为敏感的指标。另一方面，国民健康保险计划未能有效改善健康状况的原因，可能在于该体系本身存在的其他质量和效率问题，而这些问题尚未得到国民健康保险计划的解决。

abstract.text: Decision makers within a jurisdiction facing evidence of positive but uncertain incremental net benefit of a new health care intervention have viable options where no further evidence is anticipated to:(1)adopt the new intervention without further evidence;(2)adopt the new intervention and undertake a trial; or(3)delay the decision and undertake a trial.Value of information methods have been shown previously to allow optimal design of clinical trials in comparing option (2) against option (1), by trading off the expected value and cost of sample information. However, this previous research has not considered the effect of cost of reversal on expected value of information in comparing these options. This paper demonstrates that, where a new intervention is adopted, the expected value of information is reduced under optimal decision making with costs of reversing decisions. Further, the paper shows that comparing expected net gain of optimally designed trials for option (2) vs (1) conditional on cost of reversal, and (3) vs (1) conditional on opportunity cost of delay allow systematic identification of an optimal decision strategy and trial design.

10.1002/hec.1161.abstractZh: 在某一司法管辖区内的决策者，面对一种新的医疗干预措施所带来的积极但不确定的增量净收益证据时，有以下可行的选择：在没有进一步证据预期的情况下，可以选择：(1)在没有任何进一步证据的情况下采用新的干预措施；(2)采用新的干预措施并开展试验；或者(3)推迟决策并开展试验。先前的研究表明，信息方法能够优化临床试验的设计，通过比较选项(2)与选项(1)，在预期价值与样本信息成本之间进行权衡。然而，这些研究并未考虑逆转决策成本对信息预期价值的影响。本文证明，在采用新的干预措施的情况下，随着逆转决策成本的增加，信息的预期价值会降低。此外，本文还表明，通过比较在逆转决策成本条件下的选项(2)与选项(1)的预期净收益，以及选项(3)与选项(1)在延迟机会成本条件下的预期净收益，可以系统地确定最优决策策略和试验设计。

abstract.text: In 1996, free choice of health insurers was introduced to the German social health insurance system. One objective was to increase efficiency through competition. A crucial precondition for effective competition among health insurers is that consumers search for lower-priced health insurers. We test this hypothesis by estimating the price elasticities of insurers' market shares. We use unique panel data and specify a dynamic panel model to explain changes in market shares. Estimation results suggest that short-run price elasticities are smaller than previously found by other studies. In the long-run, however, estimation results suggest substantial price effects.

10.1002/hec.1167.abstractZh: 1996年，德国社会医疗保险体系引入了健康保险公司的自由选择机制。其中一个目标是通过竞争来提高效率。健康保险公司之间有效竞争的一个关键前提是，消费者会寻找价格更低的保险公司。我们通过估计保险公司市场份额的价格弹性来验证这一假设。我们使用独特的面板数据，并采用动态面板模型来解释市场份额的变化。估计结果显示，短期内的价格弹性小于其他研究发现的数值。然而，从长期来看，估计结果表明价格存在显著的影响。

abstract.text: The National Institute for Clinical Excellence has recently changed its guidelines on discounting costs and effects in economic evaluations. In common with most other regulatory bodies it now requires that health effects should be discounted at the same rate as costs. We show that the guideline leads to sub-optimal decisions because it fails to account for the changing value of health. NICE (and other regulatory bodies) should either use differential discounting or stipulate how the changing value of health should otherwise be dealt with. We also show how binding health service budget constraints should be incorporated in evaluations.

10.1002/hec.1168.abstractZh: 英国国家临床卓越研究所最近修改了其在经济评估中折现成本和效果的指南。与其他大多数监管机构一样，该指南现在要求健康效应的折现率应与成本保持一致。我们发现，这一指南会导致不理想的决策，因为它没有考虑到健康价值的变化。NICE（以及其他监管机构）应该采用差异折现法，或者明确规定如何处理健康价值的变化。我们还展示了如何在评估中纳入具有约束力的医疗服务预算限制。

abstract.text: Cost utility analyses typically incorporate preferences based upon the mean values for health states generated from a sample of the general population. The main argument for using general population values rests upon the premise that in a publicly funded health care system the main objective of the health care system is a societal one, namely to maximise health subject to equity concerns. Alternatively, it can be argued that patients themselves should be asked to value their own health state given that they have first hand experience of the state being valued. This paper investigates the relationship between patient and general population values within the context of a randomised controlled trial to compare alternative treatments for varicose veins. It was found that patients' own health valuations tended to be higher than those of the general population sample. The results from this study have important implications for economic evaluation. The incremental QALY gain for patients receiving treatment for moderate varicose veins would be almost halved if patients' own values were used to estimate QALYs in contrast to the general population values. The results also suggest that the variant of elicitation technique may be more important than the source of those values in revealing discrepancies.

10.1002/hec.1170.abstractZh: 成本效用分析通常基于从一般人群样本中得出的健康状态的均值来构建偏好。使用一般人群值的理由在于，在公共资助的医疗保健系统中，医疗保健的主要目标是对社会有益，即在考虑公平问题的前提下最大化健康水平。另一种观点是，由于患者本身有 firsthand experience 关于健康状态的评价，因此应该让他们自己来评估自己的健康状态。本文研究了在随机对照试验中，患者与一般人群值之间的关系，以比较不同治疗方法对静脉曲张的疗效。研究发现，患者自身的健康价值往往高于一般人群样本的价值。这项研究的结果对经济评估具有重要意义。如果使用患者自身的价值来估算QALY，那么接受中度静脉曲张治疗的患者所获得的增量QALY将几乎减半，而使用一般人群值则不会如此。研究结果还表明，在揭示差异方面，这种评估方法的变体可能比其价值来源更为重要。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of illicit drug use during pregnancy on two measures of poor infant health: low birth weight and abnormal infant health conditions. We use data from a national longitudinal study of urban parents that includes postpartum interviews with mothers, hospital medical record data on the mothers and their newborns, and information about the neighborhood in which the mother resides. We address the potential endogeneity of prenatal drug use. Depending on how prenatal drug use is measured, we find that it increases low birth weight by 4-6 percentage points and that it increases the likelihood of an abnormal infant health condition by 7-12 percentage points.

10.1002/hec.1171.abstractZh: 我们估计了孕期非法药物使用对婴儿健康的两个方面的影响：低出生体重和异常婴儿健康状况。我们使用了一项针对城市父母的全国性纵向研究的数据，其中包括对母亲的产后访谈、母亲及其新生儿的医院医疗记录数据，以及母亲居住地区的相关信息。我们探讨了产前药物使用可能导致的内生性问题。根据产前药物使用的测量方式，我们发现它会使低出生体重增加4-6个百分点，并使出现异常婴儿健康状况的可能性增加7-12个百分点。

abstract.text: We argue that health care quality has an important impact on economic inequality and on saving behavior. We exploit district-wide variability in health care quality provided by the Italian universal public health system to identify the effect of quality on income inequality, health inequality and precautionary saving. We find that in lower quality districts there is greater income and health dispersion and higher precautionary saving. The analysis carries important insights for the ongoing debate about the validity of the life-cycle model and interesting policy implications for the design of health care systems.

10.1002/hec.1172.abstractZh: 我们认为，医疗保健质量对经济不平等和储蓄行为有着重要影响。我们利用意大利全民公共健康体系在各地区提供的不同医疗保健质量，来研究质量对收入不平等、健康不平等以及预防性储蓄的影响。研究发现，在质量较低的地区，收入和健康状况的分散程度更高，预防性储蓄也更为显著。这一分析为关于生命周期模型有效性的持续讨论提供了重要见解，并对医疗保健系统的设计具有现实意义。

abstract.text: Background Health care funding levels differ significantly across geographic regions, but there is little correlation between regional funding levels and outcomes of elderly Medicare beneficiaries. Our goal was to determine whether this relationship holds true in a non-Medicare population cared for in a large integrated health care system with a capitated budget allocation system. Methods We explored the association between health care funding and risk-adjusted mortality in the 22 Veterans Affairs (VA) geographic Networks over a six-year time period. Allocations to Networks were adjusted for illness burden using Diagnostic Cost Groups. To test the association between funding and risk-adjusted three-year mortality, we ran logistic regressions with single-year patient cohorts, as well as hierarchical regressions on a six year longitudinal data set, clustering on VA Network. Results A 1000 dollar increase in funding per unit of patient illness burden was associated with a 2-8% reduction in three-year mortality in cross sectional regressions. However, in longitudinal hierarchical regressions clustering on Network, the significant effect of funding level was eliminated. Conclusions When longitudinal data are used, the significant cross sectional effect of funding levels on mortality disappear. Thus, the factors driving differences in mortality are Network effects, although part of the Network effect may be due to past levels of funding. Our results provide a caution for cross sectional examinations of the association between regional health care funding levels and health outcomes.

10.1002/hec.1173.abstractZh: 不同地理区域的医疗保健资金水平存在显著差异，但区域资金水平与老年医疗保险受益人的健康结果之间几乎没有相关性。我们的目标是确定这种关系是否适用于在一个具有固定预算分配系统的大型综合医疗系统中护理的非医疗保险人群。方法：我们研究了22个退伍军人事务部地理网络在六年的时间跨度内，医疗保健资金与风险调整死亡率之间的关联。根据诊断成本组对网络的资金分配进行了调整。为了测试资金与风险调整三年死亡率之间的关联，我们进行了单一年份患者群体的逻辑回归分析，以及基于六年纵向数据集的层次回归分析，聚类对象为退伍军人事务部网络。结果：在横截面回归分析中，每单位患者疾病负担增加1000美元与三年死亡率降低2-8%相关。然而，在基于网络进行纵向层次回归分析时，资金水平的显著效应消失了。结论：当使用纵向数据时，资金水平对死亡率的显著横截面效应消失了。因此，导致死亡率差异的因素是网络效应，尽管部分网络效应可能是由于过去的资金水平造成的。我们的研究结果提醒人们在研究区域医疗保健资金水平与健康结果之间的关联时，应避免进行横截面分析。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the pre-exit characteristics of hospital mergers, acquisitions, and closures. We estimate competing risk hazard models using an 18-year national data set that spans the wave of closures in the 1980s and of mergers in the 1990s. Evidence shows that weak productivity of the hospital is a strong determinant for closures while competitive pressures are more influential in the decision to consolidate. Thus, increased market power, relative to cost reductions, appears to play a larger role in the merger decision. Our results also provide insight into possible correlations between mergers and closures.

10.1002/hec.1174.abstractZh: 本文研究了医院合并、收购和关闭前的特征。我们利用一个涵盖1980年代关闭潮和1990年代合并潮的18年国家级数据集，建立了竞争风险风险模型。研究结果表明，医院的生产力低下是导致关闭的重要因素，而竞争压力在合并决策中则更为关键。因此，相对于成本降低而言，市场力量的增强在合并决策中似乎起着更大的作用。我们的研究结果还揭示了合并与关闭之间可能存在的相关性。

abstract.text: Economic evaluation of health care interventions usually requires the collection of service use data to estimate the total cost of participants in an evaluation. There are a number of methods available to measure the quantity of services used but little is known about the relative accuracy of alternative methods. In a multicentre randomised controlled trial of interventions for the treatment of adults with recurrent episodes of deliberate self-harm (the POPMACT trial), health service data were collected by patient self-report after six and twelve months and also from GP records by independent investigators. Agreement for overall costs was relatively high. However, this hides substantial variation in agreement between the two sources of information for different services. The results suggest that GP records provide more accurate data on the use of general practice-based contacts than patient report, but less reliable information on contacts with other health services. Thus reliance on GP records for data on hospital services and other community health services based outside of general practice surgeries is not recommended. Future research should explore the level of agreement between patient report and other providing sector records, such as hospital records.

10.1002/hec.1175.abstractZh: 对医疗干预措施的经济评估通常需要收集服务使用数据，以估算参与评估人员的总成本。目前有多种方法可用于衡量服务使用量，但关于不同方法的相对准确性知之甚少。在一项针对成人反复故意自残行为的干预措施的多中心随机对照试验中（POPMACT试验），通过患者自我报告在六个月和十二个月后收集了医疗服务数据，同时由独立调查人员从全科医生记录中收集数据。总体成本的一致性相对较高。然而，这种一致性掩盖了两种信息来源在各项服务上的显著差异。结果表明，全科医生记录提供了关于全科医生接触情况的更准确数据，但关于与其他医疗服务机构接触的信息则不太可靠。因此，不建议依赖全科医生记录来获取医院服务及其他社区健康服务的相关数据。未来的研究应探讨患者报告与其他提供部门记录（如医院记录）之间的一致性水平。

abstract.text: The G8 is considering committing to purchase vaccines against diseases concentrated in low-income countries (if and when desirable vaccines are developed) as a way to spur research and development on vaccines for these diseases. Under such an 'advance market commitment,' one or more sponsors would commit to a minimum price to be paid per person immunized for an eligible product, up to a certain number of individuals immunized. For additional purchases, the price would eventually drop to close to marginal cost. If no suitable product were developed, no payments would be made. We estimate the offer size which would make revenues similar to the revenues realized from investments in typical existing commercial pharmaceutical products, as well as the degree to which various model contracts and assumptions would affect the cost-effectiveness of such a commitment. We make adjustments for lower marketing costs under an advance market commitment and the risk that a developer may have to share the market with subsequent developers. We also show how this second risk could be reduced, and money saved, by introducing a superiority clause to a commitment. Under conservative assumptions, we document that a commitment comparable in value to sales earned by the average of a sample of recently launched commercial products (adjusted for lower marketing costs) would be a highly cost-effective way to address HIV/AIDS, malaria, and tuberculosis. Sensitivity analyses suggest most characteristics of a hypothetical vaccine would have little effect on the cost-effectiveness, but that the duration of protection conferred by a vaccine strongly affects potential cost-effectiveness. Readers can conduct their own sensitivity analyses employing a web-based spreadsheet tool.

10.1002/hec.1176.abstractZh: 八国集团正在考虑承诺购买针对低收入国家常见疾病的疫苗（如果合适的疫苗被研发出来），以此促进这些疾病疫苗的研究与开发。在这种“预先市场承诺”下，一个或多个赞助方将承诺为符合条件的产品为每个接种者支付最低价格，直至一定数量的人接种完毕。对于额外的购买，价格最终将降至接近边际成本的水平。如果没有合适的产品被研发出来，则不会进行任何支付。我们估算了能够使收入与现有商业制药产品投资相当的方案规模，以及不同模型合同和假设对这种承诺的成本效益的影响。我们还对预先市场承诺下的较低营销成本以及开发者可能不得不与后续开发者共享市场的风险进行了调整。此外，我们还展示了如何通过引入优越性条款来降低这一风险并节省资金。在保守的假设下，我们发现，与最近推出的商业产品平均销售额相当（考虑到较低的营销成本）的承诺，是应对艾滋病、疟疾和结核病的一种极具成本效益的方法。敏感性分析表明，假设疫苗的大多数特性对成本效益的影响较小，但疫苗提供的保护期限对潜在成本效益有显著影响。读者可以使用基于网络电子表格的工具进行自己的敏感性分析。

abstract.text: Though risk adjustment is necessary in order to make equitable comparisons of resource utilization in the treatment of acute myocardial infarction patients, there is little in the literature that can be practically applied without access to clinical records or specialized registries. The aim of this study is to show that effective models of resource utilization can be developed based on administrative data, and to demonstrate a practical application of the same models by comparing the risk-adjusted performance of the hospitals in our dataset. The study sample included 1748 AMI cases discharged from 10 large, private teaching hospitals in Japan, between 10 April 2001 and 30 June 2004. Explanatory variables included procedures (CABG and PCI), length of stay, outcome, patient demographics, diagnosis and comorbidity status. Multiple linear regression models constructed for the study were able to account for 66.5, 27.7, and 58.4% of observed variation in total charges, length of stay and charges per day, respectively. The performance of models constructed for this study was comparable to or better than performance reported by other studies that made use of explanatory variables extracted from clinical data. The use of administrative data in risk adjustment makes broad scale application of risk adjustment feasible.

10.1002/hec.1177.abstractZh: 尽管在比较急性心肌梗死患者的资源利用情况时需要进行风险调整以确保公平性，但现有文献中几乎没有无需临床记录或专门数据库即可实际应用的方案。本研究的目的是证明基于行政数据可以开发出有效的资源利用模型，并通过比较我们数据集中医院的风险调整绩效来展示这些模型的实际应用。研究样本包括2001年4月10日至2004年6月30日期间从日本10家大型私立教学医院出院的1748例急性心肌梗死患者。解释变量包括手术类型（冠状动脉旁路移植术和经皮冠状动脉介入治疗）、住院时间、治疗效果、患者人口统计学信息、诊断结果及合并症状况。为研究构建的多变量线性回归模型能够分别解释总费用、住院时间和每日费用观测变异的66.5%、27.7%和58.4%。本研究构建的模型性能与其他使用临床数据中提取的解释变量进行建模的研究相当，甚至更为优越。在风险调整中采用行政数据使得风险调整的广泛应用成为可能。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effect that binge drinking has on the probability of graduating on time from high school and on future earnings. The analysis is conducted on students in their senior year of high school using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979. Importantly, the usual instruments used to correct for the endogeneity of the drinking variable are found to be robust only for women. This paper finds that heavy drinking decreases the probability of graduating on time. Binge drinking does not have a direct impact on adults' labor earnings, but graduating late results in lower labor income. Because of a late graduation, young men who binge in high school will face an earnings penalty of 1.5-1.84 percentage points. Women also face a penalty, but this seems mostly due to the fact that women who graduate late work in industries and occupations that pay less.

10.1002/hec.1178.abstractZh: 本文分析了酗酒对高中按时毕业概率及未来收入的影响。研究基于1979年青少年纵向调查的数据，针对高中毕业年级的学生进行。值得注意的是，通常用于纠正饮酒变量内生性的工具仅对女性有效。研究发现，酗酒会降低按时毕业的概率。酗酒对成年人的劳动收入没有直接影响，但延迟毕业会导致劳动收入下降。由于延迟毕业，高中时期酗酒的年轻男性将面临1.5至1.84个百分点的收入损失。女性也面临类似的损失，但这主要是因为延迟毕业的女性从事的工资较低的行业和职业。

abstract.text: Aggregate data on household health insurance expenditure in the US and Japan that are classified by period and age are decomposed into age, period, and cohort effects by using the Bayesian cohort models. These models are developed to overcome the identification problem involved in cohort analysis. Despite the differences between the health insurance systems of the two countries, three interesting empirical findings are obtained. First, in both the countries, the age effects are the most influential, and the cohort effects have negligible influence. The latter provides a striking policy implication since the generational imbalance in social security expenditures is widely recognized in developed countries. Second, in both the countries, the period effects show a roughly upward trend. Finally, the age effects exhibit a roughly upward movement for all age groups in the US; however, in Japan, these effects show a downward movement for the 55-59 age group due to the changes in the health insurance system on retirement.

10.1002/hec.1179.abstractZh: 通过对美国和日本的家庭健康保险支出数据进行按时期和年龄分类后，使用贝叶斯队列模型将其分解为年龄、时期和队列效应。这些模型的开发旨在解决队列分析中的识别问题。尽管两国健康保险体系存在差异，但仍获得了三个有趣的实证发现。首先，在两国中，年龄效应最为显著，而队列效应的影响微乎其微。这一发现具有重要的政策意义，因为社会保障支出中的代际不平衡在发达国家已被广泛认可。其次，在两国中，时期效应均呈现上升趋势。最后，在美国，所有年龄组的年龄效应均呈现上升趋势；而在日本，由于健康保险体系在退休政策上的变化，55-59岁年龄组的效应则呈现下降趋势。

abstract.text: The health systems of Japan and the Asian Tigers (Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore and Taiwan), and the recent reforms to them, provide many potentially valuable lessons to East Asia's developing countries. All five systems have managed to keep a check on health spending despite their different approaches to financing and delivery. These differences are reflected in the progressivity of health finance, but the precise degree of progressivity of individual sources and the extent to which households are vulnerable to catastrophic health payments depend on the design features of the system - the height of any ceilings on social insurance contributions, the fraction of health spending covered by the benefit package, the extent to which the poor face reduced copayments, whether there are caps on copayments, and so on. On the delivery side, too, Japan and the Tigers offer some interesting lessons. Singapore's experience with corporatizing public hospitals - rapid cost and price inflation, a race for the best technology, and so on - illustrates the difficulties of corporatization. Korea's experience with a narrow benefit package illustrates the danger of providers shifting demand from insured services with regulated prices to uninsured services with unregulated prices. Japan, in its approach to rate setting for insured services, has managed to combine careful cost control with fine-tuning of profit margins on different types of care. Experiences with DRGs in Korea and Taiwan point to cost-savings but also to possible knock-on effects on service volume and total health spending. Korea and Taiwan both offer important lessons for the separation of prescribing and dispensing, including the risks of compensation costs outweighing the cost savings caused by more 'rational' prescribing, and cost-savings never being realized because of other concessions to providers, such as allowing them to have onsite pharmacists.

10.1002/hec.1180.abstractZh: 日本以及亚洲四小龙（香港、韩国、新加坡和台湾）的卫生体系，以及它们最近进行的改革，为东亚发展中国家提供了许多有价值的经验。尽管在融资和医疗服务提供方式上各有不同，但这五个国家的卫生体系都成功控制了卫生支出。这些差异体现在卫生财政的累进性上，但各个来源的具体累进程度以及家庭在灾难性医疗支出面前的脆弱程度，取决于体系的设计特点——如社会保险缴费的上限、福利计划覆盖的卫生支出比例、贫困人群是否面临较低的共付额、共付额是否有上限等。在医疗服务提供方面，日本和亚洲四小龙也提供了一些有趣的经验。新加坡将公立医院企业化改革的经验——包括快速的成本和价格膨胀、对最佳技术的竞争等——说明了企业化改革的困难。韩国的经验则表明，医疗服务提供者将需求从价格受监管的有保险服务转向价格不受监管的无保险服务，存在风险。日本在设定有保险服务价格时，成功地将严格的成本控制与不同类型医疗服务的利润率调整相结合。韩国和台湾在按疾病诊断相关分组制度方面的经验，既表明了成本节约的可能性，也揭示了可能对服务量和总卫生支出产生的影响。韩国和台湾在药品处方与配药分离方面提供了重要的经验，包括补偿成本可能超过更“理性”的处方所带来的成本节约，以及由于对其他提供者的让步（如允许他们在现场配备药剂师）而导致成本节约未能实现的风险。

abstract.text: An important subject of debate in cost-utility analysis of health care programmes is whether to include costs of unrelated medical care in life years gained. The inclusion of such costs is likely to be of consequence in the case of primary prevention. This paper presents different strategies regarding the inclusion not only of the costs, but also of the health effects of unrelated medical care in economic evaluations. Four different cost-utility ratios are presented and related to the criterion of internal consistency. In addition, the possibility to relate the ratios to a well-posed decision problem is analysed. An example computes the different ratios for smoking cessation interventions in different age groups. Including health care costs of unrelated medical care in life years gained increases cost utility ratios, but excluding unrelated medical costs favours smoking cessation interventions targeted at older smokers over those at younger smokers. We conclude that for primary prevention only a cost utility ratio that includes both the costs and effects of unrelated medical care meets the criterion of internal consistency and is related to a meaningful decision problem. Therefore, this type of cost-utility ratio should be preferred even if the data requirements may be substantial.

10.1002/hec.1181.abstractZh: 在医疗保健项目的成本效用分析中，一个重要的讨论话题是是否应将无关医疗护理的成本计入获得的生命年数中。在初级预防的情况下，包含此类成本可能会产生重要影响。本文提出了不同的策略，不仅涉及成本的计算，还包括在经济评估中考虑无关医疗护理的健康影响。文中提出了四种不同的成本效用比率，并分析了这些比率与内部一致性标准之间的关系。此外，还探讨了将这些比率与一个明确的决策问题联系起来的可能性。通过实例计算不同年龄组中的戒烟干预措施的不同比率，发现将无关医疗护理的成本计入生命年数可以提高成本效用比率，而排除无关医疗成本则有利于针对老年吸烟者的戒烟干预措施，而不是针对年轻吸烟者的干预措施。我们得出结论，对于初级预防而言，只有同时包含成本和相关健康影响的成本效用比率才能满足内部一致性标准，并且与有意义的决策问题相关联。因此，即使数据需求可能相当庞大，也应优先选择这种类型的成本效用比率。

abstract.text: Utilizing a panel data set of 50 US states, this note investigates nonstationarity and cointegration of health care expenditures and gross state products (GSP). Both the individual state-based method and the recent panel data method are applied. Allowing for structural breaks in the test, we find that health care expenditures and GSP are both nonstationary. The evidence also suggests that the two series form a cointegrating relationship. The income elasticities of health spending vary over states and became smaller in the 1990s.

10.1002/hec.1182.abstractZh: 本研究利用包含50个美国州的面板数据集，探讨了医疗保健支出与州生产总值之间的非平稳性和协整关系。同时采用了基于单个州的数据方法和最新的面板数据方法。在考虑结构突变的情况下，我们发现医疗保健支出和州生产总值均呈现非平稳性。研究还表明，这两个变量之间存在协整关系。各州的医疗保健支出收入弹性存在差异，且在20世纪90年代有所降低。

abstract.text: Elicitation of utilities from members of the public generally uses verbal description of health states. This paper reports the results of a small-scale time trade-off study on the feasibility of an alternative approach, where health states were simulated using plastic spectacles. This approach has methodological implications for the valuation exercise, in that many respondents find it difficult to conceive of visual impairment alone, without referring to their own current health. We conclude that it is feasible to simulate visual impairment in valuation exercises, but care must be taken to ensure what health state is effectively being valued.

10.1002/hec.1184.abstractZh: 从公众成员那里获取效用信息通常是通过描述健康状态来实现的。本文报告了一项小规模的时间权衡研究的结果，该研究探讨了另一种方法的可行性，即使用塑料眼镜来模拟健康状态。这种方法对估值过程具有方法论上的意义，因为许多受访者难以仅通过视觉障碍来描述自己的健康状况，而不提及他们当前的健康状况。我们得出结论，在估值过程中模拟视觉障碍是可行的，但必须注意确保真正评估的是哪种健康状态。

abstract.text: This paper studies the interaction between public and private health care provision in a National Health Service (NHS), with free public care and costly private care. The health authority decides whether or not to allow private provision and sets the public sector remuneration. The physicians allocate their time (effort) in the public and (if allowed) in the private sector based on the public wage income and the private sector profits. We show that allowing physician dual practice 'crowds out' public provision, and results in lower overall health care provision. While the health authority can mitigate this effect by offering a higher wage, we find that a ban on dual practice is more efficient if private sector competition is weak and public and private care are sufficiently close substitutes. On the other hand, if private sector competition is sufficiently tough, a mixed system, with physician dual practice, is always preferable to a pure NHS system.

10.1002/hec.1185.abstractZh: 本文研究了英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）中公共与私人医疗供给之间的互动关系，该体系包含免费的公共医疗服务和昂贵的私人医疗服务。卫生当局负责决定是否允许私人医疗服务，并设定公共部门的薪酬标准。医生根据公共部门的工资收入和私人部门的利润来分配自己的时间（精力），在公共部门与（如果允许的话）私人部门之间选择工作。研究表明，允许医生同时从事公共和私人医疗服务会“挤占”公共医疗供给，从而导致整体医疗供给减少。虽然卫生当局可以通过提高公共部门工资来减轻这一影响，但我们发现，如果私人部门的竞争较弱，且公共与私人医疗服务具有足够大的替代性，那么禁止医生同时从事两种服务更为有效。另一方面，如果私人部门的竞争足够激烈，那么包含医生双重执业的混合体系总是优于纯粹的国家医疗服务体系。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the aggregate relationships between traffic accidents and real economic activity in Spain during the last 30 years. Our general approach is based on two basic assumptions: (1) the number of accidents depends on the use of cars and other exogenous variables, and (2) the level of economic activity affects variation in the stock of cars, as well as degree of utilization. We propose a novel turning point characterization for monthly seasonal data that allows to check whether economic and road accident cycles coincide and, to date the beginning and end of their respective cycles. Empirical results from this section are important in establishing posterior causal models and whether or not economic activity and road accidents have a common component in the long run and a varying lead-lag relationship, depending on the cycles. These models will be the basis to check when Spain will achieve the European Union figures in terms of the fatalities/accidents ratio under different scenarios. Empirical results as well as historical experiences from other European countries proved that reducing fatalities is not only a question of diminishing accidents rates.

10.1002/hec.1186.abstractZh: 本文分析了过去30年间西班牙交通事故与实体经济活动之间的总体关系。我们的总体方法基于两个基本假设：（1）事故数量取决于汽车的使用情况以及其他外生变量；（2）经济活动的水平会影响汽车保有量的变化以及汽车的利用率。我们提出了一种用于月度季节性数据的新转折点表征方法，该方法可以检验经济活动和交通事故周期是否重合，并确定它们各自周期的起始和结束时间。这一部分的实证结果对于建立后续的因果模型非常重要，同时也有助于了解经济活动和交通事故在长期内是否存在共同的影响因素，以及它们之间的关系是否因周期的不同而发生变化。这些模型将作为判断西班牙在不同情景下何时能达到欧盟交通事故死亡率指标的基础。来自其他欧洲国家的实证结果和历史经验表明，减少死亡人数不仅仅取决于降低事故率。

abstract.text: A general population sample of Australian respondents completed a contingent valuation (CV) survey that asked them to value six scenarios. These varied according to whether the scenario was seeking to elicit: (i) use value; (ii) externality value; (iii) option value; or (iv) a combination. Results indicate that use plus externality and/or option value was significantly greater than use value alone. As CV studies in health (care) overwhelmingly focus on use value alone - often implicitly through study design rather than explicitly - this raises the possibility of mis-specification in CV research in health (care). The implications for CV in health (care) are considered.

10.1002/hec.1189.abstractZh: 澳大利亚的普通人群样本参与者完成了一项条件价值评估调查，要求他们对六个情景进行估值。这些情景的评估依据是否旨在获取：(i)使用价值；(ii)外部性价值；(iii)选择价值；或(iv)多种价值的组合。研究结果表明，使用价值加上外部性价值和/或选择价值显著大于单独的使用价值。由于健康护理领域的条件价值评估研究大多仅关注使用价值——这通常是通过研究设计隐含地体现出来的，而非明确说明——这就可能导致健康护理领域条件价值评估研究的误判。本文还探讨了这些条件价值评估在健康护理领域的意义。

abstract.text: An understanding of the relationship between cost sharing and drug consumption depends on consistent and unbiased price elasticity estimates. However, there is wide heterogeneity among studies, which constrains the applicability of elasticity estimates for empirical purposes and policy simulation. This paper attempts to provide a corrected measure of the drug price elasticity by employing meta-regression analysis (MRA). The results indicate that the elasticity estimates are significantly different from zero, and the corrected elasticity is -0.209 when the results are made robust to heteroskedasticity and clustering of observations. Elasticity values are higher when the study was published in an economic journal, when the study employed a greater number of observations, and when the study used aggregate data. Elasticity estimates are lower when the institutional setting was a tax-based health insurance system.

10.1002/hec.1190.abstractZh: 理解成本分担与药物消费之间的关系，需要获得一致且无偏的价格弹性估计。然而，不同研究之间存在较大差异，这限制了弹性估计在实证分析和政策模拟中的适用性。本文尝试通过元回归分析来修正药物价格弹性的测量方法。研究结果表明，弹性估计值显著不为零，当对异方差性和观测值聚集进行稳健化处理后，修正后的弹性值为-0.209。当研究发表在经济期刊上、使用的观测数量较多以及使用汇总数据时，弹性值较高。而当制度环境为基于税收的健康保险系统时，弹性估计值较低。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of employment-contingent health insurance (ECHI) on married women's labor supply following a health shock. First, we develop a theoretical framework that examines the effects of ECHI on the labor supply response to a health shock, which suggests that women with ECHI are less likely to reduce their labor supply in response to a health shock, relative to women with health insurance through their spouse's employer. Second, we empirically examine this relationship based on labor supply responses to breast cancer. We find that health shocks decrease labor supply to a greater extent among women insured by their spouse's policy than among women with health insurance through their own employer, suggesting that ECHI creates incentives to remain working when faced with a serious illness.

10.1002/hec.1191.abstractZh: 我们研究了就业相关的健康保险对已婚女性劳动供给的影响。首先，我们建立了一个理论框架，探讨ECHI对劳动供给反应的影响。该理论表明，与通过配偶雇主获得健康保险的女性相比，拥有ECHI的女性在面临健康冲击时更不可能减少劳动供给。其次，我们基于乳腺癌对劳动供给的反应来实证研究这一关系。研究发现，与健康保险由配偶提供相比，健康冲击导致女性劳动供给减少的程度更大，这表明ECHI在面临严重疾病时提供了继续工作的激励。

abstract.text: The study analyzes the hospitalization patterns of elderly residents to examine whether the relation between distant travel and severity of illness is uniform across racial/ethnic subgroups. A hypothesis is made that severity thresholds could be higher for minorities than whites. Hospital discharge data from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP-SID) of the Agency for Health Care Research and Quality for New York residents is used, with a link to the Area Resource File and American Hospital Association's survey files. Logistic models compare the association of distant admission with severity corresponding to each local threshold level, race, and type of hospital admission. The study uses four discrete distance thresholds in contrast to recent work. Also, an examination of severity thresholds for distant travel for different types of admission may clarify different sources of disparities in health care utilization. The findings indicate that minorities are likely to have higher severity thresholds than whites in seeking distant hospital care, although these conclusions depend on the type of condition. The study results imply that if costly elective services were regionalized to get the advantages of high volume for both cost and quality of care, some extra effort at outreach may be desirable to reduce disparities in appropriate care. Published in 2006 by John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

10.1002/hec.1192.abstractZh: 本研究分析了老年居民的住院模式，以考察远距离旅行与疾病严重程度之间的关系是否在不同种族/族裔亚群中保持一致。研究提出了一个假设，即少数族裔的病情严重程度阈值可能高于白人。研究使用了来自美国卫生研究与质量局医疗保健成本与利用项目（HCUP-SID）的纽约居民出院数据，并参考了地区资源文件和美国医院协会的调查数据。逻辑模型比较了不同距离导致的住院与不同当地阈值、种族以及住院类型对应的病情严重程度之间的关联。与近期的研究相比，本研究采用了四个不同的距离阈值。此外，对不同类型住院的远距离旅行病情严重程度阈值的分析，可能有助于阐明医疗保健利用差异的不同来源。研究结果表明，少数族裔在寻求远距离住院治疗时，其病情严重程度阈值可能高于白人，不过这一结论取决于具体的疾病类型。研究结果表明，如果将昂贵的择期服务区域化，以利用高服务量的优势来提高成本和护理质量，那么可能需要额外的努力来减少适当护理方面的差异。该研究发表于2006年，由John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.出版。

abstract.text: Effective control of asthma requires regular preventive medication. Poor medication adherence suggests that patient preferences for medications may differ from the concerns of the prescribing clinicians. This study investigated patient preferences for preventive medications across symptom control, daily activities, medication side-effects, convenience and costs, using a discrete choice experiment embedded in a randomized clinical trial involving patients with mild-moderate persistent asthma. The present data were collected after patients had received 6 weeks' treatment with one of two drugs. Three choice options were presented, to continue with the current drug, to change to an alternative, hypothetical drug, or to take no preventive medication. Analysis used random parameter multinomial logit. Most respondents chose to continue with their current drug in most choice situations but this tendency differed depending on which medication they had been allocated. Respondents valued their ability to participate in usual daily activities and sport, preferred minimal symptoms, and were less likely to choose drugs with side-effects. Cost was also significant, but other convenience attributes were not. Demographic characteristics did not improve the model fit. This study illustrates how discrete choice experiments may be embedded in a clinical trial to provide insights into patient preferences.

10.1002/hec.1193.abstractZh: 有效控制哮喘需要定期使用预防性药物。药物依从性较差表明，患者对药物的偏好可能与开药医生的担忧有所不同。本研究通过一项随机临床试验，调查了轻度至中度持续性哮喘患者对于预防性药物的偏好，涉及症状控制、日常活动、药物副作用、便利性和成本等方面。在患者接受为期6周的治疗后，研究人员提供了三种选择：继续使用当前药物、更换为另一种假设药物，或者不使用预防性药物。分析采用了随机参数多项逻辑模型。大多数受访者在大多数选择情况下都选择继续使用当前药物，但这种倾向因所分配的药物种类而异。受访者重视能够参与日常活动和运动，偏好最小的症状，并且不太可能选择有副作用的药物。成本也是一个重要因素，但其他便利性属性则不是如此。人口统计特征并未改善模型的拟合度。本研究展示了如何将离散选择实验嵌入到临床试验中，以了解患者的偏好。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of quality improvements in conjunction with user fees on the utilization and equality of outpatient services at a range of public sector health facilities in India. Project impact on outpatient visits was estimated via the difference-in-difference method using pooled time series visit data from project and control facilities. The results indicate that the quality improvements significantly increased visits at all facility types. The project effect was largest at primary health center (PHC) and community health center (CHC), followed by district hospital (DH) and female district hospital (FDH). Pro-rich inequalities in outpatient visits increased at DHs and FDHs while at CHCs and PHCs the distribution remained equitable. This suggests that quality improvements at public sector health facilities can increase utilization of outpatient services in the presence of nominal user fees, but can also promote greater inequality favoring the better-off. At the referral hospital level, quality improvements should be made in conjuction with programs which encourage utilization by the poor. In contrast, the benefit of quality improvements at PHCs and CHCs is equitably distributed.

10.1002/hec.1194.abstractZh: 本文探讨了质量提升与用户费用相结合对印度一系列公共部门医疗机构门诊服务利用和公平性影响的研究。通过采用差异分解方法，利用项目设施与对照设施之间的合并时间序列访问数据，估算了项目对门诊访问的影响。研究结果表明，质量提升显著增加了所有类型医疗机构的访问量。项目效果在初级卫生中心（PHC）和社区卫生中心（CHC）最为显著，其次是地区医院（DH）和女性地区医院（FDH）。在地区医院和女性地区医院，门诊访问中的贫富不平等现象加剧，而在社区卫生中心和初级卫生中心，分布保持公平。这表明，在名义用户费用存在的情况下，公共部门医疗机构的质量提升可以增加门诊服务的利用，但也可能加剧有利于富裕群体的不平等现象。在转诊医院层面，质量提升应与鼓励贫困人口利用服务的计划相结合。相比之下，社区卫生中心和初级卫生中心的质量提升所带来的好处则得到了公平分配。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of varying levels of malpractice litigation on area medical costs. Using a fixed-effects model and Medicare Part B as the dependent variable, the results indicate that per enrollee medical expenditures are positively related to the incidence of medical malpractice lawsuits. The higher cost is presumed to be attributable to 'defensive practices' by area physicians based on varying degrees of perceived risk. The results suggest the addition to cost is substantial, possibly adding up to 25% in some jurisdictions with the impact exceeding annual dollar amounts of malpractice judgments and settlements.

10.1002/hec.1195.abstractZh: 本文探讨了不同水平的医疗事故诉讼对地区医疗成本的影响。采用固定效应模型，以Medicare Part B作为因变量，研究结果表明，每个参保人的医疗支出与医疗事故诉讼的发生率呈正相关。较高的成本被认为是由于地区医生基于感知风险的不同程度而采取“防御性措施”所导致的。研究结果表明，成本的增加相当显著，在某些地区可能高达25%，其影响超过了医疗事故判决和和解的年度金额。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the 'catch-up' hypothesis, that is, whether or not per capita health expenditures of the UK, Canada, Japan, Switzerland, and Spain converge to the per capita health expenditures of the USA over the period 1960-2000. We propose a framework to examine convergence of health expenditures and use recent developments in unit root testing, namely the Lagrange multiplier univariate and panel approaches that allow for at most two structural breaks. Our main finding is that while univariate and panel tests that do not incorporate structural breaks fail to find evidence of convergence, univariate and panel LM tests that allow for structural breaks find strong evidence of convergence of per capita health expenditures of the UK, Canada, Japan, Switzerland, and Spain to that of the USA.

10.1002/hec.1196.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了“追赶假说”，即1960至2000年间，英国、加拿大、日本、瑞士和西班牙的人均健康支出是否趋于与美国的人均健康支出一致。我们提出了一个框架来检验健康支出的收敛性，并利用了单位根检验的最新进展，即拉格朗日乘数单变量和面板方法，这些方法最多允许两次结构突变。我们的主要发现是，那些不纳入结构突变的单变量和面板检验未能发现收敛的证据，而允许结构突变的单变量和面板LM检验则发现了英国、加拿大、日本、瑞士和西班牙的人均健康支出趋于美国的人均健康支出的有力证据。

abstract.text: This paper describes four approaches to estimating confidence intervals for willingness to pay measures: the delta, Fieller, Krinsky Robb and bootstrap methods. The accuracy of the various methods is compared using a number of simulated datasets. In the majority of the scenarios considered all four methods are found to be reasonably accurate as well as yielding similar results. The delta method is the most accurate when the data is well-conditioned, while the bootstrap is more robust to noisy data and misspecification of the model. These conclusions are illustrated by empirical data from a study of willingness to pay for a reduction in waiting time for a general practitioner appointment in which all the methods produce fairly similar confidence intervals.

10.1002/hec.1197.abstractZh: 本文描述了四种估算支付意愿置信区间的方法：delta法、Fieller法、Krinsky Robb法和自助法。通过多个模拟数据集对这些方法的有效性进行了比较。在大多数情景中，这四种方法都被证明具有相当高的准确性，并且得出的结果也较为一致。当数据条件良好时，delta法最为准确；而自助法则对噪声数据和模型误设具有更强的鲁棒性。这些结论通过一项关于全科医生预约等待时间缩短支付意愿的研究中的实证数据得到了验证，该研究中所有方法得出的置信区间都相当接近。

abstract.text: Multilevel models (MLMs) have been recommended for estimating incremental net benefits (INBs) in multicentre cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA). However, these models have assumed that the INBs are exchangeable and that there is a common variance across all centres. This paper examines the plausibility of these assumptions by comparing various MLMs for estimating the mean INB in a multinational CEA. The results showed that the MLMs that assumed the INBs were exchangeable and had a common variance led to incorrect inferences. The MLMs that included covariates to allow for systematic differences across the centres, and estimated different variances in each centre, made more plausible assumptions, fitted the data better and led to more appropriate inferences. We conclude that the validity of assumptions underlying MLMs used in CEA need to be critically evaluated before reliable conclusions can be drawn.

10.1002/hec.1198.abstractZh: 多层模型（MLMs）被推荐用于估算多中心成本效益分析中的增量净效益（INBs）。然而，这些模型假设INBs是可交换的，并且所有中心之间存在共同的方差。本文通过比较不同MLMs来估算跨国CEA中的平均INB，检验了这些假设的可行性。结果表明，假设INBs可交换且存在共同方差的MLMs会导致错误的推断。而包含协变量以考虑各中心之间的系统差异，并估算每个中心的不同方差的MLMs，则更符合实际情况，能够更好地拟合数据，并得出更合理的推断。我们得出结论，在得出可靠结论之前，需要严格评估用于CEA的MLMs所依据的假设的有效性。

abstract.text: Probabilistic sensitivity analysis (PSA) is required to account for uncertainty in cost-effectiveness calculations arising from health economic models. The simplest way to perform PSA in practice is by Monte Carlo methods, which involves running the model many times using randomly sampled values of the model inputs. However, this can be impractical when the economic model takes appreciable amounts of time to run. This situation arises, in particular, for patient-level simulation models (also known as micro-simulation or individual-level simulation models), where a single run of the model simulates the health care of many thousands of individual patients. The large number of patients required in each run to achieve accurate estimation of cost-effectiveness means that only a relatively small number of runs is possible. For this reason, it is often said that PSA is not practical for patient-level models. We develop a way to reduce the computational burden of Monte Carlo PSA for patient-level models, based on the algebra of analysis of variance. Methods are presented to estimate the mean and variance of the model output, with formulae for determining optimal sample sizes. The methods are simple to apply and will typically reduce the computational demand very substantially.

10.1002/hec.1199.abstractZh: 概率敏感性分析（PSA）是处理健康经济模型中成本效益计算所面临的不确定性所必需的。在实践中，使用蒙特卡洛方法进行PSA是最简单的方式，该方法涉及多次运行模型，并使用随机抽样的模型输入值。然而，当经济模型的运行时间较长时，这种方法可能不切实际。这种情况尤其出现在患者级模拟模型中，这些模型需要多次运行才能准确估算成本效益。由于每次运行需要大量患者数据，因此实际可行的运行次数相对较少。因此，人们通常认为PSA对于患者级模型来说并不实用。我们提出了一种基于方差分析代数方法来减少患者级模型蒙特卡洛PSA的计算负担的方法。该方法用于估算模型输出的均值和方差，并提供了确定最优样本量的公式。这些方法易于应用，通常可以大幅降低计算需求。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate to what extent alcohol-dependent individuals fare worse in the Finnish labour market, using data from a large Finnish health survey. We used the DSM-IV criteria for alcohol dependence assessed by a composite international diagnostic interview (CIDI). We find that there are substantial disadvantages for alcohol-dependent men and women in the labour market, in the sense that they have lower employment probabilities. Treating alcohol dependence as an exogenous variable, we find that alcohol dependence is associated with decrease in the probability of full-time or part-time work of around 14 percentage points for men and 11 percentage points for women. However, accounting for endogeneity increases the negative effect to some 50 percentage points for men and to some 40 percentage points for women.

10.1002/hec.1201.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们基于一项大型芬兰健康调查的数据，探讨了酒精依赖者在芬兰劳动力市场中的处境。我们采用了DSM-IV标准对酒精依赖进行评估，该评估通过综合国际诊断访谈（CIDI）进行。研究发现，酒精依赖的男性和女性在劳动力市场中存在显著的不利因素，他们的就业可能性较低。将酒精依赖视为一个外生变量后，我们发现酒精依赖与全职或兼职工作的可能性降低有关，男性这一比例分别减少了14个百分点，女性则减少了11个百分点。然而，考虑到内生性因素后，这种负面影响在男性中上升到了50个百分点，在女性中则上升到了40个百分点。

abstract.text: We use the core interviews of the US Health Interview Survey for the years 1987-1994, to study the effects of socioeconomic status (SES) on mortality and self-reported health. We find, consistent with previous studies, that the relationship between mortality and indicators such as education and income diminishes with age. We consider new explanations for this result and conclude that general biological deterioration at old age is probably the principal one. One important piece of evidence for this conclusion is the finding that there is no relationship at all between mortality and SES for people whose self-reported health status at baseline is either fair or poor.

10.1002/hec.1203.abstractZh: 我们采用了1987至1994年美国健康访谈调查的核心访谈数据，研究社会经济地位对死亡率和自我报告健康状况的影响。研究发现，与以往的研究一致，死亡率与教育水平、收入等指标之间的关系随年龄增长而减弱。我们提出了对这一结果的新解释，并认为老年时期普遍的生理衰退可能是主要因素。支持这一结论的一个重要证据是：对于那些在基线时自我报告健康状况为一般或较差的人来说，死亡率与社会经济地位之间根本没有关系。

abstract.text: This paper provides insights into how Costa Rican public hospitals responded to the pressure for increased efficiency and quality introduced by the reforms carried out over the period 1997-2001. To that purpose we compute a generalized output distance function by means of non-parametric mathematical programming to construct a productivity index, which accounts for productivity changes while controlling for quality of care. Our results show an improvement in hospital performance mainly driven by quality increases. The adoption of management contracts seems to have contributed to such enhancement, more notably for small hospitals. Further, productivity growth is primarily due to technical and scale efficiency change rather than technological change. A number of policy implications are drawn from these results.

10.1002/hec.1204.abstractZh: 本文探讨了哥斯达黎加公立医院在1997-2001年期间实施改革后，如何应对提高效率和质量的压力。为此，我们通过非参数数学规划方法计算了一个广义产出距离函数，以构建生产率指数，该指数在控制护理质量的同时，能够反映生产率的变动。研究结果表明，医院绩效的改善主要得益于质量的提升。管理合同的采用似乎对这种提升起到了积极作用，尤其是在小型医院中。此外，生产率的增长主要源于技术和规模效率的变化，而非技术变革。这些研究结果还提出了一些政策启示。

abstract.text: Policy-makers often claim that enhancing patient choice induces more competition among hospitals and may therefore reduce waiting times. This paper tests this claim using 120 English NHS hospitals over the period 1999-2001. Several proxies for the degree of choice (or competition) are constructed including: (a) the number of hospitals within the catchment area of each hospital; (b) the number of hospitals in the catchment area of each hospital standardised by the population of the catchment area; (c) the inverse of the Herfindahl index (or 'the number of effective competitors'). Several control variables are included: the availability of doctors, junior doctors, nurses, and other personnel; the availability of acute beds; the emergency admission rate; the day-case rate; the average length of inpatient stay; an indicator of case-mix; and mortality and re-admission rates. We find that more choice is significantly associated with lower waiting times at the sample mean (five hospitals) although the quantitative effect is modest: an extra hospital in a catchment area will only reduce waiting by at most a few days (or 1-2% reduction in waiting). There is also some evidence that increases in choice can boost waiting times when the degree of choice is very high (i.e. more than 11 hospitals are included in the catchment area).

10.1002/hec.1205.abstractZh: 政策制定者经常声称，增加患者的选择可以促进医院之间的竞争，从而缩短等待时间。本文通过1999-2001年期间120家英国NHS医院的样本数据来验证这一说法。我们构建了多个衡量选择程度（或竞争程度）的代理变量，包括：(a) 每家医院所在区域内的医院数量；(b) 根据区域人口标准化的每家医院所在区域内的医院数量；(c) 赫芬达尔指数的倒数（即“有效竞争者的数量”）。我们还纳入了多个控制变量：医生的可用性、初级医生的可用性、护士及其他人员的可用性；急性病床的可用性；急诊入院率；日间手术率；住院平均时长；病例组合指标；以及死亡率和再入院率。研究发现，选择的增加确实与等待时间的减少显著相关，但在样本均值（五家医院）的情况下，这种效应较为温和：区域内多一家医院，等待时间最多只会减少几天（或等待时间减少1-2%）。此外，当选择程度非常高时（即区域内包含超过11家医院），选择的增加可能会延长等待时间。

abstract.text: Between 1993 and 2003, the proportion of urban residents without health insurance rose from 27 to 50%. The probability of outpatient visits in the previous 2 weeks dropped from 19.9 to 11.8% in urban areas between 1993 and 2003, and from 16.0 to 13.9% in rural areas. To improve risk-pooling and risk-sharing, private health insurance should play an important role in China's health insurance system. This paper estimates the demand for private health insurance in urban areas using contingent valuation methods. Individuals were asked about their willingness-to-pay (WTP) for major catastrophic disease insurance (MCDI), inpatient expenses insurance (IEI), and outpatient expenses insurance (OEI). The study was based on a household survey conducted in four small cities in China in 2004 and included 2671 respondents. More people would like to buy IEI and MCDI (48.5 and 43.0%, respectively) than OEI (24.5%). In addition, individuals would pay a higher premium for MCDI and IEI than for OEI. The price elasticities of demand for MCDI, IEI, and OEI were -0.27, -0.34, and -0.42, respectively. The determinants of enrollment in the three private health insurance programs were similar with employment status, age, education, and income.

10.1002/hec.1206.abstractZh: 在1993年至2003年间，没有健康保险的城市居民比例从27%上升到50%。在1993年至2003年间，城市地区过去两周的门诊就诊率从19.9%下降到11.8%，而农村地区的这一比例则从16.0%下降到13.9%。为了改善风险共担，私人健康保险在中国健康保险体系中应发挥重要作用。本文采用条件估值方法估算了城市地区对私人健康保险的需求。研究人员询问了个体对于重大灾难性疾病保险、住院费用保险和门诊费用保险的支付意愿。该研究基于2004年在中国四个小城市进行的一项家庭调查，共包含2671名受访者。更多受访者愿意购买住院费用保险和重大灾难性疾病保险（分别占48.5%和43.0%），而购买门诊费用保险的比例较低，仅为24.5%。此外，个体对于重大灾难性疾病保险和住院费用保险的支付意愿高于门诊费用保险。重大灾难性疾病保险、住院费用保险和门诊费用保险的需求弹性分别为-0.27、-0.34和-0.42。这三个私人健康保险项目的参保决定因素相似，包括就业状况、年龄、教育和收入。

abstract.text: Out-of-pocket (OOP) payments are the principal means of financing health care throughout much of Asia. We estimate the magnitude and distribution of OOP payments for health care in fourteen countries and territories accounting for 81% of the Asian population. We focus on payments that are catastrophic, in the sense of severely disrupting household living standards, and approximate such payments by those absorbing a large fraction of household resources. Bangladesh, China, India, Nepal and Vietnam rely most heavily on OOP financing and have the highest incidence of catastrophic payments. Sri Lanka, Thailand and Malaysia stand out as low to middle income countries that have constrained both the OOP share of health financing and the catastrophic impact of direct payments. In most low/middle-income countries, the better-off are more likely to spend a large fraction of total household resources on health care. This may reflect the inability of the poorest of the poor to divert resources from other basic needs and possibly the protection of the poor from user charges offered in some countries. But in China, Kyrgyz and Vietnam, where there are no exemptions of the poor from charges, they are as, or even more, likely to incur catastrophic payments.

10.1002/hec.1209.abstractZh: 在亚洲大部分地区，自付支出是医疗保健的主要融资方式。我们估算了14个国家和地区在医疗保健方面的自付支出规模和分布，这些国家和地区占亚洲人口的81%。我们重点关注那些对家庭生活水平造成严重影响的灾难性支出，并将这些支出与占用家庭资源较大份额的支出进行类比。孟加拉国、中国、印度、尼泊尔和越南最为依赖自付融资，其灾难性支出的发生率最高。斯里兰卡、泰国和马来西亚则属于中低收入国家，这些国家的自付融资比例有限，直接支出的灾难性影响也相对较轻。在大多数中低收入国家，较富裕的人群更有可能将大量家庭资源用于医疗保健。这可能是由于最贫困的群体无法将资源从其他基本需求中转移出来，也可能是因为这些国家为穷人提供了免收费用的服务。但在中国、吉尔吉斯斯坦和越南，由于没有为穷人提供免收费用的政策，这些国家中贫困人群遭遇灾难性支出的可能性与以往相同，甚至更高。

abstract.text: This paper investigates to what extent psychiatric disorders and mental distress affect labor market outcomes in two rapidly growing populations that have not been studied to date-ethnic minorities of Latino and Asian descent, most of whom are immigrants. Using data from the National Latino and Asian American Study (NLAAS), we examine the labor market effects of meeting diagnostic criteria for any psychiatric disorder in the past 12 months as well as the effects of psychiatric distress in the past year. The labor market outcomes analyzed are current employment status, the number of weeks worked in the past year among those who are employed, and having at least one work absence in the past month among those who are employed. Among Latinos, psychiatric disorders and mental distress are associated with detrimental effects on employment and absenteeism, similar to effects found in previous analyses of mostly white, American born populations. Among Asians, we find more mixed evidence that psychiatric disorders and mental distress detract from labor market outcomes. Our findings suggest that reducing disparities and expanding access to effective treatment may have significant labor market benefits-not just for majority populations, as has been demonstrated, but also for Asians and Latinos.

10.1002/hec.1210.abstractZh: 本文研究了精神疾病和心理困扰在这两个快速增长的人口群体中对劳动力市场结果的影响程度。这两个群体至今尚未得到充分研究，分别是拉丁裔和亚裔少数族裔，其中大多数都是移民。我们利用《全国拉丁裔和亚裔美国人研究》的数据，考察了过去12个月内符合任何精神疾病诊断标准对劳动力市场的影响，以及过去一年中的心理困扰对劳动力市场的影响。所分析的劳动力市场结果包括当前就业状况、就业者在过去一年中的工作周数，以及就业者在过去一个月内至少有一次缺勤的情况。在拉丁裔中，精神疾病和心理困扰与就业和缺勤率下降有关，这与之前对白人美国出生人群的研究结果类似。而在亚裔中，我们发现关于精神疾病和心理困扰对劳动力市场结果的影响，研究结果较为复杂。我们的研究结果表明，减少差异并扩大对有效治疗的获取可能带来显著的劳动力市场效益——不仅对于多数人群如此，对于亚裔和拉丁裔也是如此。

abstract.text: National income accounting practice is to weight health service activities by their cost so that they can be aggregated into an output index. Quality changes are ignored. We propose an 'ideal' value weighted output index in which the value attached to each output reflects its contribution to health outcomes and other characteristics valued by patients. Calculation of the index for the health system as a whole is currently infeasible because of a lack of data, especially on health outcomes. We demonstrate alternative ways of combining health outcome data with existing information on post-treatment survival, life expectancy and waiting times to construct quality adjusted cost weighted and health outcome weighted indices for a small set of hospital activities for which there are health outcome data.

10.1002/hec.1211.abstractZh: 国民收入核算的做法是通过成本来加权医疗服务活动，从而将其汇总为一项产出指标。质量变化被忽略了。我们提出了一种“理想”的加权产出指标，其中每项产出的价值反映了其对健康结果以及患者重视的其他特征的贡献。由于数据缺乏，尤其是关于健康结果的数据，目前无法计算整个卫生系统的指标。我们展示了将健康结果数据与现有关于治疗后生存、预期寿命和等待时间的资料相结合的不同方法，以构建针对一小部分有健康结果数据的医院活动的质量调整成本加权及健康结果加权指标。

abstract.text: In many countries health services and/or health insurance are delivered but also partly financed by subnational entities that vary in their fiscal or financial capacity, e.g. local governments and social health insurance schemes. The central government typically mandates a specific (or at least minimum) level of benefit or expenditure per intended beneficiary, and sets rules about enrollment and coverage. It also typically contributes to the cost of the program, partly because the resources of subnational entities may be insufficient, on average, to meet the expenditure requirements, but partly for equity reasons. These two problems are typically addressed through tax-transfer schemes. In practice, there is considerable institutional heterogeneity across countries in the mix of vertical and horizontal schemes, and the way each works. In this Note, we show how the progressivity of health outlays by subnational entities can be decomposed into contributions from vertical and horizontal schemes, and how each of these can be further decomposed into contributions from taxes and transfers. We suggest that, in addition to providing a foundation for future empirical work, the decomposition provides some insights into the reasons for different institutional choices, and into the way vertical and horizontal tax-transfer schemes operate in practice.

10.1002/hec.1212.abstractZh: 在许多国家，医疗服务和/或健康保险是由地方实体提供的，但这些服务的部分资金也由不同财政或财务能力的次国家级实体提供，例如地方政府和社会健康保险计划。中央政府通常会规定每个受益人的特定（或至少是最低）福利或支出水平，并制定关于参保和覆盖范围的规则。中央政府通常也会为该项目提供资金，部分原因是次国家级实体的资源可能不足以满足支出需求，部分原因则是出于公平考虑。这两个问题通常通过税收转移机制来解决。实际上，不同国家在垂直和水平机制的组合以及各自运作方式上存在相当大的制度差异。在这篇论文中，我们展示了如何将次国家级实体在医疗支出方面的累进性分解为来自垂直和水平机制的贡献，以及如何进一步将这两种贡献分解为税收和转移的贡献。我们认为，这种分解不仅为未来的实证研究提供了基础，还为我们理解不同制度选择的原因以及垂直和水平税收转移机制在实际中的运作方式提供了一些见解。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the debate on the 'red herring', viz. the claim that population ageing will not have a significant impact on health care expenditure (HCE). It decomposes HCE into seven components, includes both survivors and deceased individuals, and estimates a two-part model of the demand for health care services, using a large Swiss data set for 1999. It finds no or weak age effects on HCE for the components of HCE when proximity to death is controlled for, and points to differences between users and non-users of long-term care (LTC). For deceased non-users of LTC services, a falling age curve for all components of HCE except for inpatient care is observed, while survivors show a weak age effect in ambulatory and inpatient care once proximity to death is controlled for. As to surviving users of LTC services, their probability of incurring LTC expenses markedly increases in old age, while most of the components of their conditional HCE show a decreasing age profile. Thus, a 'school of red herrings' can be claimed to exist-with the possible exception of LTC, where ageing might matter regardless of proximity to death.

10.1002/hec.1213.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了关于“红鲱鱼”的争论，即人口老龄化不会对医疗保健支出产生显著影响的观点。将医疗保健支出分解为七个组成部分，并涵盖幸存者和逝者，利用1999年瑞士大型数据集，建立了一个包含两部分的健康服务需求模型。研究发现，在控制死亡临近度的情况下，医疗保健支出的各个组成部分并未表现出明显的年龄效应，且幸存者与非幸存者在使用长期护理服务方面存在差异。对于使用长期护理服务的逝者而言，除住院护理外，其他医疗保健支出的各个组成部分均呈现下降的年龄曲线；而对于幸存者来说，在控制死亡临近度后，门诊和住院护理的支出并未表现出明显的年龄效应。至于使用长期护理服务的幸存者，他们在老年时期发生长期护理支出的概率显著增加，而其条件性医疗保健支出的各个组成部分则呈现出下降的年龄趋势。因此，可以认为存在一种“红鲱鱼学派”，不过长期护理服务可能是一个例外，因为无论死亡临近度如何，人口老龄化都可能对长期护理服务产生影响。

abstract.text: This paper offers an indirect measure of patient welfare based on whether patients comply with the prescription they receive. Adherence behavior is supposed to reveal patients' subjective valuations of particular therapies.
