We write a simple theoretical model of patient adherence behavior, that reflects the trade-off between perceived costs and observed regimen efficacy. A discrete choice framework is then used for the estimation, i.e. the comparison of the incremental benefit of drug intake between two regimens. Consequently, the empirical analysis is based on the identification of patient and drug characteristics associated with adherence. The econometric approach is implemented through a bivariate panel two-equation simultaneous system studying jointly the factors associated with adherence and response to treatment. The data come from a randomized clinical trial conducted in France between 1999 and 2001 and comparing the efficacy of two tritherapy strategies in HIV disease. Both the theoretical and empirical results suggest that, for comparable clinical efficacy and toxicity levels, a higher adherence level is associated with higher patient welfare, thus adding valuable information to conclusions drawn by a mere biostatistical analysis. Therefore, from the perspective of the patient, the adherence-enhancing drug must be favored. Our results based on panel data also stress that unobserved patient characteristics account substantially for drug valuation and that the assessment evolves during the course of the treatment. Furthermore, we provide a new framework for the analysis of adherence data. The microeconometric framework highlights that non-adherence is an endogenous behavior, thus suggesting new ways for improving adherence.

10.1002/hec.1214.abstractZh: 本文基于患者是否遵守所接受的治疗方案，提供了一种间接衡量患者福利的方法。患者的遵守行为被认为能够反映他们对特定疗法的主观评价。我们构建了一个简单的理论模型来描述患者遵守行为，该模型体现了感知成本与观察到的治疗方案有效性之间的权衡。随后，我们使用离散选择框架进行估计，即比较两种治疗方案下药物摄入的增量收益。因此，实证分析基于识别与遵守行为相关的患者和药物特征。计量经济学方法通过双变量面板双方程联立系统来实现，共同研究与遵守行为和治疗反应相关的因素。数据来自1999年至2001年在法国进行的随机临床试验，该试验比较了两种三联疗法策略在HIV疾病治疗中的效果。理论和实证结果均表明，在可比的临床效果和毒性水平下，更高的遵守水平与更高的患者福利相关，这为单纯通过生物统计学分析得出的结论提供了有价值的信息。因此，从患者的角度来看，应优先选择能够增强遵守行为的药物。基于面板数据的我们的研究结果还表明，未观察到的患者特征对药物评价有着重要影响，且评估在治疗过程中会发生变化。此外，我们还为分析遵守数据提供了一个新的框架。微观计量经济学框架指出，不遵守行为是一种内生行为，这为改善遵守行为提供了新的途径。

abstract.text: A major characteristic of teenage smoking is the ability to 'bum' cigarettes from peers. To date, research into the determinants of teenage smoking has largely ignored the effects of this social market on the smoking decisions of teenagers. In this paper, we estimate the demand for cigarettes using data from the Youth Risk Behavior Survey which distinguishes teens who primarily buy cigarettes from those who primarily borrow cigarettes. Our results demonstrate the ways in which higher cigarette prices and restrictions on smoking influence not only a teen's decision to smoke and the quantity of cigarettes smoked, but also the manner in which cigarettes are acquired. We show that current cigarette regulations are ineffective in reaching the group of light smokers who primarily obtain cigarettes through the social market, thus indicating that alternative measures should be explored in an effort to reduce the number of smokers in the future.

10.1002/hec.1215.abstractZh: 青少年吸烟的一个主要特点是能够从同龄人那里“蹭”到香烟。迄今为止，关于青少年吸烟决定因素的研究大多忽略了这种社会市场对青少年吸烟行为的影响。在本文中，我们利用《青少年风险行为调查》的数据来估算对香烟的需求，该调查区分了那些主要购买香烟的青少年和那些主要借用香烟的青少年。我们的研究结果表明，较高的香烟价格和对吸烟的限制不仅会影响青少年是否吸烟以及吸烟的数量，还会影响他们获取香烟的方式。我们发现，当前的香烟法规在针对那些主要通过社会市场获取香烟的轻度吸烟者方面效果不佳，因此有必要探索其他措施来减少未来的吸烟者数量。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new methodology to assess demand and price-elasticity for health care, based on patients' stated willingness to pay (WTP) values for certain aspects of health care quality improvements. A conceptual analysis of how respondents consider contingent valuation (CV) questions allowed us to specify a probability density function of stated WTP values, and consequently, to model a demand function for quality-improved health care, using a parametric survival approach. The model was empirically estimated using a CV study intended to assess patients' values for improving the quality of primary health care (PHC) services in Palestine. A random sample of 499 individuals was interviewed following medical consultation in four PHC centers. Quality was assessed using a multi-attribute approach; and respondents valued seven specific quality improvements using a decomposed valuation scenario and a payment card elicitation technique. Our results suggest an inelastic demand at low user fees levels, and when the price-increase is accompanied with substantial quality-improvements. Nevertheless, demand becomes more and more elastic if user fees continue to rise. On the other hand, patients' reactions to price-increase turn out to depend on their level of income. Our results can be used to design successful health care financing strategies that include a consideration of patients' preferences and financial capacities.

10.1002/hec.1216.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的方法，用于评估医疗保健的需求和价格弹性，该方法基于患者对医疗保健质量改进某些方面的支付意愿。通过对受访者如何考虑条件价值评估问题的概念分析，我们能够确定支付意愿的概率密度函数，并因此使用参数生存方法对质量改进的医疗保健需求函数进行建模。该模型是通过一项旨在评估巴勒斯坦患者对于改善初级医疗保健服务质量价值的评估研究来实证估计的。在四个初级医疗保健中心，对499名个体进行了医疗咨询后的随机访谈。使用多属性方法评估质量；受访者通过分解价值评估情景和支付卡引出技术来评估七个具体的质量改进。我们的结果表明，在低用户费用水平下，需求呈现非弹性，而当价格上涨伴随着显著的质量改进时，需求变得更加弹性。另一方面，患者对价格上涨的反应取决于他们的收入水平。我们的结果可用于设计成功的医疗保健融资策略，这些策略需要考虑患者的偏好和财务能力。

abstract.text: Expected value of sample information (EVSI) involves simulating data collection, Bayesian updating, and re-examining decisions. Bayesian updating in Weibull models typically requires Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We examine five methods for calculating posterior expected net benefits: two heuristic methods (data lumping and pseudo-normal); two Bayesian approximation methods (Tierney & Kadane, Brennan & Kharroubi); and the gold standard MCMC. A case study computes EVSI for 25 study options. We compare accuracy, computation time and trade-offs of EVSI versus study costs. Brennan & Kharroubi (B&K) approximates expected net benefits to within +/-1% of MCMC. Other methods, data lumping (+54%), pseudo-normal (-5%) and Tierney & Kadane (+11%) are less accurate. B&K also produces the most accurate EVSI approximation. Pseudo-normal is also reasonably accurate, whilst Tierney & Kadane consistently underestimates and data lumping exhibits large variance. B&K computation is 12 times faster than the MCMC method in our case study. Though not always faster, B&K provides most computational efficiency when net benefits require appreciable computation time and when many MCMC samples are needed. The methods enable EVSI computation for economic models with Weibull survival parameters. The approach can generalize to complex multi-state models and to survival analyses using other smooth parametric distributions.

10.1002/hec.1217.abstractZh: 样本信息的期望值（EVSI）涉及数据收集模拟、贝叶斯更新以及决策重新评估。在Weibull模型中进行贝叶斯更新通常需要马尔科夫链蒙特卡洛方法（MCMC）。我们研究了五种计算后验期望净收益的方法：两种启发式方法（数据合并和伪正态法）；两种贝叶斯近似方法（Tierney & Kadane、Brennan & Kharroubi）；以及黄金标准的MCMC方法。一个案例研究计算了25种研究选项的EVSI。我们比较了EVSI在准确性、计算时间以及与研究成本之间的权衡。Brennan & Kharroubi的近似方法能够将期望净收益的误差控制在MCMC的±1%以内。其他方法的准确性较低，数据合并（+54%）、伪正态法（-5%）和Tierney & Kadane法（+11%）的准确率较低。Brennan & Kharroubi方法也提供了最准确的EVSI近似结果。伪正态法也相当准确，而Tierney & Kadane法则始终低估了期望净收益，数据合并法则表现出较大的方差。在我们的案例研究中，Brennan & Kharroubi方法的计算速度比MCMC方法快12倍。虽然并不总是更快，但当净收益需要大量计算时间且需要多个MCMC样本时，Brennan & Kharroubi方法提供了最高的计算效率。这些方法适用于具有Weibull生存参数的经济模型。该方法还可以推广到复杂的多状态模型，以及使用其他平滑参数分布的生存分析。

abstract.text: To combat childhood overweight in the US, which has risen dramatically in the past three decades, many medical and public health organizations have called for students to spend more time in physical education (PE) classes. This paper is the first to examine the impact of state PE requirements on student PE exercise time. It also exploits variation in state laws as quasi-natural experiments in order to estimate the causal impact of PE on overall student physical activity and weight. We study nationwide data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System for 1999, 2001, and 2003 merged with data on state minimum PE requirements from the 2001 Shape of the Nation Report. We find that high school students with a binding PE requirement report an average of 31 additional minutes per week spent physically active in PE class. Our results also indicate that additional PE time raises the number of days per week that girls report having exercised vigorously or having engaged in strength-building activity. We find no evidence that PE lowers BMI or the probability that a student is overweight. We conclude that raising PE credit requirements may make girls more physically active overall but there is not yet the scientific base to declare raising PE requirements an anti-obesity initiative for either boys or girls.

10.1002/hec.1218.abstractZh: 为了应对美国儿童超重问题，这一问题在过去三十年中急剧上升，许多医学和公共卫生组织呼吁学生增加在体育课上花费的时间。本文首次研究了州级体育要求对学生体育锻炼时间的影响。同时，通过利用州法律差异作为近似自然实验，我们试图估算体育活动对学生整体身体活动和体重的影响。我们研究了1999年、2001年和2003年的全国青少年风险行为监测系统的数据，并结合了2001年《国家形态报告》中关于州级最低体育要求的数据。研究发现，有强制性体育要求的高中生在体育课上平均增加了31分钟的身体活动时间。研究结果还表明，额外的体育时间增加了女孩每周进行剧烈锻炼或力量训练的天数。我们没有发现体育活动能够降低BMI或提高学生超重的概率。因此，我们认为提高体育学分要求可能会让女孩整体更加活跃，但目前还没有科学依据可以证明提高体育要求对男孩或女孩来说是一种抗肥胖措施。

abstract.text: In many low-income countries, user charges were introduced in the 1990s. As problems emerged of equity of access, interest grew in developing prepayment mechanisms to protect users from risk of out-of-pocket payments. In Zambia, a prepayment scheme did not generate sufficient revenue, due to abuses of its terms. An alternative scheme using discount cards (a set of coupons to cover episodes of care at discount) was devised. We aimed to understand the equity implications of prepayment and discount cards relative to user charges. We proposed models predicting roles of income, perceived health status, perceived quality of care and time preference in choice of payment mechanism and use of health services. We tested these models using three data sets that could be accessed or collected. It is concluded that relative to user charges, prepayment may facilitate access without incurring income-related equity losses. Evidence concerning discount cards was weaker. We concluded that they facilitate access to a lesser extent. Discount cards offer a credible intermediate solution between user charges and prepayment that avoid some problems associated with prepayment. However, since prepayment seems to be associated with the most positive outcomes, finding other solutions to their problems would be preferred.

10.1002/hec.1219.abstractZh: 在许多低收入国家，用户收费制度于20世纪90年代引入。随着公平获取问题出现，人们开始关注开发预付机制，以保护用户免受自付费用的风险。在赞比亚，由于条款被滥用，预付制度未能产生足够的收入。于是，人们设计了另一种使用折扣卡的方案（一套优惠券，用于支付特定医疗服务的费用）。我们旨在了解预付和折扣卡相对于用户收费的公平影响。我们提出了模型，预测收入、感知健康状况、感知护理质量以及时间偏好在支付机制选择和服务使用中的作用。我们使用三个可获取或收集的数据集来测试这些模型。结论是，与用户收费相比，预付可能有助于实现获取服务，而不会造成与收入相关的公平损失。关于折扣卡的证据则较为薄弱。我们得出结论，折扣卡在促进获取服务方面的作用较小。折扣卡提供了一种介于用户收费和预付之间的可信中间方案，能够避免预付的一些问题。然而，由于预付似乎能带来最积极的结果，因此寻找其他解决方案更为理想。

abstract.text: There is little evidence about the responsiveness of doctors' labour supply to changes in pay. Given substantial increases in NHS expenditure, new national contracts for hospital doctors and general practitioners that involve increases in pay, and the gradual imposition of a ceiling on hours worked through the European Working Time Directive, knowledge of the size of labour supply elasticities is crucial in examining the effects of these major changes. This paper estimates a modified labour supply model for hospital consultants, using data from a survey of consultants in Scotland. Rigidities in wage setting within the NHS mean that the usual specification of the labour supply model is extended by the inclusion of job quality (job satisfaction) in the equation explaining the optimal number of hours worked. Generalised Method of Moments estimation is used to account for the endogeneity of both earnings and job quality. Our results confirm the importance of pay and non-pay factors on the supply of labour by consultants. The results are sensitive to the exclusion of job quality and show a slight underestimation of the uncompensated earnings elasticity (of 0.09) without controlling for the effect of job quality, and 0.12 when we controlled for job quality. Pay increases in the new contract for consultants will only result in small increases in hours worked. Small and non-significant elasticity estimates at higher quantiles in the distribution of hours suggest that any increases in hours worked are more likely for consultants who work part time. Those currently working above the median number of hours are much less responsive to changes in earnings.

10.1002/hec.1220.abstractZh: 关于医生劳动力供应对薪酬变化的反应，现有证据较少。鉴于国民医疗服务体系(NHS)的支出大幅增加，医院医生和全科医生的新国家合同要求提高薪酬，同时欧洲工作时间指令逐步规定了工作时长的上限，了解劳动力供应弹性的大小对于分析这些重大变化的影响至关重要。本文利用苏格兰医生调查的数据，对医院顾问的劳动力供应模型进行了修正。由于NHS内部工资设定的刚性，传统的劳动力供应模型被扩展，将工作质量（工作满意度）纳入解释最佳工作时长的方程中。采用广义矩估计法来考虑收入和工作质量的内生性。我们的研究结果证实了薪酬和非薪酬因素对顾问劳动力供应的重要性。结果显示，如果不考虑工作质量的影响，未补偿收入弹性会被轻微低估，为0.09；而在考虑工作质量后，弹性为0.12。新合同中的薪酬增加只会导致工作时长略有增加。在时长的较高分位数上，弹性估计值较小且不显著，这表明对于兼职顾问来说，工作时长的增加更为可能。目前工作时间超过中位数的人对收入变化的反应则较小。

abstract.text: There is a growing literature showing an association between higher family income and better child health. This paper uses cohort data with rich information on mother's early life events, her health, child-health-related behaviours, and her child's health to examine this association for the UK and to identify some of the mechanisms through which income affects child health. The paper examines the cross-sectional association between income and health, finds the expected association, but concludes that the association with current income cannot be distinguished from one between permanent income and child health. It then focuses on the mechanisms by which income translates into better child health; these include parental behaviours that may affect child health and parental health, including maternal mental health. Controlling for these factors, there is almost no direct impact of income. A significant role is played by mother's own health, particularly her mental health. No clear role is played by child-health production behaviours of the mother. Examining the maternal mental health-child health link in more detail suggests a role for maternal anxiety and somaticism.

10.1002/hec.1221.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究表明，较高的家庭收入与更好的儿童健康之间存在关联。本文利用包含丰富信息的队列数据，涉及母亲早年生活经历、健康状况、儿童健康相关行为以及儿童的健康状况，来探讨这一关联在英国的实际情况，并分析收入影响儿童健康的机制。研究考察了收入与健康之间的横向关联，发现了预期的关联，但得出结论认为，当前收入与儿童健康之间的关联无法与永久收入与儿童健康之间的关联区分开来。随后，研究重点探讨了收入如何转化为更好的儿童健康，这些机制包括可能影响儿童健康和父母健康的各种行为，包括母亲的心理健康。在控制这些因素后，收入对儿童健康的直接影响几乎不存在。母亲自身的健康状况，尤其是她的心理健康，起着重要作用。母亲在儿童健康方面的行为并未发挥明显作用。进一步详细研究母亲心理健康与儿童健康之间的联系，发现母亲的焦虑和躯体化症状可能起到一定作用。

abstract.text: The literature contains numerous studies that estimate the effect of cigarette taxes on smoking across various population groups. Although the conclusions are split, most US studies find that men are more responsive to cigarette taxes than women. This paper shows that these results are due to the failure to control for state-specific gender gaps in smoking rates that are correlated with cigarette taxes. When gender-specific state fixed effects are included to control for these gaps, the results indicate that women are nearly twice as responsive to cigarette taxes as are men. Since the econometric specification controls for variation in the tax response by household income, it is unlikely to be responsible for the difference.

10.1002/hec.1223.abstractZh: 现有文献中包含了大量关于香烟税对不同人群吸烟行为影响的研究。尽管研究结果存在分歧，但大多数美国研究指出，男性对香烟税的响应程度高于女性。本文指出，这些结果是由于未能控制与香烟税相关的各州间性别差异所致。当纳入了各州性别特定的固定效应以控制这些差异后，结果表明女性对香烟税的响应程度几乎是男性的两倍。由于计量模型考虑了家庭收入对税收响应的影响，因此这种差异不太可能是由税收机制本身造成的。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the monetary value of providing informal care by means of a well-being valuation method. This is done by assessing the compensating variation necessary to maintain the same level of well-being after an informal caregiver provides an extra hour of informal care. The informal caregiver's well-being is proxied by the answer to two subjective well-being questions that were posed in a questionnaire answered by 865 Dutch informal caregivers between the end of 2001 and the beginning of 2002. In the econometric analysis, a distinction is made between the care recipients who are and the ones who are not a family member of the informal caregiver. The results indicate that an extra hour of informal care is worth about 9 or 10 Euros. This equals 8 or 9 Euros if the care recipient is a family member and about 7 or 9 Euros if not. When applying the contingent valuation method to the same sample, the value obtained was 10.52 Euros per hour. This paper concludes that the well-being valuation method is a useful complement to the more traditional valuation methods in the health economics literature in general and more particularly for the economic valuation of informal care: it includes all costs and effects associated with providing care from the perspective of the informal caregiver, it is relatively cheap to implement, and it offers an additional possibility to determine the convergent validity of the different monetary valuation methods.

10.1002/hec.1224.abstractZh: 本文采用福祉评估方法，估算提供非正式护理的货币价值。具体做法是评估在非正式护理人员提供额外一小时非正式护理后，维持相同水平福祉所需的补偿变化。非正式护理人员的福祉通过回答两个主观福祉问题来体现，这些问题由865名荷兰非正式护理人员于2001年底至2002年初填写问卷完成。在计量经济学分析中，将护理对象分为两类：一类是非正式护理人员的家庭成员，另一类则不是。研究结果表明，额外一小时非正式护理的价值约为9至10欧元。如果护理对象是家庭成员，这一价值相当于8至9欧元；如果不是家庭成员，则约为7至9欧元。当对同一样本应用条件价值评估方法时，得出的每小时价值为10.52欧元。本文认为，福祉评估方法是对健康经济学文献中更传统评估方法的有效补充，尤其适用于非正式护理的经济价值评估：它涵盖了从非正式护理人员视角出发的所有护理相关成本和影响，实施成本相对较低，并且为确定不同货币评估方法的收敛性提供了额外可能性。

abstract.text: Background Setting priorities for research using economic in addition to scientific criteria can ensure that resources are spent efficiently and equitably. Objective This study applies two priority setting methods 'payback' and expected value of information (EVI) to two research areas (osteoporosis and pressure ulcers) and where appropriate to four clinical trials: the Record Trial, the Vitamin D and Calcium Trial and the Hip Protector Trial (osteoporosis), and the Pressure Trial (wound care). Methods Two decision-analytic models were developed. For 'payback', the PATHS model was used to estimate the expected net benefits of conducting the four clinical trials. An EVI framework was applied to estimate the cost-effectiveness of conducting further research in the two disease areas investigated. Results The application of 'payback' suggests that the Record Trial and the Vitamin D and Calcium Trial would be cost-effective. The Hip Protector and the Pressure Ulcer Trial are cost-effective under certain assumptions concerning the likelihood of obtaining positive, negative or inconclusive results. The EVI method suggests that research would be potentially cost-effective in these areas in the populations considered. Conclusion EVI provides strategic information for setting priorities for research between disease areas and study populations. 'Payback' provides information on the cost-effectiveness of specific research designs. However, further work in this area, particularly concerning the issue of implementation of research, is required.

10.1002/hec.1225.abstractZh:
背景：使用经济与科学标准来设定研究优先级，可以确保资源被高效且公平地分配。  
目的：本研究采用两种优先级设定方法——“回报期”和信息的预期价值（EVI）——应用于两个研究领域（骨质疏松症和压疮），并在适当的情况下应用于四项临床试验：记录试验、维生素D和钙试验、髋部保护试验（针对骨质疏松症）以及压疮试验（伤口护理）。  
方法：开发了两种决策分析模型。对于“回报期”，使用PATHS模型来估算进行这四项临床试验的预期净收益。采用EVI框架来估算在这两个疾病领域进一步研究的成本效益。  
结果：“回报期”分析表明，记录试验和维生素D和钙试验具有成本效益。在某些假设条件下，髋部保护试验和压疮试验也具有成本效益，这些假设涉及获得阳性、阴性或无结论结果的可能性。EVI方法表明，在考虑的人群中，这些领域的研究具有潜在的成本效益。  
结论：EVI为在不同疾病领域和研究人群之间设定研究优先级提供了战略信息。“回报期”则提供了关于特定研究设计成本效益的信息。然而，这一领域仍需进一步研究，尤其是在研究实施方面。

abstract.text: The lack of health insurance coverage could be a potentially important deterrent to the use of preventive health care by older adults with high rates of chronic co-morbidities. We use survey data from 12 100 Mexican adults ages 50 and older who participated in the 2001 Mexican Health and Aging Study (MHAS) to analyze the relation between health insurance coverage and the use of preventive health-care services in Mexico. Uninsured adults were less likely to use preventive screenings for hypertension, high cholesterol, diabetes and (breast, cervical and prostate) cancer than insured adults. After adjusting for other factors affecting preventive care utilization in a logistic regression model, we found that these results still hold for high cholesterol and diabetes screening. Similar results hold for the population not working during the survey week and for adults earning below 200% of the poverty line. Our results suggest that insured adults are in a relatively better position to detect some chronic diseases - and have them treated promptly - than uninsured adults because they have better access to cost-effective preventive screenings. Recent public policy initiatives to increase health insurance coverage rates in Mexico could lead to substantially higher preventive health-care utilization rates and improvements in population health.

10.1002/hec.1226.abstractZh: 缺乏健康保险覆盖可能是阻碍患有慢性合并症的高龄老年人使用预防性医疗保健的重要因素。我们利用2001年墨西哥健康与老龄化研究中对12,100名50岁及以上的墨西哥成年人的调查数据，分析健康保险覆盖与墨西哥预防性医疗服务使用之间的关系。未投保的成年人比投保的成年人更不可能进行高血压、高胆固醇、糖尿病以及乳腺癌、宫颈癌和前列腺癌的预防性筛查。在调整了影响预防性护理利用的其他因素后，我们发现这些结果在高胆固醇和糖尿病筛查方面仍然成立。对于在调查周期间不工作的群体以及收入低于贫困线200%的成年人来说，结果也类似。我们的研究结果表明，投保的成年人由于能够更容易获得成本效益高的预防性筛查服务，因此在检测某些慢性疾病并及时治疗方面，比未投保的成年人处于更有利的地位。墨西哥最近旨在提高健康保险覆盖率的公共政策举措，可能会显著提高预防性医疗保健的利用率，并改善人口健康状况。

abstract.text: A general population sample of 135 Australian respondents completed one of four contingent valuation surveys that asked them to value health benefits either in the absence of an explicit reference good or in the presence of one of three different forms of reference good. Results suggest that respondents have a 'ball-park' figure that is then challenged by the reference good. For values that appear far lower than, or similar to, this 'ball-park' figure, the reference good has little quantitative effect, but qualitatively appears to help respondents in their confidence in this value being their actual WTP. The implications for CV research in health care are outlined in the discussion.

10.1002/hec.1227.abstractZh: 135名澳大利亚受访者参与了四项条件价值评估调查之一，这些调查要求他们在没有特定参照商品的情况下，或存在三种不同形式的参照商品时，对健康收益进行估值。结果表明，受访者有一个大致的估值，但这一估值会受到参照商品的影响而发生变化。对于那些明显低于或接近这一“大致估值”的估值，参照商品在数量上几乎没有影响，但在质量上似乎有助于受访者相信这一估值是他们实际支付的价格。本文在讨论部分概述了这些条件价值评估研究在医疗保健领域的意义。

abstract.text: This study analyses, through the adoption of a seemingly unrelated regression approach, the temporal evolution of policy interactions among local authorities in England when allocating mental health resources. This new approach in health economics may shed light on the degree of interdependence between adjacent municipalities at a specific point in time (e.g. before, during, or after a change in policy), exploiting the information carried by the panel, rather than that of a single cross-section.

10.1002/hec.1229.abstractZh: 本研究通过采用看似不相关的回归方法，分析了英格兰地方政府在分配心理健康资源时政策互动的时间演变。这种新的健康经济学方法可能有助于揭示特定时间点（例如政策变更之前、期间或之后）相邻市镇之间的相互依赖性程度，该方法利用了面板数据中的信息，而非单一横截面数据。

abstract.text: The purpose of this study is to examine the impact of the 2003 reform of the health insurance system (in particular, the reduction in the co-payment amount) on the consumption of inpatient medical services in the city of Hangzhou using a differences-in-difference (DID) empirical strategy. The results confirm that private-sector employees (PSEs) (who were much more directly affected by the 2003 reform) were much more responsive to the reform than government employees. The growth rate of overall inpatient expenditures of PSEs (including retirees) increased by 26.4 percentage points more than that of government employees, which implies a relatively high (in absolute magnitude) price elasticity of demand for inpatient care of -1.10. Moreover, the growth rate of overall inpatient expenditures of currently employed PSEs increased by 37 percentage points more than that of government employees. Thus, the reform was effective in increasing PSEs' consumption of inpatient medical services, thereby reducing inter-occupational inequities. However, a gap still exists between government employees and PSEs in their consumption of inpatient medical services, and thus further reforms of the system (for example, further reductions in inter-occupational inequities) are needed.

10.1002/hec.1230.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是采用差异中差异（DID）实证策略，探讨2003年医疗保险制度改革（特别是共同支付金额减少）对杭州市住院医疗服务消费的影响。研究结果表明，受2003年改革直接影响较大的私营部门员工对改革的反应更为强烈，其住院支出增长率比政府员工高出26.4个百分点，表明住院护理需求的价格弹性为-1.10，且绝对值较高。此外，目前在职的私营部门员工的住院支出增长率比政府员工高出37个百分点。因此，该改革有效提高了私营部门员工对住院医疗服务的消费，从而减少了职业间的不平等现象。然而，政府员工与私营部门员工在住院医疗服务消费方面仍存在差距，因此还需要对制度进行进一步改革，以进一步减少职业间的不平等。

abstract.text: In this paper we use relative distributions to examine changes in the distribution of the body mass index (BMI) in England and Canada during the period 1994/5-2000/1. The use of relative distributions allows us to describe changes in the whole distribution of the BMI in a non-parametric fashion. While statistics analogous to the Gini index can be constructed based on the relative distribution, important characteristics of changes in the distribution of the BMI such as changes in the proportions overweight and obese are more naturally handled using measures of relative polarization. Our results show that while BMI has increased in both countries, BMI in England has increased at a much faster rate than in Canada. Both groups show polarization over time towards both tails of the weight distribution, with the English polarizing towards the upper tail at a faster rate than Canadians.

10.1002/hec.1240.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用相对分布来研究1994/5年至2000/1年间英格兰和加拿大体重指数（BMI）分布的变化。使用相对分布使我们能够以非参数的方式描述BMI整体分布的变化。虽然可以根据相对分布构建类似于基尼指数的统计量，但BMI分布变化的重要特征，如超重和肥胖比例的变化，更适合用相对极化的度量指标来反映。我们的研究结果表明，尽管两个国家的BMI都有所上升，但英格兰的BMI增长速度比加拿大快得多。两组人群随时间都向体重分布的上下两端两极分化，其中英格兰人群向高端两极分化的速度比加拿大人群快。

abstract.text: The report by the Office of Fair Trading (OFT) on the UK pharmaceutical price regulation scheme (PPRS) recommends the reform of the current scheme, which is a combination of profit and price controls, to one where price is based on the health benefits offered by a pharmaceutical. On closer examination some of the more commonly expressed concerns about these proposals do not seem to be well founded. In principle, the OFT's recommendations may contribute to allocative and dynamic efficiency in the NHS. However, there are some dangers and the details of how it will be implemented are crucial. For example, value-based pricing with an inappropriate threshold for cost-effectiveness, or an inappropriate pricing structure, could lead to technologies being adopted at prices where their benefits, in terms of health outcome, do not offset the health displaced elsewhere in the NHS, a situation in which the NHS is damaged rather than improved by innovation. A failure to account for uncertainty and the value of evidence in negotiating prices and coverage could also undermine the evidence base for future NHS practice. Whatever view is taken, the OFT report will inevitably shape the scope of future policy debates about value, guidance, price and innovation.

10.1002/hec.1249.abstractZh: 公平交易办公室关于英国药品价格监管制度的报告建议对现行制度进行改革，现行制度结合了利润控制和价格管制。报告认为，应以药品提供的健康效益为基础来制定价格。然而，一些对这项建议的常见担忧似乎并不充分。原则上，公平交易办公室的建议可能有助于提高国民健康服务的分配效率和动态效率。不过，也存在一些风险，其实施细节至关重要。例如，基于价值的价格定价，如果成本效益的门槛设置不当，或者定价结构不合理，可能会导致技术以不划算的价格被采用，而这些技术的健康效益在国民健康服务其他方面的负面影响可能会超过其带来的好处，从而使国民健康服务受损而非得到改善。此外，在定价和覆盖范围的谈判中未能充分考虑不确定性和证据的价值，也可能削弱未来国民健康服务实践的证据基础。无论持何种观点，公平交易办公室的报告都将不可避免地影响未来关于价值、指导方针、价格和创新的政策讨论。

abstract.text: This paper uses French data on ideal body weight and food attitudes to analyse the role of social norms in the individual's weight control problem. A proxy measure of social norms is calculated by averaging individual perceptions of the ideal Body Mass Index (BMI) over all observations within a reference group. Testing for different definitions of the reference group, we find that individual representations of ideal body shape are differentiated mainly along gender and age lines. Social norms regarding body shape have a significant effect on perceptions of ideal BMI only for those women who want to lose weight, with an elasticity close to 0.5. For many women and for all men, ideal BMI is almost exclusively determined by habitual BMI. Last, ideal BMI predicts a number of attitudes towards food, while social norms do not. These results suggest that promoting medical norms regarding body shape should have little effect on individual food attitudes.

10.1002/hec.1251.abstractZh: 本文利用法国关于理想体重和食物态度的数据，分析社会规范在个体体重控制问题中的作用。通过平均个体对理想体重指数的认知，计算出社会规范的代理指标。对不同定义下的参考群体进行测试后发现，个体对理想体型的认知主要随性别和年龄而变化。关于体型的社规范仅对那些希望减肥的女性产生显著影响，其弹性接近0.5。对于许多女性以及所有男性来说，理想体重指数几乎完全由惯用体重指数决定。最后，理想体重指数能够预测一系列关于食物的态度，而社规范则无法做到这一点。这些结果表明，推广关于体型的医学规范对个体食物态度的影响很小。

abstract.text: This paper suggests bivariate semiparametric index models as a tool for modelling the interplay of socioeconomic and health characteristics in determining health-care utilisation. These models allow for a fully nonparametric relationship between socioeconomic status, health-care need and care utilisation. The only parametric restriction imposed is that multiple socioeconomic and health indicators can be aggregated into two distinct indices that measure the broader concepts of socioeconomic status and health-care need, respectively. We demonstrate the usefulness of this class of models based on an illustrative empirical example. The estimations highlight complex interactions of socioeconomic status and health-care need in determining care use, which may be difficult to grasp via standard parametric modelling approaches.

10.1002/hec.1253.abstractZh: 本文提出双变量半参数指数模型，作为模拟社会经济特征与健康特征在决定医疗利用中的相互作用的工具。这些模型允许在 socioeconomic status、医疗需求与医疗利用之间建立完全非参数的关系。唯一的参数限制是，可以将多个社会经济和健康指标汇总为两个不同的指数，分别衡量社会经济地位和医疗需求的更广泛概念。我们通过一个具体的实证案例展示了这类模型的有效性。研究结果突显了社会经济地位和医疗需求在决定医疗利用中的复杂相互作用，这种关系可能难以通过标准的参数建模方法来理解。

abstract.text: This paper investigates gender differences in smoking behavior using data from the German Socio-economic Panel (SOEP). We develop a Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition method for count data models, which allows to isolate the part of the gender differential in the number of cigarettes daily smoked that can be explained by differences in observable characteristics from the part attributable to differences in coefficients. Our results reveal that the major part of the gender smoking differential is attributable to differences in coefficients indicating substantial differences in the smoking behavior between men and women.

10.1002/hec.1259.abstractZh: 本文利用德国社会经济调查数据，研究了性别在吸烟行为上的差异。我们开发了一种用于计数数据模型的Blinder-Oaxaca分解方法，该方法能够分离出由可观测特征差异导致的性别差异部分，以及由系数差异导致的部分。研究结果表明，性别吸烟差异的主要部分是由系数差异造成的，这表明男性和女性在吸烟行为上存在显著差异。

abstract.text: There are severe inequalities in health in the world, poor health being concentrated amongst poor people in poor countries. Poor countries spend a much smaller share of national income on health expenditure than do richer countries. What potential lies in political or growth processes that raise this share? This depends upon how effective government health spending in developing countries is. Existing research presents little evidence of an impact on childhood mortality. Using specifications similar to those in the existing literature, this paper finds a similar result for India, which is that state health spending saves no lives. However, upon allowing lagged effects, controlling in a flexible way for trended unobservables and restricting the sample to rural households, a significant effect of health expenditure on infant mortality emerges, the long run elasticity being about -0.24. There are striking differences in the impact by social group. Slicing the data by gender, birth order, religion, maternal and paternal education and maternal age at birth, I find the weakest effects in the most vulnerable groups (with the exception of a large effect for scheduled tribes).

10.1002/hec.1260.abstractZh: 全球范围内，健康领域的不平等现象十分严重，健康状况不佳主要集中在贫困国家的贫困人口中。贫困国家在健康支出上的投入占国民收入的比例远低于富裕国家。那么，哪些政治或经济增长机制能够提升这一比例呢？这取决于发展中国家政府健康支出的有效性。现有研究几乎没有证据表明这些机制对儿童死亡率有显著影响。本文采用与现有文献类似的模型分析，发现印度的情况也类似：州级健康支出并未挽救任何生命。然而，在考虑滞后效应、灵活控制趋势性不可观测因素并将样本限制在农村家庭后，健康支出对婴儿死亡率有显著的影响，长期弹性约为-0.24。不同社会群体的影响也存在显著差异。通过性别、出生顺序、宗教、父母教育水平以及母亲出生年龄等变量对数据进行分组分析后，我发现最脆弱的群体受到的影响最为微弱（除了 scheduled tribes群体有显著影响）。

abstract.text: The Office of Fair Trading (OFT) Report on the UK Pharmaceutical Price Regulation Scheme (PPRS) recommends that when the current five-year PPRS expires in 2010 it be replaced with 'value-based pricing' which involves pre-launch centralised government price setting based on a cost-per-QALY threshold plus periodic ex post reviews. I examine the validity of the OFTs criticisms of the existing PPRS, review its proposals and propose an alternative way forward. I conclude that PPRS has performed well as a procurement bargain between industry and the UK government. It does not, however, incentivise efficient relative prices. That is not its job. I identify a number of problems with the OFT proposals. I recommend that key elements of a reformed UK pharmaceutical environment for 2010 should include an expanded role for HTA but with companies retaining freedom to set prices at launch; HTA use targeted via a contingent value of information approach; a retained backstop PPRS, perhaps moving to an RPI-X type control; the use of risk sharing and non-linear pricing arrangements; measures to ensure more effective therapeutic switching at local level; and measures to improve the take up of cost-effective treatments.

10.1002/hec.1263.abstractZh: 公平交易办公室关于英国药品价格监管制度的报告建议，当现行的五年制药品价格监管制度在2010年到期时，应将其替换为“基于价值的定价”机制。这种机制涉及政府在产品上市前根据每QALY成本阈值进行集中定价，并定期进行事后评估。我分析了公平交易办公室对现有药品价格监管制度的批评意见，审查了其建议，并提出了一种替代方案。结论是，药品价格监管制度在促进政府与行业之间的采购合作方面表现良好，但它并未激励形成有效的相对价格，而这并非其职责所在。我指出了公平交易办公室建议中的一些问题。我建议，2010年改革后的英国药品环境应包括扩大药品技术评估机构的作用，同时允许企业自主决定产品上市价格；通过基于信息的条件价值方法来实现药品技术评估的针对性使用；保留药品价格监管制度作为过渡措施，或许可以转向RPI-X类型的控制机制；采用风险分担和非线性定价机制；采取措施确保当地层面更有效地进行治疗转换；以及采取措施提高成本效益较高的治疗方法的采用率。

abstract.text: This paper proposes an axiomatic foundation for new measures of polarization that can be applied to ordinal distributions such as self-assessed health (SAH) data. This is an improvement over the existing measures of polarization that can be used only for cardinal variables. The new measures of polarization avoid one difficulty that the related measures for evaluating health inequalities face. Indeed, inequality measures are mean based, and since only cardinal variables have a mean, SAH has to be cardinalized to compute a mean, which can then be used to calculate an inequality measure. In contrast, the new polarization measures are median based and hence do not require to impose cardinal scaling on the categories. After deriving the properties of these new polarization measures, we provide an empirical illustration using data from the British Household Panel Survey that demonstrates that SAH polarization is also a relevant question on empirical grounds, and that the polarization measures are adequate to evaluate polarization phenomena whereas inequality measures are not adequate in these cases.

10.1002/hec.1284.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于新极化度测量的公理基础，该基础可以应用于如自我评估健康数据这样的序贯分布。这比现有的仅适用于基数变量的极化度测量方法有所改进。新的极化度测量方法避免了评估健康不平等时相关测量方法所面临的难题。实际上，不平等测量是基于均值的，而由于只有基数变量具有均值，因此需要对自我评估健康数据进行基数化处理以计算均值，然后利用该均值来计算不平等度量。相比之下，新的极化度测量方法是基于中位数的，因此不需要对类别进行基数化处理。在推导了这些新极化度测量的性质之后，我们通过英国家庭面板调查的数据进行了实证验证，结果表明自我评估健康数据的极化度也是一个重要的实证问题，并且这些极化度测量方法足以评估极化现象，而不平等测量方法则不足以用于此类情况。

abstract.text: Instrumental variable (IV) methods are widely used in the health economics literature to adjust for hidden selection biases in observational studies when estimating treatment effects. Less attention has been paid in the applied literature to the proper use of IVs if treatment effects are heterogeneous across subjects and individuals select treatments based on expected idiosyncratic gains or losses from treatments. In this paper we compare conventional IV analysis with alternative approaches that use IVs to estimate treatment effects in models with response heterogeneity and self-selection. Instead of interpreting IV estimates as the effect of treatment at an unknown margin of patients, we identify the marginal patients and we apply the method of local IVs to estimate the average treatment effect and the effect on the treated on 5-year direct costs of breast-conserving surgery and radiation therapy compared with mastectomy in breast cancer patients. We use a sample from the Outcomes and Preferences in Older Women, Nationwide Survey which is designed to be representative of all female Medicare beneficiaries (aged 67 or older) with newly diagnosed breast cancer between 1992 and 1994. Our results reveal some of the advantages and limitations of conventional and alternative IV methods in estimating mean treatment effect parameters.

10.1002/hec.1291.abstractZh: 工具变量方法在健康经济学文献中被广泛用于调整观察性研究中隐藏的选择偏差，以估计治疗效果。但在应用文献中，如果治疗效果在受试者之间存在异质性，或者个体根据预期的独特收益或损失来选择治疗方案，那么对工具变量的正确使用则较少关注。本文将传统工具变量分析与使用工具变量来估计具有响应异质性和自我选择模型的治疗效果的替代方法进行了比较。我们不是将工具变量估计值解释为患者在未知边际上的治疗效果，而是识别边际患者，并采用局部工具变量方法来估计乳腺癌患者接受保乳手术和放疗与接受乳房切除术相比，5年直接成本的平均治疗效果。我们使用的样本来自“全国老年妇女结果与偏好调查”，该调查旨在代表所有1992年至1994年间被诊断出乳腺癌的老年女性医疗保险受益人。我们的研究结果揭示了传统方法和替代方法在估计平均治疗效果参数方面的优势和局限性。

abstract.text: This paper outlines the current 'state of play' regarding the use of evidence in decision modelling and highlights both practical issues and methodological challenges related to identifying, combining and reporting evidence to inform decision model parameters and structure. Based on discussions at two MRC HSRC-funded workshops consisting of 37 experts from a range of disciplines (i.e. decision-makers, health economists, information specialists, operations researchers and statisticians), it aims to derive a multi-disciplinary standpoint on the appropriate use of evidence in economic decision models and, where applicable, offer some suggestions for good modelling practice. Gaps in the established methodology knowledge base are identified for future research.

10.1002/hec.1297.abstractZh: 本文概述了在决策建模中运用证据的现状，并指出了与识别、整合和报告证据以指导决策模型参数和结构相关的实际问题和方法论挑战。基于两个由MRC HSRC资助的研讨会上的讨论，这些研讨会汇集了来自不同学科领域的37位专家（包括决策者、健康经济学家、信息专家、运营研究者和统计学家），本文旨在从多学科角度探讨在经济决策模型中适当使用证据的问题，并在适用的情况下提出一些良好的建模实践建议。同时，本文还指出了现有方法论知识库中的空白，为未来的研究提供了方向。

abstract.text: The OFT report into the Pharmaceutical Price Regulation Scheme (PPRS) called for reform of the scheme, replacing existing profit and price controls with a system of value-based pricing (VBP). The report argued that VBP would be much more effective than the current PPRS both at providing value for money for the NHS and giving pharmaceutical companies the right incentives to invest in drugs in the future. The report has sparked a widespread debate about drug pricing in the UK and has been controversial in some quarters. Some of the more negative responses are, however, based on fundamental misconceptions about the OFT recommendations. In particular, contrary to some claims, the recommended system would provide strong incentives for incremental innovation and the right balance of rewards for first in class and follow-on products. Nor, as is sometimes argued, would VBP have an adverse effect on investment in the UK.Certainly, real challenges lie ahead if VBP is to be implemented. These concern the definition of value, particularly where patient benefits differ significantly by subgroup or indication, and the level of resource required to implement VBP. The OFT report contains proposals for addressing each of these areas. Perhaps the most difficult challenge is the political one: securing acceptance for a reform package that would create winners and losers among pharmaceutical companies according to their success in producing valuable drugs. Ultimately, however, only a scheme that does precisely this can hope to meet the needs of patients, the NHS and innovative companies in the long run.

10.1002/hec.1300.abstractZh: 英国公平贸易委员会关于药品价格监管计划的报告呼吁对该计划进行改革，用基于价值的定价体系取代现有的利润和价格控制机制。报告认为，与当前的药品价格监管计划相比，基于价值的定价体系在为国民医疗服务体系提供物有所值的服务以及为制药公司提供未来投资药物的激励方面将更为有效。该报告引发了英国关于药品定价的广泛讨论，并在某些方面引起了争议。然而，一些负面反应是基于对公平贸易委员会建议的根本误解。特别是，与某些说法相反，推荐的定价体系将为渐进式创新提供强有力的激励，并能在一流产品和后续产品之间实现合理的奖励平衡。此外，正如有时所争论的那样，基于价值的定价体系不会对英国的药品投资产生负面影响。当然，如果要实施基于价值的定价体系，则面临一些实际挑战。这些挑战涉及价值的定义，特别是在不同患者群体或适应症之间，患者受益差异显著的情况下，以及实施基于价值定价体系所需的资源水平。公平贸易委员会的报告提出了解决这些问题的建议。或许最困难的挑战是政治层面的：确保改革方案的接受度，因为该方案将根据制药公司生产有价值药物的成功与否，使它们产生赢家和输家。然而，从长远来看，只有能够做到这一点的方案才能满足患者、国民医疗服务体系和创新公司的需求。

abstract.text: Statements like "quality of care is more highly valued than waiting time" can neither be supported nor refuted by comparisons of utility parameters from a traditional discrete choice experiment (DCE). Best--worst scaling can overcome this problem because it asks respondents to perform a different choice task. However, whilst the nature of the best--worst task is generally understood, there are a number of issues relating to the design and analysis of a best--worst choice experiment that require further exposition. This paper illustrates how to aggregate and analyse such data and using a quality of life pilot study demonstrates how richer insights can be drawn by the use of best--worst tasks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.04.002.abstractZh: 诸如“护理质量比等待时间更受重视”这样的陈述，既无法通过传统离散选择实验的效用参数比较来证实，也无法通过对比来否定。最佳-最差排序方法可以解决这个问题，因为它要求受访者执行不同的选择任务。然而，尽管最佳-最差任务的性质通常是可以理解的，但在设计和分析最佳-最差选择实验时仍存在一些问题，需要进一步阐述。本文展示了如何汇总和分析此类数据，并通过一项生活质量试点研究，说明了利用最佳-最差任务可以获取更丰富的洞察力。

abstract.text: We study the competitive effects of restricting direct access to secondary care by gatekeeping, focusing on the informational role of general practitioners (GPs). In the secondary care market there are two hospitals choosing quality and specialization. Patients, who are ex ante uninformed, can consult a GP to receive an (imperfect) diagnosis and obtain information about the secondary care market. We show that hospital competition is amplified by higher GP attendance but dampened by improved diagnosing accuracy. Therefore, compulsory gatekeeping may result in excessive quality competition and too much specialization, unless the mismatch costs and the diagnosing accuracy are sufficiently high. Second-best price regulation makes direct regulation of GP consultation redundant, but will generally not implement first-best.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.04.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过门卫机制限制直接获取二级护理服务的竞争效应，重点关注全科医生在信息传递中的作用。在二级护理市场中，有两家医院在质量和专业度方面具有竞争力。患者事先并不了解相关信息，可以咨询全科医生以获得（不完善的）诊断结果以及关于二级护理市场的信息。我们发现，较高的全科医生出诊率会加剧医院之间的竞争，但提高诊断准确性则会减弱这种竞争。因此，强制性的门卫机制可能导致过度的高质量竞争和过度专业化，除非不匹配的成本和诊断准确性足够高。第二优的价格监管使得直接监管全科医生咨询变得多余，但通常不会实现第一优的监管效果。

abstract.text: This novel application of spatial wage theory to health service labour markets analyses the competitiveness of nurse's pay and how this differs between local labour markets in Britain. A switching regression model is estimated to derive standardised spatial wage differentials (SSWDs) for nurses and their comparators. An SSWD gap is constructed and its relationship to vacancies estimated. A reduction in the gap in a local area is shown to result in an increase in the long-term vacancy rate for National Health Service (NHS) nurses. The competitiveness of nursing pay is shown to have a strong effect on the ability of the NHS to attract and retain nurses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.05.002.abstractZh: 这篇关于空间工资理论在医疗服务劳动力市场中的新应用研究，分析了护士薪酬的竞争力以及这种竞争力在英国不同地方劳动力市场中的差异。研究采用了切换回归模型，以得出护士及其比较对象的标准化空间工资差异。同时，研究还构建了工资差异的差距，并评估了其与职位空缺之间的关系。研究发现，当地地区工资差异的缩小会导致国家卫生服务系统护士的长期空缺率上升。结果表明，护士薪酬的竞争力对国家卫生服务系统吸引和留住护士的能力有着重要影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether managed care ameliorates or aggravates ethnic and racial health care disparities in Medicare. First, we analyze the choice of type of insurance made by Medicare enrollees to see if minorities are more likely to choose the managed care alternative. Second, we study the differential effect of managed care on disparities using several measures of access, use and cost of services. Both analyses are conducted on two independent data sets, the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey and the National Health Interview Survey. We conclude that relative to Whites, minorities are at least as well off -- in terms of benefits and costs -- in Medicare managed care as in Medicare traditional indemnity plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.06.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了管理式护理是否有助于缓解或加剧Medicare计划中的种族和健康护理差异。首先，我们分析了Medicare参保者选择保险类型的情况，以了解少数族裔是否更倾向于选择管理式护理。其次，我们通过多种服务获取、使用及成本指标，研究管理式护理对差异的影响。这两项分析分别基于Medicare当前受益人调查和全国健康访谈调查这两个独立的数据集进行。我们的结论是，与白人相比，少数族裔在Medicare管理式护理计划中的福利和成本状况至少与在传统的Medicare赔偿计划中的状况相当。

abstract.text: We describe a novel process for transforming the efficiency of partial expected value of sample information (EVSI) computation in decision models. Traditional EVSI computation begins with Monte Carlo sampling to produce new simulated data-sets with a specified sample size. Each data-set is synthesised with prior information to give posterior distributions for model parameters, either via analytic formulae or a further Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulation. A further 'inner level' Monte Carlo sampling then quantifies the effect of the simulated data on the decision. This paper describes a novel form of Bayesian Laplace approximation, which can be replace both the Bayesian updating and the inner Monte Carlo sampling to compute the posterior expectation of a function. We compare the accuracy of EVSI estimates in two case study cost-effectiveness models using 1st and 2nd order versions of our approximation formula, the approximation of Tierney and Kadane, and traditional Monte Carlo. Computational efficiency gains depend on the complexity of the net benefit functions, the number of inner level Monte Carlo samples used, and the requirement or otherwise for MCMC methods to produce the posterior distributions. This methodology provides a new and valuable approach for EVSI computation in health economic decision models and potential wider benefits in many fields requiring Bayesian approximation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.06.002.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种新颖的方法，用于提升决策模型中样本信息部分期望价值计算的效率。传统的期望价值计算始于蒙特卡洛抽样，以生成具有指定样本大小的新模拟数据集。每个数据集都结合先验信息进行合成，从而得到模型参数的后验分布，这可以通过解析公式或进一步的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）模拟来实现。进一步的“内部级”蒙特卡洛抽样则用于量化模拟数据对决策的影响。本文介绍了一种新颖的贝叶斯拉普拉斯近似方法，该方法可以替代贝叶斯更新和内部蒙特卡洛抽样，用于计算函数的后验期望。我们通过两个案例研究成本效益模型，比较了使用一阶和二阶近似公式、Tierney和Kadane近似方法以及传统蒙特卡洛方法得到的期望价值估计的准确性。计算效率的提升取决于净收益函数的复杂性、使用的内部级蒙特卡洛样本数量，以及是否需要使用MCMC方法来生成后验分布。这种方法为健康经济决策模型中的期望价值计算提供了一种新的有价值的方法，并且在许多需要贝叶斯近似的领域中具有潜在的广泛应用价值。

abstract.text: This paper re-examines the relation between the predictability of health care spending and incentives due to adverse selection. Within an explicit model of health plan decisions about service levels, we show that predictability (how well spending on certain services can be anticipated), predictiveness (how well the predicted levels of certain services contemporaneously co-vary with total health care spending), and demand responsiveness all matter for adverse selection incentives. The product of terms involving these three measures of predictability, predictiveness, and demand responsiveness define an empirical index of the direction and magnitude of selection incentives. We quantify the relative magnitude of adverse selection incentives bearing on various types of health care services in Medicare. Our results are consistent with other research on service-level selection. The index of incentives can readily be applied to data from other payers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.06.004.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了医疗保健支出可预测性与因逆向选择而产生的激励之间的关系。在一个明确的健康计划决策模型中，我们展示了可预测性（即某些服务的支出能否被准确预测）、预测性（即某些服务的预测水平如何与总医疗保健支出同时变化）以及需求响应性对逆向选择激励的影响。这三个可预测性、预测性以及需求响应性的综合指标定义了一个实证指数，用于衡量选择激励的方向和强度。我们量化了在Medicare中不同类型医疗保健服务所面临的逆向选择激励的相对强度。我们的研究结果与其他关于服务水平选择的研究结果一致。该激励指数可以很容易地应用于其他支付方的数据。

abstract.text: This paper finds that the incomes of urban households are more vulnerable to health shocks than rural households, that health shocks may precipitate increases in unearned income that partially offset reductions in earned income and large increases in medical spending even among insured households. It also finds that households spend less on food following a health shock, but more on budget items such as housing and electricity. Measures of household health shocks used include a recent death of a working-age household member, a long inpatient spell, and a recent sizeable drop in the body mass index of the household head.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.07.001.abstractZh: 本文发现，城市家庭的收入比农村家庭更容易受到健康冲击的影响。健康冲击可能导致非劳动收入的增加，从而部分抵消劳动收入的减少，并且即使是在有保险的家庭中，医疗支出的大幅增加也会发生。此外，文章还发现，在经历健康冲击后，家庭在食品上的支出减少，而在住房、电力等预算项目上的支出增加。用于衡量家庭健康冲击的指标包括近期有工作年龄家庭成员去世、长期住院以及家庭主妇的体重指数出现显著下降等情况。

abstract.text: This paper empirically studies time inconsistent preferences in the context of cigarette smoking behavior. With hyperbolic discounting, an individual has time inconsistent preferences, which give rise to a lack of self-control, i.e., she may perpetually postpone the execution of a plan. This implies that a smoker who wants to quit has a demand for control devices, e.g., a smoking ban in public areas or a hike in cigarette excise taxes. This paper empirically tests this implication, using a sample that is based on survey data from Taiwan. The estimation results indicate that a smoker's intention to quit has a positive effect on the smoker's support for smoking bans and a cigarette excise tax increase. These results lend support to the validity of the time inconsistent preferences in the context of cigarette smoking behavior. This casts doubt on the validity of the assumption that individuals have time consistent preferences in Becker and Murphy's [Becker, G.S., Murphy, K.M., 1988. A theory of rational addiction. Journal of Political Economy 96 (4), 675-700] rational addiction model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.07.002.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究探讨了在吸烟行为背景下时间不一致偏好现象。由于双曲贴现效应，个体存在时间不一致偏好，这会导致缺乏自我控制能力，即个体可能会不断推迟某个计划的执行。这意味着想要戒烟的吸烟者需要一些控制手段，例如公共场所禁烟令或提高香烟消费税。本文基于台湾的调查数据样本，对这一假设进行了实证检验。估计结果显示，吸烟者戒烟的意愿对支持禁烟令和增加香烟消费税有积极影响。这些结果支持了在吸烟行为背景下时间不一致偏好存在的合理性。这质疑了Becker和Murphy在1988年提出的理性成瘾模型中关于个体具有时间一致偏好的假设。

abstract.text: We investigate whether changes in economic inequality affect mortality in rich countries. To answer this question we use a new source of data on income inequality: tax data on the share of pretax income going to the richest 10% of the population in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK, and the US between 1903 and 2003. Although this measure is not a good proxy for inequality within the bottom half of the income distribution, it is a good proxy for changes in the top half of the distribution and for the Gini coefficient. In the absence of country and year fixed effects, the income share of the top decile is negatively related to life expectancy and positively related to infant mortality. However, in our preferred fixed-effects specification these relationships are weak, statistically insignificant, and likely to change their sign. Nor do our data suggest that changes in the income share of the richest 10% affect homicide or suicide rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.07.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了经济不平等的变化是否会影响富裕国家的死亡率。为了回答这个问题，我们使用了一种新的收入不平等数据来源：1903年至2003年间澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、爱尔兰、荷兰、新西兰、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士、英国和美国的收入不平等数据，这些数据涉及最富有的10%人群在税前收入的比例。尽管这一指标并不能很好地反映收入分布下半部分的不平等情况，但它能很好地反映收入分布上半部分的变化以及基尼系数。在没有国家和年份固定效应的情况下，最富有的10%人群在收入方面的份额与预期寿命呈负相关，与婴儿死亡率呈正相关。然而，在我们采用的固定效应模型中，这些关系较弱，统计上不显著，并且其符号可能会发生变化。此外，我们的数据表明，最富有的10%人群在收入方面的变化并不会影响凶杀率和自杀率。

abstract.text: Market power and adverse selection are prevalent features of the market for pre-paid health plans. However, most of the literature on adverse selection considers extreme cases: either perfect competition or monopoly. If instead health plans are horizontally differentiated, then (i) profits derived from each low risk are higher than from each high risk and (ii) when the profits derived from each high risk are negative (cross-subsidization), a health authority as informed as the health plans can implement a Pareto-improvement. Both local and global deviations from cross-subsidization are addressed within a Nash equilibrium framework.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.002.abstractZh: 市场力量和逆向选择是预付费健康计划市场的常见特征。然而，关于逆向选择的多数文献都考虑了极端情况：要么是完全竞争，要么是垄断。如果健康计划是水平差异化的，那么（i）来自低风险项目的利润高于高风险项目；（ii）当来自高风险项目的利润为负时（即交叉补贴），像健康计划一样了解情况的卫生当局可以实施帕累托改进。在纳什均衡框架下，既考虑了本地交叉补贴的偏差，也考虑了全球交叉补贴的偏差。

abstract.text: Recent studies using Canadian and US data have documented a positive relationship between family income and child health, with the slope of the gradient being larger for older than younger children [Case, A., Lubotsky, D., Paxson, C., 2002. Economic status and health in childhood: the origins of the gradient. American Economic Review 92, 1308-1334; Currie, J., Stabile, M., 2003. Socioeconomic status and child health: why is the relationship stronger for older children? American Economic Review 93, 1813-1823]. In this paper we explore whether or not these findings hold for England, analysing a sample of over 13,000 children (and their parents) drawn from the Health Survey for England. While we find consistent and robust evidence of a significant family income gradient in child health, using the subjective general health status measure, the slope of the gradient is very small. Moreover, we find no evidence that the slope of the gradient increases with child age. Furthermore, we find no evidence of such a gradient with more objective measures, based on nurse examinations and blood test results. Together these results suggest that family income is not a major determinant of child health in England. Finally, we provide some evidence that nutrition and family lifestyle choices have an important role in determining child health and that child health is highly correlated within the family.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.003.abstractZh: 最近使用加拿大和美国的数据进行的研究表明，家庭收入与儿童健康之间存在正相关关系，且这种关系的斜率对于年龄较大的儿童来说更为显著[Case, A., Lubotsky, D., Paxson, C., 2002. 经济地位与儿童健康：梯度的起源. 美国经济评论 92, 1308-1334; Currie, J., Stabile, M., 2003. 社会经济地位与儿童健康：为什么这种关系对年龄较大的儿童更为显著? 美国经济评论 93, 1813-1823]。在本文中，我们探讨了这些发现是否也适用于英格兰，分析了来自英格兰健康调查中的超过13,000名儿童及其父母的数据。虽然我们发现家庭收入对儿童健康的梯度存在一致且有力的证据，但使用主观的健康状况衡量标准时，这种关系的斜率非常小。此外，我们没有发现这种关系的斜率随儿童年龄增长而增加的证据。同样，基于护士检查和血液检测结果的多重客观衡量标准也未能显示出这种关系。这些结果共同表明，在英格兰，家庭收入并非儿童健康的主要决定因素。最后，我们提供了一些证据，表明营养和家庭生活方式选择在决定儿童健康方面起着重要作用，且儿童健康在家庭中具有高度相关性。

abstract.text: One of the famous questions in social science is whether money makes people happy. We offer new evidence by using longitudinal data on a random sample of Britons who receive medium-sized lottery wins of between 1000 pounds and 120,000 pounds (that is, up to approximately US$ 200,000). When compared to two control groups -- one with no wins and the other with small wins -- these individuals go on eventually to exhibit significantly better psychological health. Two years after a lottery win, the average measured improvement in mental wellbeing is 1.4 GHQ points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.004.abstractZh: 社会科学中一个著名的问题是：金钱是否能让人幸福。我们通过使用对随机选取的英国人的纵向数据来提供新的证据。这些英国人获得了1000英镑到120,000英镑之间的中等额彩票奖金。与两个对照组相比——一个没有中奖，另一个只获得了小额奖金——这些人在心理健康方面表现出了显著的优势。在彩票中奖两年后，他们的心理健康平均提升了1.4个GHQ分数。

abstract.text: In any system of health insurance, a decision must be made about what treatments the insurance should cover. One way to make this decision is to rank treatments by their ratios of health benefits to treatment costs. If treatments that are not offered by the health insurance can be purchased out of pocket, the socially optimal ranking of treatments to be included in the health insurance is different from this standard cost-effectiveness rule. It is no longer necessarily true that treatments should be ranked higher the lower are treatment costs (for given health benefits). Moreover, the larger are the costs per treatment for a given benefit-cost ratio, the higher priority should the treatment be given. If the health budget in a public health system does not exceed the socially optimal size, treatments with sufficiently low costs should not be performed by the public health system if treatment may be purchased privately out of pocket.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.005.abstractZh: 在任何健康保险体系中，都必须决定保险应涵盖哪些治疗项目。一种决策方法是根据治疗项目的健康效益与治疗成本的比率对其进行排序。如果健康保险未涵盖的治疗项目可以通过个人支付获得，那么将治疗项目纳入健康保险的社会最优排序方式就会与这种标准成本效益规则不同。不再必然地认为，治疗项目的排序应随着治疗成本的降低而提高（在给定健康效益的情况下）。此外，对于给定效益成本比而言，每项治疗的成本越高，该治疗应被赋予的优先级也应越高。如果公共健康体系中的健康预算不超过社会最优规模，那么如果可以通过私人渠道自费获得治疗项目，则公共健康体系不应实施成本足够低的治疗项目。

abstract.text: This paper develops models of the demand for and supply of elective (non-emergency) surgery using a panel of quarterly data for 200 English hospitals over the period 1995-2002. Unusually, distinct measures of supply (outpatients seen and inpatient admissions) and demand (outpatient referrals and decisions to admit) are available for each observation. These offer the opportunity to estimate separate empirical models of supply and demand using ordinary least squares (OLS) regression methods. However, the strong correlation between the residuals of these models suggests some merit in the deployment of seemingly unrelated regression (SUR) methods. Although both static and dynamic SUR estimations leave the results largely qualitatively unchanged, SUR estimation can have a considerable quantitative effect relative to the OLS results. For example, SUR estimation generates a lower elasticity of inpatient demand with respect to waiting time than that obtained via OLS. The results offer an important justification for more careful econometric modelling of hospital behaviour than has traditionally been employed in the health economics literature.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.006.abstractZh: 本文利用1995至2002年间200家英国医院的季度数据，建立了关于非紧急选择性手术的需求与供应模型。不同寻常的是，每个观测点都提供了供应（门诊就诊量和住院人数）和需求（门诊转诊次数及住院决定）的详细数据。这些数据为使用普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归方法分别建立供应和需求模型提供了可能。然而，这些模型残差之间的高度相关性表明，看似不相关的回归方法（SUR方法）具有一定的应用价值。尽管静态和动态SUR估计的结果在定性上基本保持不变，但SUR估计在定量上可能比OLS结果更有优势。例如，SUR估计得出的住院需求对等待时间的弹性低于OLS估计的结果。这些结果为更精细地建模医院行为提供了重要依据，这与传统健康经济学文献中的建模方式有所不同。

abstract.text: The vast majority of women in England attend for cervical cancer screening. Conventional economic theorising fails to explain why and its predictions are inconsistent with the evidence. Using questionnaire data, we analyse directly motivations for screening attendance. We conclude that regular attendance at screening is driven primarily by a search for reassurance, a sense of duty and herd signalling. It is evident that recognisable sub-groups of attenders exist, in which the configurations of motivational factors differ. Being motivated to attend by physicians is less significant that is widely supposed and is more frequently associated with irregular attendance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.007.abstractZh: 在英格兰，绝大多数女性都参加宫颈癌筛查。传统的经济理论无法解释这一现象，其预测结果与实际证据不符。通过问卷调查数据，我们直接分析了人们参加筛查的动机。研究结果表明，定期参加筛查主要出于寻求安心、责任感以及群体信号传递的动机。显然，存在不同的动机构成因素导致的不同筛查参与群体。由医生激发的动机并不如人们普遍认为的那么重要，反而更常与不定期参加筛查联系在一起。

abstract.text: The effect of purely persuasive advertising on generic market entry and social welfare is analysed. An incumbent has the possibility to invest in advertising which affects the prescribing physician's perceived relative qualities of the brand-name and the generic version of the drug. Advertising creates product differentiation and can induce generic market entry which is deterred without differentiation due to strong Bertrand competition. However, over-investment in advertising can deter generic market entry under certain conditions and reduces welfare as compared to accommodated market entry.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.08.008.abstractZh: 本文分析了纯粹说服性广告对通用药品市场进入和社会福利的影响。现有企业有投资广告的可能性，这会影响处方医生对品牌药品和通用药品相对品质的认知。广告能够创造产品差异化，并可能促使通用药品进入市场，而如果没有差异化，由于强烈的伯特兰竞争，通用药品进入市场的可能性就会降低。然而，在某些条件下，过度投资广告可能会阻碍通用药品的市场进入，并导致社会福利下降，相比适应性强的市场进入情况而言。

abstract.text: Beginning in the late 1980s, states and the federal government restricted the ability of physicians to "balance bill" Medicare beneficiaries for charges in excess of the copayment and reimbursement amounts approved by Medicare. In this paper, I provide empirical evidence that this policy change resulted in a 9% reduction in out-of-pocket medical expenditures by elderly households. In spite of the change in marginal reimbursement to physicians, however, I find little evidence that the restrictions affected patterns of care. Thus, this restriction on the prices charged by physicians amounted to a transfer from affected physicians to affected patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.09.001.abstractZh: 从20世纪80年代末开始，各州和联邦政府限制了医生向Medicare受益人收取超出Medicare批准的共同支付和报销金额的费用。本文提供了实证证据，表明这一政策变化使老年家庭的自付医疗费用减少了9%。然而，尽管对医生的边际报销有所调整，我发现几乎没有证据表明这些限制影响了护理模式。因此，对医生收费的限制实际上是将负担转移到了受影响的患者身上。

abstract.text: This paper reports on the findings from applying a new approach to modelling health state valuation data. The approach applies a nonparametric model to estimate SF-6D health state utility values using Bayesian methods. The data set is the UK SF-6D valuation study where a sample of 249 states defined by the SF-6D (a derivative of the SF-36) was valued by a representative sample of the UK general population using standard gamble. The paper presents the results from applying the nonparametric model and comparing it to the original model estimated using a conventional parametric random effects model. The two models are compared theoretically and in terms of empirical performance. The paper discusses the implications of these results for future applications of the SF-6D and further work in this field.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.09.002.abstractZh: 本文报告了采用一种新的方法对健康状况估值数据进行建模的研究结果。该方法采用非参数模型，利用贝叶斯方法估算SF-6D健康状况的效用值。数据集来自英国的SF-6D估值研究，该研究通过SF-6D（SF-36的衍生指标）定义了249个状态，并由英国普通人群的代表性样本通过标准赌博方法对这些状态进行估值。本文展示了采用非参数模型与传统的参数随机效应模型估算结果之间的对比。从理论和实证表现两个方面对两种模型进行了比较。文章还讨论了这些结果对未来SF-6D应用以及该领域进一步研究的意义。

abstract.text: We study how for-profit and religious nonprofit hospices respond to an exogenous Medicare reimbursement incentive that encourages maximization of patient length of stay. Hospices have the incentive to selectively admit patients with longer expected lengths of stay, and admit patients sooner after a hospital discharge. We find that for-profit hospices are significantly less likely to admit patients with shorter, less profitable, expected lengths of stay. We do not find any difference in the timing of admission by ownership. Incentives for efficiency could be strengthened by a Medicare pricing system that replaced the current flat per diem payment with one that reflected the high costs at the beginning and end of hospice stay and the lower costs in between.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.09.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了营利性和宗教非营利性临终关怀机构如何响应外部Medicare报销激励措施，该激励措施鼓励最大化患者的住院时间。临终关怀机构有动机选择性地收治预期住院时间较长的患者，并在患者出院后尽早收治。我们发现，营利性临终关怀机构不太可能收治预期住院时间较短、利润较低的患者。我们没有发现所有制类型在收治时间上的差异。通过Medicare定价系统加强效率激励措施可能是可行的，该系统可以用一种反映临终关怀期间开始和结束阶段高成本、中间阶段低成本的定价方式取代目前的固定每日费用支付方式。

abstract.text: This paper uses duration models and self-reported cannabis histories from young Australians to study the dynamics of cannabis use. We find that low cannabis prices are associated with early initiation into cannabis use. While the decision to quit does not appear to be directly influenced by price, we find that the younger an individual is when they start using cannabis the less likely they are to quit. Therefore, low cannabis prices lead to early use and because of that they lead to a low quit rate and hence a longer duration of use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.001.abstractZh: 本文利用澳大利亚年轻人的使用时长模型和自我报告的大麻使用历史，研究了大麻使用的动态变化。研究发现，低大麻价格与早期开始使用大麻有关。虽然停止使用大麻的决定似乎并不直接受到价格的影响，但我们发现，开始使用大麻的年龄越小，停止使用的可能性就越低。因此，低大麻价格导致早期使用，进而使得停止使用的比例较低，从而导致使用时间延长。

abstract.text: US hospital prices are rising again after years of limited growth. We analyze trends in hospital prices during a period of significant price growth (1999-2003) to assess whether hospitals that are part of multi-hospital systems were able to increase their prices faster than non-system hospitals. We find hospitals that were members of multi-hospital systems were able to increase their prices substantially more than comparable non-systems hospitals (34% for large systems and 17% for small systems). Further, we find that the systems effect is not confined to hospitals that have other system member hospitals in their local markets. One possible explanation is that hospitals belonging to non-local multi-hospital systems have improved their bargaining position vis-à-vis health plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.002.abstractZh: 美国医院的价格在多年增长受限后再次上升。我们分析了价格显著上涨时期（1999-2003年）医院价格的趋势，以评估属于多医院系统的医院是否能够比非系统医院更快地提高价格。研究发现，属于多医院系统的医院能够比类似的非系统医院更快地提高价格，大型系统的医院提高了34%，小型系统的医院提高了17%。此外，我们发现这种系统效应并不局限于在当地市场中有其他系统成员医院的医院。一种可能的解释是，不属于本地多医院系统的医院在与健康计划的谈判中获得了更好的地位。

abstract.text: Nursing home expenditures are a rapidly growing share of national health care spending with the government functioning as the dominant payer of services. Public insurance for nursing home care is tightly targeted on income and assets, which imposes a major tax on savings; moreover, low state reimbursement for Medicaid patients has been shown to lower treatment quality, and bed supply constraints may deny access to needy individuals. However, expanding eligibility, increasing Medicaid reimbursement, or allowing more nursing home bed slots has the potential to induce more nursing home use, increasing the social costs of long-term care. A problem in evaluating this tradeoff is that we know remarkably little about the effects of government policy on nursing home utilization. We attempt to address this shortcoming using multiple waves of the National Long-Term Care Survey, matched to changing state Medicaid rules for nursing home care. We find consistent evidence of no effect of Medicaid policies on nursing home utilization, suggesting that demand for nursing home care is relatively inelastic with respect to public program generosity. From a policy perspective, this finding indicates that changes in overall Medicaid generosity will not have large effects on utilization.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.003.abstractZh: 养老院支出在国民医疗保健支出中的比例正在迅速增长，而政府是这些服务的主要支付方。针对养老院护理的公共保险严格依据收入和资产来设定，这给储蓄带来了巨大负担；此外，州政府对医疗补助患者的报销金额较低，这降低了治疗质量，而床位供应限制则可能使需要帮助的人无法获得服务。然而，扩大资格范围、增加医疗补助的报销金额或允许更多的养老院床位，都有助于增加养老院的使用率，从而增加长期护理的社会成本。在评估这种权衡时，我们面临的一个问题是，我们对政府政策对养老院使用率的影响知之甚少。我们试图通过多次全国长期护理调查的数据来解决这个问题，这些调查与各州医疗补助政策的变化相匹配。我们发现，医疗补助政策对养老院使用率几乎没有影响，这表明对养老院护理的需求相对于公共项目的慷慨程度来说相对缺乏弹性。从政策角度来看，这一发现表明，医疗补助整体慷慨程度的变化对使用率的影响不大。

abstract.text: Around 14% of the UK labour force has informal care responsibilities and almost everyone in society will be an informal carer in their lifetime. A well-known fact in the small economic literature on informal care is the apparent negative relation between care responsibilities and labour market participation. Yet, caring and labour market participation may be endogenous. Using an instrumental variable approach and panel data techniques and employing data from the British Household Panel Study from 1991 to 2002, this paper shows that not accommodating for endogeneity in the labour market participation equation may significantly overestimate the impact care exhibits on the employment decision of informal carers. Moreover, it is shown that a negative impact on employment only applies to some care-types. Policy implications are derived.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.005.abstractZh: 大约14%的英国劳动力承担非正式护理职责，几乎每个人在其一生中都会成为非正式护理者。关于非正式护理的少量经济文献中一个众所周知的事实是，护理职责与劳动力市场参与之间存在明显的负相关关系。然而，护理行为与劳动力市场参与可能是内生性的。本文采用工具变量方法和面板数据技术，利用1991至2002年的英国家庭面板研究数据，表明在劳动力市场参与方程中不考虑内生性可能会导致对护理对非正式护理者就业决策影响的估计严重高估。此外，研究还表明，对就业的负面影响仅适用于某些类型的护理。最后，本文还提出了政策建议。

abstract.text: This paper combines differences-in-differences with propensity score matching to estimate the impacts of a health reform project in China that combined supply-side interventions aimed at improving the effectiveness and quality of care with demand-side measures aimed at expanding health insurance and providing financial support to the very poor. Data from household, village and facility surveys suggest the project reduced out-of-pocket spending, and the incidence of catastrophic spending and impoverishment through health expenses. Little impact is detected on the use of services, and while the evidence points to the project reducing sickness days, the evidence on health outcomes is mixed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.006.abstractZh: 本文结合差异对差异法和倾向得分匹配方法，用于评估中国一项健康改革项目的影响。该项目结合了供给侧的干预措施，以提高护理服务的效果和质量，以及需求侧的举措，如扩大医疗保险覆盖范围并为极度贫困人群提供经济支持。来自家庭、村庄和设施调查的数据表明，该项目减少了个人自付费用，并降低了因医疗费用导致的灾难性支出和贫困现象。然而，该项目对服务利用的影响较小。虽然证据表明该项目减少了病假天数，但关于健康结果的影响则存在争议。

abstract.text: Based on the data of the Demographic and Health Survey, and of the Household Priority Survey, carried out in 2003, the present study, examining the factors of HIV prevalence in Burkina Faso, provides two conclusions. Firstly, the fight against poverty is not necessarily a means of reducing simultaneously and drastically HIV/AIDS prevalence, an assertion based on several elements of empirical analysis. First of all, the micro-econometric estimates of the probit models suggest a positive relationship between HIV prevalence in adult women and men, and living standards of individuals. Then, the macro-econometric approach reveals the existence of a positive (negative) relationship between, on the one hand, the level of regional HIV prevalence, and, on the other hand, the average monetary provincial standard of living (poverty) of households. At the same time, the relationship between HIV prevalence and poverty, apprehended at the regional level, is not linear. Secondly, and correlatively, the relationship between HIV prevalence and poverty is called into question. First of all, some structural factors may contribute to a distortion of the relationship between resources of households and the prevalence of HIV/AIDS. This may be due, on the one hand, to the persistence of cognitive and behavioural factors inherent in a traditional society, and in particular, to the fact that the social construction of female attributes and roles confers to men a statute of "decision-makers" with regard to sexual intercourse, while the persistence of secular beliefs contributes to minimizing the perception of HIV/AIDS in terms of risk, independently of standards of living. In addition, the enclavement of Burkina Faso required development of road and railway traffic with neighbouring countries, in particular Côte d'Ivoire. Therefore, it may be that the structural conditions of the process of development of Burkina Faso, concomitant with significant flows of the exchange of goods, services and labour with a country where the prevalence of the HIV is particularly high, constitute an element of an explanation of the positive relationship between the resources of households and HIV seroprevalence. Also, factors related to the economic situation probably contributed to reinforcing the opposite relationship between HIV seroprevalence and poverty, the macro-econometric analysis highlighting a direct relationship between the massive return of migrants of Côte d'Ivoire and the level of HIV prevalence in Burkina Faso.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.007.abstractZh: 基于2003年进行的人口与健康调查以及家庭优先调查的数据，本研究探讨了布基纳法索HIV感染率的成因，得出了两个结论。首先，与减少HIV/AIDS感染率相比，消除贫困未必是一种有效的手段，这一结论基于多项实证分析。首先，微观计量经济学模型估计表明，成年女性与男性的HIV感染率与个人生活水平之间存在正相关关系。其次，宏观计量经济学分析显示，区域HIV感染率与家庭平均货币生活水平（贫困程度）之间存在正相关（负相关）关系。同时，区域层面上，HIV感染率与贫困之间的关系并非线性。其次，HIV感染率与贫困之间的关系也受到质疑。首先，一些结构性因素可能导致家庭资源与HIV/AIDS感染率之间的关系出现扭曲。这可能是由于传统社会中固有的认知和行为因素的持续存在，特别是社会对于女性属性和角色的认知方式使得男性在性行为方面具有“决策者”的地位，而世俗信仰的延续则使得人们将HIV/AIDS视为与生活水平无关的风险。此外，布基纳法索与邻国，尤其是科特迪瓦之间的道路和铁路交通发展也对其经济环境产生了影响。因此，布基纳法索发展过程中的结构性条件，伴随着与艾滋病流行率特别高的国家的商品、服务和劳动力的大规模交流，可能是解释家庭资源与艾滋病血清阳性率之间正相关关系的一个因素。此外，与经济状况相关的因素可能进一步强化了艾滋病血清阳性率与贫困之间的负相关关系。宏观计量分析表明，科特迪瓦移民的大规模回流与布基纳法索的艾滋病流行率之间存在直接关系。

abstract.text: This paper presents data from a 2005 survey of health economists who were U.S. members of the International Health Economics Association or the Health Economics Special Interest Group of Academy Health. We present summary statistics of health economist earnings by rank and type of employer, estimate log earnings models as a function of education, experience, type of employer, and research productivity, and provide summary statistics of starting salaries expected to be offered to new Ph.D. health economists by type of employer. Our findings are compared to those for economics departments, business schools, schools of public health, and for health services researchers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.008.abstractZh: 本文呈现了2005年一项针对国际健康经济学协会或 Academy Health 健康经济学特别兴趣小组的美国成员健康经济学家的调查数据。我们提供了按职位等级和雇主类型划分的健康经济学家收入的相关统计信息，并基于教育程度、工作经验、雇主类型以及研究产出情况，建立了收入的对数模型。此外，我们还提供了按雇主类型划分的新晋博士级健康经济学家预期起薪的相关统计信息。我们的研究结果与经济学系、商学院、公共卫生学院以及健康服务研究领域的类似数据进行了比较。

abstract.text: Double bounded dichotomous choice (DBDC) contingent valuation offers increased efficiency of willingness to pay (WTP) estimates compared with the single bounded format. However, evidence suggests DBDC generates anomalous respondent behaviour. This paper provides the first investigation and explanation of these anomalies in health. Results suggest the incentives for truthful preference revelation are altered in the presence of a follow up question. This result is found using both regression techniques and analysis of raw responses. Although findings suggest 'very certain' respondents exhibit less anomalous behaviour inconsistencies remain across bounds. The results of this study question the use of iterative valuation formats.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.009.abstractZh: 双边界二分选择（DBDC）意愿价值评估方法相比单一边界格式，能够提升意愿支付估计的效率。然而，有证据表明DBDC会引发异常受访者行为。本文首次对这类健康领域的异常行为进行了研究并进行了解释。研究结果表明，在存在后续问题的情况下，促使受访者真实表达偏好的激励因素会发生变化。这一结论是通过回归分析法和原始数据分析得出的。尽管研究结果表明“非常确定”的受访者表现出较少的异常行为，但在不同边界条件下仍存在不一致性。本研究的结果质疑了迭代价值评估格式的应用价值。

abstract.text: We develop an infinite horizon utility maximization model of the interaction between insurance choice and tax-preferred health savings accounts. The model can be used to examine a wide range of policy options, including flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, and health reimbursement accounts. We also develop a 2-period model to simulate various implications of the model. Key results from the simulation analysis include the following: (1) with no adverse selection, use of unrestricted health savings accounts leads to modest welfare gains, after accounting for the tax revenue loss; (2) with adverse selection and an initial pooling equilibrium comprised of "sick" and "healthy" consumers, introducing HSAs can, but does not necessarily, lead to a new pooling equilibrium. The new equilibrium results in a higher coinsurance rate, an increase in expected utility for healthy consumers, and a decrease in expected utility for sick consumers; (3) with adverse selection and a separating equilibrium, both sick and healthy consumers are better off with a health savings account; (4) efficiency gains are possible when insurance contracts are explicitly linked to tax-preferred health savings accounts.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.010.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个无限视界效用最大化模型，用于研究保险选择与税收优惠健康储蓄账户之间的互动关系。该模型可用于考察多种政策选项，包括灵活支出账户、健康储蓄账户和健康报销账户。我们还开发了一个两期模型，以模拟该模型的各种影响。模拟分析得出的关键结果包括以下几点：(1)在没有逆向选择的情况下，使用不受限制的健康储蓄账户可以在扣除税收损失后带来适度的福利收益；(2)在存在逆向选择且初始的集中均衡由“患病”和“健康”消费者组成的情况下，引入健康储蓄账户可能会，但不一定会导致新的集中均衡。新的均衡结果表现为更高的共同承担比例、健康消费者的预期效用增加，而患病消费者的预期效用下降；(3)在存在逆向选择且存在分离均衡的情况下，无论患病还是健康消费者，使用健康储蓄账户都会使他们受益；(4)当保险合同与税收优惠健康储蓄账户明确关联时，效率提升是可能的。

abstract.text: Two-tier charging, the practice of offering separate qualities of service at different prices, is a growing practice in public hospitals internationally. This paper models two-tier charging as a Stackelberg game in which the Ministry of Health leads by setting prices and a representative hospital follows by setting quality levels to maximise surplus in response. Whether or not two-tier charging will secure cross-subsidy from superior to basic service users depends on the own and cross-quality effects of the demand functions for the two services. Under a range of assumptions, the policy will evoke cross-subsidy from basic to superior services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.011.abstractZh: 双层收费，即以不同价格提供不同质量服务的做法，正在国际上越来越普遍地出现在公立医院中。本文将双层收费建模为斯塔克伯格博弈，其中卫生部通过设定价格来主导市场，而代表性医院则通过设定服务质量水平来最大化收益。双层收费是否能够从高级服务用户向基础服务用户进行交叉补贴，取决于两种服务需求函数的自身效应和交叉效应。在一系列假设条件下，该政策将促使基础服务向高级服务进行交叉补贴。

abstract.text: Infertility currently affects over 6 million individuals in the United States. While most health insurance plans nationwide do not cover infertility diagnoses or treatments, to date 15 states have enacted some form of infertility insurance mandate. In this paper, I use data from the Vital Statistics Detail Natality Data and Census population estimates to examine whether these state-level mandates were successful in increasing fertility rates. Using a difference-in-differences approach, I exploit variation in the enactment of mandates both across states and over time, and identify treatment and control groups that should have been differentially affected by infertility coverage. My results suggest that the mandates significantly increase first birth rates for women over 35, and these results are robust to a number of specification tests.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.012.abstractZh: 目前，美国有超过600万人受到不孕不育的影响。尽管全国大多数健康保险计划并不涵盖不孕不育的诊断或治疗，但迄今为止已有15个州实施了某种形式的不孕不育保险强制规定。在本文中，我利用《生命统计详细出生数据》和人口普查人口估计数据，来研究这些州级强制规定是否成功提高了生育率。通过差异-差异分析法，我利用各州之间以及随时间推移的强制规定实施情况的差异，识别出那些应该受到不孕不育保险覆盖差异影响的治疗组和对照组。我的研究结果表明，这些强制规定显著提高了35岁以上女性的首次生育率，且这些结果在多次规范检验中均保持稳定。

abstract.text: In rational addiction theory, higher discount rates encourage drug use. We test this hypothesis in the general framework of rationality and behaviour under risk. We do so using an experimental design with real monetary incentives. The decisions of 34 drug addicts are compared with those of a control group. The decisions of drug users (DU) are not any less consistent with standard theories of behaviour over time and under risk. Further, there is no difference in the estimated discount rate between drug users and the control group, but the former do appear to be more risk-seeking.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.11.001.abstractZh: 在理性成瘾理论中，较高的折现率会促进药物使用。我们在风险下的理性与行为框架内对这一假设进行了测试。我们采用了带有实际货币激励的实验设计。对34名药物成瘾者的决策与对照组进行了比较。药物使用者的决策在时间和风险条件下并不比标准行为理论所描述的更不一致。此外，药物使用者与对照组之间的估计折现率没有差异，但前者似乎更倾向于冒险行为。

abstract.text: We consider a therapeutic market with potentially three pharmaceutical firms. Two of the firms offer horizontally differentiated brand-name drugs. One of the brand-name drugs is a new treatment under patent protection that will be introduced if the profits are sufficient to cover the entry costs. The other brand-name drug has already lost its patent and faces competition from a third firm offering a generic version perceived to be of lower quality. This model allows us to compare generic reference pricing (GRP), therapeutic reference pricing (TRP), and no reference pricing (NRP). We show that competition is strongest under TRP, resulting in the lowest drug prices (and medical expenditures). However, TRP also provides the lowest profits to the patent-holding firm, making entry of the new drug treatment least likely. Surprisingly, we find that GRP distorts drug choices most, exposing patients to higher health risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.11.003.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个可能由三家制药公司构成的治疗市场。其中两家公司提供横向差异化的品牌药品。其中一款品牌药品是一种处于专利保护下的新疗法，只有在利润足以覆盖进入成本的情况下才会被引入市场。另一款品牌药品已经失去了专利保护，并面临着第三家提供仿制药的公司的竞争，而仿制药被认为质量较低。这个模型使我们能够比较仿制药参考定价、治疗参考定价和无参考定价。我们发现，在参考定价下竞争最为激烈，从而导致药品价格（以及医疗支出）最低。然而，参考定价也使得持有专利的公司获得最低的利润，使得新疗法的进入可能性最低。令人惊讶的是，我们发现仿制药参考定价对患者的药物选择产生了最大的扭曲，使患者面临更高的健康风险。

abstract.text: In this paper we argue that the usual framework for evaluating health services may need modification in the context of a National Health Scheme (NHS). Some costs and benefits may need to be ignored or discounted, others included at face value, and some transfer payments included in the decision algorithm. In contrast with the standard framework, we argue that economic evaluation in the context of an NHS should focus on 'social transfers' between taxpayers and beneficiaries, and that the nature and scope of these transfers is determined by the level of social generosity.
