Some of the implications of a modified framework are illustrated with a re-examination of (i) costs and transfer payments, (ii) unrelated future costs, (iii) moral hazard, and (iv) the rule that marginal costs should equal marginal benefits. We argue that an explicitly 'fairness-based' framework is needed for the evaluation of services in an NHS. In contrast, the usual welfare economic theoretic framework facilitates the sidelining of issues of fairness.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.11.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们认为，在国民健康计划（NHS）的框架下，评估健康服务的常规框架可能需要调整。某些成本和收益可能需要被忽略或折现，而其他成本和收益则应按其实际价值纳入考量，同时一些转移支付也需纳入决策算法中。与标准框架不同，我们认为，在NHS的框架下，经济评估应重点关注纳税人与受益者之间的“社会转移支付”，而这些转移的性质与范围则取决于社会的慷慨程度。通过重新审视以下方面，可以说明这种调整框架的一些含义：(i) 成本和转移支付；(ii) 不相关的未来成本；(iii) 道德风险；以及(iv) 边际成本应等于边际收益的法则。我们认为，对于NHS中的服务评估而言，需要一个明确的“公平基础”框架。相比之下，传统的福利经济理论框架则容易导致公平问题被忽视。

abstract.text: Many years of concerted policy effort in Western countries has not prevented young people from experimenting with cigarettes, alcohol and marijuana. One potential explanation is that social interactions make consumption "sticky". We use detailed panel data from the Add Health survey to examine risky behavior (the consumption of tobacco, alcohol and marijuana) by American adolescents. We find that, even controlling for school fixed effects, these behaviors are correlated with lagged peer group behavior. Peer group effects are strongest for alcohol use, and young males are more influential than young females. Last, we present some evidence of non-linearities in social interactions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.11.005.abstractZh: 多年来，西方国家的政策努力并未阻止年轻人尝试香烟、酒精和大麻。一种可能的解释是，社会互动使得这些行为的消费变得“难以割舍”。我们利用Add Health调查的详细面板数据，研究美国青少年对烟草、酒精和大麻的消费行为。研究发现，即使控制了学校固定效应，这些行为仍与同伴群体的行为存在相关性。在酒精消费方面，同伴群体的影响最为显著，且年轻男性比年轻女性更具影响力。最后，我们发现了社会互动中存在非线性关系的证据。

abstract.text: This paper analyses whether GPs in a capitation system have incentives to provide quality even though health is a credence good. A model is developed where the quality of the service varies due to inherent differences between the GPs and rational patients make choices based on the outcome of treatment. We find that it is difficult to provide appropriate incentives since the search activity of patients offsets direct effects of a change in reimbursement. Variation in the inherent ability of the GPs is good since it increases the search activity of the patients and the optimal reimbursement scheme is inversely proportional to the dispersion in types. Finally, we find that offering a menu of contracts can potentially increase social welfare above the level of a simple capitation regime, but it tends to lead to a higher variation in quality levels.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.001.abstractZh: 本文分析了在按服务费用付费的体系中，全科医生是否有动力提供高质量的服务，尽管健康服务属于信用商品。我们建立了一个模型，其中服务的质量因全科医生之间的固有差异而有所不同，而理性患者会根据治疗结果做出选择。我们发现，由于患者的搜索行为会抵消费用变化的直接影响，因此很难提供适当的激励措施。全科医生自身能力的差异是有益的，因为这会增加患者的搜索活动，而最优的报销方案与服务质量类型的分散程度成反比。最后，我们发现，提供多种合同方案有可能提高社会福祉，但可能会导致服务质量水平的更大差异。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between health care expenditure, income, and other factors that are not related to income for China with pooled cross-section and time series data. To study the stationarity property of these variables, we use panel Lagrange Multiplier (LM) unit root tests that allow for structural changes. To perform the LM unit root tests, we employ finite-sample critical values derived through the bootstrap method, instead of relying on the critical values from the asymptotic normal distribution. An important finding based on the estimated panel cointegrated regressions is that the government budget deficits have a significant long-run impact on China's health care expenditure. This provides supportive evidence on the differences between rich and poor areas in China's health care financing policy, and the substantial disparities in health service coverage in China.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.002.abstractZh: 本文利用汇总的交叉截面数据和时间序列数据，研究了中国医疗保健支出、收入以及其他与收入无关的因素之间的关系。为了研究这些变量的平稳性，我们采用了允许结构变化的面板拉格朗日乘数法单位根检验。在进行单位根检验时，我们采用了通过自助法得到的有限样本临界值，而不是依赖渐近正态分布的临界值。基于估计的面板协整回归结果，我们发现政府预算赤字对中国医疗保健支出有显著的长期影响。这一发现为分析中国富裕地区和贫困地区在医疗保健融资政策上的差异，以及中国医疗服务覆盖范围的巨大差异提供了支持性证据。

abstract.text: Between 1991 and 1998 English general practices had the option of holding budgets for prescribing and elective secondary care. Fundholding was reintroduced in 2005. We examine the effect of fundholding on patients' satisfaction with their practice, using a cross section of 4441 patients from 60 practices in the last year of fundholding (1998). We employ instrumental variables to allow for the endogeneity of fundholding. Patients of fundholders were less satisfied with the opening hours of their practice, their GP's knowledge of their medical history, with their GP's ability to arrange tests and willingness to refer to a specialist, and were more likely to agree that their doctor was more concerned about keeping costs down. Fundholder practices performed better on a number of process measures of care, and fundholding patients were more satisfied with additional non-medical services provided by the practice. The probability that patients were overall at least very satisfied with their GP practice was 0.073 (95% CI, 0.009-0.138) smaller in fundholding practices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.003.abstractZh: 在1991年至1998年间，英国的一般诊所可以选择为处方和选择性二级护理制定预算。2005年，诊所拥有资金制度重新被引入。本研究通过调查60家诊所中4441名患者，以考察诊所拥有资金制度对患者满意度的影响。我们使用工具变量法来消除诊所拥有资金制度的内生性影响。结果显示，拥有资金的诊所的患者对诊所的营业时间、全科医生对其病史的了解程度、全科医生安排检查的能力以及转诊专科医生的意愿表示不满，而更倾向于认为医生更关心控制成本。拥有资金的诊所在多项护理流程指标上表现更好，且患者更满意诊所提供的其他非医疗服务。总体而言，拥有资金的诊所患者对其全科诊所的满意度降低了0.073倍（95%置信区间：0.009-0.138）。

abstract.text: In this paper, we consider statistical distributions of different types of patients on the patient lists of doctors. In our framework different types of patients have different preferences regarding their preferred choice of doctor. Assuming that the system is benefit efficient in the sense that distributions with larger total utility have higher probability, we can construct unique probability measures describing the statistical distribution of the different types of patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们考虑了医生患者名单上不同类型患者的统计分布。在我们的框架中，不同类型的患者对于他们偏好的医生有不同的偏好。假设该系统在效益上是有效的，即总效用较大的分布具有更高的概率，我们可以构建独特的概率度量来描述不同类型患者的统计分布。

abstract.text: This paper tests the hypothesis that education improves health and increases people's life expectancy. It does so by analyzing the effect of education on smoking behaviors. To account for the endogeneity of smoking, the analysis develops an instrumental variable approach which relies on the fact that during the Vietnam War college attendance provided a strategy to avoid the draft. The results indicate that education does affect smoking decisions: educated individuals are less likely to smoke, and among those who initiated smoking, they are more likely to have stopped.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.005.abstractZh: 本文检验了教育能够改善健康状况并延长人们寿命的假设。通过分析教育对吸烟行为的影响，本文探讨了这一假设。为了考虑吸烟的内生性，研究采用了工具变量法，该方法基于这样一个事实：在越南战争期间，上大学是一种避免服兵役的策略。研究结果表明，教育确实会影响吸烟决策：受过教育的人吸烟的可能性较低，而在开始吸烟的人群中，他们更有可能戒烟。

abstract.text: This paper, using a difference-in-differences method, tries to quantify the long-term effects of China's 1959-1961 famine on the health and economic status of the survivors. We find that the great famine caused serious health and economic consequences for the survivors, especially for those in early childhood during the famine. Our estimates show that on average, in the absence of the famine, individuals of the 1959 birth cohort would have otherwise grown 3.03 cm taller in adulthood. The famine also greatly impacted the labor supply and earnings of the survivors with famine exposure during their early childhood.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.006.abstractZh: 本文采用差异-差异方法，试图量化1959-1961年中国饥荒对幸存者健康和经济状况的长期影响。研究发现，这场大饥荒对幸存者造成了严重的健康和经济后果，尤其是那些在饥荒期间处于幼年期的个体。我们的估计显示，如果没有发生饥荒，1959年出生的一代个体在成年后平均会增长3.03厘米。此外，饥荒还严重影响了幸存者在幼年时期遭受饥荒影响的人的劳动力供应和收入。

abstract.text: A key issue in health state valuation modelling is the choice of functional form. The two most frequently used preference based instruments adopt different approaches; one based on multi-attribute utility theory (MAUT), the other on statistical analysis. There has been no comparison of these alternative approaches in the context of health economics. We report a comparison of these approaches for the health utilities index mark 2. The statistical inference model predicts more accurately than the one based on MAUT. We discuss possible explanations for the differences in performance, the importance of the findings, and implications for future research.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.007.abstractZh: 在健康状态估值建模中，选择功能形式是一个关键问题。两种最常用的基于偏好的方法采用了不同的方法：一种基于多属性效用理论（MAUT），另一种基于统计分析。在健康经济学领域，这些替代方法之间尚未进行过比较。我们报告了这两种方法在健康效用指数标记2上的比较结果。统计推断模型比基于MAUT的方法预测更为准确。我们讨论了性能差异的可能原因、研究结果的重要性以及对未来研究的意义。

abstract.text: We empirically investigate the determinants of local authority mental health expenditure in England. We adopt a reduced form demand and supply model, extended to incorporate possible interaction among authorities, as well as unobserved heterogeneity. The model is estimated using an annual panel dataset that allows us to explore both time-series and cross-municipality variation in mental health expenditure. Results are consistent with some degree of interdependence between neighbouring municipalities in spending decisions. This first attempt to apply spatial panels in investigating health expenditure offers insights and raises new questions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.008.abstractZh: 我们通过实证研究探讨了英格兰地方政府心理健康支出决定因素。我们采用了一种简化形式的需求与供给模型，并扩展该模型以纳入各地方政府之间的相互作用以及未观察到的异质性。该模型使用年度面板数据集进行估计，使我们能够同时分析心理健康支出的时间序列变化以及不同市政当局之间的差异。研究结果表明，相邻市政当局在支出决策上存在一定程度的相互依赖关系。这是首次尝试利用空间面板模型来研究健康支出问题，不仅提供了一些见解，也提出了新的问题。

abstract.text: A substantial proportion of working age individuals in Britain are looking after sick, disabled or elderly people, often combining their work and caring responsibilities. Previous research has shown that informal care is linked with substantial opportunity costs for the individual due to forgone wages as a result of non-labour market participation. In this paper we show that informal carers exhibit further disadvantages even when participating. Using the British Household Panel Study (BHPS) we decompose wage differentials and show that carers can expect lower returns for a given set of characteristics, with this wage penalty varying along the pay distribution and by gender. Furthermore, opportunity costs from forgone wages and wage penalties are estimated and found to be substantial.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.12.009.abstractZh: 在英国，相当一部分处于工作年龄的人负责照顾生病、残疾或年老的人，他们往往同时承担工作和照顾的责任。先前的研究表明，非正规照顾工作会导致个人因不参与劳动力市场而损失大量工资，从而产生巨大的机会成本。本文指出，即使参与非正规照顾工作，照顾者仍然面临更多的不利条件。通过英国家庭面板研究数据，我们分析了工资差异，发现照顾者在特定特征下获得的回报较低，这种工资损失在工资分布的不同层次以及性别差异上都有所体现。此外，我们估算了因工资损失而产生的机会成本，发现这一成本相当可观。

abstract.text: The regular general practitioner scheme was introduced in Norway in 2001. A patient list system in combination with a partial per capita financing system for primary physician services was then introduced. The focus of this research was to study how the patient list system influences patients' accessibility to primary physicians, and how the system influences primary physicians' service production. We studied two possibilities: First, some physicians can have an incentive to acquire a long patient list in order to ensure a high unearned income from per capita payment. This can lead to rationing of consultations. Second, physicians with short lists can have an incentive to increase their service production per consultation in order to compensate for lack of income. This leads to increased costs. The research questions were investigated empirically using two large sets of national data. Two of the main findings were that long lists do not lead to rationing, and short lists do not increase service production per consultation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.01.001.abstractZh: 挪威在2001年引入了常规全科医生制度。随后，该制度结合了患者名单系统和对初级医生服务的部分人均资助制度。本研究旨在探讨患者名单系统如何影响患者获得初级医生服务的机会，以及该系统如何影响初级医生的服务提供。我们研究了两种可能性：首先，一些医生可能会为了获得较高的人均收入而获取较长的患者名单，这可能导致咨询服务的分配不均。其次，拥有较短患者名单的医生可能会为了弥补收入不足而增加每次咨询的服务量，但这会导致成本上升。通过两组大量国家数据的实证分析，我们得出了两个主要结论：较长的患者名单并不会导致咨询服务的分配不均，而较短的患者名单也不会增加每次咨询的服务量。

abstract.text: Based on prior research showing that people underestimate the influence of motivational states they are not currently experiencing, we predicted and found that heroin addicts would value an extra dose of the heroin substitute Buprenorphine more highly when they were currently craving (right before receiving BUP) than when they were currently satiated (right after receiving BUP) -- even when the extra BUP was to be received 5 days later. If addicts cannot appreciate the intensity of craving when they are not currently experiencing it, as these results suggest, it seems unlikely that those who have never experienced craving could predict its motivational force. Under-appreciation of craving by non-addicts may contribute to initial decisions to experiment with drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.01.002.abstractZh: 基于先前的研究表明，人们往往低估了当前未经历到的动机状态的影响，我们预测并发现，海洛因成瘾者在当前渴望时（在接收BUP之前）会比当前满足时（在接收BUP之后）更重视额外的BUP剂量——即使这种额外的BUP将在5天后才被提供。如果这些结果表明，成瘾者无法体会到未经历渴望时的渴望强度，那么那些从未经历过渴望的人似乎也不太可能预测到这种动机的力量。非成瘾者对渴望的低估可能会导致最初尝试使用药物的决策。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship that social fraternity and sorority membership has with binge drinking incidence and frequency among 18-24 year old full-time 4-year college students who participated in the 1995 National College Health Risk Behavior Survey. To net out unobserved heterogeneity, several measures of situational and total alcohol use are entered into the regressions as explanatory variables. Fraternity membership coefficients are substantially reduced in size, but remain large and highly significant, suggesting a causal effect on binge drinking. Otherwise, the estimates identify idiosyncratic selection into fraternities and binge drinking across students with similar overall drinking profiles. Particularly notable is that behavior by underage students appears to drive the relationship.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.01.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社交联谊会会员身份与18-24岁全日制四年制大学学生酗酒发生率和频率之间的关系，这些学生参与了1995年全国大学健康风险行为调查。为了消除未观测到的异质性，将多种情境和总体酒精使用指标作为解释变量纳入回归分析。结果显示，加入联谊会的学生的酗酒发生率显著降低，但依然保持较高水平且具有显著意义，这表明联谊会会员身份对酗酒有因果效应。此外，估计结果还显示，具有相似总体饮酒行为的学生在加入联谊会时，酗酒的发生率也呈现出特定的选择趋势。特别值得注意的是，未成年学生的行为似乎主导了这种关系。

abstract.text: We test for effects of tort liability on the use of certain diagnostic procedures, where the health care providers' expected cost of litigation is proxied by the risk-sharing arrangements agreed with their insurers. 2SLS and GMM estimators are adopted to test for possible endogeneity of these risk-sharing arrangements. Our findings are consistent with the exercise of liability-induced discretion by hospitals, especially regarding use of costly diagnostic imaging procedures. Hospitals facing higher expected costs per claim as a consequence of higher deductibles used these tests more frequently, after controlling for activity levels and casemix. These results are consistent with hospitals reacting to the incentives provided by a clinical negligence compensation system.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.01.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了侵权责任对某些诊断程序使用的影响，其中医疗服务提供者预期的诉讼成本通过其与保险公司达成的风险分担协议来反映。采用2SLS和GMM估计方法，以检验这些风险分担协议可能存在的内生性。我们的研究结果与医院因侵权责任而行使自由裁量权的情况一致，尤其是在使用昂贵的诊断成像程序方面。在控制了活动水平和案件类型后，那些因较高的免赔额而面临更高预期成本的医院更频繁地采用这些测试。这些结果与医院对临床过失赔偿制度所提供的激励作出的反应一致。

abstract.text: I use changes in immigrant eligibility for food stamps under the 1996 federal law and heterogeneous state responses to set up a natural experiment research design to study the effect of food stamps on Body Mass Index (BMI) of adults in immigrant families. I find that in the post-1996 period food stamps use by foreign-born unmarried mothers with a high school or lower education was 10 percentage points higher in states with substitute programs than in states that implemented the federal ban. However, this increase in FSP participation was not associated with any statistically significant difference in BMI. I find that FSP participation was associated a statistically insignificant 0.3% increase in BMI among low-educated unmarried mothers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.01.006.abstractZh: 我利用1996年联邦法律中关于移民资格变更对食品券使用的影响，以及各州对食品券政策的不同反应，构建了一个自然实验研究设计，以探讨食品券对移民家庭成年人体重指数（BMI）的影响。研究发现，在1996年之后，拥有高中或更低学历的外国出生未婚母亲在实行替代性计划的州，使用食品券的比例比实施联邦禁令的州高出10个百分点。然而，这种食品券使用率的上升并未与体重指数的任何统计学意义上的差异相关。此外，我还发现，在受教育程度较低的未婚母亲中，食品券的使用率与体重指数增加了0.3个百分点，但这种关联并不显著。

abstract.text: This article introduces an empirical strategy to the compensating differentials literature that (i) allows both individual observed and unobserved characteristics to be rewarded differently in firms based on health insurance provision, and (ii) selection to jobs that provide benefits to operate on both sides of the labor market. Estimates of this model are used to directly test empirical assumptions that are made with popular econometric strategies in the health economics literature. Our estimates reject the assumptions underlying numerous cross sectional and longitudinal estimators. We find that the provision of health insurance has influenced wage inequality. Finally, our results suggest there have been substantial changes in how displaced workers sort to firms that offer health insurance benefits over the past two decades. We discuss the implications of our findings for the compensating differentials literature.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.02.001.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种针对补偿差异文献的实证策略，该策略能够：(i) 根据健康保险提供情况，对个体观察到的及未观察到的特征进行不同的奖励；(ii) 选择能够带来利益的工作岗位，从而在劳动力市场的双方都获得优势。通过对该模型的估计，可以直接检验健康经济学文献中常用的计量经济策略所提出的假设。我们的估计结果否定了众多横截面和纵向估计方法所依据的假设。我们发现，健康保险提供情况对工资不平等产生了影响。最后，我们的研究结果表明，在过去二十年里，被取代的工人选择提供健康保险福利的公司的方式发生了显著变化。我们讨论了这些发现对补偿差异文献的意义。

abstract.text: It has been observed that specialist physicians who work in private hospitals are usually paid by fee-for-service while specialist physicians who work in public hospitals are usually paid by salary. This paper provides an explanation for this observation. Essentially, fee-for-service aligns the interests of income preferring specialists with profit maximizing private hospitals and results in private hospitals treating a high proportion of short stay patients. On the other hand, salary aligns the interests of fairness preferring specialists with benevolent public hospitals that commit to admit all patients irrespective of their expected length of stay.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.02.002.abstractZh: 有观察指出，在私立医院工作的专科医生通常按服务收费的方式获得报酬，而在公立医院工作的专科医生则通常按工资形式获得报酬。本文对此现象进行了解释。本质上，按服务收费的方式使得倾向于获取收入的专科医生与追求利润最大化的私立医院产生利益一致，因此私立医院会收治大量短期住院的患者。而按工资形式支付报酬则使得倾向于公平对待患者的专科医生与致力于收治所有患者的公立医院产生利益一致，公立医院会尽力收治所有患者，而不考虑患者的预期住院时间。

abstract.text: This study examines the relationship between time discounting, other sources of time preference, and choices about smoking. Using a survey fielded for our analysis, we elicit rates of time discount from choices in financial and health domains. We also examine the relationship between other determinants of time preference and smoking status. We find very high rates of time discount in the financial realm for a horizon of 1 year, irrespective of smoking status. In the health domain, the implied rates of time discount decline with the length of the time delay (hyperbolic discounting) and the sign of the payoff (the sign effect). We use a series of questions about the willingness to undergo a colonoscopy to elicit short- and long-run rates of discount in a quasi-hyperbolic discounting framework, finding no evidence that short-run and long-run rates of discount differ by smoking status. Using more general measures of time preference, i.e., impulsivity and length of financial planning horizon, smokers are more impatient. However, neither of these measures is significantly correlated with the measures of time discounting. Our results indicate that subjective rates of time discount revealed through committed choice scenarios are not related to differences in smoking behavior. Rather, a combination of more general measures of time preference and self-control, i.e., impulsivity and financial planning, are more closely related to the smoking decision.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.02.004.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了时间折扣、其他时间偏好来源与吸烟选择之间的关系。通过一项调查收集数据，我们从金融和健康领域的选择中得出时间折扣率。我们还考察了其他时间偏好因素与吸烟状态之间的关系。研究发现，在1年的时间范围内，金融领域的時間折扣率非常高，且不受吸烟状态的影响。在健康领域，时间折扣率随着时间延迟的长度（超线性折扣）和收益的符号（符号效应）而变化。我们通过一系列关于接受结肠镜检查意愿的问题，在准超线性折扣框架下得出短期和长期折扣率，未发现短期和长期折扣率因吸烟状态而异的证据。使用更一般的时间偏好指标，即冲动性和金融规划的时间范围，发现吸烟者更加不耐烦。然而，这些指标与时间折扣指标之间没有显著相关性。我们的结果表明，通过承诺选择情景揭示的主观时间折扣率与吸烟行为的差异无关。相反，更一般的时间偏好指标与自我控制能力，即冲动性和金融规划，与吸烟决策更为相关。

abstract.text: We use the Vietnam war draft avoidance behavior documented by Card and Lemieux [Card, D., Lemieux, T., May 2001. Did draft avoidance raise college attendance during the Vietnam war? American Economic Review 91 (2), 97-102] as a quasi experiment to infer causation from education to smoking and find strong evidence that education, whether measured in years of completed schooling or in educational attainment categories, reduces the probability of smoking at the time of the interview, more particularly the probability of smoking regularly. However, while we find that more education substantially increases the probability of never smoking, our instrumental procedure yields imprecise estimates of the effect of education on smoking cessation. Potential mechanisms linking education and smoking are also explored.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.03.004.abstractZh: 我们采用Card和Lemieux在2001年5月发表的论文《越南战争期间避免征兵的行为是否提高了大学入学率？》中记录的资料，将其作为一项准实验，以从教育到吸烟的因果关系进行推断。研究发现，无论以完成学年的数量还是以教育成就类别来衡量，教育程度都显著降低了受访时吸烟的概率，尤其是定期吸烟的概率。然而，尽管我们发现更高的教育程度显著增加了从不吸烟的概率，但我们的工具变量方法导致对教育对戒烟影响的估计不够精确。此外，我们还探讨了教育与吸烟之间的潜在机制。

abstract.text: In the conventional quality adjusted life year (QALY) model, people's preferences are assumed to satisfy utility independence. When health varies over time, utility independence implies that the value attached to a health state is independent of the health state that arise before or after it. Two separate studies were conducted involving a total of 155 respondents. In study one, we conducted five tests of utility independence using a standard gamble question. Three of the tests of utility independence were repeated in study two after randomisation was introduced in order to take account of possible ordering effects. Utility independence holds in the majority of cases examined here and so our work generally supports the use of utility independence to derive more tractable models.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.04.002.abstractZh: 在传统的质量调整生命年（QALY）模型中，人们的需求被假设为满足效用独立性。当健康状况随时间变化时，效用独立性意味着对某种健康状态的评价与其之前或之后出现的健康状态无关。两项独立的研究共涉及155名受访者。在第一项研究中，我们使用标准赌博问题进行了五次效用独立性测试。在第二项研究中，为了在考虑可能的排序效应后，其中三项效用独立性测试被重复进行。在大多数被研究的案例中，效用独立性都成立，因此我们的工作总体上支持使用效用独立性来构建更易于处理的模型。

abstract.text: The magnitude of provider uncompensated care has become an important public policy issue. Yet existing measures of uncompensated care are flawed because they compare uninsured payments to list prices, not to the prices actually paid by the insured. We address this issue using a novel source of data from a vendor that processes financial data for almost 4000 physicians. We measure uncompensated care as the net amount that physicians lose by lower payments from the uninsured than from the insured. Our best estimate is that physicians provide negative uncompensated care to the uninsured, earning more on uninsured patients than on insured patients with comparable treatments. Even our most conservative estimates suggest that uncompensated care amounts to only 0.8% of revenues, or at most $3.2 billion nationally. These results highlight the important distinction between charges and payments, and point to the need for a re-definition of uncompensated care in the health sector going forward.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.08.001.abstractZh: 提供方未获补偿的医疗服务规模已成为一个重要的公共政策问题。然而，现有的未补偿医疗服务衡量方法存在缺陷，因为它们是将未投保患者的支付金额与标价进行比较，而不是与投保患者实际支付的金额进行比较。我们借助一家处理近4000名医生财务数据的供应商提供的新数据来源来解决这个问题。我们将未补偿医疗服务定义为医生因从未投保患者处获得的支付金额低于从投保患者处获得的支付金额而损失的净金额。我们的最佳估计是，医生对未投保患者提供的未补偿医疗服务为负值，即在未投保患者身上获得的收益高于在投保患者身上获得的收益，即使是在类似的治疗情况下也是如此。即使是我们最保守的估计也表明，未补偿医疗服务的金额仅占总收入的0.8%，全国范围内最多为32亿美元。这些结果凸显了收费与支付之间的重要区别，并指出了未来需要在医疗领域重新定义未补偿医疗服务的重要性。

abstract.text: To customize treatments to individual patients entails costs of coordination and cognition. Thus, providers sometimes choose treatments based on norms for broad classes of patients. We develop behavioral hypotheses explaining when and why doctors customize to the particular patient, and when instead they employ "ready-to-wear" treatments. Our empirical studies examining length of office visits and physician prescribing behavior find evidence of norm-following behavior. Some such behavior, from our studies and from the literature, proves sensible; but other behavior seems far from optimal.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.08.002.abstractZh: 为每位患者定制治疗方案需要协调工作和认知努力。因此，医生有时会根据针对广泛患者群体的规范来选择治疗方案。我们提出了行为假设，以解释医生为何会在特定情况下为个别患者定制治疗方案，而何时则采用“现成”的治疗方案。我们的实证研究考察了门诊就诊时间和医生处方行为，发现存在遵循规范的倾向。其中一些行为在我们的研究和文献中被认为是合理的；但另一些行为似乎远非最优选择。

abstract.text: In designing a quality report, a health plan needs to account for the report's effect on the doctor, hospital or other provider. This paper proposes a simple model of how quality reporting affects a health care provider, using the example of a doctor subject to reporting with a "cut point" that designates the doctor as above or below some standard. Choice of cut point affects the doctor's welfare through the doctor's preferences about income and by affecting market demand for the doctor's services. These factors lead doctors to be "report-averse" or "report-loving," a determination that affects a health plan's cost to enlist a doctor in a contract with reporting and that guides choice of a cut point to maximize the doctors' effort to improve her quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.001.abstractZh: 在设计高质量报告时，健康计划需要考虑该报告对医生、医院或其他医疗服务提供者的影响。本文提出了一个简单的模型，用以说明质量报告如何影响医疗服务提供者。以一名受报告约束的医生为例，该模型设定了一个“临界点”，根据此临界点判断医生是否达到某个标准。临界点的选择会通过医生对收入的偏好以及影响市场对医生服务的需求来影响医生的福利。这些因素导致医生可能表现出“厌恶报告”或“喜欢报告”的态度，这种态度决定了健康计划在合同中引入报告机制的成本，并指导临界点的选择，以最大化医生改善自身质量的积极性。

abstract.text: This paper reexamines the efficiency-based arguments for optimal health insurance, extending the classic analysis to consider optimal coverage for prevention and treatment separately. Our paper considers the tradeoff between individuals' risk reduction on the one hand, and both ex ante and ex post moral hazard on the other. We demonstrate that it is always desirable to offer at least some insurance coverage for preventive care if individual consumers ignore the impact of their preventive care on the health premium. Using a utility-based framework, we reconfirm the conventional tradeoff between risk avoidance (by risk sharing) and moral hazard for insuring treatment goods. Uncompensated losses that reduce effective income provide a new efficiency-based argument for more generous insurance coverage for prevention and treatment of health conditions. The optimal coinsurance rates for prevention and for treatment are not identical.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.002.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了基于效率的最优健康保险论点，将经典分析扩展为分别考虑预防治疗的最优保障。我们探讨了个体风险降低与事前及事后道德风险之间的权衡。研究表明，如果个体消费者忽视预防治疗对健康保费的影响，那么提供至少部分预防保健的保险总是可取的。基于效用框架，我们再次确认了风险规避（通过风险分担）与保险治疗商品中的道德风险之间的传统权衡。未得到补偿的损失会减少实际收入，这为更全面的预防治疗健康状况的保险保障提供了新的基于效率的论据。预防治疗和治疗的理想共同保险费率并不相同。

abstract.text: Measuring the lifetime costs and benefits of medical technologies is essential in evaluating technological change and determining the productivity of medical care. Using data on Medicare beneficiaries with a heart attack in the late 1980s and 17 years of follow up data, I evaluate the long-term costs and benefits of revascularization after a heart attack. I account for non-random selection into treatment with instrumental variables; following McClellan, McNeil, and Newhouse, the instrument is the differential distance to a hospital capable of providing revascularization. The results show that revascularization is associated with over 1 year of additional life expectancy, at a cost of about $40,000. Revascularization, or other treatments correlated with it, appears to be highly cost-effective.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.003.abstractZh: 衡量医疗技术的终身成本和收益对于评估技术变革和确定医疗服务的生产力至关重要。本研究基于1980年代末心脏病发作的医疗保险受益人数据以及17年的随访数据，评估了心脏病发作后血管再通治疗的长期成本和收益。我们通过工具变量考虑了治疗选择的非随机性；根据McClellan、McNeil和Newhouse的研究，工具变量是指能够提供血管再通治疗的医院的距离差异。研究结果表明，血管再通治疗可带来超过1年的额外预期寿命，成本约为40,000美元。血管再通治疗或其他相关治疗似乎具有极高的成本效益。

abstract.text: Governments employ public disclosure strategies to reduce risks, improve public and private goods and services, and reduce injustice. In the United States, these targeted transparency policies include financial securities disclosures, nutritional labels, school report cards, automobile rollover rankings, and sexual offender registries. They constitute a light-handed approach to governance that empowers citizens. However, these policies are frequently ineffective or counterproductive. Based on a comparative analysis of eighteen major policies, the authors suggest that transparency policies often produce information that is incomplete, incomprehensible, or irrelevant to the consumers, investors, workers, and community residents who could benefit from them. Sometimes transparency fails because those who are threatened by it form political coalitions to limit or distort information. To be successful, transparency policies must place the needs of ordinary citizens at centre stage and produce information that informs their everyday choices. This title is also available as Open Access on Cambridge Core.

10.1017/9780521699617.abstractZh: 政府采用公开披露策略来降低风险、改善公共和私人产品和服务，减少不公正现象。在美国，这些有针对性的透明度政策包括金融证券披露、营养标签、学校成绩单、汽车碰撞排名以及性犯罪者登记等。这些政策是一种温和的治理方式，能够赋予公民权力。然而，这些政策往往效果不佳，甚至可能产生反效果。通过对十八项主要政策的比较分析，作者指出，透明度政策往往产生的信息不完整、难以理解，或者与那些可能从中受益的消费者、投资者、工人和社区居民无关。有时，透明度政策之所以失败，是因为那些受到威胁的人会联合起来限制或扭曲信息。要想取得成效，透明度政策必须将普通公民的需求置于中心位置，并提供能够帮助他们做出日常决策的信息。该论文也可在剑桥核心平台上以开放获取方式获取。

abstract.text: Governments in recent decades have employed public disclosure strategies to reduce risks, improve public and private goods and services, and reduce injustice. In the United States, these targeted transparency policies include financial securities disclosures, nutritional labels, school report cards, automobile rollover rankings, and sexual offender registries. They constitute a light-handed approach to governance that empowers citizens. However, as Full Disclosure shows these policies are frequently ineffective or counterproductive. Based on a comparative analysis of eighteen major policies, the authors suggest that transparency policies often produce information that is incomplete, incomprehensible, or irrelevant to the consumers, investors, workers, and community residents who could benefit from them. Sometimes transparency fails because those who are threatened by it form political coalitions to limit or distort information. To be successful, transparency policies must place the needs of ordinary citizens at centre stage and produce information that informs their everyday choices.

10.1017/cbo9780511510533.abstractZh: 近几十年来，各国政府采用公开披露策略来降低风险、改善公共和私人产品和服务，减少不公正现象。在美国，这些有针对性的透明度政策包括金融证券披露、营养标签、学校成绩单、汽车碰撞排名以及性犯罪者登记等。这些政策是一种温和的治理方式，能够赋予公民权力。然而，正如《全面披露》一书所指出的，这些政策往往无效或产生反效果。通过对十八项主要政策的比较分析，作者认为透明度政策往往产生的信息不完整、难以理解，或者与那些可能从中受益的消费者、投资者、工人和社区居民无关。有时，透明度政策之所以失败，是因为那些受到威胁的人会联合起来限制或扭曲信息。要想取得成效，透明度政策必须将普通公民的需求置于中心位置，并提供能够帮助他们做出日常决策的信息。

abstract.text: A 58-year-old man has chest pain at 9:30 a.m.; 3 hours later, he calls for an ambulance. Paramedics arrive, provide standard treatment, and transport him to the nearest emergency department. On his arrival at a small hospital at 1 p.m., the findings are diagnostic of a myocardial infarction with ST-segment elevation. The emergency department physician recommends immediate transfer to a hospital 1 hour away for primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).

10.1056/nejmct063503.abstractZh: 一名58岁的男子在上午9:30出现胸痛，3小时后他呼叫了救护车。急救人员到达后，进行了标准治疗，并将他送往最近的急诊室。下午1点，他在一家小型医院被诊断出患有ST段抬高的心肌梗死。急诊室的医生建议立即转往1小时车程外的医院进行经皮冠状动脉介入治疗。

abstract.text: Emerging market business cycles exhibit strongly countercyclical current accounts, consumption volatility that exceeds income volatility, and “sudden stops” in capital inflows. These features contrast with developed small open economies. Nevertheless, we show that a standard model characterizes both types of markets. Motivated by the frequent policy regime switches observed in emerging markets, our premise is that these economies are subject to substantial volatility in trend growth. Our methodology exploits the information in consumption and net exports to identify the persistence of productivity. We find that shocks to trend growth—rather than transitory fluctuations around a stable trend—are the primary source of fluctuations in emerging markets. The key features of emerging market business cycles are then shown to be consistent with this underlying income process in an otherwise standard equilibrium model.

10.1086/511283.abstractZh: 新兴市场的商业周期表现出强烈的逆周期特征，包括经常账户波动大于收入波动，以及资本流入的“突然停止”。这些特征与发达的小型开放经济体形成对比。尽管如此，我们证明了一个标准模型能够同时描述这两种市场。鉴于新兴市场频繁的政策变动，我们的假设是这些经济体的趋势增长存在显著的波动性。我们的研究方法利用消费和净出口的信息来识别生产力的持续性。我们发现，新兴市场波动的主要来源是趋势增长的冲击，而非围绕稳定趋势的短暂波动。因此，新兴市场商业周期的关键特征与这种基础收入过程在标准的均衡模型中是一致的。

abstract.text: Household investment leads nonresidential business fixed investment over the U.S. business cycle. Because real business cycle theory has not been able to account for this observation, it represents a potent challenge to the view that transitory productivity disturbances are the main source of aggregate fluctuations. This paper reconciles RBC theory with the investment dynamics by extending the traditional home production model to make household capital complementary to business capital and labor in market production. Empirical evidence suggesting that household capital is a complementary input in market production is also presented.

10.1086/511994.abstractZh: 家庭投资在美国经济周期中占据非住宅性商业固定投资的主体地位。由于实际商业周期理论无法解释这一现象，这对该观点构成了有力挑战——即认为短暂的生产率波动是总波动的主要来源。本文通过将传统家庭生产模型扩展，使家庭资本与商业资本和劳动力在市场生产中形成互补关系，从而调和了实际商业周期理论与投资动态之间的关系。同时，本文还提供了实证证据，表明家庭资本是市场生产中的互补要素。

abstract.text: For industries ranging from software to pharmaceuticals and entertainment, there is an intense debate about the appropriate level of protection for intellectual property. The Internet provides a natural crucible to assess the implications of reduced protection because it drastically lowers the cost of copying information. In this paper, we analyze whether file sharing has reduced the legal sales of music. While this question is receiving considerable attention in academia, industry, and Congress, we are the first to study the phenomenon employing data on actual downloads of music files. We match an extensive sample of downloads to U.S. sales data for a large number of albums. To establish causality, we instrument for downloads using data on international school holidays. Downloads have an effect on sales that is statistically indistinguishable from zero. Our estimates are inconsistent with claims that file sharing is the primary reason for the decline in music sales during our study period.

10.1086/511995.abstractZh: 从软件到制药和娱乐等多个行业，关于知识产权保护程度的争论十分激烈。互联网为评估降低保护程度的影响提供了一个天然的平台，因为互联网极大地降低了信息复制的成本。在本文中，我们分析了文件共享是否减少了音乐的合法销售。尽管这个问题在学术界、工业界和国会都受到了广泛关注，但我们是第一个使用实际音乐文件下载数据来研究这一现象的研究团队。我们将大量下载数据与美国大量专辑的销售额进行了匹配。为了确立因果关系，我们使用国际学校假期的数据对下载行为进行了工具变量处理。结果显示，下载对销售额的影响在统计上与零无显著差异。我们的研究结果与认为文件共享是音乐销售下降主要原因的说法不符。

abstract.text: We present a model of lawmaking by appellate courts in which judges influenced by policy preferences can distinguish precedents at some cost. We find a cost and a benefit of diversity of judicial views. Policy-motivated judges distort the law away from efficiency, but diversity of judicial views also fosters legal evolution and increases the law’s precision. We call our central finding the Cardozo theorem: even when judges are motivated by personal agendas, legal evolution is, on average, beneficial because it washes out judicial biases and renders the law more precise. Our paper provides a theoretical foundation for the evolutionary adaptability of common law.

10.1086/511996.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于上诉法院立法的模型，在这个模型中，受到政策偏好影响的法官可以在一定代价下区分判例。我们发现，司法观点的多样性既有成本也有收益。出于政策考虑的法官会扭曲法律，使其偏离效率目标，但司法观点的多样性也有助于法律的演变，并提高法律的精确性。我们将这一核心发现称为“卡多佐定理”：即使法官受到个人议程的驱动，法律的演变平均来说也是有益的，因为它能够消除司法偏见，使法律更加精确。我们的论文为普通法的进化适应性提供了理论基础。

abstract.text: A large literature in medicine documents variation across areas in the use of surgical treatments that is unrelated to outcomes. Observers of this phenomena have invoked "flat of the curve medicine" to explain these facts, and have advocated for reductions in spending in high-use areas. In contrast, we develop a simple Roy model of patient treatment choice with productivity spillovers that can generate the empirical facts. Our model predicts that high-use areas will have higher returns to surgery, better outcomes among patients most appropriate for surgery, and worse outcomes among patients least appropriate for surgery, while displaying no relationship between treatment intensity and overall outcomes. Using data on treatments for heart attacks, we find strong empirical support for these and other predictions of our model, and reject alternative explanations such as waste or supplier induced demand, for geographic variation in medical care.

10.1086/512249.abstractZh: 医学领域有大量文献记录了与治疗效果无关的手术治疗使用差异。研究这一现象的学者们提出了“平坦曲线医学”这一概念来解释这些现象，并主张减少高使用领域的医疗支出。相比之下，我们提出了一个简单的Roy模型，用于描述患者治疗选择及生产力溢出效应，该模型能够解释这些现象。我们的模型预测，高使用领域的手术将带来更高的回报，最适合手术的患者治疗效果会更好，而不适合手术的患者治疗效果则会更差，同时治疗强度与整体治疗效果之间并无关联。通过心脏病治疗的数据验证，我们发现该模型的其他预测得到了强有力的实证支持，并排除了诸如浪费或供应商诱导需求等解释，这些解释无法解释医疗服务的地理差异。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of a monetary economy in which individual firms are subject to idiosyncratic productivity shocks as well as general inflation. Sellers can change price only by incurring a real “menu cost.” We calibrate this cost and the variance and autocorrelation of the idiosyncratic shock using a new U.S. data set of individual prices due to Klenow and Kryvtsov. The prediction of the calibrated model for the effects of high inflation on the frequency of price changes accords well with international evidence from various studies. The model is also used to conduct numerical experiments on the economy’s response to various shocks. In none of the simulations we conducted did monetary shocks induce large or persistent real responses.

10.1086/512625.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个货币经济模型，其中个体企业不仅要面临特有的生产率冲击，还要面对一般性的通货膨胀。卖方只能通过承担实际的“菜单成本”来调整价格。我们采用Klenow和Kryvtsov提供的新美国个体价格数据集来校准这一成本，以及特有冲击的方差和自相关性。该模型对高通货膨胀对价格变化频率影响的预测与多项国际研究的证据相符。该模型还被用于进行数值实验，以研究经济对各种冲击的响应。在我们进行的所有模拟中，货币冲击并未导致大的或持续的实际反应。

abstract.text: This paper empirically investigates the possible market power effects of vertical integration proposed in the theoretical literature on vertical foreclosure. It uses a rich data set of cement and ready‐mixed concrete plants that spans several decades to perform a detailed case study. There is little evidence that foreclosure is quantitatively important in these industries. Instead, prices fall, quantities rise, and entry rates remain unchanged when markets become more integrated. These patterns are consistent, however, with an alternative efficiency‐based mechanism. Namely, higher‐productivity producers are more likely to vertically integrate and are also larger, more likely to survive, and more likely to charge lower prices. We find evidence that integrated producers’ productivity advantage is tied to improved logistics coordination afforded by large local concrete operations. Interestingly, this benefit is not due to firms’ vertical structures per se: nonvertical firms with large local concrete operations have similarly high productivity levels.

10.1086/514347.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究，探讨了理论文献中提出的垂直整合可能对市场力量产生的影响，以及这种整合对市场封锁的效应。研究采用了涵盖数十年数据的水泥和预拌混凝土工厂的丰富数据集，进行了详细的案例研究。结果显示，在这些行业中，市场封锁在数量上并不显著。相反，随着市场整合程度的提高，价格下降，产量上升，而进入门槛保持不变。然而，这些现象与另一种基于效率的机制相一致：生产效率较高的企业更有可能进行垂直整合，而且这些企业通常规模较大，更有可能存活下来，并且更有可能以较低的价格出售产品。我们发现，整合企业的生产效率优势与大型本地混凝土企业的物流协调能力有关。有趣的是，这种优势并非源于企业的垂直结构本身：那些拥有大型本地混凝土企业的非垂直企业，其生产效率同样较高。

abstract.text: We model happiness as a measurement tool used to rank alternative actions. Evolution favors a happiness function that measures the individual’s success in relative terms. The optimal function is based on a time-varying reference point—or performance benchmark—that is updated over time in a statistically optimal way in order to match the individual’s potential. Habits and peer comparisons arise as special cases of such an updating process. This updating also results in a volatile level of happiness that continuously reverts to its long-term mean. Throughout, we draw a parallel with a problem of optimal incentives, which allows us to apply statistical insights from agency theory to the study of happiness.

10.1086/516737.abstractZh: 我们将幸福感建模为一种用于评估不同选择的工具。进化过程倾向于选择一种能够衡量个体相对成功的幸福感函数。最优函数基于一个随时间变化的参考点或绩效基准，该基准会以统计上最优的方式随时间更新，以匹配个体的潜力。习惯和同伴比较是这种更新过程的特殊情况。这种更新还导致幸福感水平呈现出波动特性，但会不断回归到长期平均水平。在整个过程中，我们将这一模型与最优激励问题进行了类比，从而能够将代理理论中的统计洞察应用于幸福感的研究。

abstract.text: This paper presents a randomized field experiment on reducing corruption in over 600 Indonesian village road projects. I find that increasing government audits from 4 percent of projects to 100 percent reduced missing expenditures, as measured by discrepancies between official project costs and an independent engineers’ estimate of costs, by eight percentage points. By contrast, increasing grassroots participation in monitoring had little average impact, reducing missing expenditures only in situations with limited free-rider problems and limited elite capture. Overall, the results suggest that traditional top-down monitoring can play an important role in reducing corruption, even in a highly corrupt environment.

10.1086/517935.abstractZh: 本文介绍了在600多个印度尼西亚村庄道路项目中进行的随机实地实验，旨在减少腐败现象。研究发现，将政府审计比例从4%提高到100%后，通过减少官方项目成本与独立工程师估算成本之间的差异，腐败现象减少了8个百分点。相比之下，增加基层参与监督的效果较为有限，仅在存在较少搭便车问题和精英捕获现象的情况下，才有效减少了遗漏支出。总体而言，结果表明，即使在腐败严重的环境中，传统的自上而下的监督机制也能在减少腐败方面发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: We study the optimal design of organizations under the assumption that agents in a contest care about their relative position. A principal determines the number and size of status categories in order to maximize output. We first consider the pure status case without tangible prizes. Our results connect the optimal partition in status categories to properties of the distribution of ability among contestants. The top status category always contains a unique element. For distributions that have an increasing failure rate (IFR), a proliferation of status classes is optimal, whereas the optimal partition involves only two categories if the distribution of abilities is sufficiently concave. Moreover, for IFR distributions, a coarse partition with two status categories achieves at least half of the output obtained in the optimal partition with many categories. Finally, if status is derived solely from monetary rewards, we show that the optimal partition in status classes contains only two categories.

10.1086/518010.abstractZh: 我们研究了在假设参与竞争的主体关心其相对位置的情况下，组织的最优设计问题。委托人确定状态类别的数量和规模，以最大化产出。我们首先考虑没有实际奖励的纯状态情况。我们的研究结果将状态类别的最优划分与参赛者能力分布的性质联系起来。最高级别的状态类别总是包含一个独特的元素。对于具有递增失败率（IFR）的分布，增加状态类别的数量是最优的；而如果能力分布足够凹，则最优划分仅包含两个类别。此外，对于具有递增失败率的分布，一个包含两个状态类别的粗略划分至少能实现与多个类别的最优划分相当一半的产出。最后，如果状态仅由金钱奖励决定，我们表明最优的状态类别划分仅包含两个类别。

abstract.text: We explore steady-state inequality in an intergenerational model with altruistically linked individuals who experience privately observed taste shocks. When the welfare function depends only on the initial generation, efficiency requires immiseration: inequality grows without bound and everyone’s consumption converges to zero. We study other efficient allocations in which the welfare function values future generations directly, placing a positive but vanishing weight on their welfare. The social discount factor is then higher than the private one, and for any such difference we find that consumption exhibits mean reversion and that a steady-state, cross-sectional distribution for consumption and welfare exists, with no one trapped at misery.

10.1086/518741.abstractZh: 我们在一个代际模型中探讨了稳态不平等问题，该模型中的个体以利他主义的方式相互关联，并经历私人观察到的品味冲击。当福利函数仅依赖于初始代时，效率要求人们必须陷入贫困：不平等会无限增长，每个人的消费都会趋于零。我们研究了其他高效的分配方式，在这些方式中，福利函数直接衡量未来代际的福祉，并对他们的福祉赋予正但逐渐消失的权重。此时，社会折现因子高于私人折现因子，对于任何这样的差异，我们发现消费表现出均值回归现象，并且存在一个稳态的、跨截面的消费与福利分配，没有人会陷入贫困。

abstract.text: The dictator game represents a workhorse within experimental economics, frequently used to test theory and to provide insights into the prevalence of social preferences. This study explores more closely the dictator game and the literature’s preferred interpretation of its meaning by collecting data from nearly 200 dictators across treatments that varied the action set and the origin of endowment. The action set variation includes choices in which the dictator can “take” money from the other player. Empirical results question the received interpretation of dictator game giving: many fewer agents are willing to transfer money when the action set includes taking. Yet, a result that holds regardless of action set composition is that agents do not ubiquitously choose the most selfish outcome. The results have implications for theoretical models of social preferences, highlight that “institutions” matter a great deal, and point to useful avenues for future research using simple dictator games and relevant manipulations.

10.1086/519249.abstractZh: 独裁者游戏是实验经济学中不可或缺的研究工具，常被用来检验理论并揭示社会偏好的普遍性。本研究通过收集近200名参与者的数据，深入探讨了独裁者游戏及其相关理论解释。数据涵盖了不同的行动集和初始资金来源设置。行动集的变化包括独裁者可以从其他参与者那里“拿走”资金的情况。实证结果对独裁者游戏的传统解释提出了质疑：当行动集包含“拿走”资金的选择时，愿意进行资金转移的参与者数量明显减少。然而，无论行动集如何设置，一个普遍现象是参与者并不总是选择最自私的结果。这些结果对社会偏好理论模型具有启示意义，强调了“制度”的重要性，并为未来使用简单的独裁者游戏及相关操作进行研究提供了方向。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes Markov equilibria in a model of strategic lending in which (i) agents cannot commit to long-term contracts, (ii) contracts are incomplete, and (iii) incumbent lenders can coordinate their actions. Default cycles occur endogenously over time along every equilibrium path. After a sequence of bad shocks, the borrower in a competitive market accumulates debt so large that the incumbent lenders exercise monopoly power. Even though the incumbents could maintain this power forever, they find it profitable to let the borrower regain access to the competitive market after a sequence of good shocks. Equilibria are computed numerically, and their attributes are qualitatively consistent with numerous known empirical facts on sovereign lending. In addition, the model predicts that a borrower who accumulates debt overhang will regain access to the competitive credit market only after good shocks. This prediction is shown to be consistent with data on emerging market economies.

10.1086/519749.abstractZh: 本文分析了战略借贷模型中的马尔可夫均衡。该模型具有以下特点：(i) 参与者无法承诺长期合同；(ii) 合同内容不完整；(iii) 现有借贷者可以协调他们的行动。随着时间的推移，每个均衡路径上都会内生性地出现违约循环。在一系列负面冲击之后，竞争市场中的借款人会积累大量债务，以至于现有借贷者能够行使垄断权力。尽管现有借贷者可以永远保持这种权力，但他们认为让借款人在一系列正面冲击后重新进入竞争市场是盈利的。通过数值计算得到了均衡点，其特性与许多关于主权借贷的已知实证事实一致。此外，该模型预测，积累债务过剩的借款人只有在正面冲击之后才能重新进入竞争信贷市场。这一预测与新兴市场经济体的数据结果一致。

abstract.text: How should moral sanctions and moral rewards—the moral sentiments involving feelings of guilt and of virtue—be employed to govern individuals’ behavior if the objective is to maximize social welfare? In the model that we examine, guilt is a disincentive to act and virtue is an incentive because we assume that they are negative and positive sources of utility. We also suppose that guilt and virtue are costly to inculcate and are subject to certain constraints on their use. We show that the moral sentiments should be used chiefly to control externalities and further that guilt is best to employ when most harmful acts can successfully be deterred whereas virtue is best when only a few individuals can be induced to behave well. We also contrast the optimal use of guilt and virtue to optimal Pigouvian taxation and discuss extensions of our analysis.

10.1086/519927.abstractZh: 如果目标是最大化社会福利，那么应该如何运用道德制裁和道德奖励——即涉及罪恶感和美德的道德情感——来引导个体的行为？在我们研究的模型中，罪恶感是一种抑制行为的因素，而美德则是一种激励因素，因为我们认为它们是负效用和正效用的来源。我们还假设，培养和运用罪恶感与美德都需要成本，并且它们的使用受到一定的限制。我们表明，道德情感应该主要用于控制外部性，并且当大多数有害行为可以被成功阻止时，使用罪恶感最为合适；而当只有少数个体能够被引导为良好行为时，美德则最为合适。我们还比较了道德制裁与美德的最佳使用方式，以及最优的庇古税制度，并讨论了我们分析的扩展情况。

abstract.text: We study the impact of smoking cessation product advertising. To measure potential exposure, we link survey data on magazine-reading habits and smoking behavior with an archive of print advertisements. We find that smokers who are exposed to more advertising are more likely to attempt to quit and to successfully quit. While some increased quitting involves product purchases, we find that product advertisements also prompt cold turkey quitting. Identifying the causal impact of advertising is difficult because advertisers target consumers. Although reverse causality could bias our estimates upward, our baseline results are not sensitive to a series of checks.

10.1086/520065.abstractZh: 我们研究了戒烟产品广告的影响。为了衡量潜在的曝光程度，我们将关于杂志阅读习惯和吸烟行为的调查数据与印刷广告的档案数据进行了关联。我们发现，接触更多广告的吸烟者更有可能尝试戒烟，并且更有可能成功戒烟。虽然戒烟过程中部分增加是由于购买了相关产品，但我们发现产品广告也促进了突然戒烟的行为。由于广告商会针对特定消费者进行宣传，因此很难确定广告的因果效应。尽管逆向因果关系可能会使我们的估计结果偏高，但我们的基线结果并不容易受到一系列检验的干扰。

abstract.text: This paper examines the optimal allocation of risk in an overlapping-generations economy. It compares the allocation of risk the economy reaches naturally to the allocation that would be reached if generations behind a Rawlsian "veil of ignorance" could share risk with one another through complete Arrow-Debreu contingent-claims markets. The paper then examines how the government might implement optimal intergenerational risk sharing with a social security system. One conclusion is that the system must either hold equity claims to capital or negatively index benefits to equity returns.

10.1086/520646.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在跨代经济中风险的最优分配问题。文章比较了经济自然实现的风险分配方式，以及如果遵循罗尔斯的“无知之幕”原则，各代之间通过完全阿罗-德布鲁条件市场来共享风险的情况。随后，文章探讨了政府如何通过社会保障体系来实现最优的代际风险共享。研究得出的一个结论是，该体系必须要求资本持有股权收益，或者将福利与股权回报负相关。

abstract.text: This paper examines the behavior of prices following the unexpected arrival of a large number of immigrants from the former Soviet Union (FSU) to Israel during 1990. I use store-level price data on 915 consumer price index products to show that the increase in aggregate demand prompted by the arrival of the FSU immigration significantly reduced prices during 1990. When one controls for native population size and city and month effects, a one-percentage-point increase in the ratio of immigrants to natives in a city decreases prices by 0.5 percentage point on average. It is argued that this negative immigration effect is consistent with FSU immigrants-the new consumers-having higher price elasticities and lower search costs than the native population. Thus immigration can have a moderating effect on inflation through its direct effect on product markets, and not only by increasing the supply of labor.

10.1086/521529.abstractZh: 本文研究了1990年大量前苏联移民意外抵达以色列后物价的变化情况。通过对比915种消费者价格指数产品的商店级价格数据，我们发现前苏联移民的到来显著增加了总需求，从而在1990年降低了物价。在控制当地人口规模以及城市与月份因素后，一个城市中移民与本地居民的比例每上升一个百分点，平均会导致物价下降0.5个百分点。研究认为，这种负面移民效应与前苏联移民作为新消费者所具有更高的价格弹性以及更低的搜索成本有关。因此，移民对通货膨胀的影响并非仅通过增加劳动力供应来实现，还可能通过直接影响产品市场而产生抑制作用。

abstract.text: We explore the implications of a country's external constraint for the dynamics of net foreign assets, returns, and exchange rates. Deteriorations in external accounts imply future trade surpluses (trade channel) or excess returns on the net foreign portfolio (valuation channel). Using a new data set on U.S. gross external positions, we find that stabilizing valuation effects contribute 27 percent of the cyclical external adjustment. Our approach has asset-pricing implications: external imbalances predict net foreign portfolio returns one quarter to two years ahead and net export growth at longer horizons. The exchange rate is forecastable in and out of sample at one quarter and beyond.

10.1086/521966.abstractZh: 我们探讨了一个国家的外部约束对净外国资产、回报和汇率动态的影响。外部账户状况的恶化意味着未来会出现贸易盈余（贸易渠道）或净外国投资组合的超额回报（估值渠道）。利用美国总体外部头寸的新数据集，我们发现稳定的估值效应贡献了周期性外部调整的27%。我们的研究对资产定价有启示意义：外部失衡可以预测净外国投资组合回报的1至2个季度，并且可以预测更长期内的净出口增长。汇率在样本内和样本外都可以进行预测，预测时间跨度可达1个季度以上。

abstract.text: This paper endogenizes the market structure of an economy with heterogeneous agents who want to form bilateral matches in the presence of search frictions and when utility is nontransferable. There exist infinitely many marketplaces, and each agent chooses which marketplace to be in: agents get to choose not only whom to match with but also whom they meet with. Perfect segmentation is obtained in equilibrium, where agents match with the first person they meet. All equilibria have the same matching pattern. Although perfect assortative matching is not obtained in equilibrium, the degree of assortativeness is greater than in standard models.

10.1086/521967.abstractZh: 本文探讨了具有异质代理人的经济市场结构，这些代理人希望在存在搜索摩擦且效用不可转移的情况下进行双边匹配。存在无限多个市场，每个代理人都可以选择加入哪个市场；代理人不仅可以选择匹配对象，还可以选择与之相遇的对象。在均衡状态下，代理人会与遇到的第一个人进行匹配，从而实现完全的分化。所有均衡都具有相同的匹配模式。尽管在均衡状态下无法实现完全的同配匹配，但同配程度仍高于标准模型中的情况。

abstract.text: This paper develops a framework for estimating household preferences for school and neighborhood attributes in the presence of sorting. It embeds a boundary discontinuity design in a heterogeneous residential choice model, addressing the endogeneity of school and neighborhood characteristics. The model is estimated using restricted-access Census data from a large metropolitan area, yielding a number of new results. First, households are willing to pay less than 1 percent more in house prices-substantially lower than previous estimates-when the average performance of the local school increases by 5 percent. Second, much of the apparent willingness to pay for more educated and wealthier neighbors is explained by the correlation of these sociodemographic measures with unobserved neighborhood quality. Third, neighborhood race is not capitalized directly into housing prices; instead, the negative correlation of neighborhood percent black and housing prices is due entirely to the fact that blacks live in unobservably lower-quality neighborhoods. Finally, there is considerable heterogeneity in preferences for schools and neighbors, with households preferring to self-segregate on the basis of both race and education.

10.1086/522381.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于在存在排序现象的情况下估算家庭对学校和社区属性的偏好。该框架将边界不连续设计融入异质住宅选择模型中，从而解决了学校与社区特征的内生性问题。模型采用来自一个大型都市区的受限访问人口普查数据进行了估计，得出了一些新的结果。首先，当当地学校的平均表现提高5%时，家庭愿意支付的价格仅增加不到1%，这一数值远低于之前的估计值。其次，人们愿意为更有教育背景和更高收入的邻居支付更多费用，这主要是由于这些社会人口统计指标与未观测到的社区质量之间存在相关性。第三，社区的种族特征并不会直接体现在房价上；相反，社区中黑人比例与房价之间的负相关关系，完全是由于黑人居住在质量较低的社区所导致的。最后，家庭对学校和社区的偏好存在显著的异质性，家庭倾向于根据种族和教育水平进行自我隔离。

abstract.text: I use longitudinal earnings data from Social Security records to study the effect of selective emigration on the measured progress of immigrants to the United States. The immigrant-native earnings gap closes by 10-15 percent during immigrants' first 20 years in the United States, or about half as fast as typical estimates from repeated cross sections of the decennial census. The divergent results indicate that emigration by low-wage immigrants has systematically led past researchers to overestimate the wage progress of immigrants who remain in the United States. Selective back-and-forth migration also leads typical estimates to overstate the measured decline in earnings among successive immigrant arrival cohorts between 1960 and 1980.

10.1086/522871.abstractZh: 我利用社会保障记录中的纵向收入数据来研究选择性移民对移民到美国后的收入增长的影响。在移民在美国的头20年里，移民与本土人的收入差距缩小了10-15%，这一速度大约相当于十年一次人口普查重复样本研究中典型估计值的一半。这些不同的结果表明，低薪移民的迁移行为系统性地导致过去的研究人员高估了留在美国的移民的收入增长情况。选择性往返迁移还导致典型估计值高估了1960年至1980年间不同移民群体之间的收入下降幅度。

abstract.text: After completing the first version of this comment (September 2003), we became aware of a paper (Rustichini and Siconolfi 2003) in which a point similar to ours is made. We wish to thank the editor, Robert Shimer, and two anonymous referees for very helpful comments. Financial support from the Ministry for University and Research (project 2005135328_002) and the School for Advanced Studies in Venice to Gottardi and Fundación Ramón Areces and Spanish Dirección General de Ciencia y Tecnología (projects SEJ2004-07861 and HI2001-0039 and Ramón y Cajal Program) to Jerez is gratefully acknowledged.

10.1086/522872.abstractZh: 在完成这篇评论的初稿后（2003年9月），我们发现有一篇论文（Rustichini和Siconolfi 2003）提出了与我们观点类似的观点。我们衷心感谢编辑Robert Shimer以及两位匿名审稿人的宝贵意见。同时，我们也非常感谢威尼斯高等研究院对Gottardi的资助，以及Ramón Areces基金会和西班牙科学技术总司对Jerez的资助（项目编号分别为SEJ2004-07861和HI2001-0039，以及Ramón y Cajal计划）。

abstract.text: Each worker brings a bundle of skills to the workplace, for example, quantitative and communication skills. Since employers must take this bundle as a package deal, they choose workers with just the right mix of skills. We show that international differences in the distribution of worker skill bundles-for example, Japan's abundance of workers with a modest mix of both quantitative and teamwork skills-have important implications for international trade, industrial structure, and domestic income distribution. Formally, we model two-dimensional worker heterogeneity and show that the second moments of the distribution of skills are critical, as in the Roy model.

10.1086/523657.abstractZh: 每位劳动者都会带着一系列技能来到工作场所，例如定量分析和沟通能力。由于雇主必须将这些技能作为一个整体来考虑，因此他们会选择那些具备适当技能组合的员工。我们发现，不同国家之间在劳动者技能组合的分布上存在差异——例如，日本拥有大量具备一定定量分析和团队合作能力的劳动者——这些差异对国际贸易、产业结构以及国内收入分配有着重要的影响。在理论上，我们模拟了二维劳动者异质性模型，并表明技能分布的二阶矩特征至关重要，这与Roy模型中的结论是一致的。

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium search model that incorporates job-to-job transitions, exhibits instances of replacement hiring, and conceptually distinguishes between job and worker flows. We propose a notion of competitive equilibrium for random-matching environments and study the extent to which it achieves an efficient allocation of resources. The model can be used to study how the permanent incomes and employment states of individual workers evolve over time, the amount of worker turnover in excess of job reallocation, the lengths of job tenures and unemployment durations, and the size and persistence of changes in workers' incomes following displacements or job-to-job transitions.

10.1086/524203.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个均衡搜索模型，该模型包含了工作之间的转换、替代性招聘现象，并在概念上区分了工作流和工人流。我们提出了一种适用于随机匹配环境的竞争均衡概念，并研究了这种均衡在多大程度上能够实现资源的有效分配。该模型可用于研究个体工人的永久收入及就业状态随时间的变化、超过工作重新分配后的工人流动情况、工作年限和失业持续时间，以及工人因职位变动或工作转换而导致的收入变化的大小和持续性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the efficiency of household investment decisions using comprehensive disaggregated Swedish data. We consider two main sources of inefficiency: underdiversification ("down") and nonparticipation in risky asset markets ("out"). While a few households are very poorly diversified, most Swedish households outperform the Sharpe ratio of their domestic stock index through international diversification. Financially sophisticated households invest more efficiently but also more aggressively, and overall they incur higher return losses from underdiversification. The return cost of nonparticipation is smaller by almost one-half when we take account of the fact that nonparticipants would likely be inefficient investors.

10.1086/524204.abstractZh: 本文利用全面的瑞典细分数据，研究了家庭投资决策的效率。我们主要探讨了两种导致效率低下的情况：投资分散不足（“向下”）以及不参与风险资产市场（“向外”）。虽然少数家庭的分散投资程度很低，但大多数瑞典家庭的国际多元化投资表现优于其国内股票指数的夏普比率。财务上较为精明的家庭投资效率更高，但投资行为也更为激进，因此总体上因投资分散不足而遭受的回报损失更大。当我们考虑到不参与投资的人可能属于效率较低的投资者这一事实时，不参与投资所带来的回报成本几乎减少了近一半。

abstract.text: This article studies a search model of the labor market in which firms have private information about the quality of their vacancies, they can costlessly communicate with unemployed workers before the beginning of the application process, but the content of the communication does not constitute a contractual obligation. At the end of the application process, wages are determined as the outcome of an alternating offer bargaining game. The model is used to show that vague noncontractual announcements about compensation-such as those one is likely to find in help wanted ads-can be correlated with actual wages and can partially direct the search strategy of workers.

10.1086/525544.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个劳动力市场中的搜索模型。在该模型中，企业拥有关于其职位质量的私人信息，可以在申请流程开始之前与失业者进行无需成本的沟通，但沟通内容并不构成合同义务。在申请流程结束时，工资是通过轮流报价博弈得出的结果。该模型表明，关于薪酬的模糊非合同性声明——比如常见于招聘广告中的内容——可以与实际工资相关联，并能够在一定程度上影响求职者的搜索策略。

abstract.text: This article investigates the internal governance institutions of violent criminal enterprise by examining the law, economics, and organization of pirates. To effectively organize their banditry, pirates required mechanisms to prevent internal predation, minimize crew conflict, and maximize piratical profit. Pirates devised two institutions for this purpose. First, I analyze the system of piratical checks and balances crews used to constrain captain predation. Second, I examine how pirates used democratic constitutions to minimize conflict and create piratical law and order. Pirate governance created sufficient order and cooperation to make pirates one of the most sophisticated and successful criminal organizations in history.

10.1086/526403.abstractZh: 本文通过研究海盗的法律、经济和组织结构，来探讨暴力犯罪组织的内部治理机制。为了有效组织他们的劫掠活动，海盗需要一些机制来防止内部掠夺、减少船员之间的冲突，并最大化海盗收益。为此，海盗设计了两种治理机制。首先，我分析了海盗所使用的制衡制度，以限制船长对船员资源的掠夺行为。其次，我探讨了海盗如何利用民主制度来减少冲突，并制定海盗社会的法律和秩序。海盗的治理机制确保了足够的秩序和合作，使得海盗成为历史上最复杂且最成功的犯罪组织之一。

abstract.text: We study cultural norms and legal enforcement in controlling corruption by analyzing the parking behavior of United Nations officials in Manhattan. Until 2002, diplomatic immunity protected UN diplomats from parking enforcement actions, so diplomats' actions were constrained by cultural norms alone. We find a strong effect of corruption norms: diplomats from high-corruption countries (on the basis of existing survey-based indices) accumulated significantly more unpaid parking violations. In 2002, enforcement authorities acquired the right to confiscate diplomatic license plates of violators. Unpaid violations dropped sharply in response. Cultural norms and (particularly in this context) legal enforcement are both important determinants of corruption.

10.1086/527495.abstractZh: 我们通过分析联合国官员在曼哈顿的停车行为，来研究文化规范和法律执行在遏制腐败方面的作用。直到2002年，外交豁免权使得联合国外交官免受停车处罚，因此他们的行为主要受到文化规范的约束。我们发现，腐败规范对这一现象有着显著的影响：根据现有的调查数据，来自腐败程度较高的国家的外交官，未处理的停车违规次数明显更多。2002年，执法部门获得了没收违规者外交车牌的权利，未处理的违规次数随之大幅下降。文化规范以及法律执行都是影响腐败的重要因素。

abstract.text: We use a new panel data set of credit card accounts to analyze how consumers responded to the 2001 federal income tax rebates. We estimate the monthly response of credit card payments, spending, and debt, exploiting the unique, randomized timing of the rebate disbursement. We find that, on average, consumers initially saved some of the rebate, by increasing their credit card payments and thereby paying down debt. But soon afterward their spending increased, counter to the permanent income model. Spending rose most for consumers who were initially most likely to be liquidity constrained, whereas debt declined most (so saving rose most) for unconstrained consumers.

10.1086/528721.abstractZh: 我们使用一个新的信用卡账户面板数据集来分析消费者如何对2001年的联邦所得税退税作出反应。我们通过利用退税发放的独特随机时间特性，来估算信用卡支付、消费和债务情况的月度变化。研究发现，平均而言，消费者最初会保存一部分退税金额，通过增加信用卡支付来偿还债务。但随后他们的消费却增加了，这与永久收入模型相悖。对于那些最初面临流动性约束的消费者来说，消费增长最为明显，而对于那些没有流动性约束的消费者来说，债务减少最为明显（因此储蓄增加最为明显）。

abstract.text: In an environment characterized by weak contractual enforcement, sovereign lenders can enhance the likelihood of repayment by making their claims more difficult to restructure ex post. We show, however, that competition for repayment between lenders may result in a sovereign debt that is excessively difficult to restructure in equilibrium. This inefficiency may be alleviated by a suitably designed bankruptcy regime that facilitates debt restructuring.

10.1086/528759.abstractZh: 在合同执行力度较弱的环境中，主权贷款方可以通过使他们的债权在事后难以重组来提高还款的可能性。然而，我们发现，贷款方之间的竞争可能导致主权债务在均衡状态下难以重组。这种低效现象可以通过设计合适的破产机制来减轻，该机制有助于债务重组。

abstract.text: We exploit the major international health improvements from the 1940s to estimate the effect of life expectancy on economic performance. We construct predicted mortality using preintervention mortality rates from various diseases and dates of global interventions. Predicted mortality has a large impact on changes in life expectancy starting in 1940 but no effect before 1940. Using predicted mortality as an instrument, we find that a 1 percent increase in life expectancy leads to a 1.7-2 percent increase in population. Life expectancy has a much smaller effect on total GDP, however. Consequently, there is no evidence that the large increase in life expectancy raised income per capita.

10.1086/529000.abstractZh: 我们利用1940年代以来的重大国际健康改善情况，来估算预期寿命对经济表现的影响。我们通过使用各种疾病在干预前的死亡率以及全球干预的日期，来推算预期的死亡率。从1940年开始，预期的死亡率对预期寿命的变化有着显著的影响，但在1940年之前则没有这种影响。利用预期的死亡率作为工具变量，我们发现预期寿命每增加1%，人口就会增加1.7%到2%。然而，预期寿命对总GDP的影响则相对较小。因此，没有证据表明预期寿命的大幅增加能够提高人均收入。

abstract.text: We endogenize preferences using the “indirect evolutionary approach”. Individuals are randomly matched to play a two-person game. Individual (subjective) preferences determine their behaviour and may differ from the actual (objective) pay-offs that determine fitness. Matched individuals may observe the opponents' preferences perfectly, not at all, or with some in-between probability. When preferences are observable, a stable outcome must be efficient. When they are not observable, a stable outcome must be a Nash equilibrium and all strict equilibria are stable. We show that, for pure-strategy outcomes, these conclusions are robust to allowing almost perfect, and almost no, observability, with the notable exception that inefficient strict equilibria may fail to be stable with any arbitrarily small degree of observability (despite being stable with no observability).

10.1093/restud/74.3.685.abstractZh: 我们采用“间接进化方法”来内生偏好。个体被随机匹配以进行两人博弈。个体的（主观）偏好决定了他们的行为，这些偏好可能与决定适应度的实际（客观）收益有所不同。匹配后的个体可能完全观察到对手的偏好，也可能完全不观察到，或者介于两者之间。当偏好是可观察的时，稳定的结果必须是有效的。当偏好不可观察时，稳定的结果必须是纳什均衡，而所有严格的均衡都是稳定的。我们表明，对于纯策略结果，这些结论在允许几乎完全可观察或几乎不可观察的情况下仍然成立，唯一的例外是，即使在任何任意小的可观察程度上，效率低的严格均衡也可能不稳定（尽管在不可观察的情况下它们是稳定的）。

abstract.text: This paper considers the role of foreign investors in developed-country equity markets. It presents a quantitative model of trading that is built around two new assumptions: (i) both the foreign and domestic investor populations contain investors of different sophistication, and (ii) investor sophistication matters for performance in both public equity and private investment opportunities. The model delivers a unified explanation for three stylized facts about US investors' international equity trades: (i) trading by US investors occurs in bursts of simultaneous buying and selling, (ii) Americans build and unwind foreign equity positions gradually and (iii) US investors increase their market share in a country when stock prices there have recently been rising. The results suggest that heterogeneity within the foreign investor population is much more important than heterogeneity of investors across countries.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00412.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了外国投资者在发达国家股市中的作用。文中提出了一个基于两个新假设的量化交易模型：(i) 外国投资者和国内投资者群体中的投资者具有不同的投资成熟度；(ii) 投资者的投资成熟度对公共股权和私人投资机会的表现都有重要影响。该模型为关于美国投资者国际股权交易的三个典型现象提供了统一的解释：(i) 美国投资者的交易活动以同时买入和卖出的模式进行；(ii) 美国人逐步建立并撤出外国股权头寸；(iii) 当某国的股价近期上涨时，美国投资者在该国的市场份额会增加。研究结果表明，外国投资者群体内部的异质性比不同国家之间投资者的异质性更为重要。

abstract.text: This paper presents a model of international trade that features heterogeneous firms, relative endowment differences across countries, and consumer taste for variety. The paper demonstrates that firm reactions to trade liberalization generate endogenous Ricardian productivity responses at the industry level that magnify countries' comparative advantage. Focusing on the wide range of firm-level reactions to falling trade costs, the model also shows that, as trade costs fall, firms in comparative advantage industries are more likely to export, that relative firm size and the relative number of firms increases more in comparative advantage industries and that job turnover is higher in comparative advantage industries than in comparative disadvantage industries.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00413.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个国际贸易模型，该模型包含异质性企业、各国之间的相对资源差异以及消费者对多样性的偏好。研究表明，企业对贸易自由化的反应会在行业层面产生内生性的李嘉图型生产率响应，从而放大各国的比较优势。模型还揭示了企业面对贸易成本下降时的多种反应：随着贸易成本下降，具有比较优势的行业中的企业更有可能进行出口；在这些行业中，相对企业规模和企业数量的增加幅度更大；此外，具有比较优势的行业中的就业流动率也高于处于劣势的行业。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of interest rates on investment in an environment where firms make irreversible investments with uncertain pay-offs. In this setting, changes in the interest rate affect both the cost of capital and the cost of delaying investment to acquire information. These two forces combine to generate an aggregate investment demand curve that is a backward-bending function of the interest rate. At low rates, increasing the interest rate raises investment by increasing the cost of delay.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00414.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了在企业进行具有不确定回报的不可逆投资的情况下，利率对投资的影响。在这种情况下，利率的变化既会影响资本成本，也会影响因等待获取信息而推迟投资的成本。这两种力量共同作用，形成了一条随利率变化的投资需求曲线，该曲线呈现向后弯曲的形态。在利率较低的情况下，提高利率会通过增加延迟成本来提升投资水平。

abstract.text: This paper shows how standard arguments supporting the imposition of price caps break down in the presence of demand uncertainty. In particular, though in the deterministic case the introduction or lowering of a price cap (above marginal cost) results in increased production, increased total welfare, decreased prices, and increased consumer welfare, we show that all of the above comparative statics predictions fail for generic uncertain demand functions. For example, for price caps sufficiently close to marginal cost, a decrease in the price cap always leads to a decrease in production and total welfare under certain mild conditions. Under stronger regularity assumptions, all of the monotone comparative statics predictions from the deterministic case also do not hold for a generic uncertain demand if we restrict attention to price caps in an arbitrary fixed interval (as long as the price caps are binding for some values in that interval).

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00415.x.abstractZh: 本文揭示了在需求不确定性存在的情况下，支持实施价格上限的标准论点如何失效。具体而言，虽然在确定性情况下，引入或降低价格上限（高于边际成本）会导致产量增加、总福利提升、价格下降以及消费者福利改善，但我们表明，对于所有通用的不确定需求函数而言，上述比较静态预测均不成立。例如，对于价格上限与边际成本足够接近的情况，在某些温和条件下，降低价格上限总是会导致产量和总福利的下降。在更强的规律性假设下，如果我们将注意力限制在任意固定区间内的价格上限上（只要这些价格上限在该区间内对某些数值具有约束力），那么从确定性情况得出的所有单调比较静态预测同样不再成立。

abstract.text: Much of the existing literature on social security has taken the extreme assumption that individuals have little or no altruism; this paper takes an opposite assumption that there is full two-sided altruism. When households insure members that belong to the same family line, privatizing social security can gain public support. In our benchmark model calibrated to the U.S. economy, privatization without compensation is favoured by 52% of the population. If social security participants are fully compensated for their contributions, and the transition to privatization is financed by a combination of debt and a consumption tax, 58% experience a welfare gain. These gains and the resulting public support for social security reform depend critically on a flexible labour market. If the labour supply elasticity is low, then support for privatization disappears.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00416.x.abstractZh: 现有的关于社会保障的文献大多假设个体几乎没有或完全没有利他主义行为；本文则提出相反的假设，即存在完全的双边利他主义。当家庭为同一家族成员提供保险时，私有化社会保障制度能够获得公众的支持。在我们针对美国经济体系进行校准的基准模型中，没有补偿的私有化方案受到52%人口的青睐。如果社会保障参与者能够完全获得其贡献的补偿，并且私有化的过渡通过债务和消费税的结合来融资，则有58%的人会从中获得福利收益。这些收益以及公众对社会保障改革的支持，在很大程度上取决于灵活的劳动力市场。如果劳动力供给的弹性较低，那么对私有化的支持就会消失。

abstract.text: We construct an infinite horizon model of harmful addiction. Consumption is compulsive if it differs from what the individual would have chosen had commitment been available. A good is addictive if its consumption leads to more compulsive consumption of the same good. We analyse the welfare implications of drug policies and find that taxes on drugs decrease welfare while prohibitive policies may increase welfare. We also analyse the agent's demand for voluntary commitment (“rehab”). For appropriate parameters, the model predicts a cycle of addiction where the agent periodically checks into rehab. Between these visits his drug consumption increases each period.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00417.x.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个无限视野的有害成瘾模型。如果消费行为与个体在可做出承诺的情况下会选择的消费行为不同，那么这种消费就是强迫性的。如果一个商品的使用会导致对同一商品的更强迫性消费，那么这种商品就是成瘾性的。我们分析了毒品政策的福利影响，发现对毒品征税会降低福利，而禁令政策可能会提高福利。我们还分析了个体对自愿承诺（“康复”）的需求。在适当的参数条件下，该模型预测了一个成瘾循环，其中个体会定期去康复中心。在这些访问期间，他的毒品消费量会不断增加。

abstract.text: This paper analyses a dynamic auction in which a fraction of each bid is sunk. Jump bidding is used by bidders to signal their private information. Bluffing (respectively sandbagging) occurs when a weak (respectively strong) player seeks to deceive his opponent into thinking that he is strong (respectively weak). A player with a moderate valuation bluffs by making a high bid and drops out if his bluff is called. A player with a high valuation should vary his bids and should sometimes sandbag by bidding low, to induce lower bids by his rival.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00418.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了一种动态拍卖机制，其中每笔出价的部分金额是固定的。竞拍者使用“跳跃出价”的方式来传递他们的私人信息。当较弱的竞拍者试图欺骗对手，使其误以为自己较强时，就会发生“虚张声势”行为。估值适中的竞拍者会通过出高价进行虚张声势，如果自己的虚张声势被识破，就会退出竞拍。估值较高的竞拍者则应该调整出价策略，有时可以通过出低价来诱导对手降低出价。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of observed and unobserved heterogeneity in the desire to die with positive net worth. Using a structural life-cycle model nested in a switching regression with unknown sample separation, we find that roughly three-fourths of the elderly single population has abequest motive. Both the presence and the magnitude of the bequest motive are statistically and economically significant. On average, households with a bequest motive spend about 25% less on consumption expenditures. We conclude that, among the elderly single households in our sample, about four-fifths of their net wealth will be bequeathed and approximately half of this is due to a bequest motive.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00419.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了有正净资产的老年人对死亡意愿中观察到的和未观察到的异质性效应。通过在一个具有未知样本分离结构的切换回归模型中的结构生命周期模型进行分析，我们发现大约四分之三的老年单身人群具有遗赠动机。遗赠动机的存在及其强度在统计和经济上都是显著的。平均而言，具有遗赠动机的家庭在消费支出上减少了约25%。我们得出结论，在我们样本中的老年单身家庭中，大约五分之四的净资产将被遗赠，其中约一半是由于遗赠动机所致。

abstract.text: In contrast to domestic trade, international trade inherently requires more intensive use of skilled labour with expertise in areas such as international business, language skills, and maritime insurance, and the transoceanic transportation is more capital intensive than the local transportation. In the presence of such bias in factor demands, globalization caused by an improvement in the export technologies can lead to a worldwide increase in the relative prices of the factors used intensively in international trade. Furthermore, a worldwide increase in the factors used intensively in international trade can lead to globalization. To capture these effects, we develop a flexible approach to model costly international trade, which includes the standard iceberg approach as a special case. More specifically, we extend the Ricardian model of trade with a continuum of goods by introducing multiple factors of production and by making technologies of supplying goods depend on whether the destination is home or abroad. If the technologies of supplying the same good to the two destinations differ only in total factor productivity, the model becomes isomorphic to the Ricardian model with the iceberg cost. By allowing the two technologies to differ in the factor intensities, our approach enables us to examine the links between factor endowments, factor prices, and globalization that cannot be captured by the iceberg approach.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00420.x.abstractZh: 与国内贸易相比，国际贸易本质上需要更密集地利用具有国际商务、语言技能和海事保险等领域专业知识的熟练劳动力，而且跨洋运输比本地运输需要更多的资本投入。在要素需求存在这种偏向的情况下，由于出口技术的改进导致的全球化可能会使国际贸易中密集使用的各要素的全球价格上升。此外，国际贸易中密集使用的要素的全球性增加也会促进全球化进程。为了捕捉这些效应，我们开发了一种灵活的方法来模拟昂贵的国际贸易，该方法将标准的冰山模型作为特例纳入其中。更具体地说，我们通过引入多种生产要素，并将供应商品的技术取决于目的地是本国还是国外，从而扩展了基于李嘉图模型的贸易模型。如果向两个目的地供应同一商品的技术仅在全要素生产率上有所不同，那么该模型就与带有冰山成本的李嘉图模型同构。通过允许这两种技术在不同要素强度上有所区别，我们的方法能够揭示要素禀赋、要素价格与全球化之间的联系，而这些联系是冰山模型无法捕捉到的。

abstract.text: In a plurality-rule election, a group of voters must coordinate behind one of two challengers in order to defeat a disliked status quo. Departing from existing work, the support for each challenger must be inferred from the private observation of informative signals. The unique equilibrium involves limited strategic voting and incomplete coordination. This is driven by negative feedback: an increase in strategic voting by others reduces the incentives for a voter to act strategically. Strategic-voting incentives are lower in relatively marginal elections, after controlling for the distance from contention of a trailing preferred challenger. A calibration applied to the U.K. General Election of 1997 is consistent with the impact of strategic voting and the reported accuracy of voters' understanding of the electoral situation.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00421.x.abstractZh: 在多数规则选举中，一群选民必须团结在两位挑战者中的一位背后，以推翻不喜欢的现状。与现有研究不同，对每位挑战者的支持必须通过对信息信号的私人观察来推断。这种独特的均衡状态涉及有限的策略性投票和不完全的协调。这一现象是由负面反馈驱动的：其他选民增加策略性投票的行为会降低选民进行策略性投票的动机。在相对边缘化的选举中，控制住候选者距离争议点的距离后，策略性投票的激励会更低。对1997年英国大选进行的校准结果与策略性投票的影响以及选民对选举形势的理解准确性是一致的。

abstract.text: A Welfare-to-Work (WTW) program is a mix of government expenditures on various labour market policies targeted to the unemployed (e.g. unemployment insurance (UI), job search monitoring (JM), social assistance (SA), wage subsidies). This paper provides a dynamic principal—agent framework suitable for analysing chief features of an optimal WTW program, such as the sequence and duration of the different policies, the dynamic pattern of payments along the unemployment spell, and the emergence of taxes/subsidies upon re-employment. The optimal program endogenously generates an absorbing policy of last resort (“social assistance”) characterized by a constant lifetime payment and no active participation by the agent. Human capital depreciation is a necessary condition for policy transitions to be part of an optimal WTW program. The typical sequence of policies is quite simple: the program starts with standard UI, then switches into monitored search and, finally, into SA. The optimal benefits are decreasing during unemployment insurance and constant during both JM and SA. Whereas taxes (subsidies) can be either increasing or decreasing with duration during UI, they must decrease (increase) during a phase of JM. In a calibration exercise, we use our model to analyse quantitatively the features of the optimal program for the U.S. economy. With respect to the existing U.S. system, the optimal WTW scheme delivers sizeable welfare gains to unskilled workers because the incentives to search for a job can be retained even while delivering more insurance and using costly monitoring less intensively.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00422.x.abstractZh: 福利到工作计划（WTW）是政府在不同劳动力市场政策上的支出组合，这些政策主要针对失业者，例如失业保险、求职监测、社会援助以及工资补贴。本文提出了一个动态主体-代理框架，用于分析最优福利到工作计划的主要特征，如不同政策的实施顺序和持续时间、失业期间支付的动态模式，以及重新就业时税收/补贴的出现。最优计划会内生地产生一种最后手段的政策——社会援助，其特点是持续性的终身支付，且代理无需主动参与。人力资本折旧是政策转换成为最优福利到工作计划的前提条件。典型的政策实施顺序相当简单：计划首先采用标准失业保险，然后转向求职监测，最后实施社会援助。在失业保险期间，福利水平会逐渐下降，而在求职监测和社援助期间则保持恒定。虽然税收（补贴）在失业保险期间可能随时间增加或减少，但在求职监测阶段必须减少（增加）。在一项校准实验中，我们使用模型对美国经济中最优计划的特征进行了定量分析。与现有的美国体系相比，最优福利到工作计划为非技术工人带来了显著的福利收益，因为即使提供更多的保险并减少昂贵的监测成本，仍能保持他们寻找工作的积极性。

abstract.text: Towards developing a theory of systematic biases about strategies, I analyse strategic implications of a particular bias: wishful thinking about the strategies. I identify a player as a wishful thinker if she hopes to enjoy the highest pay-off that is consistent with her information about the others' strategies. I develop a straightforward elimination process that characterizes the strategy profiles that are consistent with wishful thinking, mutual knowledge of wishful thinking, and so on. Every pure-strategy Nash equilibrium is consistent with common knowledge of wishful thinking.
