For generic two-person games, I further show that the pure Nash equilibrium strategies are the only strategies that are consistent with common knowledge of wishful thinking. My analysis also illustrates how one can characterize the strategic implications of general decision rules using the tools of game theory.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00423.x.abstractZh: 在尝试发展关于策略的系统性偏见理论时，我分析了一种特定偏见对策略的影响：对策略的乐观思维。如果一个玩家希望获得与其对其他玩家策略的了解相一致的最高收益，那么就可以认为该玩家具有乐观思维的特征。我提出了一种简单的排除过程，用于描述与乐观思维、相互了解乐观思维等相关的策略组合。每个纯策略纳什均衡都与对乐观思维的普遍了解相一致。对于一般的二人游戏，我还证明了纯纳什均衡策略是唯一与对乐观思维的普遍了解相一致的策略。我的分析还展示了如何利用博弈论的工具来描述一般决策规则对策略的影响。

abstract.text: An entrepreneur with limited liability needs to finance an infinite horizon investment project. An agency problem arises because she can divert operating cash flows before reporting them to the financiers. We first study the optimal contract in discrete time. This contract can be implemented by cash reserves, debt, and equity. The latter is split between the financiers and the entrepreneur and pays dividends when retained earnings reach a threshold. To provide appropriate incentives to the entrepreneur, the firm is downsized when it runs short of cash. We then study the continuous-time limit of the model. We prove the convergence of the discrete-time value functions and optimal contracts. Our analysis yields rich implications for the dynamics of security prices. Stock prices follow a diffusion reflected at the dividend barrier and absorbed at 0. Their volatility, as well as the leverage ratio of the firm, increase after bad performance. Stock prices and book-to-market ratios are in a non-monotonic relationship. A more severe agency problem entails lower price-earning ratios and firm liquidity and higher default risk.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00425.x.abstractZh: 一位有限责任企业家需要为无限期投资项目融资。由于企业家在向融资方报告之前可以挪用运营现金流，因此会出现代理问题。我们首先研究离散时间下的最优契约。该契约可以通过现金储备、债务和股权来实现，其中股权部分由融资方和企业家共同持有，并在留存收益达到一定阈值时支付股息。为了给企业家提供适当的激励，当公司现金不足时，会进行裁员。随后，我们研究该模型在连续时间下的极限情况。我们证明了离散时间下的价值函数和最优契约的收敛性。我们的分析为证券价格动态提供了丰富的启示。股票价格遵循在股息门槛处反射并在0处吸收的扩散过程。在业绩不佳后，股票的波动性以及公司的杠杆比率都会上升。股票价格与市净率之间存在非单调关系。更严重的代理问题会导致较低的市盈率、公司流动性和更高的违约风险。

abstract.text: This paper shows that with (partial) irreversibility higher uncertainty reduces the responsiveness of investment to demand shocks. Uncertainty increases real option values making firms more cautious when investing or disinvesting. This is confirmed both numerically for a model with a rich mix of adjustment costs, time-varying uncertainty, and aggregation over investment decisions and time and also empirically for a panel of manufacturing firms. These "cautionary effects" of uncertainty are large--going from the lower quartile to the upper quartile of the uncertainty distribution typically halves the first year investment response to demand shocks. This implies the responsiveness of firms to any given policy stimulus may be much weaker in periods of high uncertainty, such as after the 1973 oil crisis and September 11, 2001.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00426.x.abstractZh: 本文指出，在（部分）不可逆性条件下，较高的不确定性会降低投资对需求冲击的响应能力。不确定性增加实际选择价值，使得企业在投资或撤资时更加谨慎。这一结论通过数值模拟得到了验证，该模型包含了丰富的调整成本、时变不确定性以及针对投资决策的时间聚合因素。同时，通过制造业企业的面板数据也证实了这一点。不确定性的“谨慎效应”非常显著——在不确定性分布的下四分位到上四分位范围内，投资对需求冲击的响应通常会减半。这意味着，在高度不确定的时期，如1973年石油危机和2001年9月11日之后，企业对任何政策刺激的反应可能会更加迟钝。

abstract.text: Robert Wilson criticizes applied game theory's reliance on common-knowledge assumptions. In reaction to Wilson's critique, the recent literature of mechanism design has adopted the goal of finding detail-free mechanisms in order to eliminate this reliance. In practice this has meant restricting attention to simple mechanisms such as dominant-strategy mechanisms. However, there has been little theoretical foundation for this approach. In particular it is not clear the search for an optimal mechanism that does not rely on common-knowledge assumption would lead to simpler mechanisms rather than more complicated ones. This paper tries to fill the void. In the context of an expected revenue maximizing auctioneer, we investigate some foundations for using simple, dominant-strategy auctions.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00427.x.abstractZh: 罗伯特·威尔逊批评了应用博弈论对共同知识假设的依赖。作为对威尔逊批评的回应，最近的机制设计文献致力于寻找无需详细描述的机制，以消除这种依赖。实际上，这意味着将注意力集中在简单的机制上，例如占优策略机制。然而，这种方法几乎没有理论依据。特别是，尚不清楚寻找不依赖共同知识假设的最优机制是否会带来更简单的机制，而不是更复杂的机制。本文试图填补这一空白。在预期收益最大化的拍卖场景中，我们探讨了一些使用简单占优策略拍卖的基础。

abstract.text: Workers earn higher wages in cities vs. rural areas. This gap could arise because cities make workers more productive, or it could be the result of a non-random selection of workers into cities based on their ability and their endogenous history of career choices. To untangle these issues, this paper estimates a dynamic programming model, which embeds the choice of residing in a city or rural area within a model of career choices over time. After controlling for all the sources of selection and endogeneity, the estimates indicate that a given worker does earn more in the city for white-collar work, but not for blue-collar work. In addition, city work experience is found to be worth more than rural work experience in the rural area for white-collar work, but not for blue-collar work. These results support the interpretation that cities make white-collar workers more productive and suggest that workers may consider moving to the city not only in terms of locational choice, but also as a form of human capital investment.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00428.x.abstractZh: 城市中的工人比农村地区的工人获得更高的工资。这种差距可能是因为城市使工人更具生产力，或者是因为工人基于他们的能力和职业选择的历史被非随机地选择到城市。为了理清这些问题，本文建立了一个动态规划模型，将居住在城市或农村的选择纳入随时间变化的职业选择模型中。在控制了所有选择来源和内生性因素后，估计结果显示，对于白领工作而言，城市中的工人确实获得更高的工资，但对于蓝领工作则并非如此。此外，对于白领工作而言，城市的工作经验比农村地区的经验更有价值，但对于蓝领工作则并非如此。这些结果支持了这样的解释：城市使白领工人更具生产力，并且表明工人可能不仅出于地理位置的选择，还将其视为一种人力资本投资而考虑迁移到城市。

abstract.text: We develop a transferable utility model of the household in which the marriage market is characterized by (negative or positive) assortative matching, and spousal allocations are determined by premarital investments. We demonstrate that all sharing rules along the assortative order support efficient outcomes both in terms of premarital investments and intra-household allocations. The efficiency of premarital choices and household allocations then enables us to show that, for each couple, the marriage market generates a unique and maritally sustainable sharing rule that is a function of the distribution of premarital endowments and the sex ratios in the market. According to our results, transfers among spouses occur on two margins: premarital investments and intra-marital spousal allocations. Asymmetries in the sex ratios in the marriage markets produce gender differences in premarital investments and consumption that are larger for individuals with small premarital endowments than those with larger endowments. A corollary of these findings is that, when men are in short supply in the marriage markets, women can invest more than men even when the returns to investment are lower or the costs are higher for women.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00429.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个可转移的家庭效用模型，在该模型中，婚姻市场具有（负或正的）选择性匹配特征，而配偶之间的分配则由婚前投资决定。我们证明，沿着选择性匹配顺序的所有共享规则都能在婚前投资和家庭内部分配方面实现高效的结果。婚前选择和家庭分配的效率使得我们能够表明，对于每一对夫妻来说，婚姻市场都会产生一种独特的、具有婚姻可持续性的共享规则，这一规则取决于婚前资产的分配以及市场中的性别比例。根据我们的研究结果，配偶之间的转移发生在两个层面：婚前投资和婚姻内的配偶分配。婚姻市场中性别比例的差异会导致婚前投资和消费的性别差异，对于婚前资产较小的个体来说，这种差异比资产较大的个体更为显著。这些发现的推论是，当婚姻市场中男性稀缺时，女性即使面临较低的投资回报或较高的成本，也可以比男性进行更多的投资。

abstract.text: Understanding the accumulation of match-specific capital is crucial in shedding light on the reasons for the prevalence of long-term employment relationships and on the welfare consequences of turnover in the labour market. One of the most important sources of match-specific capital is human capital acquired through match-specific learning. Such learning can take on two distinct forms. In the first case, workers accumulate match-specific human capital through learning by doing. In the second case, a worker and a firm in an employment relationship learn about the quality of the match over time, thereby acquiring valuable information. I construct a structural model that embeds these two learning explanations and show that it is possible to distinguish the two by using turnover data on employing firms coupled with data on workers. I use a French matched employer—employee data-set to estimate the structural model using the Efficient Method of Moments, a simulation-based estimation method. I find that, while learning by doing may be present during the first six months of an employment relationship, learning about match quality dominates at longer tenures. This finding has important consequences for the understanding of the sources of match-specific capital and for the desirability of policies that alter the incentives for turnover for workers of different tenure.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00430.x.abstractZh: 理解特定匹配资本的积累对于揭示长期雇佣关系普遍存在的理由以及劳动力市场中人员流动对福利的影响至关重要。特定匹配资本最重要的来源之一是通过特定匹配学习获得的人力资本。这种学习可以有两种不同的形式。在第一种情况下，工人通过实践学习积累特定匹配的人力资本。在第二种情况下，雇佣关系中的工人和公司随着时间的推移了解匹配的质量，从而获取有价值的信息。我构建了一个结构模型，将这两种学习解释纳入其中，并表明可以通过使用雇佣公司的人员流动数据以及工人的数据来区分这两种情况。我使用法国匹配的雇主-雇员数据集，采用基于模拟的估计方法——有效矩方法，来估计这个结构模型。我发现，虽然在雇佣关系的头六个月可能存在通过实践学习的情况，但在更长的雇佣期间，关于匹配质量的学习更为重要。这一发现对于理解特定匹配资本的来源以及制定改变不同雇佣期工人流动激励的政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper studies a model in which in period 1, a decision-maker chooses a set of lotteries and in period 2, Nature chooses a lottery from the set chosen by the decision-maker and the decision-maker consumes the lottery chosen by Nature. Larger sets are interpreted as representing more ambiguous objective information about the lottery that will be consumed. The axioms imposed on preferences over sets of lotteries generalize those often imposed on preferences over single lotteries in the existing literature. A decision-maker who satisfies these axioms evaluates sets of lotteries according to a weighted average of the expected utilities of the best and the worst lottery in a set, with the weights interpreted as a measure of (comparative) attitude to objective ambiguity.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00431.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个模型，其中在第一个时期，决策者选择一组彩票；在第二个时期，自然从决策者选择的一组彩票中挑选出一个彩票，然后决策者消费自然选定的彩票。较大的彩票集合被解释为代表了关于即将消费的彩票的更模糊的客观信息。对彩票集合的偏好所施加的公理，推广了现有文献中对单个彩票的偏好所通常施加的公理。满足这些公理的决策者会根据一组彩票中最好的和最差彩票的预期效用的加权平均值来评估这些彩票集合，其中权重被解释为对客观模糊性的（比较性）态度的衡量。

abstract.text: Most economic activity occurs in cities. This creates a tension between local increasing returns, implied by the existence of cities, and aggregate constant returns, implied by balanced growth. To address this tension, we develop a theory of economic growth in an urban environment. We show that the urban structure is the margin that eliminates local increasing returns to yield constant returns to scale in the aggregate, which is sufficient to deliver balanced growth. In a multi-sector economy with specific factors and productivity shocks, the same mechanism leads to a city size distribution that is well described by a power distribution with coefficient one: Zipf's Law. Under certain assumptions our theory produces Zipf's Law exactly. More generally, it produces the systematic deviations from Zipf's Law observed in the data, including the under-representation of small cities and the absence of very large ones. In general, the model identifies the standard deviation of industry productivity shocks as the key parameter determining dispersion in the city size distribution. We present evidence that the relationship between the dispersion of city sizes and the variance of productivity shocks is consistent with the data.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00432.x.abstractZh: 大多数经济活动发生在城市中。这导致了局部递增收益与整体恒定收益之间的矛盾，前者由城市的存在所暗示，而后者则由均衡增长所体现。为了缓解这一矛盾，我们提出了一种城市环境中的经济增长理论。我们指出，城市结构起到了消除局部递增收益、实现整体规模恒定收益的作用，这足以实现均衡增长。在一个具有特定因素和生产力冲击的多部门经济中，同样的机制导致城市规模分布呈现出幂律分布，其系数为一，即Zipf定律。在某些假设条件下，我们的理论能够精确预测Zipf定律。更一般地，该理论能够解释数据中观察到的系统性偏差，包括小城市的代表性不足以及大型城市的缺失。总体而言，该模型将行业生产力冲击的标准偏差确定为决定城市规模分布离散性的关键参数。我们提供了证据，证明城市规模离散性与生产力冲击方差之间的关系与数据是一致的。

abstract.text: In this paper, different models of vertical relationships between manufacturers and retailers in the supermarket industry are compared. Demand estimates are used to compute price-cost margins for retailers and manufacturers under different supply models when wholesale prices are not observed. The purpose is to identify the set of margins compatible with the margins obtained from estimates of cost and to select the model most consistent with the data among non-nested competing models. The models considered are (1) a simple linear pricing model; (2) a vertically integrated model; and (3) a variety of alternative (strategic) supply scenarios that allow for collusion, non-linear pricing, and strategic behaviour with respect to private label products. Using data on yogurt sold in several stores in a large urban area of the U.S. the results imply that wholesale prices are close to marginal cost and that retailers have pricing power in the vertical chain. This is consistent with non-linear pricing by the manufacturers or high bargaining power of the retailers.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00433.x.abstractZh: 本文比较了超市行业中制造商与零售商之间不同垂直关系的模型。通过需求估计，在无法观察到批发价格的情况下，计算了不同供应模式下零售商和制造商的价格成本利润空间。目的是找出与成本估算结果相一致的利润空间，并选择与数据最一致的模型，而非嵌套竞争模型中的最优模型。所考虑的模型包括：(1) 简单的线性定价模型；(2) 垂直整合模型；以及(3) 多种替代的（战略性）供应情景，这些情景考虑了勾结、非线性定价以及针对自有品牌产品的战略行为。利用美国某大城市多个商店销售酸奶的数据，结果表明批发价格接近边际成本，零售商在垂直供应链中拥有定价权。这与制造商的非线性定价或零售商较高的议价能力是一致的。

abstract.text: Institutions—quality of contract enforcement, property rights, shareholder protection, and the like—have received a great deal of attention in recent years. Yet trade theory has not considered the implications of institutional differences, beyond treating them simply as different technologies or taxes. The purpose of this paper is twofold. First, we propose a simple model of international trade in which institutional differences are modelled within the framework of incomplete contracts. We show that doing so reverses many of the conclusions obtained by equating institutions with productivity. Institutional differences as a source of comparative advantage imply, among other things, that the less developed country may not gain from trade and factor prices may actually diverge as a result of trade. Second, we test empirically whether institutions act as a source of trade, using data on U.S. imports disaggregated by country and industry. The empirical results provide evidence of “institutional content of trade”: institutional differences are an important determinant of trade flows.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00435.x.abstractZh: 近年来，制度因素——如合同执行的质量、产权、股东保护等——受到了广泛关注。然而，贸易理论并未充分考虑制度差异的影响，仅仅将其视为不同的技术或税收因素。本文的目的有两个。首先，我们提出了一个简单的国际贸易模型，在该模型中，制度差异被纳入不完全契约的框架内进行建模。我们发现，这样做可以推翻许多将制度等同于生产力的结论。制度差异作为比较优势的来源，意味着欠发达国家可能无法从贸易中获益，且由于贸易的影响，要素价格可能会出现差异。其次，我们通过美国按国家和行业分列的进口数据，实证检验了制度是否作为贸易的驱动力。实证结果证明了“贸易的制度内容”：制度差异是贸易流动的重要决定因素。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new approach to change-point modelling that allows the number of change-points in the observed sample to be unknown. The model we develop assumes that regime durations have a Poisson distribution. It approximately nests the two most common approaches: the time-varying parameter (TVP) model with a change-point every period and the change-point model with a small number of regimes. We focus considerable attention on the construction of reasonable hierarchical priors both for regime durations and for the parameters that characterize each regime. A Markov chain Monte Carlo posterior sampler is constructed to estimate a version of our model, which allows for change in conditional means and variances. We show how real-time forecasting can be done in an efficient manner using sequential importance sampling. Our techniques are found to work well in an empirical exercise involving U.S. GDP growth and inflation. Empirical results suggest that the number of change-points is larger than previously estimated in these series and the implied model is similar to a TVP (with stochastic volatility) model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00436.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的变点建模方法，该方法允许观察到的样本中的变点数量未知。我们开发的模型假设各时期持续时间的分布服从泊松分布。该模型大致融合了两种常见的建模方法：一种是在每个时期都有一个变点的时变参数模型，另一种是以少量时期为特征的变点模型。我们特别关注为时期持续时间和表征每个时期的参数构建合理的层次先验分布问题。我们构建了一个马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛后验采样器，用于估计我们模型的版本，该模型允许条件均值和方差的变化。我们展示了如何使用序贯重要性采样高效地进行实时预测。在涉及美国GDP增长和通胀的实证实验中，我们的技术表现良好。实证结果表明，这些序列中的变点数量比之前估计的要多，且所得到的模型类似于一个具有随机波动性的时变参数模型。

abstract.text: This paper shows how particle filtering facilitates likelihood-based inference in dynamic macroeconomic models. The economies can be non-linear and/or non-normal. We describe how to use the output from the particle filter to estimate the structural parameters of the model, those characterizing preferences and technology, and to compare different economies. Both tasks can be implemented from either a classical or a Bayesian perspective. We illustrate the technique by estimating a business cycle model with investment-specific technological change, preference shocks, and stochastic volatility.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00437.x.abstractZh: 本文展示了粒子滤波如何促进动态宏观经济模型中的基于似然的推断。这些经济模型可能是非线性的和/或非正态的。我们描述了如何利用粒子滤波的输出来估计模型的结构参数，这些参数表征了偏好和技术特征，并用于比较不同的经济模型。这两项任务可以从经典或贝叶斯的角度来实现。我们通过估计一个包含投资特定技术变革、偏好冲击和随机波动性的商业周期模型来说明这一技术。

abstract.text: We report experimental results from long sequences of decisions in environments that are theoretically prone to severe information cascades. Observed behaviour is much different—information cascades are ephemeral. We study the implications of a theoretical model based on quantal response equilibrium, in which the observed cascade formation/collapse/formation cycles arise as equilibrium phenomena. Consecutive cascades may reverse states, and usually such a reversal is self-correcting: the cascade switches to the correct state. These implications are supported by the data. We extend the model to allow for base rate neglect and find strong evidence for overweighting of private information. The estimated belief trajectories indicate fast and efficient learning dynamics.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00438.x.abstractZh: 我们报告了在理论上容易出现严重信息级联的环境中对长序列决策的实验结果。观察到的行为有很大不同——信息级联是短暂的。我们研究了一个基于量子响应均衡的理论模型的含义，在该模型中，观察到的级联形成/崩溃/形成循环作为均衡现象出现。连续的级联可能会改变状态，而且这种改变通常是自我纠正的：级联会切换到正确的状态。这些结论得到了数据的支持。我们扩展了模型，以允许忽略基础概率，并发现了私人信息被过度重视的强烈证据。估计的信念轨迹表明存在快速且高效的学习动态。

abstract.text: We present identification and estimation results for the "collective" model of labour supply in which there are discrete choices, censoring of hours, and non-participation in employment. We derive the collective restrictions on labour supply functions and contrast them with restrictions implied by the usual "unitary" framework. Using the large changes in the wage structure between men and women in the U.K. over the last two decades, we estimate a collective labour supply model for married couples without children. The estimates of the sharing rule show that male wages and employment have a strong influence on bargaining power within couples.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00440.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了“集体”劳动供给模型的识别与估计结果，该模型包含离散选择、工作时间限制以及非参与就业的情况。我们推导了集体劳动供给函数的限制条件，并将其与通常的“单一”框架所隐含的限制条件进行了对比。通过利用过去二十年英国男女工资结构的大幅变化数据，我们为没有孩子的已婚夫妇建立了一个集体劳动供给模型。估计结果显示，男性工资和就业状况对夫妻之间的议价能力有着显著的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper I show that an equilibrium exists to the sequential voting game in which a bandwagon begins with probability 1. These bandwagons are driven by a combination of beliefs and the desire of voters to vote for the winning candidate. Significantly, in this equilibrium the pivot probability for each voter is non-zero, even in an infinite population. Consequently, the bandwagons do not always start after one (or at most two) favourable decisions (as do economic cascades) and varying levels of informative voting are observed, consistent with observations from sequential voting in U.S. presidential primaries. Further, voters are exposed to counterintuitive incentives, referred to as “buyers' remorse”, that have been attributed to real primary voters. I also derive equilibrium behaviour in this environment when voting is simultaneous and compare the quality of information aggregation within each mechanism. I relate the conclusions to U.S. presidential primaries and find they are consistent with a common conclusion about the front-loading of the primary process: that in tight elections (with no front-runner) simultaneous voting is preferred, whereas in lopsided elections sequential voting is preferred. The superior performance of sequential voting in lopsided races is precisely because bandwagons occur.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00441.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我证明了在一种连续投票游戏中存在一个均衡状态，其中“跟风效应”以1的概率开始。这些跟风效应是由选民的信念以及投票给获胜候选人的愿望共同驱动的。值得注意的是，在这种均衡状态下，每个选民的转向概率并非为零，即使是在无限大的选民群体中也是如此。因此，跟风效应并不总是在一项或最多两项有利决策之后才开始（就像经济连锁反应一样），并且观察到不同水平的信息性投票行为，这与美国总统初选中的连续投票现象一致。此外，选民还面临一些反直觉的激励因素，被称为“买家的懊悔”，这些激励因素被归因于真实的初选选民。我还推导了在同时投票情况下的均衡行为，并比较了每种机制下的信息聚合质量。我将这些结论与美国总统初选联系起来，发现它们与关于初选过程前置化的一般结论一致：在竞争激烈的选举中（没有领跑者），同时投票更为理想；而在势均力敌的选举中，连续投票则更为合适。连续投票在势均力敌的选举中表现更优，正是因为存在跟风效应。

abstract.text: We analyse a situation where a monopolist is selling an indivisible good to risk-neutral buyers who only have an estimate of their private valuations. The seller can release, without observing, certain additional signals that affect the buyers' valuations. Our main result is that in the expected revenue-maximizing mechanism, the seller makes available all the information that she can, and her expected revenue is the same as it would be if she could observe the part of the information that is "new" to the buyers. We also show that this mechanism can be implemented by what we call a handicap auction in interesting applications. In the first round of this auction, each buyer picks a price premium from a menu offered by the seller (a smaller premium costs more). Then the seller releases the additional signals. In the second round, the buyers bid in a second-price auction where the winner pays the sum of his premium and the second highest non-negative bid. In the case of a single buyer, this mechanism simplifies to a menu of European call options.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00442.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个情况，即一个垄断者正在向风险中性的买家出售不可分割的商品，这些买家仅对其私人估值有所了解。卖方可以在不观察的情况下释放某些影响买家估值的额外信号。我们的主要结论是，在预期收入最大化的机制中，卖方会提供她所能获得的所有信息，其预期收入与她能够观察到对买家来说“新”的信息部分时的收入相同。我们还表明，这种机制可以通过我们称之为“障碍拍卖”的方式在有趣的应用中实现。在拍卖的第一轮中，每个买家从卖方提供的价格菜单中选择一个价格溢价（较小的溢价成本更高）。然后卖方释放额外的信号。在第二轮中，买家在第二个价格拍卖中出价，获胜者支付其溢价与第二高非负出价之和。在单个买家的情况下，这种机制简化为欧式看涨期权的菜单。

abstract.text: This paper studies moral hazard in teams using a model where efforts are promoted via the combination of profit shares and relational contracts. The focus is on how these two forms of incentives interact. According to the degree of effort observability and the importance of future interaction, the optimal allocation of profit shares can range from a wide dispersion across players to a full concentration of shares in the hands of a single player. When shares are sufficiently concentrated, the corresponding residual claimant can also adopt the role of administering all relational contracts, therefore serving as an endogenously chosen principal.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00443.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了团队中的道德风险问题，采用了一个模型来探讨如何通过利润分享和关系契约的结合来促进努力。重点在于这两种激励方式之间的相互作用。根据努力的可观察程度以及未来互动的重要性，利润分享的最优分配可以从各参与者之间广泛分散，到全部利润集中在单个参与者手中。当利润分享过于集中时，相应的剩余索赔人也可以承担起管理所有关系契约的角色，从而成为一种内生选择的主体。

abstract.text: Formal models of elections have emphasized the convergence of party leaders towards the centre of the electoral distribution. This paper attempts to resolve the apparent disparity between the formal result and the perception of political divergence by considering a model incorporating valence. Valence can be interpreted as the non-policy basis of political judgement made by the electorate concerning the quality of political contenders. The theorem presented here shows that there is a necessary condition for convergence. The condition involves the difference in party valences and the electoral variance. When the condition fails, the low-valence parties will be forced to adopt policy positions far from the electoral centre. The inference appears to be substantiated by an empirical model of the Israel election in 1996.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00444.x.abstractZh: 关于选举的形式化模型通常强调政党领袖向选举分布中心趋同的趋势。本文试图通过引入“价值”这一概念来解释形式化结果与政治分歧感知之间的明显差异。价值可以被理解为选民对政治候选人品质的非政策性判断基础。本文提出的定理表明，存在一种实现趋同的必要条件。该条件涉及政党价值的差异以及选举结果的变异程度。当这一条件不成立时，价值较低的政党将被迫采取与选举中心相去甚远的政策立场。这一推论似乎得到了1996年以色列选举的实证模型的验证。

abstract.text: Experts often collect and report information over time. What reporting protocol elicits the most information? Here, a principal receives reports sequentially from an agent with privately known ability, who observes two signals about the state of the world. The signals differ in initial quality and, unlike previous work, differ in quality improvement. The paper finds that “mind changes” (inconsistent reports) can signal talent if a smart agent improves faster. Also, sequential reports dominate when the principal's decision is very sensitive to information; a single report dominates if the mediocre agent's signals improve faster or the agent is likely mediocre.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00446.x.abstractZh: 专家们通常会随着时间的推移收集和报告信息。哪种报告方式能引出最多的信息呢？在这里，委托人依次从一位具有私人已知能力的代理人那里接收报告，该代理人观察到关于世界状态的两种信号。这两种信号在初始质量上有所不同，并且与之前的研究不同，它们在质量提升方面也有所不同。本文发现，“思维变化”（不一致的报告）可以表明代理人的能力，如果智能代理人提升得更快的话。此外，当委托人的决策对信息非常敏感时，顺序报告占主导地位；如果平庸代理人的信号提升得更快，或者该代理人很可能属于平庸水平，则单一报告占主导地位。

abstract.text: In this paper, a formal test of intra-household commitment is derived and performed. To that end, two models of household intertemporal behaviour are developed. In both models, household members are characterized by individual preferences. In the first formulation, household decisions are always on the ex ante Pareto frontier. In the second model, the assumption of intra-household commitment required by ex ante efficiency is relaxed. It is shown that the full-efficiency household Euler equations are nested in the no-commitment Euler equations. Using this result, the hypothesis that household members can commit to future allocations of resources is tested using the Consumer Expenditure Survey. I strongly reject this hypothesis. It is also shown that the standard unitary framework is a special case of the full-efficiency model. However, if household members are not able to commit, household intertemporal behaviour cannot be characterized using the standard life-cycle model. These findings have two main implications. First, policy makers can change household behaviour by modifying the decision power of individual household members. Second, to evaluate programmes designed to improve the welfare of household members, it would be beneficial to replace the standard unitary model with a characterization of household behaviour that allows for lack of commitment.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00447.x.abstractZh: 本文推导并检验了家庭内部承诺的正式模型。为此，我们构建了两个关于家庭跨时期行为的模型。在这两个模型中，家庭成员都受到个体偏好的影响。在第一个模型中，家庭决策始终位于事前帕累托前沿上。而在第二个模型中，对家庭内部承诺的假设被放宽，以符合事前效率的要求。研究表明，完全效率的家庭欧拉方程嵌套在无承诺的欧拉方程中。利用这一结果，我们测试了家庭成员能否承诺未来资源分配这一假设，并通过消费者支出调查进行了验证。我们强烈否定了这一假设。此外，我们还发现标准单位框架是完全效率模型的一个特例。然而，如果家庭成员无法承诺，那么家庭跨时期行为就无法用标准生命周期模型来描述。这些发现有两个主要意义：首先，政策制定者可以通过改变家庭成员的决策权来改变家庭行为；其次，为了评估旨在改善家庭成员福利的计划，用能够容纳缺乏承诺的家庭行为描述模型来替代标准单位模型将是有益的。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of peer effects in teenagers' smoking behaviour in the U.S.A. I present a random utility model that incorporates complementarity between individual and peer smoking. A Markov process model of smoking interactions between individuals is presented. I estimate the structural parameters of the model using a steady-state distribution that is determined by the Markov process. The empirical results strongly support the presence of positive peer effects. Interestingly, peer interactions are found to be stronger within the same gender than across genders. The same result is found for race. Moreover, a multiplier effect is found.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00448.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了同伴效应在美国青少年吸烟行为中的作用。我提出了一个随机效用模型，该模型考虑了个体吸烟行为与同伴吸烟之间的互补性。同时，还提出了一种关于个体间吸烟互动的马尔可夫过程模型。通过马尔可夫过程确定的稳态分布，对模型的参数进行了估计。实证结果强烈支持同伴效应的存在。有趣的是，发现同性同伴之间的互动比异性同伴之间的互动更为紧密。种族因素也表现出类似的结果。此外，还发现了一种乘数效应。

abstract.text: Does capital-embodied technological change play an important role in shaping labour-market outcomes? To address this question, we develop a model with vintage capital and search-matching frictions where irreversible investment in new vintages of capital creates heterogeneity in productivity among firms, matched as well as vacant. We demonstrate that capital-embodied technological change reduces labour demand and raises equilibrium unemployment and unemployment durations. In addition, the presence of labour-market regulations (unemployment benefits, payroll taxes, and firing costs) exacerbates these effects. Thus, the model is qualitatively consistent with some key features of the European labour-market experience relative to that of the U.S.: it features a sharper rise in unemployment and a sharper fall in the vacancy rate and the labour share. A calibrated version of our model suggests that this technology—policy interaction could explain a sizeable fraction of the observed differences between the U.S. and Europe.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00449.x.abstractZh: 资本所包含的技术变革在塑造劳动力市场结果中是否发挥着重要作用？为了回答这个问题，我们建立了一个模型，该模型考虑了资本的老旧程度以及搜寻匹配摩擦。在模型中，对新一代资本进行不可逆的投资会导致企业之间在生产力上的差异，这些企业既有被匹配就业的，也有处于空缺状态的。我们证明，资本所包含的技术变革会减少劳动力需求，并增加均衡失业率及失业持续时间。此外，劳动力市场法规的存在（如失业救济金、工资税和解雇成本）会加剧这些效应。因此，该模型在定性上与欧洲劳动力市场的一些关键特征一致：欧洲的失业率上升更为明显，空缺率和劳动力份额下降更为显著。我们模型的一个校准版本表明，这种技术政策互动可以解释美国和欧洲之间观察到的显著差异的相当一部分。

abstract.text: We study coalition formation in “real time”, a situation in which coalition formation is intertwined with the ongoing receipt of pay-offs. Agreements are assumed to be permanently binding: They can only be altered with the full consent of existing signatories. For characteristic function games we prove that equilibrium processes—whether or not these are history dependent—must converge to efficient absorbing states. For three-player games with externalities each player has enough veto power that a general efficiency result can be established. However, there exist four-player games in which all Markov equilibria are inefficient from every initial condition, despite the ability to write permanently binding agreements.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00450.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了“实时”下的联盟形成问题，在这种情况下，联盟形成与持续获得的收益密切相关。假设协议具有永久约束力：只有所有签署方完全同意时，协议才能被修改。对于特征函数博弈，我们证明了均衡过程——无论这些过程是否依赖于历史——最终都会收敛到有效且被吸收的状态。对于具有外部性的三玩家博弈，每个玩家都拥有足够的否决权，可以确保实现普遍的效率结果。然而，存在四玩家博弈，无论从哪个初始条件开始，所有马尔可夫均衡都是低效的，尽管可以签订永久性的约束性协议。

abstract.text: During financial disruptions, market makers provide liquidity by absorbing external selling pressure. They buy when the pressure is large, accumulate inventories, and sell when the pressure alleviates. This paper studies optimal dynamic liquidity provision in a theoretical market setting with large and temporary selling pressure and order-execution delays. I show that competitive market makers offer the socially optimal amount of liquidity, provided they have access to sufficient capital. If raising capital is costly, this suggests a policy role for lenient central bank lending during financial disruptions.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00451.x.abstractZh: 在金融动荡期间，做市商通过吸收外部卖压来提供流动性。当卖压较大时，他们进行买入，积累库存；当卖压缓解时，则进行卖出。本文研究在存在大规模且短暂的卖压以及订单执行延迟的理论市场环境下，最优的动态流动性供给问题。研究表明，只要具备足够的资金，竞争性做市商能够提供社会最优的流动性。如果筹集资金的成本较高，这表明在金融动荡期间，央行应采取宽松的信贷政策。

abstract.text: We consider a version of the Solow growth model where technological progress can be investment specific or investment neutral. The labour market is subject to search frictions, and the existing productive units may fail to adopt the most recent technological advances. Technological progress can lead to the destruction of technologically obsolete jobs and cause unemployment. We calibrate the model to replicate the high persistence that characterizes the dynamics of firms' neutral technology and the frequency of firms' capital adjustment. We find that neutral technological advances increase job destruction and job reallocation and reduce aggregate employment. Investment-specific technological advances reduce job destruction, have mild effects on job creation, and are expansionary. Hence, neutral technological progress prompts Schumpeterian creative destruction, while investment-specific technological progress operates essentially as in the standard neoclassical growth model. Using structural VAR models, we provide support to the key dynamic implications of the model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00452.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑了索洛增长模型的一个版本，在这个版本中，技术进步可以是投资特定的，也可以是投资中性的。劳动力市场受到搜寻摩擦的影响，现有的生产单位可能无法采用最新的技术进步。技术进步可能导致技术过时的工作岗位被淘汰，从而引发失业。我们对模型进行了校准，以反映企业中性技术动态的高持续性以及企业资本调整的频率。我们发现，中性技术进步会增加工作岗位的破坏和重新分配，并减少总体就业人数。投资特定的技术进步则可以减少工作岗位的破坏，对就业创造的影响较小，并且具有扩张性。因此，中性技术进步促进了熊彼特式的创造性破坏，而投资特定的技术进步则基本上遵循标准新古典增长模型的操作方式。通过结构向量自回归模型，我们为模型的关键动态含义提供了支持。

abstract.text: This paper presents a theory of location choice that draws on insights from the incomplete contracts and investment flexibility (real option) literatures. Our analysis indicates that the choice of locating within rather than away from industry clusters is influenced by the extent to which training costs are borne by firms versus employees. In addition, the uncertainty about future productivity shocks and the ability of firms to modify the scale of their operations also influence location choice. In particular, we show that locating in clusters is preferred when training costs are borne by workers and when firm-specific productivity shocks can potentially be large. However, there is an incentive for firms to choose isolated locations when significant training costs are borne by firms.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00453.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种选址理论，该理论借鉴了关于不完全合约和投资灵活性（实物期权）的研究成果。我们的分析表明，企业是否选择位于产业集群内部而非外部，取决于培训成本是由企业还是员工承担。此外，未来生产率冲击的不确定性以及企业调整运营规模的能力也会影响选址决策。具体而言，当培训成本由员工承担，且企业特定的生产率冲击可能较大时，企业更倾向于选择位于产业集群内。然而，当培训成本主要由企业承担时，企业有动机选择孤立的地理位置。

abstract.text: The paper estimates and examines the empirical plausibility of asset pricing models that attempt to explain features of financial markets such as the size of the equity premium and the volatility of the stock market. In one model, the long-run risks (LRR) model of Bansal and Yaron, low-frequency movements, and time-varying uncertainty in aggregate consumption growth are the key channels for understanding asset prices. In another, as typified by Campbell and Cochrane, habit formation, which generates time-varying risk aversion and consequently time variation in risk premia, is the key channel. These models are fitted to data using simulation estimators. Both models are found to fit the data equally well at conventional significance levels, and they can track quite closely a new measure of realized annual volatility. Further, scrutiny using a rich array of diagnostics suggests that the LRR model is preferred.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00454.x.abstractZh: 该论文估计并检验了那些试图解释金融市场特征的资产定价模型的实证合理性，例如股权溢价的大小和股票市场的波动性。在一个模型中，Bansal和Yaron提出的长期风险模型、低频波动以及总体消费增长中的时变不确定性是理解资产价格的关键渠道。在另一个模型中，如Campbell和Cochrane所提出的模型，习惯形成机制——它会产生时变的风险厌恶，从而导致风险溢价的变化——是关键的渠道。这些模型通过模拟估计器对数据进行拟合。两种模型在常规显著性水平下都能很好地拟合数据，并且它们能够非常准确地预测新的年度实际波动性指标。此外，通过一系列诊断方法的分析表明，LRR模型更为优越。

abstract.text: Autocrats in many developing countries have extracted enormous personal rents from power. In addition, they have imposed inefficient policies including pervasive patronage spending. I present a model in which the presence of ethnic identities and the absence of institutionalized succession processes allow the ruler to elicit support from a sizeable share of the population despite large reductions in welfare. The fear of falling under an equally inefficient and venal ruler that favours another group is enough to discipline supporters. The model predicts extensive use of patronage, ethnic bias in taxation, and spending patterns and unveils a new mechanism through which economic frictions translate into increased rent extraction by the leader. These predictions are consistent with the experiences of bad governance, ethnic bias, wasteful policies, and kleptocracy in post-colonial Africa.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00455.x.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家的独裁者从权力中榨取了巨大的个人利益。此外，他们还实施了低效的政策，包括普遍的裙带式支出。我提出了一个模型，该模型认为，由于存在种族身份差异以及缺乏制度化的继任机制，统治者能够吸引相当一部分民众的支持，尽管这导致福利大幅减少。对陷入同样低效且腐败的统治者统治的恐惧，足以约束支持者。该模型预测，会广泛使用裙带式行为、种族偏见的税收和支出模式，并揭示了一种新机制，即通过这种机制，经济摩擦转化为领导者更多的利益获取。这些预测与后殖民时期非洲的糟糕治理、种族偏见、浪费性政策以及黑手党统治的经验相符。

abstract.text: In many preferential trade agreements (PTAs), countries exchange not only reductions in trade barriers but also cooperation in non-trade issues such as labour and environmental standards, intellectual property, etc. We provide a model of PTAs motivated by cooperation in non-trade issues and analyse its implications for global free trade and welfare. We find that such PTAs increase the cost of multilateral tariff reductions and thus cause a stumbling block to global free trade. This occurs because multilateral tariff reductions decrease the threat that can be used in PTAs and thus the surplus that can be extracted from them. By explicitly modelling the interaction between preferential and multilateral negotiations, we derive a testable prediction and provide novel econometric evidence that supports the model's key prediction. The welfare analysis shows that the current World Trade Organization rules allowing this type of PTAs may be optimal for economically large countries, thus the model can predict the rules we observe. We also analyse alternative rules that constitute a Pareto improvement.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00456.x.abstractZh: 在许多优惠贸易协定中，各国不仅交换降低贸易壁垒的措施，还就劳动标准、环境标准、知识产权等非贸易问题开展合作。我们提出了一个以非贸易问题合作为动机的优惠贸易协定模型，并分析其对全球自由贸易和福利的影响。研究发现，此类优惠贸易协定会增加多边关税削减的成本，从而成为全球自由贸易的障碍。这是因为多边关税削减减少了可用于优惠贸易协定的威胁，进而减少了从中获得的收益。通过明确模拟优惠贸易协定与多边谈判之间的互动关系，我们得出了一个可验证的预测，并提供了新的计量经济学证据来支持该模型的关键预测。福利分析表明，当前世界贸易组织允许此类优惠贸易协定的规则可能对经济规模较大的国家最为有利，因此该模型可以预测我们所观察到的规则。我们还分析了构成帕累托改进的其他规则。

abstract.text: This paper presents a test for exogeneity of explanatory variables that minimizes the need for auxiliary assumptions that are not required by the definition of exogeneity. It concerns inference about a non-parametric function g that is identified by a conditional moment restriction involving instrumental variables (IV). A test of the hypothesis that g is the mean of a random variable Y conditional on a covariate X is developed that is not subject to the ill-posed inverse problem of non-parametric IV estimation. The test is consistent whenever g differs from E (Y ∣ X) on a set of non-zero probability. The usefulness of this new exogeneity test is displayed through Monte Carlo experiments and an application to estimation of non-parametric consumer expansion paths.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00458.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种解释变量外生性的检验方法，该方法最大限度地减少了因外生性定义而无需的辅助假设的使用。该检验涉及对一种非参数函数g的推断，该函数通过包含工具变量的条件矩限制来识别。本文提出了一种检验假设的方法，即g是在协变量X条件下随机变量Y的均值，这种检验不受非参数工具变量估计中存在的病态逆问题的影响。只要g在非零概率集上与E(Y ∣ X)存在差异，该检验就是一致的。通过蒙特卡洛实验以及对非参数消费者消费增长路径估计的应用，展示了这种新外生性检验的实用性。

abstract.text: This paper considers learning when the distinction between risk and ambiguity matters. It first describes thought experiments, dynamic variants of those provided by Ellsberg, that highlight a sense in which the Bayesian learning model is extreme—it models agents who are implausibly ambitious about what they can learn in complicated environments. The paper then provides a generalization of the Bayesian model that accommodates the intuitive choices in the thought experiments. In particular, the model allows decision-makers' confidence about the environment to change—along with beliefs—as they learn. A portfolio choice application compares the effect of changes in confidence under ambiguity vs. changes in estimation risk under Bayesian learning. The former is shown to induce a trend towards more stock market participation and investment even when the latter does not.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00464.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在风险与不确定性之间的区别变得重要时的学习问题。首先，本文描述了由Ellsberg提出的思维实验及其动态变体，这些实验凸显了贝叶斯学习模型的极端性——它模拟了在复杂环境中具有不切实际雄心壮志的决策者。随后，本文对贝叶斯模型进行了推广，以容纳思维实验中的直观选择。具体而言，该模型允许决策者对环境的信心随着学习过程的变化而发生变化。通过投资组合选择的案例，本文比较了在不确定性下信心变化与在贝叶斯学习下估计风险变化所带来的影响。结果表明，即使后者没有带来显著影响，前者仍会导致更多人参与股市和投资。

abstract.text: A two-country model of oligopoly in general equilibrium is used to show how changes in market structure accompany the process of trade and capital-market liberalization. The model predicts that bilateral mergers in which low-cost firms buy out higher-cost foreign rivals are profitable under Cournot competition. As a result, trade liberalization can trigger international merger waves, in the process encouraging countries to specialize and trade more in accordance with comparative advantage. With symmetric countries, welfare is likely to rise, though the distribution of income always shifts towards profits.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00466.x.abstractZh: 该论文采用了一个双国寡头垄断的一般均衡模型，用以说明市场结构的变化如何伴随着贸易和资本市场自由化的进程。该模型预测，在库尔诺竞争条件下，低成本企业收购高成本外国竞争对手的双边合并是能够带来利润的。因此，贸易自由化可能会引发国际间的合并浪潮，从而促使各国根据比较优势进行专业化生产和贸易。在对称国家的情况下，福利水平可能会上升，尽管收入分配总是会向利润方向转移。

abstract.text: This paper examines changes in the distribution of wages using bounds to allow for the impact of nonrandom selection into work. We show that worst case bounds can be informative. However, because employment rates in the United Kingdom are often low, they are not informative about changes in educational or gender wage differentials. Thus we explore ways to tighten these bounds using restrictions motivated from economic theory. With these assumptions, we find convincing evidence of an increase in inequality within education groups, changes in educational differentials, and increases in the relative wages of women.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00750.x.abstractZh: 本文通过边界分析来研究工资分配的变化，以考虑非随机选择进入劳动力市场的影响。我们发现，最坏情况下的边界可以提供一些信息。然而，由于英国的就业率通常较低，这些边界并不能反映教育或性别工资差异的变化。因此，我们探讨了利用经济理论中的限制条件来收紧这些边界的方法。在这些假设下，我们发现教育群体内部不平等程度有所增加，教育差异发生变化，以及女性相对工资的上升。

abstract.text: Rationalizability is a central solution concept of game theory. Economic models often have many rationalizable outcomes, motivating economists to use refinements of rationalizability, including equilibrium refinements. In this paper we try to achieve a general understanding of when this multiplicity occurs and how one should deal with it. Assuming that the set of possible payoff functions and belief structures is sufficiently rich, we establish a revealing structure of the correspondence of beliefs to sets of rationalizable outcomes. We show that, for any rationalizable action a of any type, we can perturb the beliefs of the type in such a way that a is uniquely rationalizable for the new type. This unique outcome will be robust to further small changes. When multiplicity occurs, then we are in a “knife-edge” case, where the unique rationalizable outcome changes, sandwiched between open sets of types where each of the rationalizable actions is uniquely rationalizable. As an immediate application of this result, we characterize, for any refinement of rationalizability, the predictions that are robust to small misspecifications of interim beliefs. These are only those predictions that are true for all rationalizable strategies, that is, the predictions that could have been made without the refinement.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00751.x.abstractZh: 合理性是博弈论中的一个核心解决概念。经济模型往往存在许多可合理化的结果，这促使经济学家采用更精细的合理性概念，包括均衡的精细化。在本文中，我们试图全面了解这种情况何时发生，以及如何应对。假设可能的收益函数和信念结构集合足够丰富，我们建立了一个揭示信念与可合理化结果集合之间对应关系的结构。我们表明，对于任何类型的可合理化行动a，我们可以通过调整信念的方式，使得新的类型下a是唯一可合理化的。这种唯一结果对于进一步的微小变化仍然具有鲁棒性。当存在多重性时，我们处于一个“刀刃”情况，即唯一可合理化的结果会发生变化，而两侧则是开放的类型集合，在这些集合中，每个可合理化的行动都是唯一可合理化的。作为这一结果的直接应用，我们描述了对于任何合理的细化，那些对中间信念的微小误设仍然具有鲁棒性的预测。这些预测是对于所有可合理化策略都成立的，也就是说，这些预测可以在没有细化的情况下被做出。

abstract.text: This paper develops and applies some new results in the theory of monotone comparative statics. Let f be a real-valued function defined on Rl and consider the problem of maximizing f(x) when x is constrained to lie in some subset C of Rl. We develop a natural way to order the constraint sets C and find the corresponding restrictions on the objective function f that guarantee that optimal solutions increase with the constraint set. We apply our techniques to problems in consumer, producer, and portfolio theory. We also use them to generalize Rybcsynski's theorem and the LeChatelier principle.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00752.x.abstractZh: 本文发展并应用了一些关于单调比较静态理论的新结果。设f是一个定义在Rl上的实值函数，考虑在x被限制在Rl的某个子集C内时最大化f(x)的问题。我们提出了一种自然的方法来排序约束集C，并找到了相应的目标函数f的限制条件，这些限制条件保证了最优解随着约束集的增加而提高。我们将这些技术应用于消费者理论、生产者理论和投资组合理论中的问题。我们还利用这些技术来推广Rybcsynski定理和勒夏特列原理。

abstract.text: Does individual behavior in a laboratory setting provide a reliable indicator of behavior in a naturally occurring setting? We consider this general methodological question in the context of eliciting risk attitudes. The controls that are typically employed in laboratory settings, such as the use of abstract lotteries, could lead subjects to employ behavioral rules that differ from the ones they employ in the field. Because it is field behavior that we are interested in understanding, those controls might be a confound in themselves if they result in differences in behavior. We find that the use of artificial monetary prizes provides a reliable measure of risk attitudes when the natural counterpart outcome has minimal uncertainty, but that it can provide an unreliable measure when the natural counterpart outcome has background risk. Behavior tended to be moderately risk averse when artificial monetary prizes were used or when there was minimal uncertainty in the natural nonmonetary outcome, but subjects drawn from the same population were much more risk averse when their attitudes were elicited using the natural nonmonetary outcome that had some background risk. These results are consistent with conventional expected utility theory for the effects of background risk on attitudes to risk.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00753.x.abstractZh: 在实验室环境中，个体行为能否作为自然环境中行为的可靠指标？我们将这一一般性的方法论问题置于引出风险态度的背景下进行探讨。在实验室环境中通常采用的控制措施，例如使用抽象彩票，可能会促使受试者采用与实地不同的行为规则。由于我们感兴趣的是实地行为，这些控制措施本身可能会成为混淆因素，导致行为出现差异。我们发现，当自然对应结果的不确定性极低时，使用人工货币奖励可以可靠地衡量风险态度；而当自然对应结果存在背景风险时，这种测量方式则可能不可靠。当使用人工货币奖励或自然非货币结果的不确定性较低时，行为倾向于适度规避风险；而当使用具有背景风险的自然非货币结果来引出态度时，来自同一群体的受试者则表现出更强的风险规避倾向。这些结果与传统期望效用理论关于背景风险对风险态度影响的解释一致。

abstract.text: This paper considers issues related to estimation, inference, and computation with multiple structural changes that occur at unknown dates in a system of equations. Changes can occur in the regression coefficients and/or the covariance matrix of the errors. We also allow arbitrary restrictions on these parameters, which permits the analysis of partial structural change models, common breaks that occur in all equations, breaks that occur in a subset of equations, and so forth. The method of estimation is quasi-maximum likelihood based on Normal errors. The limiting distributions are obtained under more general assumptions than previous studies. For testing, we propose likelihood ratio type statistics to test the null hypothesis of no structural change and to select the number of changes. Structural change tests with restrictions on the parameters can be constructed to achieve higher power when prior information is present. For computation, an algorithm for an efficient procedure is proposed to construct the estimates and test statistics. We also introduce a novel locally ordered breaks model, which allows the breaks in different equations to be related yet not occurring at the same dates.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00754.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在方程组中发生多个结构变化的估计、推断和计算问题。这些变化可能发生在回归系数和/或误差协方差矩阵上。我们还允许对这些参数施加任意限制，从而可以分析部分结构变化模型、所有方程中发生的共同断裂、部分方程中发生的断裂等。估计方法基于正态误差的准最大似然法。在比以往研究更一般的假设下，得到了极限分布。在检验方面，我们提出了似然比统计量来检验无结构变化的零假设，并选择变化的次数。当存在先验信息时，可以构建带有参数限制的结构变化检验，以提高检验功效。在计算方面，我们提出了一种高效算法来构建估计值和检验统计量。我们还引入了一种新颖的局部有序断裂模型，该模型允许不同方程中的断裂之间存在关联，但不会发生在同一日期。

abstract.text: An extension to Ellsberg's experiment demonstrates that attitudes to ambiguity and compound objective lotteries are tightly associated. The sample is decomposed into three main groups: subjective expected utility subjects - who reduce compound objective lotteries and are ambiguity neutral, and two groups that exhibit different forms of association between preferences over compound lotteries and ambiguity - corresponding to alternative theoretical models that account for ambiguity averse or seeking behavior.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00755.x.abstractZh: 对Ellsberg实验的扩展表明，人们对模糊性和复合目标彩票的态度之间存在紧密关联。样本被分为三个主要群体：主观期望效用主体——他们倾向于减少复合目标彩票的使用，并且对模糊性持中立态度；以及两个表现出不同形式的偏好关联的群体——这些群体对复合彩票的偏好与模糊性之间存在不同的关联，这对应于两种理论模型，分别解释了厌恶模糊性或寻求模糊性的行为。

abstract.text: This paper considers identification and estimation of the effect of a mismeasured binary regressor in a nonparametric or semiparametric regression, or the conditional average effect of a binary treatment or policy on some outcome where treatment may be misclassified. Failure to account for misclassification is shown to result in attenuation bias in the estimated treatment effect. An identifying assumption that overcomes this bias is the existence of an instrument for the binary regressor that is conditionally independent of the treatment effect. A discrete instrument suffices for nonparametric identification.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00756.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在非参数或半参数回归中，对测量不准确的二元回归变量进行识别与估计的问题，以及二元处理或政策对某些结果的条件平均效应进行估计时可能出现的分类错误。研究表明，未能纠正这种分类错误会导致估计出的处理效应出现偏差。一种能够克服这种偏差的识别假设是：二元回归变量的工具变量在条件上独立于处理效应。对于非参数回归而言，使用离散工具变量就足以满足识别需求。

abstract.text: We provide a nonparametric characterization of a general collective model for multi-person household consumption, which includes externalities and public goods. We derive the minimum number of commodities and observations that enable the falsification of this general model for aggregrate household quantity and price data; these requirements are generally less stringent than the conditions derived by Browning and Chiappori (1998) within a parametric setting. Next, we institute necessary and sufficient conditions for data consistency with collective rationality that only include observed price and quantity information. These conditions are formally similar to the GARP condition for the unitary model (see Varian, 1982); which is particularly convenient from a practical point of view. To illustrate the generality of the collective model, we also discuss a number of interesting special cases, including the traditional unitary model and the collective labor supply a la Chiappori (1988).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00757.x.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种非参数化的描述，用于描述多个人口家庭消费的一般集体模型，该模型包含了外部性和公共物品。我们推导出了使这一通用模型能够用于聚合家庭数量和价格数据的最小商品数量和观测数据数量；这些要求通常比Browning和Chiappori在参数化框架下得出的条件更为宽松。接下来，我们提出了数据一致性与集体理性之间必要且充分的条件，这些条件仅包含观测到的价格和数量信息。这些条件在形式上与单位模型的GARP条件类似（参见Varian, 1982）；从实际角度来看，这种形式特别方便。为了说明这一集体模型的普遍性，我们还讨论了一些有趣的特例，包括传统的单位模型和Chiappori（1988）提出的集体劳动供给模型。

abstract.text: In this article we introduce efficient Wald tests for testing the null hypothesis of the unit root against the alternative of the fractional unit root. In a local alternative framework, the proposed tests are locally asymptotically equivalent to the optimal Robinson Lagrange multiplier tests. Our results contrast with the tests for fractional unit roots, introduced by Dolado, Gonzalo, and Mayoral, which are inefficient. In the presence of short range serial correlation, we propose a simple and efficient two-step test that avoids the estimation of a nonlinear regression model. In addition, the first-order asymptotic properties of the proposed tests are not affected by the preestimation of short or long memory parameters.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00758.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们介绍了用于检验单位根零假设的有效Wald检验方法，以及针对分数单位根替代假设的检验方法。在局部替代框架下，所提出的检验方法在局部渐近意义上与最优的Robinson Lagrange乘数检验方法等价。我们的结果与Dolado、Gonzalo和Mayoral提出的分数单位根检验方法形成对比，后者效率较低。在短期序列相关性的情况下，我们提出了一种简单且高效的两步检验方法，该方法无需估计非线性回归模型。此外，所提出检验方法的一阶渐近性质不受短期或长期记忆参数预估计的影响。

abstract.text: Dekel, Lipman and Rustichini (2001) (henceforth DLR) axiomatically characterized three representations of preferences that allow for a desire for flexibility and/or commitment. In one of these representations (ordinal expected utility), the independence axiom is stated in a weaker form than is necessary to obtain the representation; in another (additive expected utility), the continuity axiom is too weak. In this erratum we provide examples showing that the axioms used by DLR are not sufficient, and provide stronger versions of these axioms that, together with the other axioms used by DLR, are necessary and sufficient for these two representations.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00759.x.abstractZh: Dekel、Lipman和Rustichini（2001）提出了三种偏好表示方式，这些方式允许灵活性和/或承诺性。其中，序数期望效用表示方式中的独立性公理表述比实现该表示方式所需的表述要弱；而加法期望效用表示方式中的连续性公理表述又过于宽松。在本文的勘误表中，我们提供了实例说明DLR所使用的公理并不充分，并提出了更强大的公理版本。这些公理版本，加上DLR使用的其他公理，共同构成了这两种偏好表示方式的必要充分条件。

abstract.text: This paper studies the estimation of dynamic discrete games of incomplete information. Two main econometric issues appear in the estimation of these models: the indeterminacy problem associated with the existence of multiple equilibria, and the computational burden in the solution of the game. We propose a class of pseudo maximum likelihood (PML) estimators that deals with these problems and we study the asymptotic and finite sample properties of several estimators in this class. We first focus on two-step PML estimators which, though attractive for their computational simplicity, have some important limitations: they are seriously biased in small samples; they require consistent nonparametric estimators of players' choice probabilities in the first step, which are not always feasible for some models and data; and they are asymptotically inefficient. Second, we show that a recursive extension of the two-step PML, which we call nested pseudo likelihood (NPL), addresses those drawbacks at a relatively small additional computational cost. The NPL estimator is particularly useful in applications where consistent nonparametric estimates of choice probabilities are either not available or very imprecise, e.g., models with permanent unobserved heterogeneity. Finally, we illustrate these methods in Montecarlo experiments and in an empirical application to a model of firm entry and exit in oligopoly markets using Chilean data from several retail industries.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00731.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了不完全信息下动态离散博弈的估计问题。在模型估计过程中出现了两个主要的计量经济学问题：与多重均衡存在相关的不确定性问题，以及求解博弈时的计算负担。我们提出了一种伪最大似然估计器类，能够解决这些问题，并研究了该类估计器在渐近和有限样本条件下的性能。首先，我们关注两步伪最大似然估计器，尽管它们在计算上具有优势，但存在一些重要限制：在小样本情况下存在严重偏差；需要第一步中一致的非参数估计器来估计玩家的选择概率，而这对于某些模型和数据来说并不总是可行的；此外，这些估计器在渐近意义上效率较低。其次，我们展示了一种递归扩展的两步伪最大似然估计器，我们称之为嵌套伪似然估计器，它能够以相对较小的额外计算成本解决这些问题。当无法获得或估计选择概率的非参数估计非常不准确时，例如在有永久未观测异质性模型的场合，嵌套伪似然估计器特别有用。最后，我们通过蒙特卡洛实验和一个实证应用来验证这些方法的有效性，该应用使用了智利多个零售行业的寡头市场中的企业进入和退出模型数据。

abstract.text: This paper develops a theoretical framework for studying contract and enforcement in settings with nondurable trading opportunities and complete but unverifiable information. The framework explicitly accounts for the parties' individual trade actions. The sets of implementable state-contingent payoffs, under various assumptions about renegotiation opportunities, are characterized and compared. The results indicate the benefit of modeling trade actions as individual, rather than as public, and they highlight the usefulness of a structured game-theoretic framework for applied research.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00732.x.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，用于研究在缺乏持久交易机会且信息完整但无法验证的情况下的合同与执行问题。该框架明确考虑了各方个体的交易行为。在关于重新谈判机会的各种假设下，对可实施的基于状态的收益集合进行了描述和比较。研究结果表明，将交易行为视为个体行为而非公共行为进行建模具有优势，同时也凸显了结构化博弈论框架在应用研究中的实用性。

abstract.text: Families, primarily female-headed minority households with children, living in high-poverty public housing projects in five U.S. cities were offered housing vouchers by lottery in the Moving to Opportunity program. Four to seven years after random assignment, families offered vouchers lived in safer neighborhoods that had lower poverty rates than those of the control group not offered vouchers. We find no significant overall effects of this intervention on adult economic self-sufficiency or physical health. Mental health benefits of the voucher offers for adults and for female youth were substantial. Beneficial effects for female youth on education, risky behavior, and physical health were offset by adverse effects for male youth. For outcomes that exhibit significant treatment effects, we find, using variation in treatment intensity across voucher types and cities, that the relationship between neighborhood poverty rate and outcomes is approximately linear.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00733.x.abstractZh: 在美国五个城市的高贫困公共住房项目中，以女性为户主、有孩子的家庭获得了“迈向机会”计划提供的住房券。在随机分配后四到七年，获得住房券的家庭居住在比未获得住房券的对照组更安全的社区，这些社区的贫困率更低。我们发现，这一干预措施对成人的经济自给自足或身体健康没有显著影响。对于成人和女性青少年来说，住房券对心理健康有显著益处。然而，对女性青少年在教育、风险行为和身体健康方面的积极影响被男性青少年出现的负面影响所抵消。对于那些显示出显著治疗效果的结果，我们发现，通过不同住房券类型和城市的干预强度差异，社区贫困率与各种结果之间的关系大致呈线性关系。

abstract.text: We show experimentally that fairness concerns may have a decisive impact on the actual and optimal choice of contracts in a moral hazard context. Bonus contracts that offer a voluntary and unenforceable bonus for satisfactory performance provide powerful incentives and are superior to explicit incentive contracts when there are some fair-minded players, but trust contracts that pay a generous wage up front are less efficient than incentive contracts. The principals understand this and predominantly choose the bonus contracts. These results are consistent with recently developed theories of fairness, which offer important new insights into the interaction of contract choices, fairness, and incentives.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00734.x.abstractZh: 我们通过实验表明，在道德风险情境下，公平问题可能对合同的实际选择和优化产生决定性影响。对于那些为表现优异者提供自愿且不可强制执行的奖金的合同，当存在一些公平意识的参与者时，它们能够提供强大的激励作用，并且优于明确的激励合同。而预先支付丰厚工资的信任合同则不如激励合同有效。各方都明白这一点，因此更倾向于选择奖金合同。这些结果与最近发展起来的公平理论一致，这些理论为合同选择、公平性和激励之间的相互作用提供了重要的新见解。

abstract.text: Consider a decentralized, dynamic market with an infinite horizon and participa-tion costs in which both buyers and sellers have private information concerning their values for the indivisible traded good. Time is discrete, each period has length δ, and each unit of time continuums of new buyers and sellers consider entry. Traders whose expected utility is negative choose not to enter. Within a period each buyer is matched anonymously with a seller and each seller is matched with zero, one, or more buyers. Every seller runs a first price auction with a reservation price and, if trade occurs, both the seller and winning buyer exit the market with their realized utility. Traders who fail to trade continue in the market to be rematched. We characterize the steady-state equilibria that satisfy a subgame perfection cri-terion. We show that, as δ converges to zero, equilibrium prices at which trades occur converge to the Walrasian price and the realized allocations converge to the competitive allocation. We also show existence of equilibria for δ sufficiently small.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00735.x.abstractZh: 考虑一个去中心化的、动态的市场，具有无限的时间范围，并且存在参与成本。买卖双方都拥有关于他们所交易的不可分割商品价值的私人信息。时间是不连续的，每个时期的长度为δ，每个时间单位都有新的买卖方考虑进入市场。预期效用为负的交易者会选择不进入市场。在一个时期内，每个买家都会匿名地与一个卖家配对，每个卖家也会与零个、一个或多个买家配对。每个卖家都会进行第一价格拍卖，并设定一个保留价格；如果交易发生，卖家和获胜的买家都会以实际获得的效用退出市场。未能交易的交易者会继续留在市场中，等待重新配对。我们描述了满足子博弈完美性条件的稳态均衡。我们证明了，随着δ趋近于零，发生交易的均衡价格会趋近于瓦尔拉斯价格，而实际分配则会趋近于竞争分配。我们还证明了，在δ足够小的情况下，也存在均衡。

abstract.text: This paper establishes that instruments enable the identification of nonparametric regression models in the presence of measurement error by providing a closed form solution for the regression function in terms of Fourier transforms of conditional expectations of observable variables. For parametrically specified regression functions, we propose a root n consistent and asymptotically normal estimator that takes the familiar form of a generalized method of moments estimator with a plugged-in nonparametric kernel density estimate. Both the identification and the estimation methodologies rely on Fourier analysis and on the theory of generalized functions. The finite-sample properties of the estimator are investigated through Monte Carlo simulations.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00736.x.abstractZh: 本文证明了，在存在测量误差的情况下，工具变量能够帮助我们识别非参数回归模型。通过利用条件期望的可观变量傅里叶变换，我们可以以封闭形式得到回归函数的表达式。对于参数指定的回归函数，我们提出了一种根n一致且渐近正态的估计量，该估计量具有广义矩估计量常见的形式，并包含了非参数核密度估计。这两种估计方法都依赖于傅里叶分析和广义函数理论。通过蒙特卡洛模拟，我们研究了该估计量在有限样本下的性质。

abstract.text: Consider a Bayesian collective decision problem in which the preferences of agents are private information. We provide a general demonstration that the utility costs associated with incentive constraints become negligible when the decision problem is linked with a large number of independent copies of itself. This is established by defining a mechanism in which agents must budget their representations of preferences so that the frequency of preferences across problems mirrors the underlying distribution of preferences, and then arguing that agents' incentives are to satisfy their budget by being as truthful as possible. We also show that all equilibria of the linking mechanisms converge to the target utility levels. The mechanisms do not require transferable utility or interpersonal comparisons of utility, and are immune to manipulations by coalitions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00737.x.abstractZh: 考虑一个贝叶斯集体决策问题，其中代理人的偏好是私有信息。我们提供了一个通用的证明：当决策问题与大量独立的自身副本相关联时，与激励约束相关的效用成本变得可以忽略不计。这一结论是通过定义一个机制来建立的，该机制要求代理人对偏好进行预算安排，使得不同问题中的偏好频率与潜在的偏好分布一致。接着，我们认为代理人的动机是尽可能真实地满足自己的预算。我们还证明了，所有链接机制的均衡都会收敛到目标效用水平。这些机制不需要可转移的效用或人际间的效用比较，并且不受联盟操纵的影响。

abstract.text: This paper develops estimators for quantile treatment effects under the identifying restriction that selection to treatment is based on observable characteristics. Identification is achieved without requiring computation of the conditional quantiles of the potential outcomes. Instead, the identification results for the marginal quantiles lead to an estimation procedure for the quantile treatment effect parameters that has two steps: nonparametric estimation of the propensity score and computation of the difference between the solutions of two separate minimization problems. Root-N consistency, asymptotic normality, and achievement of the semiparametric efficiency bound are shown for that estimator. A consistent estimation procedure for the variance is also presented. Finally, the method developed here is applied to evaluation of a job training program and to a Monte Carlo exercise. Results from the empirical application indicate that the method works relatively well even for a data set with limited overlap between treated and controls in the support of covariates. The Monte Carlo study shows that, for a relatively small sample size, the method produces estimates with good precision and low bias, especially for middle quantiles.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00738.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种在识别限制条件下估计分位数处理效应的方法，该限制条件要求选择接受处理是基于可观测特征。识别过程无需计算潜在结果的条件分位数，而是通过对边际分位数进行识别，从而得到分位数处理效应参数的估计方法。该方法包括两个步骤：非参数估计倾向得分以及计算两个独立最小化问题解之间的差值。文中证明了该估计量的根N一致性、渐近正态性以及达到半参数效率界限。此外，还提出了一种对方差进行一致估计的方法。最后，将所开发的方法应用于一项就业培训项目的评估以及蒙特卡洛模拟实验中。实证应用结果表明，即使在处理组和对照组在协变量支持上存在有限重叠的情况下，该方法仍能取得相对良好的效果。蒙特卡洛研究表明，在样本量相对较小的条件下，该方法能够产生精度高且偏差低的估计结果，尤其是在中等分位数上。

abstract.text: This paper applies some general concepts in decision theory to a simple instrumental variables model. There are two endogenous variables linked by a single structural equation; k of the exogenous variables are excluded from this structural equation and provide the instrumental variables (IV). The reduced-form distribution of the endogenous variables conditional on the exogenous variables corresponds to independent draws from a bivariate normal distribution with linear regression functions and a known covariance matrix. A canonical form of the model has parameter vector (ρ, φ, ω), where φis the parameter of interest and is normalized to be a point on the unit circle. The reduced-form coefficients on the instrumental variables are split into a scalar parameter ρand a parameter vector ω, which is normalized to be a point on the (k−1)-dimensional unit sphere; ρmeasures the strength of the association between the endogenous variables and the instrumental variables, and ωis a measure of direction. A prior distribution is introduced for the IV model. The parameters φ, ρ, and ωare treated as independent random variables. The distribution for φis uniform on the unit circle; the distribution for ωis uniform on the unit sphere with dimension k-1. These choices arise from the solution of a minimax problem. The prior for ρis left general. It turns out that given any positive value for ρ, the Bayes estimator of φdoes not depend on ρ; it equals the maximum-likelihood estimator. This Bayes estimator has constant risk; because it minimizes average risk with respect to a proper prior, it is minimax. The same general concepts are applied to obtain confidence intervals. The prior distribution is used in two ways. The first way is to integrate out the nuisance parameter ωin the IV model. This gives an integrated likelihood function with two scalar parameters, φand ρ. Inverting a likelihood ratio test, based on the integrated likelihood function, provides a confidence interval for φ. This lacks finite sample optimality, but invariance arguments show that the risk function depends only on ρand not on φor ω. The second approach to confidence sets aims for finite sample optimality by setting up a loss function that trades off coverage against the length of the interval. The automatic uniform priors are used for φand ω, but a prior is also needed for the scalar ρ, and no guidance is offered on this choice. The Bayes rule is a highest posterior density set. Invariance arguments show that the risk function depends only on ρand not on φor ω. The optimality result combines average risk and maximum risk. The confidence set minimizes the average—with respect to the prior distribution for ρ—of the maximum risk, where the maximization is with respect to φand ω.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00764.x.abstractZh: 本文将决策理论中的一些通用概念应用于一个简单的工具变量模型。模型中有两个内生变量，它们通过单一的结构方程相连；其中k个外生变量被排除在这个结构方程之外，而它们则作为工具变量。在给定外生变量的条件下，内生变量的简化形式分布相当于从具有线性回归函数和已知协方差矩阵的双变量正态分布中独立抽取的值。模型的规范形式具有参数向量(ρ, φ, ω)，其中φ是感兴趣的参数，并被归一化为单位圆上的一个点。工具变量上的简化形式系数被分解为一个标量参数ρ和一个参数向量ω，后者被归一化为(k-1)维单位球面上的一个点；ρ衡量内生变量与工具变量之间的关联强度，而ω则衡量方向。为工具变量模型引入了一个先验分布。参数φ、ρ和ω被视为独立的随机变量。φ的分布在单位圆上均匀分布；ω的分布在单位球面上均匀分布，且单位球的维度为k-1。这些选择源于一个极小极大问题的解。ρ的先验分布被设定为一般形式。结果表明，对于任何正的ρ值，φ的贝叶斯估计量并不依赖于ρ；它等于最大似然估计量。这个贝叶斯估计量具有恒定的风险；因为它在适当的先验条件下最小化了平均风险，所以它属于极小极大估计量。同样的一般概念也被用于获得置信区间。先验分布以两种方式使用：第一种方式是在工具变量模型中积分掉干扰参数ω。这给出了一个包含两个标量参数φ和ρ的集成似然函数。基于该集成似然函数进行的似然比检验，可以给出φ的置信区间。这种方法缺乏有限样本最优性，但不变性论证表明，风险函数仅依赖于ρ，而不依赖于φ或ω。第二种置信集的构建方法通过设定一个损失函数来实现有限样本最优性，该损失函数在覆盖率和区间长度之间进行权衡。对于φ和ω，使用了自动均匀先验，但对于标量ρ也需要一个先验，而关于这一选择的指导并不明确。贝叶斯规则是最高后验密度设定。不变性论证表明，风险函数仅依赖于ρ，而不依赖于φ或ω。最优性结果结合了平均风险和最大风险。置信集在ρ的先验分布下，最小化最大风险的平均风险，其中最大化是相对于φ和ω进行的。

abstract.text: Consider a two-person intertemporal bargaining problem in which players choose actions and offers each period, and collect payoffs (as a function of that period's actions) while bargaining proceeds. This can alternatively be viewed as an infinitely repeated game wherein players can offer one another enforceable contracts that govern play for the rest of the game. Theory is silent with regard to how the surplus is likely to be split, because a folk theorem applies. Perturbing such a game with a rich set of behavioral types for each player yields a specific asymptotic prediction for how the surplus will be divided, as the perturbation probabilities approach zero. Behavioral types may follow nonstationary strategies and respond to the opponent's play. In equilibrium, rational players initially choose a behavioral type to imitate and a war of attrition ensues. How much should a player try to get and how should she behave while waiting for the resolution of bargaining? In both respects she should build her strategy around the advice given by the "Nash bargaining with threats" (NBWT) theory developed for two-stage games. In any perfect Bayesian equilibrium, she can guarantee herself virtually her NBWT payoff by imitating a behavioral type with the following simple strategy: in every period, ask for (and accept nothing less than) that player's NBWT share and, while waiting for the other side to concede, take the action Nash recommends as a threat in his two-stage game. The results suggest that there are forces at work in some dynamic games that favor certain payoffs over all others. This is in stark contrast to the classic folk theorems, to the further folk theorems established for repeated games with two-sided reputational perturbations, and to the permissive results obtained in the literature on bargaining with payoffs as you go.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00765.x.abstractZh: 考虑一个两人跨时期讨价还价问题，其中每个时期，参与者都会选择行动并提出报价，在讨价还价过程中，他们会根据该时期的行动获得收益。这也可以被视为一个无限重复的游戏，参与者可以互相提出具有约束力的合同，以规范游戏的后续进程。关于收益如何分配，理论并没有给出明确说明，因为适用了一个“民间定理”。通过对这种游戏施加一系列行为类型，可以得出一个具体的渐近预测，即随着扰动概率趋近于零，收益将如何分配。行为类型可能会采取非静态策略，并对对手的行动作出反应。在均衡状态下，理性参与者最初会选择一个行为类型来模仿，随后会进入一种消耗战。参与者在等待讨价还价结果时，应该采取怎样的策略呢？在这两个方面，她都应该遵循为两阶段游戏所发展的“纳什威胁讨价还价”理论所提供的建议。在任何完美的贝叶斯均衡中，通过模仿某种行为类型，她几乎可以确保获得自己的纳什威胁讨价还价收益。在每个时期，她都应该要求得到对方的纳什威胁讨价还价份额，并且在等待对方让步时，采取纳什在其两阶段游戏中推荐的行动作为威胁。研究结果表明，在某些动态游戏中，存在一些力量使得某些收益比其他收益更有优势。这与经典的民间定理形成了鲜明对比，也与针对具有双向声誉扰动重复博弈而建立的进一步民间定理以及关于支付随博弈进行而变化的讨价还价问题的文献中所获得的宽容性结果形成了对比。

abstract.text: George-Marios Angeletos, Christian Hellwig, and Alessandro Pavan, “Dynamic Global Games of Regime Change: Learning, Multiplicity and Timing of Attacks”, Econometrica, vol. 75, n. 3, May 2007, pp. 711–756.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00766.x.abstractZh: 乔治-马里奥斯·安杰莱托斯、克里斯蒂安·赫尔维格和亚历山德罗·帕万，《动态全球政权更迭博弈：学习、多重性及攻击时机》，《经济计量学》，第75卷，第3期，2007年5月，第711-756页。

abstract.text: In this paper, we consider the nonparametric identification and estimation of the average effect of a dummy endogenous regressor in models where the regressors are weakly but not additively separable from the error term. The model is not required to be strictly increasing in the error term, and the class of models considered includes limited dependent variable models such as discrete choice models. Conditions are established conditions under which it is possible to identify the average effect of the dummy endogenous regressor in a weakly separable model without relying on parametric functional form or distributional assumptions and without the use of large support conditions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00767.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们考虑了在回归变量与误差项弱但不可加性分离的情况下，非参数方法用于识别与估计虚拟内生回归变量的平均效应。模型不要求严格依赖于误差项，所考虑的模型类别包括有限因变量模型，如离散选择模型。本文建立了条件，在这些条件下，可以在弱可分离模型中识别虚拟内生回归变量的平均效应，而无需依赖参数化函数形式或分布假设，也无需使用大支持条件。

abstract.text: We propose a simple method to help researchers develop quantitative models of economic fluctuations. The method rests on the insight that many models are equivalent to a prototype growth model with time-varying wedges that resemble productivity, labor and investment taxes, and government consumption. Wedges that correspond to these variables—efficiency, labor, investment, and government consumption wedges—are measured and then fed back into the model so as to assess the fraction of various fluctuations they account for. Applying this method to U.S. data for the Great Depression and the 1982 recession reveals that the efficiency and labor wedges together account for essentially all of the fluctuations; the investment wedge plays a decidedly tertiary role, and the government consumption wedge plays none. Analyses of the entire postwar period and alternative model specifications support these results. Models with frictions manifested primarily as investment wedges are thus not promising for the study of U.S. business cycles.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00768.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种简单的方法，帮助研究人员构建经济波动的定量模型。该方法基于这样的洞察：许多模型实际上等同于一个原型增长模型，该模型中的时间变化楔形部分分别对应于生产力、劳动力和投资税收，以及政府消费。这些变量对应的楔形部分——效率、劳动力、投资和政府消费楔形部分——被测量后反馈到模型中，以评估它们各自所解释的波动比例。将这种方法应用于美国大萧条和1982年经济衰退的数据，发现效率与劳动力楔形部分共同解释了几乎所有波动；投资楔形部分的作用明显较弱，而政府消费楔形部分则完全没有作用。对整个战后时期以及不同模型规格的分析都支持了这些结果。因此，那些主要以投资楔形形式体现摩擦的模型，并不适合用于研究美国的经济周期。

abstract.text: As the exchange rate, foreign demand, production costs and export promotion policies evolve, manufacturing firms are continually faced with two issues: whether to be an exporter, and if so, how much to export. we develop a dynamic structural model of export supply that characterizes these two decisions and estimate the model using plant-level panel data on Colombian chemical producers. The model embodies uncertainty, plant-level heterogeneity in export profits, and sunk entry costs for plants breaking into foreign markets. Our estimates, and the simulation exercises that they support, yield several implications. First, entry costs are typically large, but vary greatly across proucers. second, there is substantial cross-plant heterogeneity in gross expected export profit streams. Third, these large entry costs make expectations about future exporting conditions important for many producers, so changes in the exchange rate regime that are credible induce much more entry than those that are not. Fourth, however, most of the entry and exit takes place among marginal exporters who contribute little to aggregate export revenues. Finally, subsidies on export earnings have much large impact on export revenues(per dollar spent)than subsidies that reduce the entry costs faced by new exporters.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00769.x.abstractZh: 随着汇率、外国需求、生产成本以及出口促进政策的不断变化，制造企业始终面临两个问题：是否成为出口商，如果选择出口，则出口数量如何确定。我们建立了一个动态结构模型来描述这两个决策，并利用哥伦比亚化学生产企业的面板数据对模型进行了估计。该模型考虑了不确定性、不同工厂在出口利润上的差异，以及新工厂进入外国市场的沉没成本。我们的估计结果以及相应的模拟分析揭示了几个重要结论：首先，进入成本通常很高，但不同企业之间的成本差异很大；其次，不同工厂在预期出口利润上存在显著的差异；第三，高昂的进入成本使得人们对未来出口状况的预期对许多企业来说非常重要，因此，可信的汇率政策变化会比不可信的政策变化引发更多的企业进入市场；第四，大多数企业的进入和退出都发生在边缘出口商之间，这些企业对整体出口收入贡献很小；最后，对出口收入的补贴对出口收入的影响远大于降低新出口商进入成本的补贴。

abstract.text: One of the primary tasks of the mechanism-design literature has been to draw theo-retical barriers to trade due to asymmetric information. However, this literature has focused exclusively on trade that is motivated by di¤erences in tastes. In principle, one could pose the same set of questions when the motivation for trade is di¤erences

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00770.x.abstractZh: 机制设计领域的首要任务之一，就是分析由于信息不对称而产生的贸易理论障碍。然而，这一领域的研究主要集中在由偏好差异引发的贸易行为上。原则上，当贸易的动机源于偏好差异时，同样可以提出相同的问题。

abstract.text: We analyze a cheap talk game, à la Crawford and Sobel, in a multidimensional state and policy space. A feature of the multidimensional state space is that communication on one dimension often reveals information on others. We show how this feature imposes bounds on communication.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00771.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种类似Crawford和Sobel提出的廉价闲谈游戏，该游戏发生在多维状态与政策空间中。多维状态空间的一个特点是，一个维度上的信息往往能揭示其他维度上的信息。我们展示了这一特性如何对沟通行为施加限制。

abstract.text: We report recent advances concerning the package allocation problem, in which traders seek to buy or sell combinations of goods. The problems are most difficult when some goods are not substitutes. In that case, competitive equilibrium typically fail to exist but the core is non-empty and comprises the competitive solutions. Also in that case, the Vickrey auction fails to select core allocations and yield revenues that are less than competitive. The Ausubel-Milgrom auction generally selects core allocations and, when goods are substitutes, prescribes the Vickrey allocation. We also evaluate the problems and promise of mechanisms for the package exchange problem.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00778.x.abstractZh: 我们报告了关于包裹分配问题的最新进展，在这个问题中，交易者寻求购买或出售各种商品的组合。当某些商品不是替代品时，这些问题最为复杂。在这种情况下，竞争均衡通常不存在，但核心解是非空的，并且包含了竞争解决方案。同样在这种情况下，Vickrey拍卖也无法选择核心分配方案，并且产生的收益低于竞争均衡下的收益。Ausubel-Milgrom拍卖通常能够选择核心分配方案，而当商品是替代品时，它还能规定Vickrey分配方案。我们还评估了这些问题的机制，并承诺为包裹交换问题提供解决方案。

abstract.text: In this paper I demonstrate how one can generalize finitely many examples to statements about (infinite) classes of economic models. If there exist upper bounds on the number of connected components of one-dimensional linear subsets of the set of parameters for which a conjecture is true, one can conclude that it is correct for all parameter values in the class considered, except for a small residual set, once one has verified the conjecture for a predetermined finite set of points. I show how to apply this insight to computational experiments and spell out assumptions on the economic fundamentals that ensure that the necessary bounds on the number of connected components exist. I argue that these methods can be fruitfully utilized in applied general equilibrium analysis. I provide general assumptions on preferences and production sets that ensure that economic conjectures define sets with a bounded number of connected components. Using the theoretical results, I give an example of how one can explore qualitative and quantitative implications of general equilibrium models using computational experiments. Finally, I show how random algorithms can be used for generalizing examples in high-dimensional problems.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00779.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我展示了如何将有限数量的例子推广到关于（无限）类经济模型的陈述。如果存在一个上限，用于描述参数集合的一维线性子集的连通分量数量，并且某个猜想在该类参数值下成立，那么只要已经验证了预定有限数量点的猜想，就可以得出结论：该猜想对于所考虑的所有参数值都是正确的，除了一小部分剩余情况。我展示了如何将这一见解应用于计算实验，并详细说明了确保连通分量数量存在必要上限的经济基础假设。我认为，这些方法可以在应用性一般均衡分析中得到有效的利用。我提出了关于偏好和生产集的一般假设，以确保经济猜想所定义的集合具有有限数量的连通分量。利用这些理论结果，我举例说明了如何使用计算实验来探索一般均衡模型的定性和定量影响。最后，我展示了如何使用随机算法来推广高维问题中的例子。

abstract.text: Many tests of asset pricing models address only the pricing predictions - but these pricing predictions rest on portfolio choice predictions which seem obviously wrong. This paper suggests a new approach to asset pricing and portfolio choices, based on unobserved heterogeneity. This approach yields the standard pricing conclusions of classical models but is consistent with very different portfolio choices. Novel econometric tests link the price and portfolio predictions and take account of the general equilibrium effects of sample-size bias. The paper works through the approach in detail for the case of the classical CAPM, producing a model called CAPM+. When these econometric tests are applied to data generated by large-scale laboratory asset markets which reveal both prices and portfolio choices, CAPM+ is not rejected.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00780.x.abstractZh: 许多资产定价模型的测试仅关注定价预测，但这些定价预测基于的投资组合选择预测显然是错误的。本文提出了一种基于未观测异质性的资产定价和投资组合选择的新方法。该方法得出经典模型的标准定价结论，但与完全不同的投资组合选择相一致。新的计量经济学测试将价格预测与投资组合选择联系起来，并考虑了样本量偏差的一般均衡效应。本文详细阐述了该方法在经典CAPM案例中的应用，并提出了一种称为CAPM+的模型。当这些计量经济学测试应用于由大规模实验室资产市场生成的数据时，CAPM+并未被否定。

abstract.text: In this paper, we generalize the notion of Pareto-efficiency to make it applicable to environments with endogenous populations. Two efficiency concepts are proposed, P-efficiency and A-efficiency. The two concepts differ in how they treat people who are not born. We show how these concepts relate to the notion of Pareto-efficiency when fertility is exogenous. We then prove versions of the first welfare theorem assuming that decision making is efficient within the dynasty. Finally, we give two sets of sufficient conditions for noncooperative equilibria of family decision problems to be efficient. These include the Barro and Becker model as a special case.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00781.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们将帕累托效率的概念推广到具有内生人口的环境中。我们提出了两种效率概念：P-效率和A-效率。这两种概念在处理非出生人口的方式上有所不同。我们展示了当生育率是外生变量时，这两种概念如何与帕累托效率的概念相关联。接着，我们证明了在决策行为在家族内部是高效的情况下，第一个福利定理的几种版本。最后，我们给出了两组充分条件，用于确保家庭决策问题的非合作均衡是高效的。其中，巴罗和贝克尔模型是这些条件的特例。

abstract.text: We present sufficient conditions for monotone matching in environments where utility is not fully transferable between partners. These conditions involve not only complementarity in types of the total payoff to a match, as in the transferable utility case, but also monotonicity in type of the degree of transferability between partners. We apply our conditions to study some models of risk sharing and incentive problems, deriving new results for predicted matching patterns in those contexts.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00782.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了在效用无法完全在双方之间转移的环境中进行单调匹配的充分条件。这些条件不仅涉及总收益的类型的互补性，就像在可转移效用情况下那样，还涉及双方之间可转移性的类型的单调性。我们将这些条件应用于研究一些风险分担和激励问题模型，从而在这些情境下推导出新的匹配模式预测结果。
