abstract.text: This paper analyzes equilibrium and welfare for a tractable class of economies (games) that have externalities, strategic complementarity or substitutability, and heterogeneous information. First, we characterize the equilibrium use of information: complementarity heightens the sensitivity of equilibrium actions to public information, raising aggregate volatility, whereas substitutability heightens the sensitivity to private information, raising cross-sectional dispersion. Next, we define and characterize an efficiency benchmark designed to address whether the equilibrium use of information is optimal from a social perspective; the efficient use of information reflects the social value of aligning choices across agents. Finally, we examine the comparative statics of equilibrium welfare with respect to the information structure; the social value of information is best understood by classifying economies according to the inefficiency, if any, in the equilibrium use of information. We conclude with a few applications, including production externalities, beauty contests, business cycles, and large Cournot and Bertrand games.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00783.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了一类具有外部性、战略互补性或可替代性以及异质信息的可处理经济（博弈）的均衡与福利问题。首先，我们描述了信息使用的均衡特性：互补性提高了均衡行为对公共信息的敏感性，从而增加整体波动性；而可替代性则提高了对私人信息的敏感性，导致横截面上的分散程度增加。接下来，我们定义了一个效率基准，用以判断从社会角度来看，信息的均衡使用是否是最优的；信息的有效使用反映了不同主体之间选择协调的社会价值。最后，我们考察了均衡福利与信息结构之间的比较静态关系；通过分类经济体的信息使用效率，可以更好地理解信息的社会价值。最后，我们列举了一些应用案例，包括生产外部性、选美比赛、商业周期以及大型的库尔诺博弈和伯特兰博弈。

abstract.text: HAL is a multi-disciplinary open access archive for the deposit and dissemination of sci-entific research documents, whether they are pub-lished or not. The documents may come from teaching and research institutions in France or abroad, or from public or private research centers. L’archive ouverte pluridisciplinaire HAL, est destinée au dépôt et a ̀ la diffusion de documents scientifiques de niveau recherche, publiés ou non, émanant des établissements d’enseignement et de recherche français ou étrangers, des laboratoires publics ou privés.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00784.x.abstractZh: HAL是一个多学科的开放访问档案库，用于存储和传播科学研究文档，无论这些文档是否已经发表。这些文档可能来自法国或国外的教学与研究机构，或者来自公共或私有的研究中心。这个多学科开放档案库旨在存储和传播各类研究级别的科学研究文档，无论这些文档是否已经发表，它们都来自法国或国外的教学与研究机构，以及公共或私有的实验室。

abstract.text: This paper considers the problem of selection of weights for averaging across leastsquares estimates obtained from a set of models. Existing model average methods are based on exponential AIC and BIC weights. In distinction, this paper proposes selecting the weights by minimizing a Mallows ’ criterion, the latter an estimate of the average squared error from the model average fit. We show that our new Mallows ’ Model Average (MMA) estimator is asymptotically optimal in the sense of achieving the lowest possible squared error in a class of discrete model average estimators. In a simulation experiment we show that the MMA estimator compares favorably with those based on AIC and BIC weights. The proof of the main result is an application of Li (1987). Research supported by the National Science Foundation. I gratefully thank the Co-Editor (Whitney Newey), three referees, and Benedickt Potscher for helpful comments.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00785.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了为从一组模型中获得的残差估计值进行平均运算而选择权重的问题。现有的模型平均方法基于指数形式的AIC和BIC权重。与以往方法不同，本文提出了通过最小化Mallows准则来选择权重的方法，该准则是对模型平均拟合所得的平均平方误差的估计。我们证明，新的Mallows模型平均估计量在离散模型平均估计量类中具有渐近最优性，即能够实现最低可能的平方误差。在模拟实验中，我们发现MMA估计量与基于AIC和BIC权重的估计量相比具有明显优势。主要结果的证明是应用了Li（1987）的理论。本研究得到了美国国家科学基金会的支持。我衷心感谢联合编辑Whitney Newey、三位审稿人以及Benedickt Potscher提供的宝贵意见。

abstract.text: We consider nonparametric estimation of a regression function that is identified by requiring a specified quantile of the regression “error” conditional on an instrumental variable to be zero. The resulting estimating equation is a nonlinear integral equation of the first kind, which generates an ill-posed inverse problem. The integral operator and distribution of the instrumental variable are unknown and must be estimated nonparametrically. We show that the estimator is mean-square consistent, derive its rate of convergence in probability, and give conditions under which this rate is optimal in a minimax sense. The results of Monte Carlo experiments show that the estimator behaves well in finite samples.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00786.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一种非参数估计回归函数的方法，该方法通过要求在工具变量条件下，回归“误差”的特定分位数为零来识别回归函数。由此产生的估计方程是一个非线性的第一类积分方程，这导致了一个不适定的逆问题。积分运算工具和工具变量的分布是未知的，必须采用非参数方法进行估计。我们证明了该估计量具有均方一致性，推导了其概率收敛速率，并给出了在极小极大意义上该速率最优的条件。蒙特卡洛实验的结果表明，该估计量在有限样本情况下表现良好。

abstract.text: For vectors z and w and scalar v, let r(v, z, w) be a function that can be nonparametrically estimated consistently and asymptotically normally, such as a distribution, density, or conditional mean regression function. We provide consistent, asymptotically normal nonparametric estimators for the functions G and H, where r(v, z, w)=H[vG(z), w], and some related models. This framework encompasses homothetic and homothetically separable functions, and transformed partly additive models r(v, z, w)=h[v+g(z), w] for unknown functions g and h. Such models reduce the curse of dimensionality, provide a natural generalization of linear index models, and are widely used in utility, production, and cost function applications. We also provide an estimator of G that is oracle efficient, achieving the same performance as an estimator based on local least squares knowing H.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00787.x.abstractZh: 对于向量z和w以及标量v，令r(v, z, w)为一个函数，该函数可以非参数地一致估计，并且具有渐近正态性，例如分布、密度或条件均值回归函数。我们为函数G和H提供了一致且渐近正态的非参数估计器，其中r(v, z, w)=H[vG(z), w]，以及一些相关的模型。该框架涵盖了相似函数和相似可分离函数，以及部分加性变换模型r(v, z, w)=h[v+g(z), w]，其中g和h是未知函数。这类模型减少了维数灾难，提供了线性指数模型的自然推广，并广泛应用于效用、生产和成本函数的应用中。我们还提供了一种G的估计器，该估计器具有预言效率，其性能与基于局部最小二乘法的估计器在知道H的情况下具有相同的性能。

abstract.text: Earlier version: June 16, 2004; Revision: June 22, 2006

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00794.x.abstractZh: 早期版本：2004年6月16日；修订版：2006年6月22日

abstract.text: This paper investigates a new class of 2-player games in continuous time, in which the players' observations of each other's actions are distorted by Brownian motions.These games are analogous to repeated games with imperfect monitoring in which the players take actions frequently.Using a differential equation we find the set E(r) of payoff pairs achievable by all public perfect equilibria of the continuous-time game, where r is the discount rate.The same differential equation allows us to find public perfect equilibria that achieve any value pair on the boundary of the set E(r).These public perfect equilibria are based on a pair of continuation values as a state variable, which moves along the boundary of E(r) during the course of the game.In order to give players incentives to take actions that are not static best responses, the pair of continuation values is stochastically driven by the players' observations of each other's actions along the boundary of the set E(r).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00795.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类连续时间下的两人博弈，其中玩家对彼此行为的观察受到布朗运动的干扰。这类博弈类似于存在不完全监控的重复博弈，玩家会频繁采取行动。通过微分方程，我们找到了连续时间博弈中所有公共完美均衡所能实现的收益对集合E(r)，其中r为折现率。同样的微分方程还允许我们找到在E(r)边界上实现任意收益对的公共完美均衡。这些公共完美均衡基于一对连续值作为状态变量，在博弈过程中沿着E(r)的边界移动。为了激励玩家采取非静态最优反应，这对连续值由玩家在E(r)边界上对彼此行为的观察来随机驱动。

abstract.text: We describe a two-step algorithm for estimating dynamic games under the assumption that behavior is consistent with Markov perfect equilibrium. In the first step, the policy functions and the law of motion for the state variables are estimated. In the second step, the remaining structural parameters are estimated using the optimality conditions for equilibrium. The second step estimator is a simple simulated minimum distance estimator. The algorithm applies to a broad class of models, including industry competition models with both discrete and continuous controls such as the Ericson and Pakes (1995) model. We test the algorithm on a class of dynamic discrete choice models with normally distributed errors and a class of dynamic oligopoly models similar to that of Pakes and McGuire (1994).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00796.x.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种两步算法，用于在行为与马尔可夫完美均衡一致这一假设下估计动态博弈。第一步是估计状态变量的策略函数和运动规律。第二步是利用均衡的最优条件来估计剩余的结构参数。第二步的估计器是一种简单的模拟最小距离估计器。该算法适用于广泛的模型类别，包括具有离散和连续控制的行业竞争模型，例如Ericson和Pakes（1995年）模型。我们在一类具有正态分布误差的动态离散选择模型以及一类类似于Pakes和McGuire（1994年）提出的动态寡头垄断模型上测试了该算法。

abstract.text: This paper presents three sets of results about equilibrium bias of technology. First, I show that when the menu of technological possibilities only allows for factor-augmenting technologies, the increase in the supply of a factor induces technological change relatively biased toward that factor—meaning that the induced technological change increases the relative marginal product of the factor becoming more abundant. Moreover, this induced bias can be strong enough to make the relative marginal product of a factor increasing in response to an increase in its supply, thus leading to an upward-sloping relative demand curve. I also show that these results about relative bias do not generalize when more general menus of technological possibilities are considered. Second, I prove that under mild assumptions, the increase in the supply of a factor induces technological change that is absolutely biased toward that factor—meaning that it increases its marginal product at given factor proportions. The third and most important result in the paper establishes the possibility of and conditions for strong absolute equilibrium bias—whereby the price (marginal product) of a factor increases in response to an increase in its supply. I prove that, under some regularity conditions, there will be strong absolute equilibrium bias if and only if the aggregate production function of the economy fails to be jointly concave in factors and technology. This type of failure of joint concavity is possible in economies where equilibrium factor demands and technologies result from the decisions of different agents.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00797.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于技术均衡偏差的三组研究结果。首先，我证明了当技术选择方案仅允许增加某种生产要素的技术时，该生产要素的供应增加会促使技术变革相对偏向该要素——这意味着诱导的技术变革会提高该要素的相对边际产量，使其变得更加充裕。此外，这种诱导的偏差可能足够强烈，以至于该要素的相对边际产量会随着其供应的增加而上升，从而导致相对需求曲线呈上升趋势。我还指出，当考虑更一般的技术选择方案时，这些关于相对偏差的研究结果并不具有普遍性。其次，我在一些温和的假设下证明了，生产要素的供应增加会促使技术变革绝对偏向该要素——也就是说，它会在给定的要素比例下提高该要素的边际产量。第三，也是最重要的结果，本文提出了强绝对均衡偏差的可能性及条件——即某种生产要素的价格（边际产量）会随着其供应的增加而上升。我证明，在某些常规条件下，只有当经济的总生产函数未能在要素和技术上同时呈现凹性时，才会出现强绝对均衡偏差。这种联合凹性的失效在那些均衡要素需求和技术是由不同主体决策所决定的经济体系中是可能发生的。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to provide theoretical justification for some existing methods for constructing confidence intervals for the sum of coefficients in autoregressive models. We show that the methods of Stock (1991), Andrews (1993), and Hansen (1999) provide asymptotically valid confidence intervals, whereas the subsampling method of Romano and Wolf (2001) does not. In addition, we generalize the three valid methods to a larger class of statistics. We also clarify the difference between uniform and pointwise asymptotic approximations, and show that a pointwise convergence of coverage probabilities for all values of the parameter does not guarantee the validity of the confidence set.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00798.x.abstractZh: 本文的目的是为构建自回归模型中系数总和的置信区间提供一些现有方法的理论依据。我们证明，Stock（1991）、Andrews（1993）和Hansen（1999）提出的方法能够给出渐近有效的置信区间，而Romano和Wolf（2001）提出的子样本方法则无法做到这一点。此外，我们将这三种有效方法推广到更广泛的统计量类别。我们还阐明了均匀渐近近似与逐点渐近近似之间的区别，并表明，即使所有参数值的覆盖概率都呈逐点收敛，也不能保证置信集的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper takes steps toward integrating firm theory in the spirit of Alchian and Demsetz (1972) and Grossman and Hart (1986), contract theory in the spirit of Holmstrom (1979), and general equilibrium theory in the spirit of Arrow and Debreu (1954) and McKenzie (1959). In the model presented here, the set of firms that form and the contractual arrangements that appear, the assignments of agents to firms, the prices faced by firms for inputs and outputs, and the incentives to agents are all determined endogenously at equilibrium. Agents choose consumption—but they also choose which firms to join, which roles to occupy in those firms, and which actions to take in those roles. Agents interact anonymously with the (large) market, but strategically within the (small) firms they join. The model accommodates moral hazard, adverse selection, signaling, and insurance. Equilibria may be Pareto ranked.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00799.x.abstractZh: 本文试图将企业理论整合到阿尔奇安和德姆塞茨（1972年）以及格罗斯曼和哈特（1986年）所倡导的框架下，将契约理论融入到霍姆斯特罗姆（1979年）的理论体系中，并将一般均衡理论纳入阿罗和德布鲁（1954年）以及麦肯齐（1959年）的研究范畴。在本文所构建的模型中，形成企业的集合、出现的契约安排、代理人被分配到哪些企业、企业面临的投入与产出价格，以及代理人的激励因素，所有这些都在均衡状态下由内生因素决定。代理人选择消费行为，但他们也会选择加入哪些企业、在那些企业中担任哪些角色，以及在这些角色中采取哪些行动。代理人与（大型的）市场进行匿名互动，但在他们加入的（小型的）企业内部则采取策略性互动。该模型能够容纳道德风险、逆向选择、信号传递和保险机制。均衡状态可以是帕累托最优的。

abstract.text: This study reports evidence from a field experiment that was conducted to investigate the relevance of gift exchange in a natural setting. In collaboration with a charitable organization, we sent roughly 10,000 solicitation letters to potential donors. One-third of the letters contained no gift, one-third contained a small gift, and one-third contained a large gift. Treatment assignment was random. The results confirm the economic importance of gift exchange. Compared to the no gift condition, the relative frequency of donations increased by 17 percent if a small gift was included and by 75 percent for a large gift. The study extends the current body of research on gift exchange, which is almost exclusively confined to laboratory studies.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00800.x.abstractZh: 本研究通过一项实地实验，探讨了礼物交换在自然环境中的相关性。我们与一家慈善组织合作，向潜在捐赠者发送了大约10,000封邀请函。其中三分之一的邀请函不包含任何礼物，三分之一包含小礼物，另外三分之一则包含大礼物。礼物分配是随机进行的。研究结果证实了礼物交换在经济上的重要性。与没有礼物的情况相比，如果包含小礼物，捐赠的相对频率增加了17%；而包含大礼物时，捐赠频率则增加了75%。这项研究扩展了目前关于礼物交换的研究领域，因为目前的相关研究几乎都局限于实验室环境。

abstract.text: Nonseparable models do not impose any type of additivity between the unobserved part and the observable regressors, and are therefore ideal for many economic applications. To identify these models using the entire joint distribution of the data as summarized in regression quantiles, monotonicity in unobservables has frequently been assumed. This paper establishes that in the absence of monotonicity, the quantiles identify local average structural derivatives of nonseparable models.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00801.x.abstractZh: 不可分离模型不要求未观测部分与可观测回归变量之间存在某种类型的可加性，因此非常适合许多经济应用。为了利用数据整体联合分布来识别这些模型，通常假设未观测变量具有单调性。本文证明，在缺乏单调性的情况下，分位数能够识别出不可分离模型的局部平均结构导数。

abstract.text: We study, theoretically and quantitatively, the general equilibrium of an economy in which households smooth consumption by means of both a riskless asset and unsecured loans with the option to default. The default option resembles a bankruptcy filing under Chapter 7 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code. Competitive financial intermediaries offer a menu of loan sizes and interest rates wherein each loan makes zero profits. We prove the existence of a steady-state equilibrium and characterize the circumstances under which a household defaults on its loans. We show that our model accounts for the main statistics regarding bankruptcy and unsecured credit while matching key macroeconomic aggregates, and the earnings and wealth distributions. We use this model to address the implications of a recent policy change that introduces a form of “means testing” for households contemplating a Chapter 7 bankruptcy filing. We find that this policy change yields large welfare gains.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00806.x.abstractZh: 我们从理论上和定量上研究了一个经济体的一般均衡问题，该经济体中的家庭通过无风险资产和无担保贷款来平滑消费，同时拥有违约的选择。违约选项类似于根据美国破产法第七章进行破产申请。具有竞争力的金融中介机构提供不同贷款规模和利率的选择，而每笔贷款都不会产生利润。我们证明了稳态均衡的存在，并描述了家庭违约的情况。我们的模型能够解释与破产和无担保信贷相关的主要统计数据，同时与关键的宏观经济总量以及收入和财富分布相匹配。我们利用这个模型来探讨最近一项政策变化的影响，该变化为考虑申请破产的家庭引入了“收入测试”机制。我们发现，这一政策变化带来了显著的福利改善。

abstract.text: We study a two-player one-arm bandit problem in discrete time, in which the risky arm can have two possible types, high and low, the decision to stop experimenting is irreversible, and players observe each other's actions but not each other's payoffs. We prove that all equilibria are in cutoff strategies and provide several qualitative results on the sequence of cutoffs.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00807.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个离散时间下的双玩家单臂老虎机问题，其中风险臂有两种可能类型：高和低。停止实验的决策是不可逆的，玩家可以观察到彼此的行为，但无法得知彼此的收益。我们证明了所有均衡都采用截止策略，并提供了关于截止顺序的若干定性结果。

abstract.text: This paper studies a shape-invariant Engel curve system with endogenous total expenditure, in which the shape-invariant specification involves a common shift parameter for each demographic group in a pooled system of nonparametric Engel curves. We focus on the identification and estimation of both the nonparametric shapes of the Engel curves and the parametric specification of the demographic scaling parameters. The identification condition relates to the bounded completeness and the estimation procedure applies the sieve minimum distance estimation of conditional moment restrictions, allowing for endogeneity. We establish a new root mean squared convergence rate for the nonparametric instrumental variable regression when the endogenous regressor could have unbounded support. Root-n asymptotic normality and semiparametric efficiency of the parametric components are also given under a set of “low-level” sufficient conditions. Our empirical application using the U.K. Family Expenditure Survey shows the importance of adjusting for endogeneity in terms of both the nonparametric curvatures and the demographic parameters of systems of Engel curves.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00808.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个具有内生总支出的形状不变Engel曲线系统，其中形状不变的设定涉及每个人口群体的一个共同偏移参数，这些参数被纳入一个非参数Engel曲线的汇总系统中。我们重点关注非参数Engel曲线的形状和人口规模参数的参数化设定的识别与估计。识别条件与有界完备性相关，而估计过程采用了条件矩限制的筛选最小距离估计方法，从而考虑了内生性问题。我们为当内生回归变量可能具有无界支持时，非参数工具变量回归建立了新的均方根收敛速率。在一系列“低水平”充分条件下，参数分量的根渐近正态性和半参数效率也得到了证明。我们通过对英国家庭支出调查的实证应用，证明了在调整内生性问题方面，无论是非参数曲线形状还是Engel曲线系统的人口参数，都具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We analyze use of a quasi-likelihood ratio statistic for a mixture model to test the null hypothesis of one regime versus the alternative of two regimes in a Markov regime-switching context. This test exploits mixture properties implied by the regime-switching process, but ignores certain implied serial correlation properties. When formulated in the natural way, the setting is nonstandard, involving nuisance parameters on the boundary of the parameter space, nuisance parameters identified only under the alternative, or approximations using derivatives higher than second order. We exploit recent advances by Andrews (2001) and contribute to the literature by extending the scope of mixture models, obtaining asymptotic null distributions different from those in the literature. We further provide critical values for popular models or bounds for tail probabilities that are useful in constructing conservative critical values for regime-switching tests. We compare the size and power of our statistics to other useful tests for regime switching via Monte Carlo methods and find relatively good performance. We apply our methods to reexamine the classic cartel study of Porter (1983) and reaffirm Porter's findings.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00809.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了用于混合模型的拟似然比统计量，以检验马尔可夫制度转换情境下单一制度与两种制度的零假设。该检验利用了制度转换过程所蕴含的混合特性，但忽略了某些隐含的序列相关特性。当以自然方式构建时，该情境是非标准的，涉及参数空间边界上的干扰参数，这些参数仅在另一种制度假设下才能被识别，或者使用高于二阶的导数进行近似。我们借鉴了Andrews（2001）的最新研究成果，并通过扩展混合模型的范围，得到了与现有文献不同的渐近零分布。我们还为常见模型提供了临界值，或为尾部概率提供了界限，这些在构建制度转换检验的保守临界值时非常有用。我们通过蒙特卡洛方法比较了我们的统计量与其他有用的制度转换检验的性能和功效，发现我们的统计量表现相对良好。我们将我们的方法应用于重新审视Porter（1983）的经典卡特尔研究，并重新确认了Porter的研究结果。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a structural nonequilibrium model of initial responses to incomplete-information games based on “level-k” thinking, which describes behavior in many experiments with complete-information games. We derive the model's implications in first- and second-price auctions with general information structures, compare them to equilibrium and Eyster and Rabin's (2005) “cursed equilibrium,” and evaluate the model's potential to explain nonequilibrium bidding in auction experiments. The level-k model generalizes many insights from equilibrium auction theory. It allows a unified explanation of the winner's curse in common-value auctions and overbidding in those independent-private-value auctions without the uniform value distributions used in most experiments.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00810.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个基于“层级k”思维的结构性非均衡模型，用于描述对不完全信息博弈的初始反应。该模型适用于许多完全信息博弈的实验，并推导出该模型在具有一般信息结构的第一价格和第二价格拍卖中的含义。我们将这些模型与均衡状态以及Eyster和Rabin在2005年提出的“诅咒均衡”进行了比较，并评估了该模型在解释拍卖实验中的非均衡出价行为的潜力。层级k模型推广了均衡拍卖理论中的许多见解。它允许对常见价值拍卖中的“赢家诅咒”以及独立私人价值拍卖中的过度出价现象进行统一解释，而无需像大多数实验那样使用统一的价值分布。

abstract.text: A new panel data model is proposed to represent the behavior of economies in transition allowing for a wide range of possible time paths and individual heterogeneity. The model has both common and individual specific components and is formulated as a nonlinear time varying factor model. When applied to a micro panel, the decomposition provides flexibility in idiosyn-cratic behavior over time and across section, while retaining some commonality across the panel by means of an unknown common growth component. This commonality means that when the heterogeneous time varying idiosyncratic components converge over time to a constant, a form of panel convergence holds, analogous to the concept of conditional sigma convergence. The paper provides a framework of asymptotic representations for the factor components which enables the development of econometric procedures of estimation and testing. In particular, a simple regression based convergence test is developed, whose asymptotic properties are analyzed under both null and local alternatives, and a new method of clustering panels into club convergence groups is constructed. These econometric methods are applied to analyze convergence in cost of living indices among 19 US. metropolitan cities.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2007.00811.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的面板数据模型，用于描述转型经济体的行为，该模型能够涵盖广泛的时间路径和个体异质性。该模型包含共同成分和个体特定成分，并被构建为一个非线性时变因子模型。当应用于微观面板数据时，这种分解方式能够灵活地反映不同时间和不同地区的特异性行为，同时通过一个未知的共同增长成分来保持面板间的某些共性。这种共性意味着，当异质性的时变特异性成分随时间收敛到某个常数时，就会形成一种面板收敛现象，类似于条件σ收敛的概念。本文为因子成分提供了渐近表示框架，从而能够开发出用于估计和检验的经济计量学方法。特别地，本文开发了一种基于简单回归的收敛检验方法，并分析了其在零假设和局部假设下的渐近性质。此外，还提出了一种将面板数据聚类为收敛群的新方法。这些经济计量学方法被应用于分析美国19个大都市城市的生活成本指数收敛情况。

abstract.text: This article exploits policy change by the UK government to identify the impact of competition on quality. It uses differences in competition over time and space to examine the impact of competition in an environment with limited quality signals in which hospitals competed mainly on price. Using AMI mortality as a measure of hospital quality we find that the relationship between competition and this measure of quality is negative. We also find that competition reduced waiting times. Our results indicate that hospitals in competitive markets reduced unmeasured and unobserved quality in order to improve measured and observed waiting times.

10.1111/j.1468-0297.2007.02107.x.abstractZh: 本文通过分析英国政府政策的变化，探讨竞争对质量的影响。通过对比不同时期和不同地区的竞争情况，研究在质量信号有限、医院主要基于价格进行竞争的环境中，竞争对质量的影响。以AMI死亡率作为医院质量的衡量指标，我们发现竞争与这一质量指标之间存在负相关关系。此外，我们还发现竞争减少了等待时间。我们的研究结果表明，处于竞争环境中的医院会减少未测量和未观察到的质量问题，以提高可测量和观察到的等待时间。

abstract.text: This study evaluates the economic consequences of the successful eradication of hookworm disease from the American South. The hookworm-eradication campaign ( c. 1910) began soon after (i) the discovery that a variety of health problems among Southerners could be attributed to the disease and (ii) the donation by John D. Rockefeller of a substantial sum to the effort. The Rockefeller Sanitary Commission (RSC) surveyed infection rates in the affected areas (eleven southern states) and found that an average of forty percent of school-aged children were infected with hookworm. The RSC then sponsored treatment and education campaigns across the region. Follow-up studies indicate that this campaign substantially reduced hookworm disease almost immediately. The sudden introduction of this treatment combines with the cross-area differences in pre-treatment infection rates to form the basis of the identification strategy. Areas with higher levels of hookworm infection prior to the RSC experienced greater increases in school enrollment, attendance, and literacy after the intervention. This result is robust to controlling for a variety of alternative factors, including differential trends across areas, changing crop prices, shifts in certain educational and health policies, and the effect of malaria eradication. No significant contemporaneous results are found for adults, who should have benefited less from the intervention owing to their substantially lower (prior) infection rates. A long-term follow-up of affected cohorts indicates a substantial gain in income that coincided with exposure to hookworm eradication. I also find evidence that eradication increased the return to schooling.

10.1162/qjec.121.1.73.abstractZh: 本研究评估了美国南部成功根除钩虫病的经济后果。钩虫根除运动（约1910年）在以下两个因素出现后不久就开始了：一是发现南方人的多种健康问题可归因于该疾病；二是约翰·D·洛克菲勒向该运动捐赠了大量资金。洛克菲勒卫生委员会对受影响地区（11个南方州）的感染率进行了调查，发现平均有40%的学龄儿童感染了钩虫。随后，洛克菲勒卫生委员会在该地区开展了治疗和教育活动。后续研究表明，这一运动几乎立即显著减少了钩虫病的发生。这种治疗的突然实施，加上各地区治疗前的感染率差异，构成了识别策略的基础。在洛克菲勒卫生委员会行动之前钩虫感染率较高的地区，干预后学校的入学率、出勤率和识字率均有显著提升。这一结果在控制多种替代因素后依然成立，包括地区间的差异、农作物价格的变化、某些教育和健康政策的变化以及疟疾根除的影响。对于成年人来说，没有发现显著的结果，因为他们由于感染率较低，本应从干预中获益较少。对受影响群体的长期跟踪显示，在接触钩虫根除措施的同时，他们的收入也显著增加了。我还发现，根除措施提高了人们接受教育的积极性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of market-wide changes in health insurance by examining the single largest change in health insurance coverage in American history: the introduction of Medicare in 1965. I estimate that the impact of Medicare on hospital spending is over six times larger than what the evidence from individual-level changes in health insurance would have predicted. This disproportionately larger effect may arise if market-wide changes in demand alter the incentives of hospitals to incur the fixed costs of entering the market or of adopting new practice styles. I present some evidence of these types of effects. A back of the envelope calculation based on the estimated impact of Medicare suggests that the overall spread of health insurance between 1950 and 1990 may be able to explain about half of the increase in real per capita health spending over this time period.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.1.abstractZh: 本文通过研究美国历史上最大规模的医疗保险改革——1965年医疗保险制度的引入，来探讨市场范围内医疗保险变化的影响。研究表明，医疗保险对医院支出的影响是个体层面医疗保险变化所预测效果的六倍多。这种不成比例更大的影响可能是由于市场范围内的需求变化改变了医院承担市场进入成本或采用新经营模式的动机。本文还提供了一些此类影响的证据。基于对医疗保险影响的估算，计算得出1950年至1990年间医疗保险普及程度的提升可能解释了这一时期实际人均医疗支出增长的一半左右。

abstract.text: I analyze a new set of data on Korean American adoptees who were quasi-randomly assigned to adoptive families. I find large effects on adoptees' education, income, and health from assignment to parents with more education and from assignment to smaller families. Parental education and family size are significantly more correlated with adoptee outcomes than are parental income or neighborhood characteristics. Outcomes such as drinking, smoking, and the selectivity of college attended are more determined by nurture than is educational attainment. Using the standard behavioral genetics variance decomposition, I find that shared family environment explains 14 percent of the variation in educational attainment, 35 percent ofthe variation in college selectivity, and 33 percent of the variation in drinking behavior.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.119.abstractZh: 我分析了一组关于韩裔美国被收养者的新数据，这些被收养者被随机分配到不同的收养家庭。我发现，被分配到教育程度较高且家庭规模较小的父母家庭中的被收养者，在教育、收入和健康方面受到了显著的影响。与父母收入或社区特征相比，父母的教育程度和家庭规模与被收养者的结果有更显著的关联。诸如饮酒、吸烟以及大学选择等结果，更多地受到后天因素的影响，而非教育成就。通过标准的行为遗传学方差分解方法，我发现共享的家庭环境解释了教育成就变化的14%，大学选择变化的35%，以及饮酒行为变化的33%。

abstract.text: This paper exploits a new source of variation in Head Start funding to identify the program's effects on health and schooling. In 1965 the Office of Economic Opportunity (OEO) provided technical assistance to the 300 poorest counties to develop Head Start proposals. The result was a large and lasting discontinuity in Head Start funding rates at the OEO cutoff for grant-writing assistance. We find evidence of a large drop at the OEO cutoff in mortality rates for children from causes that could be affected by Head Start, as well as suggestive evidence for a positive effect on educational attainment.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.159.abstractZh: 本文利用Head Start项目资金来源的新变化，来探讨该项目对健康和教育的积极影响。1965年，经济机会办公室为300个最贫困的县提供了技术支持，帮助他们制定Head Start项目的提案。结果在获得资助的截止日期时，Head Start项目的资金率出现了显著且持久的下降。我们发现，在截止日期时，来自可能导致儿童死亡的原因的死亡率大幅下降，同时也有证据表明该项目对儿童的教育成就有积极影响。

abstract.text: We study the formation of beliefs in a squatter settlement in the outskirts of Buenos Aires exploiting a natural experiment that induced an allocation of property rights that is exogenous to the characteristics of the squatters. There are significant differences in the beliefs that squatters with and without land titles declare to hold. Lucky squatters who end up with legal titles report beliefs closer to those that favor the workings of a free market. Examples include materialist and individualist beliefs (such as the belief that money is important for happiness or the belief that one can be successful without the support of a large group). The effects appear large. The value of a (generated) index of “market” beliefs is 20 percent higher for titled squatters than for untitled squatters, in spite of leading otherwise similar lives. Moreover, the effect is sufficiently large so as to make the beliefs of the squatters with legal titles broadly comparable to those of the general Buenos Aires population, in spite of the large differences in the lives they lead.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.209.abstractZh: 我们研究了布宜诺斯艾利斯郊区一个临时居住区中人们信念的形成过程，通过一项自然实验来诱发产权分配，这种分配与临时居住者的特征无关。有土地所有权和没有土地所有权的人所宣称的信念存在显著差异。那些最终获得合法土地所有权的临时居住者所持有的信念更接近于支持自由市场运作的信念。例如，物质主义和个体主义的信念（比如认为金钱对幸福很重要，或者认为没有大群体的支持也能取得成功）。这种效应非常显著。拥有土地所有权的临时居住者所持有的“市场”信念指数比没有土地所有权的临时居住者高出20%，尽管他们的生活状况相似。此外，这种效应足够显著，以至于拥有土地所有权的临时居住者的信念与布宜诺斯艾利斯普通人群的认知大致相当，尽管他们的生活状况存在很大差异。

abstract.text: Why is GDP growth so much more volatile in poor countries than in rich ones? We identify three possible reasons: (i) poor countries specialize in fewer and more volatile sectors; (ii) poor countries experience more frequent and more severe aggregate shocks (e.g., from macroeconomic policy); and (iii) poor countries' macroeconomic fluduations are more highly correlated with the shocks affecting the sectors they specialize in. We show how to decompose volatility into the various sources, quantify their contribution to aggregate volatility, and study how they relate to the stage of development. We document the following regularities. First, as countries develop, their productive structure moves from more volatile to less volatile sectors. Second, the volatility of country-specific macroeconomic shocks falls with development. Third, the covariance between sector-specific and country-specific shocks does not vary systematically with the level of development. There is also some evidence that the degree of sectoral concentration declines with development at early stages, and increases at later stages. We argue that many theories linking volatility and development are not consistent with these findings, and suggest new directions for future theoretical work.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.243.abstractZh: 为什么贫困国家的GDP增长比富裕国家更加不稳定？我们提出了三个可能的原因：(i) 贫困国家专注于较少且更不稳定的行业；(ii) 贫困国家经历更频繁且更严重的宏观经济冲击（例如，来自宏观经济政策的影响）；以及(iii) 贫困国家的宏观经济波动与其所专注的行业受到的冲击高度相关。我们展示了如何将波动性分解为各种来源，量化它们对总体波动性的贡献，并研究它们与发展阶段之间的关系。我们发现以下规律：首先，随着国家的发展，其生产结构会从更不稳定转向更稳定的行业。其次，特定国家的宏观经济冲击的波动性随着发展而降低。第三，特定行业特定冲击与特定国家特定冲击之间的协方差并不随发展水平的系统变化而变化。还有一些证据表明，在早期阶段，行业集中度随着发展而降低，而在后期阶段则会增加。我们认为，许多将波动性与发展联系起来的理论并不符合这些发现，并提出了未来理论研究的新的方向。

abstract.text: Firms start and stop exporting. Previous research suggests that these export participation decisions alter the comovement of net exports with the real exchange rate. We evaluate these predictions in a general equilibrium environment. Specifically, assuming firms face an up-front, sunk cost of entering foreign markets, and a smaller period-by-period continuation cost, we derive the discrete entry and exit decisions yielding exporter dynamics in an open economy business cycle model. The model's business cycle exporter dynamics are consistent with that of U.S. exporters. However, in contrast to previous partial equilibrium analyses, model results reveal that export decisions have negligible aggregate effects.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.289.abstractZh: 企业会开始和停止出口活动。先前的研究表明，这些出口参与决策会改变净出口与实际汇率之间的联动关系。我们在一般均衡环境中对这些预测进行了评估。具体来说，假设企业面临进入外国市场的前期沉没成本，以及较小的逐期持续成本，我们推导出离散的进入和退出决策，从而在开放经济商业周期模型中产生出口企业的动态变化。该模型中的商业周期出口企业动态与美国出口企业的动态一致。然而，与之前的部分均衡分析相比，模型结果表明出口决策的总体影响微乎其微。

abstract.text: A committee makes a decision on a project on behalf of “the public.” Members of the committee agree on the a priori value of the project, and hold additional private information about its consequences. They are experts who care about the value of the project and about being considered well informed. Before voting on the project, members can exchange their private information simultaneously. We show that reputational concerns make the a priori unconventional decision more attractive and lead committees to show a united front. These results hold irrespective of whether information can be manipulated or not. Also, reputational concerns induce members to manipulate information and vote strategically if their preferences differ considerably from those ofthe member casting the decisive vote. Our last result is that the optimal voting rule balances the quality of information exchange and the alignment of interests of the decisive voter with those of the public.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.337.abstractZh: 一个委员会代表“公众”对某个项目做出决策。委员会成员对项目的先验价值达成一致，并掌握有关项目后果的其他私人信息。他们是关注项目价值以及自身信息透明度的专家。在投票决定该项目之前，成员可以同时交换他们的私人信息。我们证明，声誉方面的考虑使得这种先验上非传统的决策更具吸引力，并促使委员会形成一致立场。无论信息是否可以被操纵，这些结果都成立。此外，声誉方面的考虑会促使成员在信息被操纵或投票策略性选择的情况下，调整自己的偏好，以使其与最终投票者的利益保持一致。我们的最后一个结论是，最优的投票规则能够平衡信息交换的质量，以及最终投票者的利益与公众利益的契合程度。

abstract.text: We characterize efficient technical languages and study their interaction with the scope and structure of organizations. Efficient languages use precise words for frequent events and vague words for unusual ones. A broader organizational scope allows for more synergies to be captured, but reduces within-unit efficiency, since it requires a more generic language. A manager working as specialized translator may also be used to achieve between-unit coordination while maintaining separate languages. Our theory reconciles two recent well-documented phenomena within organizations: the recent increase in information centralization and the reduction in hierarchical centralization.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.373.abstractZh: 我们描述了高效的技术语言，并研究了它们与组织范围与结构的互动关系。高效的语言对于常见事件使用精确词汇，对于不常见事件则使用模糊词汇。更广阔的组织范围能够捕捉到更多的协同效应，但会降低单位内部的效率，因为需要一种更通用的语言。作为专业翻译人员的管理者，也可以用于实现单位之间的协调，同时保持各自的语言独立性。我们的理论调和了组织内部两个近期被充分记录的现象：信息集中度的增加与层级集中度的降低。

abstract.text: Over the past half century, Americans spent a rising share of total economic resources on health and enjoyed substantially longer lives as a result. Debate on health policy often focuses on limiting the growth of health spending. We investigate an issue central to this debate: Is the growth of health spending a rational response to changing economic conditions—notably the growth of income per person? We develop a model based on standard economic assumptions and argue that this is indeed the case. Standard preferences—of the kind used widely in economics to study consumption, asset pricing, and labor supply—imply that health spending is a superior good with an income elasticity well above one. As people get richer and consumption rises, the marginal utility of consumption falls rapidly. Spending on health to extend life allows individuals to purchase additional periods of utility. The marginal utility of life extension does not decline. As a result, the optimal composition of total spending shifts toward health, and the health share grows along with income. In projections based on the quantitative analysis of our model, the optimal health share of spending seems likely to exceed 30 percent by the middle of the century.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.39.abstractZh: 在过去的半个世纪里，美国人将越来越多的经济资源投入到医疗保健上，因此他们的寿命也显著延长。关于健康政策的讨论往往集中在限制医疗支出的增长上。我们探讨了一个与这一讨论核心相关的问题：医疗支出的增长是否是对不断变化的经济状况的一种理性反应——尤其是人均收入的增长？我们基于标准的经济假设建立了一个模型，并认为确实如此。标准的偏好设定——这些设定在经济学中常用于研究消费、资产定价和劳动力供给——表明医疗支出是一种“优质商品”，其收入弹性远高于一。随着人们变得更加富裕，消费水平上升，消费的边际效用迅速下降。通过支出用于延长寿命，个人可以获得更多的效用期。而延长寿命的边际效用并不会下降。因此，总支出的最优分配会向医疗保健倾斜，而医疗保健支出在收入增长的同时也会增加。根据我们模型的定量分析，到本世纪中叶，医疗保健支出的最优比例似乎将超过30%。

abstract.text: Lower birth weight babies have worse outcomes, both short-run in terms of one-year mortality rates and longer run in terms of educational attainment and earnings. However, recent research has called into question whether birth weight itself is important or whether it simply reflects other hard-to-measure characteristics. By applying within twin techniques using an unusually rich dataset from Norway, we examine the effects of birth weight on both short-run and long-run outcomes for the same cohorts. We find that birth weight does matter; despite short-run twin fixed effects estimates that are much smaller than OLS estimates, the effects on longer-run outcomes such as adult height, IQ, earnings, and education are significant and similar in magnitude to OLS estimates.

10.1162/qjec.122.1.409.abstractZh: 出生体重较低的婴儿在短期内（如一年内的死亡率）以及长期（如教育水平和收入方面）的表现都较差。然而，最近的研究对出生体重本身的重要性提出了质疑，或者出生体重只是反映了其他难以测量的特征。通过运用来自挪威的丰富数据集，采用双胞胎内部设计的方法，我们研究了出生体重对短期和长期结果的影响。研究发现，出生体重确实很重要；尽管在短期内的双胞胎固定效应估计值远小于普通最小二乘法估计值，但出生体重对长期结果的影响，如成年身高、智商、收入和教育水平，是显著的，其影响幅度与普通最小二乘法估计值相当。

abstract.text: We develop an index of segregation based on two premises: (1) a measure of segregation should disaggregate to the level of individuals, and (2) an individual is more segregated the more segregated are the agents with whom she interacts. We present an index that satisfies (1) and (2) and that is based on agents' social interactions: the extent to which blacks interact with blacks, whites with whites, etc. We use the index to measure school and residential segregation. Using detailed data on friendship networks, we calculate levels of within-school racial segregation in a sample of U. S. schools. We also calculate residential segregation across major U. S. cities, using block-level data from the 2000 U. S. Census.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.441.abstractZh: 我们基于两个前提开发了一个隔离指数：（1）隔离的衡量标准应该细化到个体层面；（2）一个个体与其互动的群体越具有隔离性，该个体自身的隔离程度也越高。我们提出了一个满足上述两个前提的指数，该指数基于个体之间的社会互动：即黑人与黑人、白人与白人之间的互动程度。我们利用该指数来衡量学校和住宅区的隔离情况。通过详细的数据分析友谊网络，我们计算了美国部分学校内部的种族隔离程度。同时，我们借助2000年美国人口普查的街区级数据，计算了美国主要城市之间的住宅隔离情况。

abstract.text: We study optimal taxation in an economy where the skills of agents evolve stochastically over time and are private information and in which agents can trade unobservably in competitive markets. We show that competitive equilibria are constrained inefficient. The government can improve welfare by distorting capital accumulation with the sign ofthe distortion depending on the nature of the skill process. Finally, we show that private insurance provision responds endogenously to policy, that government insurance tends to crowd out private insurance, and, in a calibrated example, that this crowding out effect is large.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.487.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个经济中的最优税收问题，其中代理人的技能随时间随机演化，且属于私人信息。同时，代理人可以在竞争市场中进行不可观测的交易。我们指出，竞争均衡往往是低效的。政府可以通过扭曲资本积累来改善福利，这种扭曲的幅度取决于技能过程的特性。最后，我们表明私人保险供给会内生性地响应政策，政府提供的保险往往会挤出私人保险，并且在经过校准的例子中，这种挤出效应是显著的。

abstract.text: Whether or not the marginal product of capital (MPK) differs across countries is a question that keeps coming up in discussions of comparative economic development and patterns of capital flows. Using easily accessible macroeconomic data we find that MPKs are remarkably similar across countries. Hence, there is no prima facie support for the view that international credit frictions playa major role in preventing capital flows from rich to poor countries. Lower capital ratios in these countries are instead attributable to lower endowments of complementary factors and lower efficiency, as well as to lower prices of output goods relative to capital. We also show that properly accounting for the share of income accruing to reproducible capital is critical to reach these conclusions. One implication of our findings is that increased aid flows to developing countries will not significantly increase these countries' capital stocks and incomes.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.535.abstractZh: 资本边际产品在不同国家是否存在差异，是比较经济发展和资本流动模式讨论中经常出现的问题。通过易于获取的宏观经济数据我们发现，资本边际产品在各国之间表现出显著的相似性。因此，国际信贷摩擦在阻止资本从富裕国家流向贫穷国家方面并未发挥重要作用。这些国家较低的资本比率实际上是由于互补因素的禀赋较低、效率较低，以及产出商品相对于资本的价格较低所导致的。我们还指出，正确计算可再投资资本所占比率对于得出这些结论至关重要。我们的研究结果的一个含义是，增加对发展中国家的援助并不会显著增加这些国家的资本存量和收入。

abstract.text: Is a country's ability to enforce contracts an important determinant of comparative advantage? To answer this question, I construct a variable that measures, for each good, the proportion of its intermediate inputs that require relationship-specific investments. Combining this measure with data on trade flows and judicial quality, I find that countries with good contract enforcement specialize in the production of goods for which relationship-specific investments are most important. According to my estimates contract enforcement explains more of the pattern of trade than physical capital and skilled labor combined.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.569.abstractZh: 一个国家的合同执行能力是否是决定比较优势的重要因素？为了回答这个问题，我构建了一个变量，用于衡量每种商品的中间投入中需要特定关系投资的部分所占的比例。结合贸易流量和司法质量的数据，我发现那些合同执行良好的国家会专门生产那些对特定关系投资至关重要的商品。根据我的估计，合同执行对贸易模式的解释力超过了物质资本和熟练劳动力之和。

abstract.text: This paper studies the productivity and distributional effects of large irrigation dams in India. Our instrumental variable estimates exploit the fact that river gradient affects a district's suitability for dams. In districts located downstream from a dam, agricultural production increases, and vulnerability to rainfall shocks declines. In contrast, agricultural production shows an insignificant increase in the district where the dam is located but its volatility increases. Rural poverty declines in downstream districts but increases in the district where the dam is built, suggesting that neither markets nor state institutions have alleviated the adverse distributional impacts of dam construction.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.601.abstractZh: 本文研究了印度大型灌溉大坝对生产力和分配效应的影响。我们的工具变量估计利用了河流坡度会影响一个地区是否适合修建大坝这一事实。在位于大坝下游的地区，农业生产增加，对降雨冲击的脆弱性降低。相反，在大坝所在地区，农业生产虽有轻微增加，但其波动性却有所上升。在下游地区，农村贫困程度下降，而在大坝建设所在的地区，农村贫困程度上升，这表明无论是市场还是国家机构都没有缓解大坝建设带来的负面分配影响。

abstract.text: This paper uses a unique dataset from Denmark to investigate the impact of family characteristics in corporate decision making and the consequences of these decisions on firm performance. We focus on the decision to appoint either a family or external chief executive officer (CEO). The paper uses variation in CEO succession decisions that result from the gender of a departing CEO's firstborn child. This is a plausible instrumental variable (IV), as male first-child firms are more likely to pass on control to a family CEO than are female first-child firms, but the gender of the first child is unlikely to affect firms' outcomes. We find that family successions have a large negative causal impact on firm performance: operating profitability on assets falls by at least four percentage points around CEO transitions. Our IV estimates are significantly larger than those obtained using ordinary least squares. Furthermore, we show that family-CEO underperformance is particularly large in fast-growing industries, industries with highly skilled labor force, and relatively large firms. Overall, our empirical results demonstrate that professional, nonfamily CEOs provide extremely valuable services to the organizations they head.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.647.abstractZh: 本文利用丹麦独有的数据集，研究家庭特征对企业决策的影响以及这些决策对企业绩效的影响。我们重点关注任命家族成员还是外部首席执行官的决策。研究通过CEO离任时首胎性别的差异来考察CEO继任决策的变化。这是一个合理的工具变量，因为男性首胎企业更有可能将控制权交给家族CEO，而女性首胎企业则不太可能如此，但首胎性别不太可能直接影响企业的绩效。我们发现，家族继任对企业绩效有显著的负面影响：在CEO更替期间，企业的运营盈利能力至少下降了四个百分点。我们的工具变量估计值明显大于使用普通最小二乘法得到的估计值。此外，我们还发现，在快速增长行业、高技能劳动力丰富的行业以及规模较大的企业中，家族CEO的业绩表现下降尤为明显。总体而言，我们的实证结果表明，职业的非家族CEO为他们所领导的组织提供了极其宝贵的服务。

abstract.text: This paper studies the influence of mass media on U. S. government response to approximately 5,000 natural disasters occurring between 1968 and 2002. These disasters took nearly 63,000 lives and affected 125 million people per year. We show that U. S. relief depends on whether the disaster occurs at the same time as other newsworthy events, such as the Olympic Games, which are obviously unrelated to need. We argue that the only plausible explanation of this is that relief decisions are driven by news coverage of disasters and that the other newsworthy material crowds out this news coverage.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.693.abstractZh: 本文研究了大众媒体对美国政府在1968年至2002年间发生的约5000起自然灾害反应的影响。这些灾害导致近63,000人死亡，每年影响1.25亿人。我们发现，美国的救援行动取决于灾害是否与其他具有新闻价值的事件同时发生，例如奥运会，而这些事件显然与需求无关。我们认为，唯一合理的解释是，救援决策是由对灾害的新闻报道所驱动的，而其他具有新闻价值的材料则挤占了这些新闻报道的篇幅。

abstract.text: We present evidence from a firm level experiment in which we engineered an exogenous change in managerial compensation from fixed wages to performance pay based on the average productivity of lower-tier workers. Theory suggests that managerial incentives affect both the mean and dispersion of workers' productivity through two channels. First, managers respond to incentives by targeting their efforts towards more able workers, implying that both the mean and the dispersion increase. Second, managers select out the least able workers, implying that the mean increases but the dispersion may decrease. In our field experiment we find that the introduction of managerial performance pay raises both the mean and dispersion of worker productivity. Analysis of individual level productivity data shows that managers target their effort towards high ability workers, and the least able workers are less likely to be selected into employment. These results highlight the interplay between the provision of managerial incentives and earnings inequality among lower-tier workers.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.729.abstractZh: 我们展示了来自一项企业级实验的证据，在该实验中，我们人为地改变了管理层的薪酬结构，从固定工资转变为基于低层工人平均生产率的绩效薪酬。理论表明，管理层的激励措施通过两种途径影响工人生产率的均值和离散度。首先，管理者会响应激励，将努力集中在能力更强的工人身上，这意味着均值和离散度都会增加。其次，管理者会排除能力最差的工人，这意味着均值会增加，但离散度可能会减少。在我们的实地实验中，我们发现，引入管理层绩效薪酬既提高了工人生产率的均值，也增加了其离散度。对个体层面生产率的数据分析表明，管理者会将努力集中在能力较高的工人身上，而能力最差的工人则不太可能被选中就业。这些结果凸显了管理层激励措施与低层工人收入不平等之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: Between 1950 and 1990, the aggregate population of central cities in the United States declined by 17 percent despite population growth of 72 percent in metropolitan areas as a whole. This paper assesses the extent to which the construction of new limited access highways has contributed to central city population decline. Using planned portions of the interstate highway system as a source of exogenous variation, empirical estimates indicate that one new highway passing through a central city reduces its population by about 18 percent. Estimates imply that aggregate central city population would have grown by about 8 percent had the interstate highway system not been built.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.775.abstractZh: 在1950年至1990年间，尽管整个大都市地区的人口增长了72%，但美国中心城市的总人口却减少了17%。本文评估了新建有限通道高速公路在导致中心城市人口下降方面的作用。通过选取州际公路系统的部分路段作为外生变量的来源，实证分析表明，每有一条新的高速公路穿过中心城市，该城市的人口就会减少约18%。估计结果显示，如果没有修建州际公路系统，中心城市的总人口本可以增长约8%。

abstract.text: Analyses of the effects of election outcomes on the economy have been hampered by the problem that economic outcomes also influence elections. We sidestep these problems by analyzing movements in economic indicators caused by clearly exogenous changes in expectations about the likely winner during election day. Analyzing high frequency financial fluctuations following the release of flawed exit poll data on election day 2004, and then during the vote count we find that markets anticipated higher equity prices, interest rates and oil prices, and a stronger dollar under a George W. Bush presidency than under John Kerry. A similar Republican-Democrat differential was also observed for the 2000 BushGore contest. Prediction market based analyses of all presidential elections since 1880 also reveal a similar pattern of partisan impacts, suggesting that electing a Republican president raises equity valuations by 2–3 percent, and that since Ronald Reagan, Republican presidents have tended to raise bond yields.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.807.abstractZh: 对选举结果对经济影响的分析一直受到一个问题的阻碍，即经济结果也会影响选举。我们通过分析选举日期间人们对获胜者的预期发生明显变化所导致的经济指标变动，从而绕过了这些问题。在2004年选举日，当存在有缺陷的出口民调数据发布后，市场出现了高频金融波动。在计票期间，我们发现市场预计在乔治·W·布什执政期间，股票价格、利率和油价会上升，美元也会更强。在2000年布什与戈尔的对决中，也观察到了类似的共和党与民主党之间的差异。自1880年以来所有总统选举的预测市场分析也揭示了类似的党派影响模式，表明选举出共和党总统会使股票估值上升2-3%，而自罗纳德·里根以来，共和党总统往往会导致债券收益率上升。

abstract.text: Many households devote a large fraction of their budgets to “consumption commitments”—goods that involve transaction costs and are infrequently adjusted. This paper characterizes risk preferences in an expected utility model with commitments. We show that commitments affect risk preferences in two ways: (1) they amplify risk aversion with respect to moderate-stake shocks, and (2) they create a motive to take large-payoff gambles. The model thus helps resolve two basic puzzles in expected utility theory: the discrepancy between moderate-stake and large-stake risk aversion and lottery playing by insurance buyers. We discuss applications of the model such as the optimal design of social insurance and tax policies, added worker effects in labor supply, and portfolio choice. Using event studies of unemployment shocks, we document evidence consistent with the consumption adjustment patterns implied by the model.

10.1162/qjec.122.2.831.abstractZh: 许多家庭将大量预算用于“消费承诺”——这类商品涉及交易成本，且调整频率较低。本文在预期效用模型框架下，对带有消费承诺的风险偏好进行了分析。我们指出，消费承诺通过两种方式影响风险偏好：(1) 在中等风险冲击下，消费承诺会加剧风险厌恶；(2) 消费承诺会促使人们倾向于承担高回报的赌博行为。该模型有助于解决预期效用理论中的两个基本难题：中等风险与高风险风险厌恶之间的差异，以及保险购买者参与彩票游戏的行为。我们还讨论了该模型在社会保险和税收政策优化、劳动力供给中的附加工人效应以及投资组合选择等方面的应用。通过失业冲击的事件研究，我们发现了与模型所预测的消费调整模式一致的证据。

abstract.text: We use a randomized evaluation of a Kenyan deworming program to estimate peer effects in technology adoption and to shed light on foreign aid donors' movement towards sustainable community provision of public goods. Deworming is a public good since much of its social benefit comes through reduced disease transmission. People were less likely to take deworming if their direct first-order or indirect second-order social contacts were exposed to deworming. Efforts to replace subsidies with sustainable worm control measures were ineffective: a drug cost-recovery program reduced take-up 80 percent; health education did not affect behavior, and a mobilization intervention failed. At least in this context, it appears unrealistic for a one-time intervention to generate sustainable voluntary local public goods provision.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1007.abstractZh: 我们通过随机评估肯尼亚的驱虫计划，来估算技术采纳中的同伴效应，并探讨外国援助机构对可持续社区公共物品供给的推动作用。驱虫是一种公共物品，因为其社会效益主要体现在减少疾病传播上。如果人们的一级或二级社会联系对象已经接触过驱虫措施，他们就不太可能参与驱虫活动。试图用可持续的驱虫措施替代补贴的努力并未取得成效：药物成本回收计划使驱虫活动的参与率降低了80%；健康教育对行为没有影响，而动员干预也未能成功。至少在这个背景下，一次性干预措施难以实现可持续的自愿性地方公共物品供给。

abstract.text: We examine whether men and women of the same ability differ in their selection into a competitive environment. Participants in a laboratory experiment solve a real task, first under a noncompetitive piece rate and then a competitive tournament incentive scheme. Although there are no gender differences in performance, men select the tournament twice as much as women when choosing their compensation scheme for the next performance. While 73 percent of the men select the tournament, only 35 percent of the women make this choice. This gender gap in tournament entry is not explained by performance, and factors such as risk and feedback aversion only playa negligible role. Instead, the tournament-entry gap is driven by men being more overconfident and by gender differences in preferences for performing in a competition. The result is that women shy away from competition and men embrace it.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1067.abstractZh: 我们研究具有相同能力的男性和女性在选择参与竞争环境时是否存在差异。实验参与者在实验室中完成一项实际任务，首先是在非竞争性的计件工资模式下，然后是在竞争性的锦标赛激励模式下。尽管在表现上不存在性别差异，但男性在选择下一次表现的报酬方案时，选择锦标赛的比例是女性的两倍。其中，73%的男性选择锦标赛，而只有35%的女性做出这一选择。这种性别在参与锦标赛方面的差异并非由表现决定，诸如风险厌恶和反馈回避等因素的作用也微乎其微。相反，男性更倾向于参与竞争，而女性则对竞争表现出回避心理。结果表明，女性倾向于回避竞争，而男性则乐于参与竞争。

abstract.text: This paper describes an analytically tractable model of balanced growth that is consistent with the observed size distribution of Þrms. Growth is the result of idiosyncratic Þrm productivity improvements, selection of successful Þrms, and imitation by entrants. Selection tends to improve aggregate productivity at a fast rate if entry and imitation are easy. The empirical phenomenon of Zipfs law can be interpreted to mean that entry costs are high or that imitation is difficult, or both. The small size of entrants indicates that imitation must be difficult. A calibration based on U.S. data suggests that about half of output growth can be attributed to selection. But the implied variance of the combined preference and technology shocks is puzzlingly high. ∗The views expressed herein are those of the author and not necessarily those of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis or the Federal Reserve System. I thank Michele Boldrin, Jonathan Eaton, Xavier

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1103.abstractZh: 本文描述了一个分析上可行的平衡增长模型，该模型与观察到的Þrms规模分布一致。增长是Þrm独特的生产力提升、成功Þrms的选择以及新进入者的模仿所导致的结果。如果进入和模仿都很容易，那么选择行为往往会以较快的速度提高总体生产力。Zipfs定律的实证现象可以解释为进入成本较高或模仿行为困难，或者两者兼而有之。新进入者的规模较小表明模仿行为必定很困难。基于美国数据的校准结果表明，大约一半的产量增长可以归因于选择行为。然而，综合偏好和技术冲击所导致的方差却出人意料地高。*本文所表达的观点仅代表作者个人意见，并不一定代表明尼阿波利斯联邦储备银行或联邦储备系统的立场。感谢Michele Boldrin、Jonathan Eaton和Xavier的协助。

abstract.text: This paper argues that a risk-averse worker's after-tax reservation wage encodes all the relevant information about her welfare. This insight leads to a novel test for the optimality of unemployment insurance based on the responsiveness of reservation wages to unemployment benefits. Some existing estimates imply significant gains to raising the current level of unemployment benefits in the United States but highlight the need for more research on the determinants of reservation wages. Our approach complements those based on Baily's [Journal of Public Economics, X (1978), 379–402] test.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1145.abstractZh: 本文认为，风险规避的工人税后保留工资包含了其福利相关的所有信息。这一见解为失业保险的最优性提供了一种新的检验方法，即通过观察保留工资对失业救济金的响应程度来进行检验。一些现有的估计表明，提高美国的失业救济金水平会带来显著的好处，但同时也强调了需要更多研究以了解保留工资的决定因素。我们的方法补充了基于Baily的[《公共经济学杂志》，X卷（1978年），379-402页]的检验方法。

abstract.text: Does media bias affect voting? We analyze the entry of Fox News in cable markets and its impact on voting. Between October 1996 and November 2000, the conservative Fox News Channel was introduced in the cable programming of 20 percent of U. S. towns. Fox News availability in 2000 appears to be largely idiosyncratic, conditional on a set of controls. Using a data set of voting data for 9,256 towns, we investigate if Republicans gained vote share in towns where Fox News entered the cable market by the year 2000. We find a significant effect of the introduction of Fox News on the vote share in Presidential elections between 1996 and 2000. Republicans gained 0.4 to 0.7 percentage points in the towns that broadcast Fox News. Fox News also affected voter turnout and the Republican vote share in the Senate. Our estimates imply that Fox News convinced 3 to 28 percent of its viewers to vote Republican, depending on the audience measure. The Fox News effect could be a temporary learning effect for rational voters, or a permanent effect for nonrational voters subject to persuasion.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1187.abstractZh: 媒体偏见是否会影响投票？我们分析了福克斯新闻进入有线电视市场及其对投票的影响。在1996年10月至2000年11月期间，保守派福克斯新闻频道在美国20%的城市有线电视节目中播出。2000年福克斯新闻的播出情况似乎在很大程度上是特定条件下的偶然现象。我们使用9,256个城市的投票数据，研究在福克斯新闻进入有线电视市场后的几年里，共和党在这些城市的得票率是否有所提升。我们发现，在1996年至2000年间，福克斯新闻的引入对总统选举中共和党的得票率产生了显著影响。在播放福克斯新闻的城市中，共和党的得票率增加了0.4到0.7个百分点。福克斯新闻还影响了选民的投票率以及共和党在参议院的得票率。我们的估计表明，福克斯新闻使3%到28%的观众决定投票给共和党，这一比例取决于所测量的受众群体。福克斯新闻的影响可能是理性选民的暂时性学习效应，而对于受说服影响的非理性选民来说，则可能是永久性的影响。

abstract.text: This paper presents the results of two randomized experiments conducted in schools in urban India. A remedial education program hired young women to teach students lagging behind in basic literacy and numeracy skills. It increased average test scores of all children in treatment schools by 0.28 standard deviation, mostly due to large gains experienced by children at the bottom of the test-score distribution. A computer-assisted learning program focusing on math increased math scores by 0.47 standard deviation. One year after the programs were over, initial gains remained significant for targeted children, but they faded to about 0.10 standard deviation.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1235.abstractZh: 本文介绍了在印度城市学校进行的两项随机实验的结果。一项补习教育项目聘请年轻女性来教授那些在基础读写和计算能力方面落后的学生，该项目的效果使得实验学校中所有儿童的平均测试分数提高了0.28个标准差，其中得分最低的儿童的进步尤为显著。另一项以数学为重点的计算机辅助学习项目使数学分数提高了0.47个标准差。项目结束后一年，针对特定群体的儿童所取得的初步进步仍然显著，但这一进步逐渐减弱，降至约0.10个标准差。

abstract.text: I use microeconomic estimates of the effect of health on individual outcomes to construct macroeconomic estimates of the proximate effect of health on GDP per capita. I employ a variety of methods to construct estimates of the return to health, which I combine with cross-country and historical data on height, adult survival rates, and age at menarche. Using my preferred estimate, eliminating health differences among countries would reduce the variance of log GDP per worker by 9.9 percent and reduce the ratio of GDP per worker at the 90th percentile to GDP per worker at the lOth percentile from 20.5 to 17.9. While this effect is economically significant, it is also substantially smaller than estimates of the effect of health on economic growth that are derived from cross-country regressions.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1265.abstractZh: 我采用微观经济估计方法来评估健康对个人成果的影响，进而构建宏观经济估计，以了解健康对人均GDP的直接影响。我采用多种方法来计算健康带来的收益，并将这些估计结果与跨国和历史的身高数据、成人存活率以及初潮年龄数据相结合。根据我采用的估计方法，消除国家间的健康差异将使每个工人的对数GDP方差减少9.9%，并将第90百分位的工人人均GDP与第10百分位的工人人均GDP的比率从20.5降低到17.9。虽然这种效应在经济学上具有重要意义，但其规模也远小于从跨国回归分析中得出的健康对经济增长影响的估计值。

abstract.text: U. S. copyright law effectively prevents direct price discrimination for copyright holders that sell to different markets. In response, these firms can engage in indirect price discrimination. I derive theoretical predictions about the use of indirect price discrimination, and I analyze how optimal pricing strategies differ for different products. Using data on VHS and DVD movie distribution, I find that firms' pricing choices are consistent with the predictions of theory and that firms' use of indirect price discrimination benefits consumers (but harms ancillary retailers). Finally, I examine what optimal pricing strategies might look like in a legal environment that permits direct price discrimination.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.1307.abstractZh: 美国版权法实际上禁止版权所有者对不同市场进行直接价格歧视。作为回应，这些公司可以采用间接价格歧视。我提出了关于间接价格歧视使用的理论预测，并分析了不同产品的最优定价策略有何差异。通过研究VHS和DVD电影的分销数据，我发现公司的定价选择与理论预测一致，而且公司采用间接价格歧视的方式实际上对消费者有利（但会对辅助零售商造成不利影响）。最后，我探讨了在允许直接价格歧视的法律环境下，可能的最优定价策略是什么。

abstract.text: When information is limited or costly, agents are unable to engage in optimal arbitrage. Excess price dispersion across markets can arise and goods may not be allocated efficiently; in this setting, information technologies may improve market performance and increase welfare. Between 1997 and 2001, mobile phone service was introduced throughout Kerala, a state in India with a large fishing industry. Using micro-level survey data, we show that the adoption of mobile phones by fishermen and wholesalers was associated with a dramatic reduction in price dispersion, the complete elimination of waste and near-perfect adherence to the Law of One Price. Both consumer and producer welfare increased.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.879.abstractZh: 当信息有限或成本高昂时，市场主体无法进行最优的套利行为。市场间的价格差异可能会加剧，商品可能无法得到有效的分配；在这种情况下，信息技术可以提高市场绩效并提升福利。在1997年至2001年间，印度的一个以渔业为主的州——喀拉拉邦，引入了移动电话服务。通过微观层面的调查数据，我们发现，渔民和批发商采用移动电话后，价格差异显著减少，浪费现象完全消除，价格一致性也达到了近乎完美的程度。消费者和生产者的福利都得到了提升。

abstract.text: I study the optimal taxation oflabor and capital in a dynamic economy subject to government expenditure and technology shocks. Unlike representative-agent Ramsey models, workers are heterogenous and lump-sum taxation is not ruled out. I consider two tax scenarios: (a) linear taxation, with a lump-sum intercept and (b) nonlinear-Mirrleesian taxation. When taxes are linear, I derive a partial-equivalence result with Ramsey settings that provides a reinterpretation of such analyses. I find conditions for perfect tax smoothing oflabor-income taxes and zero capital taxation. Implications that contrast with Ramsey are derived for public-debt management, for the nature of the time-inconsistency problem and for the viability of replicating complete markets without state-contingent bonds. Shifts in the distribution of skills provide a novel source for variations in tax rates. For the nonlinear tax scenario, I show that taxation based on income averages is optimal.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.925.abstractZh: 我研究了在政府支出和技术冲击影响下的动态经济中劳动力和资本的最优税收问题。与代表性代理人Ramsey模型不同，劳动者具有异质性，且定额税收并非不可行。我考虑了两种税收方案：(a)线性税收，采用定额截距；(b)非线性Mirrleesian税收。当税收为线性时，我推导出一个与Ramsey设定相关的部分等价结果，这为这类分析提供了重新解释。我找到了劳动力收入税完全平滑化以及零资本税收的条件。与Ramsey理论相比，我还得出了一些与公共债务管理、时间不一致性问题本质以及在没有国家条件债券的情况下复制完整市场可行性的相关结论。技能分布的变动为税收率的差异提供了新的来源。对于非线性税收方案，我证明了基于收入平均值的税收是最优的。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use five decades of time-use surveys to document trends in the allocation of time within the United States. We find that a dramatic increase in leisure time lies behind the relatively stable number of market hours worked between 1965 and 2003. Specifically, using a variety of definitions for leisure, we show that leisure for men increased by roughly six to nine hours per week (driven by a decline in market work hours) and for women by roughly four to eight hours per week (driven by a decline in home production work hours). Lastly, we document a growing inequality in leisure that is the mirror image of the growing inequality of wages and expenditures, making welfare calculation based solely on the latter series incomplete.

10.1162/qjec.122.3.969.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用了五十年时间使用调查的数据，来记录美国境内时间分配的趋势。我们发现，从1965年到2003年间，虽然工作市场时间相对稳定，但休闲时间却显著增加。具体来说，根据不同的休闲定义，我们发现男性的休闲时间每周增加了大约六到九小时（主要是由于市场工作时间减少），而女性的休闲时间则增加了大约四到八小时（主要是由于家庭生产工作时间减少）。最后，我们发现休闲时间的不平等现象日益严重，这与工资和支出不平等现象的增长形成了镜像关系，因此仅基于后者进行福利计算是不完整的。

abstract.text: We use an innovative survey tool to collect management practice data from 732 medium-sized firms in the United States, France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. These measures of managerial practice are strongly associated with firm-level productivity, profitability, Tobin's Q, and survival rates. Management practices also display significant cross-country differences, with U.S. firms on average better managed than European firms, and significant within-country differences, with a long tail of extremely badly managed firms. We find that poor management practices are more prevalent when product market competition is weak and/or when family-owned firms pass management control down to the eldest sons (primogeniture).

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1351.abstractZh: 我们采用一种创新的调查工具，从美国、法国、德国和英国的732家中等规模企业收集管理实践数据。这些管理实践指标与企业的生产率、盈利能力、托宾Q值以及存活率有着密切关联。管理实践在不同国家之间也存在显著差异，美国企业的管理通常优于欧洲企业，而在同一国家内部，管理状况则存在巨大差异，存在大量管理极其糟糕的企业。我们发现，在产品市场竞争较弱以及家族企业将管理权交给长子的情况下，糟糕的管理实践更为普遍。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the problem of optimal districting in the context of a simple model of legislative elections. In the model, districting matters because it determines the seat-vote curve, which describes the relationship between seats and votes. The paper first characterizes the optimal seat-vote curve and shows that, under a weak condition, there exist districtings that generate this ideal relationship. The paper then develops an empirical methodology for computing seat-vote curves and measuring the welfare gains from implementing optimal districting. This is applied to analyze the districting plans used to elect U.S. state legislators during the 1990s.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1409.abstractZh: 本文研究了在简单立法选举模型背景下的最优选区划分问题。在模型中，选区划分至关重要，因为它决定了席位与选票之间的关系，即席位-选票曲线。文章首先描述了最优席位-选票曲线，并表明在一定的弱条件下，存在能够生成这种理想关系的选区划分方案。随后，文章提出了一种计算席位-选票曲线以及衡量实施最优选区划分所带来的福利增益的实证方法。该方法被应用于分析20世纪90年代用于选举美国州议员的选区划分方案。

abstract.text: This paper develops an approach to studying how bias in favor of one party due to the pattern of electoral districting affects policy choice. We tie a commonly used measure of electoral bias to the theory of party competition and show how this affects party strategy in theory. The usefulness of the approach is illustrated using data on local government in England. The results suggest that reducing electoral bias leads parties to moderate their policies.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1473.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种研究由于选区划分模式导致的偏向某一政党的偏见如何影响政策选择的方法。我们将一种常用的选区偏见衡量方法与政党竞争理论相结合，探讨这一偏见如何在理论上影响政党的策略制定。通过英格兰地方政府的数据验证了该方法的实用性。研究结果表明，减少选区偏见有助于政党调整其政策。

abstract.text: This paper presents new tests of the permanent income hypothesis and other widely used models of household behavior using data from the labor market. We estimate the excess sensitivity of job search behavior to cash-on-hand using sharp discontinuities in eligibility for severance pay and extended unemployment insurance (UI) benefits in Austria. Analyzing data for over one-half million job losers, we obtain three empirical results: (1) a lump-sum severance payment equal to two months of earnings reduces the job-finding rate by 8%–12% on average; (2) an extension of the potential duration of UI benefits from 20 weeks to 30 weeks similarly lowers job-finding rates in the first 20 weeks of search by 5%–9%; and (3) increases in the duration of search induced by the two programs have little or no effect on subsequent job match quality. Using a search-theoretic model, we show that estimates of the relative effect of severance pay and extended benefits can be used to calibrate and test a wide set of intertemporal models. Our estimates of this ratio are inconsistent with the predictions of a simple permanent income model, as well as naive rule of thumb behavior. The representative job searcher in our data is 70% of the way between the permanent income benchmark and credit-constrained behavior in terms of sensitivity to cash-on-hand.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1511.abstractZh: 本文提出了对永久收入假说及其他广泛使用的家庭行为模型的新的检验方法，这些检验基于劳动力市场的数据。我们通过奥地利在离职补偿金和失业保险福利期限上的突然变化，来估计求职行为对现金持有量的过度敏感性。通过对超过50万失业者的数据分析，我们得到了三个实证结果：(1) 一次性离职补偿金相当于两个月工资时，平均会降低8%至12%的求职成功率；(2) 将失业保险福利期限从20周延长至30周时，求职初期20周内的成功率会降低5%至9%；(3) 这两项政策导致的求职期限延长对后续的工作匹配质量几乎没有影响。通过搜索理论模型，我们表明可以运用这些估计值来校准和检验一系列跨时间模型。我们的估计结果与简单的永久收入模型以及简单的经验法则预测不符。我们数据中的代表性求职者在现金持有量的敏感性方面，介于永久收入基准和信贷约束行为之间，大约处于中间水平。

abstract.text: Between 1996 and 2003, the Peruvian government issued property titles to over 1.2 million urban households, the largest titling program targeted at urban squatters in the developing world. This paper examines the labor market effects of increases in tenure security resulting from the program. To isolate the causal role of ownership rights, I make use of differences across regions induced by the timing ofthe program and differences across target populations in level of preprogram ownership rights. My estimates suggest that titling results in a substantial increase in labor hours, a shift in labor supply away from work at home to work in the outside market, and substitution of adult for child labor.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1561.abstractZh: 在1996年至2003年间，秘鲁政府向超过120万户城市家庭发放了房产所有权证书，这是发展中国家针对城市流浪者实施的最大规模的所有权授予计划。本文探讨了该计划增加产权保障对劳动力市场的影響。为了明确所有权的因果作用，我考虑了计划实施时间导致的地区差异，以及目标人群在计划实施前的产权持有程度差异。我的估计表明，产权授予导致劳动小时数显著增加，劳动力供应从家庭劳动转向外部市场劳动，并且成年劳动力的使用比例上升，而儿童劳动力的使用比例下降。

abstract.text: This paper examines revealed preferences of parents for their children's education, using parent requests for individual elementary school teachers and information on teacher attributes, including principal reports of teacher characteristics that are typically unobservable. On average, parents strongly prefer teachers whom principals describe as good at promoting student satisfaction, though they also value teacher ability to raise academic achievement. These aggregate effects mask striking differences across schools. Families in higher poverty schools strongly value student achievement and appear indifferent to the principal's report of a teacher's ability to promote student satisfaction. The results are reversed for families in wealthier schools.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1603.abstractZh: 本文研究了父母对孩子教育的显性偏好，通过父母对个别小学教师的请求以及教师属性信息来进行分析，其中包括校长对教师特征的报告，而这些特征通常是无法观察到的。平均而言，父母更偏好那些被校长描述为能够提升学生满意度的教师，尽管他们也重视教师提升学业成绩的能力。这些总体效应掩盖了不同学校之间的显著差异。在贫困程度较高的学校中，家庭非常重视学生的学业成绩，并且对校长关于教师提升学生满意度的评价并不在意。而在较富裕的学校中，情况则相反。

abstract.text: We study the allocation of driver's licenses in India by randomly assigning applicants to one of three groups: bonus (offered a bonus for obtaining a license quickly), lesson (offered free driving lessons), or comparison. Both the bonus and lesson groups are more likely to obtain licenses. However, bonus group members are more likely to make extralegal payments and to obtain licenses without knowing how to drive. All extralegal payments happen through private intermediaries (“agents”). An audit study of agents reveals that they can circumvent procedures such as the driving test. Overall, our results support the view that corruption does not merely reflect transfers from citizens to bureaucrats but distorts allocation.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1639.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度驾驶执照的分配问题，通过随机将申请人分配到三个组：奖励组（因快速获得执照而获得奖励）、免费驾驶课程组以及对比组。奖励组和免费驾驶课程组更有可能获得执照。然而，奖励组的成员更有可能进行非法支付，并在不懂驾驶的情况下获得执照。所有非法支付都是通过私人中介（“代理人”）进行的。对代理人的审计研究表明，他们可以绕过诸如驾驶测试等程序。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持这样的观点：腐败不仅反映了公民与官僚之间的权力转移，还扭曲了资源的分配。

abstract.text: While privatizing Social Security would not produce Pareto efficiency gains or losses in a deterministic economy with labor taxes and inelastic labor supply, the presence of elastic labor supply and uncertainty changes matters considerably. On one hand, privatization could reduce the effective tax rate on labor and labor supply distortions even if all policy instru-ments are second best. On the other hand, privatization could reduce valuable risk sharing when households face uninsurable wage shocks or uninsurable longevity uncertainty. Deter-mining the overall change in efficiency thus requires the use of simulation analysis. We investigate these competing effects using a heterogeneous overlapping-generations (OLG) model in which agents with elastic labor supply face idiosyncratic earnings shocks and longevity uncertainty. We find that stylized privatization can have a powerful effect on labor supply incentives: When wage shocks are insurable, a stylized 50-percent privatization can produce new resources of roughly $21,000 for each future household (growth adjusted over time), after all households have been fully compensated for possible transitional losses from reform. However, when wages are not insurable, privatization reduces efficiency—by roughly $4,400 per future household—despite the improved labor supply incentives. This loss is mitigated to some degree if privatization is accompanied with increased risk sharing, such as introducing contribution matching to low income households or raising progressivity in the benefit schedule.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1677.abstractZh: 在具有劳动税和劳动供给弹性不足特征的确定性经济中，将社会保障私有化并不会带来帕累托效率的提升或损失。然而，当劳动供给具有弹性且存在不确定性时，情况就会发生重大变化。一方面，私有化可以降低劳动和劳动供给的实际税率，即使所有政策措施都是次优的。另一方面，私有化可以在家庭面临无法投保的工资冲击或寿命不确定性时，减少宝贵的风险分担。因此，要确定效率的整体变化，需要使用模拟分析。我们采用异质重叠世代模型来研究这些相互竞争的影响，其中劳动供给具有弹性的个体面临特殊的收入冲击和寿命不确定性。研究发现，在特定的私有化条件下，可以对劳动供给激励产生显著影响：当工资冲击可以投保时，50%的私有化可以为每个未来家庭带来约21,000美元的新资源（经过时间调整后的增长值），前提是所有家庭都得到了对改革可能带来的过渡性损失的充分补偿。然而，当工资无法投保时，私有化会导致效率下降——每个未来家庭大约损失4,400美元——尽管劳动供给的激励有所改善。如果私有化伴随着增加风险分担的措施，例如为低收入家庭提供贡献匹配或提高福利计划的累进性，这种损失可以在一定程度上得到缓解。

abstract.text: To study the effects of new information technologies (IT) on productivity, we have assembled a unique data set on plants in one narrowly defined industry—valve manufacturing—and analyze several plant-level mechanisms through which IT could promote productivity growth. The empirical analysis reveals three main results. First, plants that adopt new IT-enhanced equipment also shift their business strategies by producing more customized valve products. Second, new IT investments improve the efficiency of all stages of the production process by reducing setup times, run times, and inspection times. The reductions in setup times are theoretically important because they make it less costly to switch production from one product to another and support the change in business strategy to more customized production. Third, adoption of new IT-enhanced capital equipment coincides with increases in the skill requirements of machine operators, notably technical and problem-solving skills, and with the adoption of new human resource practices to support these skills.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1721.abstractZh: 为了研究新型信息技术对生产力的影响，我们收集了一个关于特定行业——阀门制造——工厂的独特数据集，并分析了多种通过信息技术促进生产力增长的工厂级机制。实证分析揭示了三个主要结果。首先，采用新型信息技术增强设备的工厂会通过生产更多定制化的阀门产品来调整其业务策略。其次，新的信息技术投资通过减少设置时间、运行时间和检查时间，提高了生产过程的各个阶段的效率。设置时间的减少在理论上具有重要意义，因为它降低了从一种产品转向另一种产品的成本，并支持了向更定制化生产转变的业务策略。第三，新型信息技术增强的资本设备的采用与机器操作员的技能要求增加相吻合，尤其是技术和解决问题的能力，同时与采用新的人力资源实践以支持这些技能的发展密切相关。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the relationship between the diffusion of new technologies and the decentralization of firms. Centralized control relies on the information of the principal, which we equate with publicly available information. Decentralized control, on the other hand, delegates authority to a manager with superior information. However, the manager can use his informational advantage to make choices that are not in the best interest of the principal. As the available public information about the specific technology increases, the tradeoff shifts in favor of centralization. We show that firms closer to the technological frontier, firms in more heterogeneous environments, and younger firms are more likely to choose decentralization. Using three data sets on French and British firms in the 1990s, we report robust correlations consistent with these predictions.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1759.abstractZh: 本文分析了新技术扩散与企业去中心化之间的关系。集中式控制依赖于主方的信息，我们将其等同于公开可用的信息。而去中心化则将权力委托给拥有更丰富信息的管理者。然而，管理者可能会利用其信息优势做出不符合主方利益的选择。随着关于特定技术的公开信息增加，这种权衡倾向于集中化。我们发现，更靠近技术前沿的企业、处于更异质环境中的企业以及较年轻的企业更有可能选择去中心化。通过利用1990年代法国和英国企业的三个数据集，我们发现了与这些预测一致的稳健相关性。

abstract.text: I study bequest and wealth accumulation behavior of the wealthy (subject to the estate tax) shortly before death. The onset of a terminal illness leads to a very significant reduction in the value of estates reported on tax returns—fifteen to twenty percent with illness lasting "months to years" and about five to ten percent in the case of illness reported as lasting "days to weeks." I provide evidence suggesting that these findings cannot be explained by real shocks to net worth, such as medical expenses or lost income, but instead reflect "deathbed" estate planning. The results suggest that wealthy individuals actively care about disposition of their estates but that this preference is dominated by the desire to hold on to their wealth while alive.

10.1162/qjec.2007.122.4.1801.abstractZh: 我研究的是在去世前不久，富人（需缴纳遗产税）的遗产分配和财富积累行为。当面临绝症时，税务申报中报告的遗产价值会显著下降——对于持续“数月至数年”的疾病，降幅为15%至20%；而对于持续“数天至数周”的疾病，降幅约为5%至10%。我的研究结果表明，这些现象并非由净资产的实际冲击（如医疗费用或收入损失）所导致，而是反映了“临终时”的遗产规划行为。研究结果表明，富人非常关心自己遗产的分配问题，但这种偏好主要源于希望在生前保留自己的财富。

abstract.text: Most Americans are now in some form of managed care plan that restricts access to services in order to reduce costs. It is difficult to determine whether these restrictions affect health because individuals and firms self-select into managed care. We investigate the effect of managed care using a California law that required some pregnant women on Medicaid to enter managed care. We use a unique longitudinal database of California births in which we observe changes in the regime faced by individual mothers between births. We find that Medicaid managed care reduced the quality of prenatal care and increased low birth weight, prematurity, and neonatal death.

10.1162/rest.89.3.385.abstractZh: 如今，大多数美国人都参加了某种形式的管理式护理计划，这种计划通过限制服务获取来降低成本。很难确定这些限制是否会影响健康，因为个人和企业会自行选择加入管理式护理。我们通过加州的一项法律来研究管理式护理的影响，该法律要求一些享受医疗补助的孕妇加入管理式护理。我们使用了加州出生数据的独特纵向数据库，观察了个体母亲在每次分娩前后所面临的护理制度的变化。研究发现，医疗补助管理式护理降低了产前护理的质量，并增加了低出生体重、早产和新生儿死亡的情况。

abstract.text: *This paper is based on a long-term research program with Rachel Kranton on the implications of identity for economic behavior and also a manuscript we are currently writing on the missing motivation in economics. Our previous joint papers (Akerlof and Kranton (2000), (2002) and (2005)) have explored implications outside of macroeconomics of utility functions dependent on peoples notions of what ought to be. Conversations with Kranton have also been the basis for the section on economic methodology. I have also benefitted from conversations with Robert Shiller, with whom I am co-authoring work on behavioral macroeconomics. In addition, I

10.1257/000282807780323488.abstractZh: 本文基于与Rachel Kranton的长期研究项目，探讨身份认同对经济行为的影响，同时我们目前正在撰写一篇关于经济学中缺失动机的论文。我们之前的联合研究（Akerlof和Kranton，2000年、2002年和2005年）探讨了效用函数与人们关于“应当是什么”的观念之间的关系，这些研究的影响范围超出了宏观经济学领域。与Kranton的对话也为经济方法论部分提供了基础。此外，我也从与Robert Shiller的对话中获得了启发，我们正在合作撰写关于行为宏观经济学的研究。

abstract.text: In a recent contribution, Mark Walker and John Wooders (2001) analyzed serve choices in Grand Slam tennis matches to provide an empirical test of the mixed strategy equilibrium. They argued convincingly that unlike subjects in laboratories, professional players have sufficient experience to play games well, and that they are also highly motivated to win these games. Their results indicated that there were no statistical differences in win rates for male players across various strategies, which is consistent with the equilibrium prediction. They fairly noted, however, that even the top male players tended to switch from one strategy to another too often, resulting in serial dependence. This paper reexamines the results of Walker and Wooders (2001) by collecting and analyzing a broader dataset, including men’s, women’s, and juniors’ matches. We find that the support of the minimax hypothesis is stronger. The plays in our data pass all of the tests in Walker and Wooders (2001) and therefore are more consistent with the theory of equilibrium than those in Walker and Wooders (2001). In short, the two hypotheses implied by the equilibrium, i.e., the equal probability of winning serve directions and the serial independence of serves, are borne out in our data.

10.1257/000282807780323550.abstractZh: 在最近的一项研究中，Mark Walker和John Wooders（2001年）分析了大满贯网球比赛中的发球选择，以实证检验混合策略均衡理论。他们有说服力地指出，与实验室中的受试者不同，职业选手拥有足够的经验来出色地打球，并且他们也有强烈的动机去赢得这些比赛。他们的研究结果表明，不同策略下男性选手的胜率之间没有统计学上的差异，这与均衡理论预测的结果一致。然而，他们也指出，即使是顶尖的男性选手，也经常频繁地更换策略，导致发球行为的序列依赖性。本文通过收集和分析更广泛的数据集，包括男子、女子和青少年选手的比赛，重新检验了Walker和Wooders（2001年）的研究结果。我们发现，最小最大化假设的支持更为明显。我们数据中的发球行为通过了Walker和Wooders（2001年）的所有测试，因此与均衡理论更为一致。简而言之，均衡理论所暗示的两个假设，即发球方向的获胜概率相等以及发球行为的序列独立性，在我们的数据中得到了验证。

abstract.text: The purpose of this note is to correct an error in the seminal article on secession by Buchanan and Faith (1987). In their paper, Buchanan and Faith neglected an important effect: political separation affects markets and consequently individual private incomes.

10.1257/000282807780323631.abstractZh: 本文旨在纠正Buchanan和Faith在1987年关于分离问题的开创性文章中存在的错误。在他们的论文中，Buchanan和Faith忽略了一个重要因素：政治分离会影响市场，进而影响到个人的私人收入。

abstract.text: This paper develops an infinite horizon model of public spending and taxation in which policy decisions are determined by legislative bargaining. The policy space incorporates both productive and distributive public spending and distortionary taxation. The productive spending is investing in a public good that benefits all citizens (e.g., national defense) and the distributive spending is district-specific transfers (e.g., pork-barrel spending).
