Investment in the public good creates a dynamic linkage across policymaking periods. The analysis explores the dynamics of legislative policy choices, focusing on the efficiency of the steady-state level of taxation and allocation of spending. (JEL D72, E62, H20, H50)

10.1257/aer.97.1.118.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个无限视野的公共支出和税收模型，其中政策决策通过立法协商来确定。该政策空间涵盖了生产性和分配性公共支出以及扭曲性的税收。生产性支出是对所有公民都有益的公共设施的投入（例如，国家防御），而分配性支出则是针对特定地区的转移支付（例如，地方财政支出）。对公共设施的投入在政策制定期间形成了动态联系。分析重点探讨了立法政策选择的动态性，以及税收水平和支出分配的效率问题。（JEL D72, E62, H20, H50）

abstract.text: In this paper I analyze the effect of transparency on decision making in committees. I focus on committees whose members are motivated by career concerns. The main result is that when the decision-making process is secretive (when individual votes are not revealed to the public), committee members comply with preexisting biases. For example, if the voting rule demands a supermajority to accept a reform, individuals vote more often against reforms. Transparent committees are therefore more likely to accept reforms. I also find that coupled with the right voting rule, a secretive procedure may induce better decisions than a transparent one. (JEL D71, D72)

10.1257/aer.97.1.150.abstractZh: 在本文中，我分析了透明度对委员会决策过程的影响。我重点关注那些成员受职业利益驱动的委员会。主要结论是，当决策过程保密时（即个人投票结果不向公众公开），委员会成员会遵循现有的偏见。例如，如果投票规则要求超过多数票才能通过改革，那么个人更可能反对改革。因此，透明的委员会更有可能接受改革。我还发现，在正确的投票规则下，保密程序可能比透明程序更能做出更好的决策。（JEL D71, D72）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the normative criteria that guide the allocation of a policy task to an elected politician versus an independent bureaucrat. The bureaucrat is preferable for technical tasks for which ability is more important than effort, or if there is great uncertainty about whether the policymaker has the required abilities. The optimal allocation of redistributive tasks is ambiguous, and depends on how the bureaucrat can be instructed. But irrespective of the normative conclusion, the politician prefers not to delegate redistributive policies. (JEL D72, D73, D82)

10.1257/aer.97.1.169.abstractZh: 本文探讨了指导将政策任务分配给当选政治家与独立官僚的规范标准。对于那些能力比努力更重要的技术性任务，或者当对政策制定者是否具备所需能力存在巨大不确定性时，选择官僚更为合适。再分配任务的最佳分配是模糊的，这取决于如何对官僚进行指导。但无论规范结论如何，政治家更倾向于不委托再分配政策。（JEL D72, D73, D82）

abstract.text: Many individuals are motivated to exert effort because they care about their jobs, rather than because there are monetary consequences to their actions. The intrinsic motivation of bureaucrats is the focus of this paper, and three primary results are shown. First, bureaucrats should be biased. Second, sometimes this bias takes the form of advocating for their clients more than would their principal, while in other cases, they are more hostile to their interests. For a range of bureaucracies, those who are biased against clients lead to more efficient outcomes. Third, self-selection need not produce the desired bias. Instead, selection to bureaucracies is likely to be bifurcated, in the sense that it becomes composed of those who are most preferred by the principal, and those who are least preferred. (JEL D64, D73, D82)

10.1257/aer.97.1.180.abstractZh: 许多个人之所以努力，是因为他们关心自己的工作，而不是因为他们的行为会带来金钱上的回报。本文的重点是官僚的内在动机，并提出了三个主要结论。首先，官僚可能存在偏见。其次，这种偏见有时表现为更偏袒他们的客户，而在其他情况下，他们对自身利益的敌意则更为明显。对于多种类型的官僚机构而言，那些对客户存在偏见的官僚能够带来更高效的结果。第三，自我选择并不一定会产生预期的偏见。相反，进入官僚机构的过程可能分为两部分：一部分是那些最受上级青睐的人，另一部分则是那些最不受青睐的人。（JEL D64, D73, D82）

abstract.text: With the use of French and US data, new and systematic evidence is provided about the rapid location changes of industries across cities (the fast). Cities are also slowly moving up and down the urban hierarchy (the slow), while the size distribution of cities is skewed to the right and very stable (the still). The model proposed here reproduces these three features. Small, innovation-driven shocks lead to the churning of industries across cities. Then, cities slowly grow or decline following net gains or losses of industries. These changes occur within a stable distribution. The quantitative implications of the model are also explored. (JEL R12, R32)

10.1257/aer.97.1.197.abstractZh: 利用法国和美国的数据，本文提供了关于城市间行业快速迁移的新且系统的证据。城市也在城市等级结构中缓慢上下移动，同时城市的规模分布向右偏斜且非常稳定。本文提出的模型再现了这三个特征：小型、创新驱动的行业迁移导致城市间行业的快速变动；随后，城市随着行业的净增加或减少而缓慢增长或衰退。这些变化发生在稳定的分布范围内。本文还探讨了该模型的定量含义。（JEL R12, R32）

abstract.text: A new 45-industry, 23-year, dataset for Japan is used to investigate the duration of industry leadership. A new scaling relationship linking a firm's current market share with the standard deviation of market share changes is reported. This relationship discriminates in a powerful way between rival candidate theoretical models of market share dynamics. It also makes possible a useful simplification in testing a benchmark model of a Markovian kind. Relative to that model, it is found that at least some industries display a “Chandlerian” bias toward longer durations of leadership than would be present in the benchmark model. (JEL D43, L13)

10.1257/aer.97.1.222.abstractZh: 本研究使用了一个新的包含45个行业、为期23年的日本数据集，来探讨行业领导地位的持续时间。研究发现，存在一个新的比例关系，该比例将企业的当前市场份额与市场份额变化的标准差联系起来。这一关系能够有力地区分各种关于市场份额动态的理论模型。此外，这一发现还为测试马尔可夫模型提供了一种有用的简化方法。与马尔可夫模型相比，研究发现至少有一些行业表现出“Chandlerian”特征，即行业领导地位的持续时间比马尔可夫模型所预测的要长。（JEL D43, L13）

abstract.text: We investigate the “generalized second-price” (GSP) auction, a new mechanism used by search engines to sell online advertising. Although GSP looks similar to the Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism, its properties are very different. Unlike the VCG mechanism, GSP generally does not have an equilibrium in dominant strategies, and truth-telling is not an equilibrium of GSP. To analyze the properties of GSP, we describe the generalized English auction that corresponds to GSP and show that it has a unique equilibrium. This is an ex post equilibrium, with the same payoffs to all players as the dominant strategy equilibrium of VCG. (JEL D44, L81, M37)

10.1257/aer.97.1.242.abstractZh: 我们研究了“广义第二价格”拍卖机制，这是一种搜索引擎用于在线广告销售的新机制。尽管广义第二价格拍卖与Vickrey-Clarke-Groves拍卖机制看起来相似，但其特性却大相径庭。与VCG机制不同，广义第二价格拍卖通常不存在占优策略均衡，而真实信息披露也不是广义第二价格拍卖的均衡状态。为了分析广义第二价格拍卖的特性，我们描述了与广义第二价格拍卖相对应的广义英语拍卖机制，并证明了该机制存在唯一的均衡。这是一种事后均衡，所有参与者的收益与VCG的占优策略均衡相同。（JEL D44, L81, M37）

abstract.text: We consider a seller who faces several buyers and lacks access to an institution to credibly close a sale. If buyers anticipate that the seller may negotiate further, they will prefer to wait before making their best and final offers. This in turn induces the seller to bargain at length with buyers, even if doing so is costly. When the seller's cost of soliciting another round of offers is either very large or very small, the seller credibly commits to an auction and experiences negligible bargaining costs. Otherwise, there may be several rounds of increasing offers and significant seller losses. In these situations, an intermediary with a sufficiently valuable reputation and/or weak marginal incentives regarding price can create value by credibly committing to help sell the object without delay. (JEL C78, D44)

10.1257/aer.97.1.260.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个面临多个买家的卖家，且该卖家无法通过一个正式的机构来可信地完成交易。如果买家预期卖家可能会进一步协商，他们会选择等待，然后再提出最佳和最终的报价。这反过来促使卖家与买家进行长时间的谈判，即使这样做成本很高。当卖家寻求新一轮报价的成本非常高或非常低时，卖家可以可信地选择拍卖方式，并且谈判成本几乎可以忽略不计。否则，可能会出现多轮不断增加的报价，导致卖家遭受重大损失。在这种情况下，一个具有足够高声誉和/或对价格有较弱边际激励的中间人，可以通过可信地承诺协助尽快完成交易来创造价值。（JEL C78, D44）

abstract.text: Many individuals' choices and valuations involve a degree of uncertainty/imprecision. This paper reports an experiment designed to obtain some measure of imprecision and to examine the extent to which it can explain preference reversals of two opposite forms, one of which appears not to have been reported previously. The model of imprecision we examine not only predicts both patterns but also provides an account of earlier results that are otherwise not well explained. The results suggest that any successful descriptive theory of choice and valuation will need to allow in some way for the imprecision surrounding people's decisions. (JEL C91, D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.97.1.277.abstractZh: 许多人的选择和价值观都包含一定程度的不确定性/不精确性。本文报道了一项实验，旨在衡量这种不精确性，并探讨其能否解释两种相反形式的偏好逆转，其中一种形式似乎之前未曾被报道过。我们研究的这种不精确性模型不仅预测了这两种模式，还解释了那些之前无法得到充分解释的结果。研究结果表明，任何成功的决策和估值描述理论都需要以某种方式考虑到人们决策中的不精确性。（JEL C91, D11, D81）

abstract.text: Most previous studies on intertemporal labor supply found very small or insignificant substitution effects. It is possible that these results are due to constraints on workers' labor supply choices. We conducted a field experiment in a setting in which workers were free to choose hours worked and effort per hour. We document a large positive elasticity of overall labor supply and an even larger elasticity of hours, which implies that the elasticity of effort per hour is negative. We examine two candidate models to explain these findings: a modified neoclassical model with preference spillovers across periods, and a model with reference dependent, loss-averse preferences. With the help of a further experiment, we can show that only loss-averse individuals exhibit a negative effort response to the wage increase. (JEL J22, J31)

10.1257/aer.97.1.298.abstractZh: 以往关于跨时劳动供给的研究发现，替代效应非常小或几乎不存在。这些结果可能是由于对劳动者劳动供给选择的限制所致。我们在一种劳动者可以自由选择工作时间和每小时劳动强度的环境中进行了实地实验。我们发现，整体劳动供给具有较大的正弹性，而每小时劳动强度的弹性则更大，这意味着每小时劳动强度的弹性为负。我们考察了两种可能的模型来解释这些发现：一种是对新古典模型进行修正，考虑跨时期的偏好溢出效应；另一种模型则考虑了依赖参考值的、厌恶损失的偏好。通过进一步的实验，我们发现只有厌恶损失的个体对工资上涨表现出负劳动强度反应。（JEL J22, J31）

abstract.text: Arguably the most aggressive affirmative action program ever implemented in the United States was a series of court-ordered racial hiring quotas imposed on municipal police departments. My best estimate of the effect of court-ordered affirmative action on work-force composition is a 14-percentage-point gain in the fraction African American among newly hired officers. Evidence on police performance is mixed. Despite substantial black-white test score differences on police department entrance examinations, city crime rates appear unaffected by litigation. However, litigation lowers slightly both arrests per crime and the fraction black among serious arrestees. (JEL H76, J15, J78, K31)

10.1257/aer.97.1.318.abstractZh: 可以说，美国实施过的最激进的平权行动计划之一，就是法院下令对市政警察部门实施种族招聘配额。根据我的估计，法院规定的平权行动对劳动力构成的影响表现为新聘用的警官中非裔美国人比例增加了14个百分点。关于警察部门绩效的证据则不一。尽管警察部门入学考试中的黑人与白人考试成绩存在显著差异，但城市犯罪率似乎并未受到诉讼的影响。不过，诉讼略微降低了每起犯罪中的逮捕次数以及严重逮捕事件中黑人所占的比例。（JEL H76, J15, J78, K31）

abstract.text: This paper measures the economic impact of climate change on US agricultural land by estimating the effect of random year-to-year variation in temperature and precipitation on agricultural profits. The preferred estimates indicate that climate change will increase annual profits by $1.3 billion in 2002 dollars (2002$) or 4 percent. This estimate is robust to numerous specification checks and relatively precise, so large negative or positive effects are unlikely. We also find the hedonic approach—which is the standard in the previous literature—to be unreliable because it produces estimates that are extremely sensitive to seemingly minor choices about control variables, sample, and weighting. (JEL L25, Q12, Q51, Q54)

10.1257/aer.97.1.354.abstractZh: 本文通过估算温度和降水量的随机年际变化对农业利润的影响，来衡量气候变化对美国农业土地的经济影响。初步估计表明，气候变化将使2002年的年利润增加13亿美元，即4%。这一估计在多次检验后仍然可靠且较为精确，因此出现大幅负面或正面影响的可能性较低。我们还发现，传统的 hedonic 方法在估计中并不可靠，因为该方法对控制变量、样本选择和加权方式等看似微小的选择极为敏感。（JEL L25, Q12, Q51, Q54）

abstract.text: The (reputation for) competence of a central bank at doing its job makes monetary policy under discretion credible and transparent. Based on its reading of the state of the economy, the central bank announces its policy intentions to the public in a cheap-talk game. The precision of its private signal measures its competence. The fineness of the equilibrium message space measures its credibility and transparency. This is increasing in the competence/inflation bias ratio: the public expects a competent central bank to use its discretion more to pursue its “objective” targets than to surprise expectations and stimulate output. (JEL E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.97.1.37.abstractZh: 中央银行在履行职责方面的能力声誉，使得其货币政策的可信度和透明度得以保障。根据对经济状况的判断，中央银行通过“闲聊游戏”向公众传达其政策意图。其私人信号的精确性衡量了其能力；而均衡信息空间的精细程度则衡量了其可信度和透明度。随着能力/通胀偏差比率的提高，公众期望一个有能力的中央银行更多地运用其自由裁量权来追求其“目标”指标，而不是让公众感到意外并刺激产出。（JEL E52, E58）

abstract.text: The existing literature typically does not differentiate between security returns and the returns of investors in these securities. This study clarifies that investor and security returns differ because of the timing and magnitude of investor capital flows into and out of these securities. The empirical results indicate that actual investor returns are systematically lower than buy-and-hold returns for nearly all major international stock markets. These results imply that the historical equity premium and the cost of equity capital are likely lower than previously thought. (JEL G11, G12, G15)

10.1257/aer.97.1.386.abstractZh: 现有文献通常不区分证券的回报与投资者的回报。本研究指出，投资者回报与证券回报存在差异，原因在于投资者资金流入和流出这些证券的时间和规模不同。实证结果表明，几乎所有主要国际股市中，实际投资者的回报系统性地低于长期持有投资的回报。这些结果意味着，历史上的股票溢价和股票资本成本可能比之前认为的要低。（JEL G11, G12, G15）

abstract.text: Consumer bankruptcy provides partial insurance against bad luck, but, by driving up interest rates, makes life-cycle smoothing more difficult. We argue that to assess this trade-off one needs a quantitative model of consumer bankruptcy with three key features: life-cycle component, idiosyncratic earnings uncertainty, and expense uncertainty (exogenous negative shocks to household balance sheets). We find that transitory and persistent earnings shocks have very different implications for evaluating bankruptcy rules. More persistent shocks make the bankruptcy option more desirable. Larger transitory shocks have the opposite effect. Our findings suggest the current US bankruptcy system may be desirable for reasonable parameter values. (JEL D14, D91, K35)

10.1257/aer.97.1.402.abstractZh: 消费者破产可以提供一定的风险对冲，但通过推高利率，使得生命周期平滑变得更加困难。我们认为，要评估这种权衡，需要一个具有三个关键特征的消费者破产定量模型：生命周期成分、独特的收益不确定性以及支出不确定性（家庭资产负债表的外生负面冲击）。我们发现，短暂性和持续性收益冲击对评估破产规则的影响截然不同。更持久的冲击使破产选择更具吸引力，而较大的短暂性冲击则产生相反的效果。我们的研究结果表明，在合理的参数值下，当前的美国破产制度可能是可取的。（JEL D14, D91, K35）

abstract.text: We extend William Rogerson's (2003) intriguing analysis of simple procurement contracts to settings where the supplier's innate production cost is not necessarily distributed uniformly. Although the simple contract that Rogerson analyzes performs remarkably well when the smaller cost realizations are relatively likely, it can perform poorly when the larger cost realizations are relatively likely. We show that in all settings under consideration, a simple pair of contracts – one that involves linear cost sharing and one that involves full cost reimbursement – can always secure more than 73 percent of the gain achieved with a fully optimal contract. (JEL D86)

10.1257/aer.97.1.419.abstractZh: 我们将William Rogerson（2003年）对简单采购合同的有趣分析扩展到了供应商的固有生产成本并非均匀分布的情境。尽管Rogerson分析的简单合同在较小成本实现概率较高时表现优异，但在较大成本实现概率较高时则可能表现不佳。我们证明，在所有考虑的情境下，一种包含线性成本分担和全额成本补偿的简单合同组合，总能确保获得超过73%的收益，这一收益超过了完全最优合同所能获得的收益。（JEL D86）

abstract.text: We study a multisector model of growth with differences in TFP growth rates across sectors and derive sufficient conditions for the coexistence of structural change, characterized by sectoral labor reallocation and balanced aggregate growth. The conditions are weak restrictions on the utility and production functions. Along the balanced growth path, labor employed in the production of consumption goods gradually moves to the sector with the lowest TFP growth rate, until in the limit it is the only sector with nontrivial employment of this kind. The employment shares of intermediate and capital goods remain constant during the reallocation process. (JEL O41)

10.1257/aer.97.1.429.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个多部门增长模型，其中各部门的全要素生产率增长率存在差异。我们推导出了结构变革共存的充分条件，这种变革以部门间劳动力重新分配和总体增长平衡为特征。这些条件是对效用函数和生产函数的弱限制。在平衡增长路径上，用于生产消费品的劳动力逐渐转移到全要素生产率增长率最低的部门，最终该部门成为唯一具有此类非平凡就业形式的部门。在重新分配过程中，中间产品和资本产品的就业份额保持不变。（JEL O41）

abstract.text: This paper empirically examines belief updating of the perceived probability of arrest and its criminal deterrence effects using two longitudinal data sources. While beliefs about the probability of arrest are positively correlated with local official arrest rates, they are unresponsive to information acquired from random individuals and local neighborhood conditions. Importantly, perceptions respond to changes in an individual's criminal and arrest history. Young males who engage in crime without getting arrested revise their perceived probability of arrest downward, while those who are arrested revise their probability upward. Estimates suggest that beliefs about the probability of arrest significantly deter crime. (JEL K42)

10.1257/aer.97.1.444.abstractZh: 本文通过两个纵向数据来源，实证研究了人们对被捕概率的认知更新及其对犯罪威慑的影响。虽然人们对被捕概率的认知与当地实际逮捕率呈正相关，但这些认知对来自随机个体或当地社区环境的信息反应不大。重要的是，人们的认知会随个人犯罪和逮捕经历的变化而变化。那些犯罪后未被逮捕的年轻男性会降低他们对被捕概率的认知，而曾经被捕的人则会提高他们的认知。研究结果表明，对被捕概率的认知确实能够显著抑制犯罪行为。（JEL K42）

abstract.text: In contrast to the believed similarity in their health outcomes, workers in different Western countries report very different rates of work disability. Using new data from the United States and the Netherlands, we offer a partial resolution to this paradox. We find that observed differences in reported work disability largely stem from the fact that Dutch respondents have a lower threshold in reporting whether they have a work disability than American respondents. For those who do not suffer from pain, work disability is similar in both countries once thresholds are the same. For respondents with pain, however, a significant difference remains. (JEL J14, J28)

10.1257/aer.97.1.461.abstractZh: 与人们认为的健康结果相似性的观点相反，不同西方国家的工人报告的工作残疾率却大相径庭。利用来自美国和荷兰的新数据，我们对这一悖论提供了部分解释。我们发现，报告中的工作残疾差异主要源于荷兰受访者报告自己是否患有工作残疾的门槛比美国受访者低。对于那些没有疼痛的受访者来说，一旦门槛相同，两个国家的工作残疾情况是相似的。然而，对于有疼痛的受访者来说，仍然存在显著差异。（JEL J14, J28）

abstract.text: Central banks target CPI inflation; independent central banks are concerned about their balance sheet and the level of their capital. The first fact makes it difficult for a central bank to implement the optimal escape from a liquidity trap, because it undermines a commitment to overshoot the inflation target. We show that the second fact provides a solution. Capital concerns provide a mechanism for an independent central bank to commit to inflate ex post. The optimal policy can take the form of a currency depreciation combined with a crawling peg, a policy advocated by Svensson as the “Foolproof Way” to escape from a liquidity trap. (JEL E31, E52, E58, E62)

10.1257/aer.97.1.474.abstractZh: 中央银行以CPI通胀为目标；独立的中央银行则关注其资产负债表和资本水平。第一个事实使得中央银行难以实施最优的退出流动性陷阱的策略，因为这会削弱其超过通胀目标的承诺。我们指出，第二个事实提供了一种解决方案：资本关注为独立中央银行提供了一种承诺事后通胀的机制。最优政策可以是货币贬值与爬行钉住汇率相结合的形式，这一政策被Svensson称为“万无一失的退出流动性陷阱的方法”。(JEL E31, E52, E58, E62)

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of cash transfers as a screening device when combined with in-kind transfers. It shows that linking in-kind to cash transfers makes first-best redistribution possible despite the government's inability to tell rich and poor individuals apart. Moreover, the maximal attainable welfare for the poor can be pushed beyond its first-best level by distorting downward the quality of the indivisible good the poor receive relative to the cash value of their net transfers. Using in-kind transfers alone, as in Besley and Coate (1991), leads to a third-best solution. (JEL D31, H23, H41)

10.1257/aer.97.1.491.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在结合实物转移的情况下，现金转移作为筛选机制的作用。研究表明，将实物转移与现金转移相结合，即使政府无法区分富人和穷人，也能实现最优的再分配。此外，通过降低穷人获得的不可分割物品的质量，相对于他们的净现金转移价值，可以为穷人带来的最大福利超过其最优水平。仅使用实物转移，如Besley和Coate（1991）所提出的，则会导致次优的解决方案。（JEL D31, H23, H41）

abstract.text: We develop a simple macroeconomic model of credit market imperfections with heterogeneous investment projects. The projects differ in productivity, the investment requirement, and the severity of agency problems behind the borrowing constraints. A movement in borrower net worth shifts the composition of the credit between projects with different productivity levels, thereby causing endogenous investment-specific technological change. Furthermore, such endogenous technological change in turn affects borrower net worth. These composition effects could give rise to credit traps, credit collapse, leapfrogging, credit cycles, and growth miracles in the dynamics of the aggregate investment and borrower net worth. (JEL E22, E44, O33)

10.1257/aer.97.1.503.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个简单的宏观经济模型，用于研究信贷市场不完善的情况，其中投资项目具有异质性。这些项目在生产力、投资需求以及借款约束背后的代理问题严重程度方面存在差异。借款人净资产的变动会促使信贷在具有不同生产力水平的项目之间重新分配，从而导致投资相关的技术变革。此外，这种内生性技术变革反过来会影响借款人的净资产。这些结构效应可能导致信贷陷阱、信贷崩溃、跳跃式发展、信贷周期，以及总体投资和借款人净资产动态中的增长奇迹。（JEL E22, E44, O33）

abstract.text: Many view the period after the Second Industrial Revolution as a paradigm of a transition to a new economy following a technological revolution, including the Information Technology Revolution. We build a quantitative model of diffusion and growth during transitions to evaluate that view. With a learning process quantified by data on the life cycle of US manufacturing plants, the model accounts for the key features of the transition after the Second Industrial Revolution. But we find that features like those will occur in other transitions only if a large amount of knowledge about old technologies exists before the transition begins. (JEL L60, N61, N62, N71, N72, O33)

10.1257/aer.97.1.64.abstractZh: 许多人认为第二次工业革命之后的时期是经济向新的经济形态过渡的典型时期，这种过渡伴随着技术革命，包括信息技术革命。我们建立了一个定量模型，用于评估这种过渡过程中的扩散与增长现象。该模型通过美国制造工厂生命周期的数据来量化学习过程，从而考虑了第二次工业革命之后过渡的关键特征。然而，我们发现，只有在过渡开始前对旧技术有大量的了解之后，这些特征才会在其他过渡过程中出现。（JEL L60, N61, N62, N71, N72, O33）

abstract.text: Aggregate consumption growth risk explains why low interest rate currencies do not appreciate as much as the interest rate differential and why high interest rate currencies do not depreciate as much as the interest rate differential. Domestic investors earn negative excess returns on low interest rate currency portfolios and positive excess returns on high interest rate currency portfolios. Because high interest rate currencies depreciate on average when domestic consumption growth is low and low interest rate currencies appreciate under the same conditions, low interest rate currencies provide domestic investors with a hedge against domestic aggregate consumption growth risk. (JEL E21, E43, F31, G11)

10.1257/aer.97.1.89.abstractZh: 总体消费增长风险解释了为什么低利率货币不会像利率差那样大幅升值，以及为什么高利率货币不会像利率差那样大幅贬值。国内投资者在低利率货币投资组合中获得负超额收益，而在高利率货币投资组合中则获得正超额收益。由于高利率货币在总体消费增长较低时平均会贬值，而低利率货币在相同条件下会升值，因此低利率货币为国内投资者提供了对冲总体消费增长风险的工具。（JEL E21, E43, F31, G11）

abstract.text: To identify the important tradeoffs in consulting a single expert for both diagnosis and treatment, we examine the costs and health outcomes of elderly Medicare beneficiaries with coronary artery disease. We compare the empirical consequences of diagnosis by cardiologists who can provide surgical treatment – “integrated” cardiologists – to the consequences of diagnosis by a nonintegrated cardiologist. Diagnosis by an integrated cardiologist leads, on net, to higher health spending but similar health outcomes. The net effect contains three components: reduced spending and improved outcomes from better allocation of patients to surgical treatment options; increased spending conditional on treatment option; and worse outcomes from poorer provision of nonsurgical care. (JEL I11, I18)

10.1257/aer.97.3.1013.abstractZh: 为了识别在诊断和治疗中咨询单一专家所带来的重要权衡，我们研究了患有冠状动脉疾病的老年医疗保险受益人的成本和健康结果。我们比较了由能够提供外科治疗的“综合”心脏病专家进行诊断与由非综合心脏病专家进行诊断的实证后果。由综合心脏病专家进行诊断，总体上会导致更高的健康支出，但健康结果相似。净效应包含三个组成部分：减少支出和通过更好地分配患者到外科治疗选项而改善结果；在采用治疗选项的情况下增加支出；以及由于非外科护理的提供较差而导致的结果恶化。（JEL I11, I18）

abstract.text: The dynamics of a linear (or linearized) dynamic stochastic economic model can be expressed in terms of matrices (A, B, C, D) that define a state space system for a vector of observables. An associated state space system (A, ^ B,C, ^D) determines a vector autoregression for those same observables. We present a simple condition for checking when these two state space systems match up and when they do not when there are equal numbers of economic and VAR shocks. We illustrate our condition with a permanent income example. (JEL C32, E32)

10.1257/aer.97.3.1021.abstractZh: 线性（或线性化）动态随机经济模型的动态可以用矩阵（A、B、C、D）来表示，这些矩阵定义了一个状态空间系统，用于描述一组可观测变量。相关的状态空间系统（A、^B、C、^D）则决定了这些可观测变量的向量自回归过程。我们提出了一个简单的条件，用于判断这两个状态空间系统何时匹配，以及何时不匹配，尤其是在经济冲击和自回归冲击数量相等的情况下。我们通过一个永久收入模型来说明这一条件。（JEL C32, E32）

abstract.text: The theory of two-sided matching markets has interested researchers for its theoretical appeal and relevance to real-life applications. The matching of medical residents and hospitals in the United States has been studied extensively by Alvin E. Roth (1984) and others. The National Resident Matching Program (NRMP), the matching authority in the US hospital-resident matching market, runs a centralized matching mechanism that is a variant of the deferred acceptance algorithm of David Gale and Lloyd S. Shapley (1962), redesigned by Roth and Elliott Peranson (1999). A recent antitrust case against the NRMP charged that the centralized matching mechanism

10.1257/aer.97.3.1027.abstractZh: 双边匹配市场理论因其理论上的吸引力以及与现实应用的相关性而引起了研究人员的兴趣。Alvin E. Roth（1984年）及其他学者对美国的医疗住院医师与医院之间的匹配机制进行了广泛研究。美国国家住院医师匹配计划（NRMP）是美国医院与住院医师匹配市场的官方机构，它采用一种集中式匹配机制，该机制是David Gale和Lloyd S. Shapley（1962年）提出的延迟接受算法的变体，后来由Roth和Elliott Peranson（1999年）进行了改进。最近针对NRMP的反垄断诉讼指控该集中式匹配机制存在垄断行为。

abstract.text: The positive correlation between real investment rates and real income levels across countries is driven largely by differences in the price of investment relative to output. The high relative price of investment in poor countries is due to the low price of consumption goods in those countries. Investment prices are no higher in poor countries. Thus, the low real investment rates in poor countries are not driven by high tax or tariff rates on investment. Poor countries, instead, appear to be plagued by low efficiency in producing investment goods and in producing consumer goods to trade for them. (JEL E22, E23, O16, O47)

10.1257/aer.97.3.562.abstractZh: 各国实际投资率与实际收入水平之间的正相关性，主要源于投资相对于产出的价格差异。贫困国家中投资的高相对价格，是由于这些国家消费商品的价格较低所致。贫困国家的投资价格并不更高。因此，贫困国家实际投资率较低并非由于对投资的高税收或高关税。相反，贫困国家似乎在生产投资商品和用于交换这些商品的消费品方面效率低下。（JEL E22, E23, O16, O47）

abstract.text: Using a Bayesian likelihood approach, we estimate a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model for the US economy using seven macroeconomic time series. The model incorporates many types of real and nominal frictions and seven types of structural shocks. We show that this model is able to compete with Bayesian Vector Autoregression models in out-of-sample prediction. We investigate the relative empirical importance of the various frictions. Finally, using the estimated model, we address a number of key issues in business cycle analysis: What are the sources of business cycle fluctuations? Can the model explain the cross correlation between output and inflation? What are the effects of productivity on hours worked? What are the sources of the “Great Moderation”? (JEL D58, E23, E31, E32)

10.1257/aer.97.3.586.abstractZh: 采用贝叶斯似然方法，我们使用七个宏观经济时间序列来估计美国经济的动态随机一般均衡模型。该模型包含了多种实际和名义摩擦因素，以及七种结构性冲击。我们证明该模型在样本外预测方面能够与贝叶斯向量自回归模型相竞争。我们研究了各种摩擦因素的相对重要性。最后，利用所估计的模型，我们探讨了商业周期分析中的几个关键问题：商业周期波动的来源是什么？该模型能否解释产出与通货膨胀之间的交叉相关性？生产率对工作时间有何影响？“大缓和”现象的来源是什么？（JEL D58, E23, E31, E32）

abstract.text: The paper generalizes the Taylor principle—the proposition that central banks can stabilize the macroeconomy by raising their interest rate instrument more than one-for-one in response to higher inflation—to an environment in which reaction coefficients in the monetary policy rule change regime, evolving according to a Markov process. We derive a long-run Taylor principle which delivers unique bounded equilibria in two standard models. Policy can satisfy the Taylor principle in the long run, even while deviating from it substantially for brief periods or modestly for prolonged periods. Macroeconomic volatility can be higher in periods when the Taylor principle is not satisfied, not because of indeterminacy, but because monetary policy amplifies the impacts of fundamental shocks. Regime change alters the qualitative and quantitative predictions of a conventional new Keynesian model, yielding fresh interpretations of existing empirical work. (JEL E31, E43, E52)

10.1257/aer.97.3.607.abstractZh: 本文将泰勒原理——即中央银行可以通过提高利率工具的比例超过1来应对较高的通货膨胀，从而稳定宏观经济——推广到货币政策规则变化机制的反应系数按照马尔可夫过程演变的环境。我们推导出一个长期泰勒原理，该原理在两个标准模型中提供了独特的有界均衡。即使在短期内或长期内出现显著偏离，政策也可以在长期内满足泰勒原理。当泰勒原理不满足时，宏观经济波动性可能会更高，这不是因为不确定性，而是因为货币政策放大了基本冲击的影响。规则的变化改变了传统新凯恩斯模型的质量和数量预测，为现有实证研究提供了新的解释。（JEL E31, E43, E52）

abstract.text: A vast empirical literature has documented delayed and persistent effects of monetary policy shocks on output. We show that this finding results from the aggregation of output impulse responses that differ sharply depending on the timing of the shock. When the monetary policy shock takes place in the first two quarters of the year, the response of output is quick, sizable, and dies out at a relatively fast pace. In contrast, output responds very little when the shock takes place in the third or fourth quarter. We propose a potential explanation for the differential responses based on uneven staggering of wage contracts across quarters. Using a dynamic general equilibrium model, we show that a realistic amount of uneven staggering can generate differences in output responses quantitatively similar to those found in the data. (JEL E23, E24, E58, J41)

10.1257/aer.97.3.636.abstractZh: 大量实证文献记录了货币政策冲击对产出产生的延迟且持续的影响。我们发现，这一现象是由于产出反应在不同时间点时存在显著差异所导致的。当货币政策冲击发生在一年中的前两个季度时，产出的反应迅速且显著，并且会以相对较快的速度消退。相反，当冲击发生在第三或第四季度时，产出的反应则非常微弱。我们提出了一种可能的解释，即由于各季度工资合同的安排不均衡，导致了这种差异性的产出反应。通过动态一般均衡模型分析，我们发现，适度的不均衡安排确实能够产生与数据中所发现的产出反应差异相当的结果。（JEL E23, E24, E58, J41）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the welfare costs of business cycles when workers face uninsurable job displacement risk. The paper uses a simple macroeconomic model with incomplete markets to show that cyclical variations in the long-term earnings losses of displaced workers can generate arbitrarily large cost of business cycles even if the variance of individual income changes is constant over the cycle. In addition to the theoretical analysis, this paper conducts a quantitative study of the cost of business cycles using empirical evidence on the long-term earnings losses of US workers. The quantitative analysis shows that realistic variations in job displacement risk generate sizable costs of business cycles, even though a second-moment analysis would suggest negligible costs. (JEL E21, E24, E32, J63)

10.1257/aer.97.3.664.abstractZh: 本文分析了在工人面临不可保险的工作岗位流失风险时，商业周期所带来的福利成本。通过一个简单的不完全市场宏观经济模型，本文表明，即使个人收入变化的方差在整个周期中保持不变，岗位流失工人长期收入损失的周期性波动仍可能导致商业周期的任意大成本。除了理论分析外，本文还利用美国工人长期收入损失的实证数据，对商业周期的成本进行了定量研究。定量分析显示，尽管第二 Moment 分析表明成本可以忽略不计，但现实中的岗位流失风险变化确实会导致相当大的商业周期成本。（JEL E21, E24, E32, J63）

abstract.text: The current literature offers two views on the nature of the labor income process. According to the first view, individuals are subject to very persistent income shocks while facing similar life-cycle income profiles (the RIP process, Thomas MaCurdy 1982). According to the alternative, individuals are subject to shocks with modest persistence while facing individual-specific profiles (the HIP process, Lee A. Lillard and Yoram A. Weiss 1979). In this paper we study the restrictions imposed by these two processes on consumption data—in the context of a life-cycle model—to distinguish between the two views. We find that the life-cycle model with a HIP process, which has not been studied in the previous literature, is consistent with several features of consumption data, whereas the model with a RIP process is consistent with some, but not with others. We conclude that the HIP model could be a credible contender to—and along some dimensions, a more coherent alternative than—the RIP model. (JEL D83, D91, E21, J31)

10.1257/aer.97.3.687.abstractZh: 现有文献对劳动收入过程的本质提出了两种观点。第一种观点认为，个体面临非常持久的收入冲击，同时其生命周期收入状况相似（即RIP过程，Thomas MaCurdy 1982）。另一种观点则认为，个体面临的冲击持续性较低，且收入状况具有个体特异性（即HIP过程，Lee A. Lillard和Yoram A. Weiss 1979）。本文研究了这两种过程对消费数据的影响，以区分这两种观点。我们发现，采用HIP过程的生命周期模型与消费数据的若干特征相符，而采用RIP过程的模型则符合部分特征，但不完全符合其他特征。我们得出结论，HIP模型可能是一个可信的竞争者，并且在某些方面，它比RIP模型更为合理。（JEL D83, D91, E21, J31）

abstract.text: Many important economic questions hinge on the extent to which new goods either crowd out or complement consumption of existing products. Recent methods for studying new goods rule out complementarity by assumption, so their applicability to these questions has been limited. I develop a new model that relaxes this restriction, and use it to study competition between print and online newspapers. Using new micro data from Washington, DC, I estimate the relationship between the print and online papers in demand, the welfare impact of the online paper's introduction, and the expected impact of charging positive online prices. (JEL C25, L11, L82)

10.1257/aer.97.3.713.abstractZh: 许多重要的经济问题取决于新商品在多大程度上挤占或补充现有产品的消费。最近研究新商品的方法通过假设排除了互补性，因此这些方法在这些问题上的应用受到限制。我开发了一个新的模型，放宽了这一限制，并用它来研究纸质报纸与在线报纸之间的竞争。利用来自华盛顿特区的新的微观数据，我估计了纸质报纸与在线报纸之间的需求关系、在线报纸引入所带来的福利影响，以及收取正向在线价格所带来的预期影响。（JEL C25, L11, L82）

abstract.text: We develop a structural econometric model to estimate risk preferences from data on deductible choices in auto insurance contracts. We account for adverse selection by modeling unobserved heterogeneity in both risk (claim rate) and risk aversion. We find large and skewed heterogeneity in risk attitudes. In addition, women are more risk averse than men, risk aversion exhibits a U-shape with respect to age, and proxies for income and wealth are positively associated with absolute risk aversion. Finally, unobserved heterogeneity in risk aversion is greater than that of risk, and, as we illustrate, has important implications for insurance pricing. (JEL D81, G22)

10.1257/aer.97.3.745.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个结构经济计量模型，用于从汽车保险合同中可扣除选择的数据中估计风险偏好。我们通过建模风险（索赔率）和风险厌恶的未观测异质性，来考虑逆向选择问题。我们发现风险态度存在较大且偏斜的异质性。此外，女性比男性更厌恶风险，风险厌恶随年龄呈U形分布，而收入和财富的代理变量与绝对风险厌恶呈正相关。最后，风险厌恶的未观测异质性大于风险异质性，正如我们所说明的，这对保险定价具有重要意义。（JEL D81, G22）

abstract.text: This paper estimates a general equilibrium model of school quality and household residential and school choice for economies with multiple public school districts and private (religious and nonsectarian) schools. The estimates, obtained through full-solution methods, are used to simulate two large-scale private school voucher programs in the Chicago metropolitan area: universal vouchers and vouchers restricted to nonsectarian schools. In the simulations, both programs increase private school enrollment and affect household residential choice. Under nonsectarian vouchers, however, private school enrollment expands less than under universal vouchers, and religious school enrollment declines for large nonsectarian vouchers. Fewer households benefit from nonsectarian vouchers. (JEL H75, I21, I22)

10.1257/aer.97.3.789.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个关于学校质量、家庭居住选择与学校选择的通用均衡模型，研究对象为拥有多个公立学区以及私立（宗教和非宗派）学校的经济体。通过完全解方法获得的模型估计结果被用于模拟芝加哥大都会区两个大规模的私立学校券计划：普遍型券计划和仅限非宗派学校的券计划。模拟结果显示，这两种计划都增加了私立学校的入学人数，并影响了家庭的居住选择。然而，在非宗派学校券计划下，私立学校的入学增长幅度小于普遍型券计划，而大型非宗派学校券计划则导致宗教学校的入学人数下降。因此，非宗派学校券计划对较少的家庭产生积极影响。（JEL H75, I21, I22）

abstract.text: A core question in the contemporary debate on distributive justice is how to understand fairness in situations involving production. Important theories of distributive justice, such as strict egalitarianism, liberal egalitarianism, and libertarianism, provide different answers to this question. This paper presents the results from a dictator game where the distribution phase is preceded by a production phase. Each player's contribution is a result of a freely chosen investment level and an exogenously given rate of return. We estimate simultaneously the prevalence of three principles of distributive justice among the players and the distribution of the weight they attach to fairness. (JEL D63)

10.1257/aer.97.3.818.abstractZh: 当代关于分配正义的辩论中的一个核心问题是，如何理解生产过程中的公平性问题。分配正义的重要理论，如严格平等主义、自由平等主义和自由意志主义，对这一问题给出了不同的答案。本文研究了一个 dictator game 的结果，其中分配阶段之前有一个生产阶段。每个玩家的贡献都是其自由选择的投资水平以及外部给定的回报率的结果。我们同时估计了玩家们对三种分配正义原则的遵循程度，以及他们对公平性的重视程度。（JEL D63）

abstract.text: Patients needing kidney transplants may have donors who cannot donate to them because of blood or tissue incompatibility. Incompatible patient-donor pairs can exchange donor kidneys with other pairs only when there is a "double coincidence of wants." Developing infrastructure to perform three-way as well as two-way exchanges will have a substantial effect on the number of transplants that can be arranged. Larger than three-way exchanges have less impact on efficiency. In a general model of type-compatible exchanges, the size of the largest exchanges required to achieve efficiency equals the number of types.

10.1257/aer.97.3.828.abstractZh: 需要肾脏移植的患者可能会遇到无法提供移植器官的捐赠者，这是由于血液或组织不兼容的原因。只有当存在“双重需求巧合”时，不兼容的患者与捐赠者之间才能交换肾脏。建立能够进行三方以及双向交换的基础设施，将对可安排的移植数量产生显著影响。超过三方交换规模的双向交换对效率的影响较小。在一种通用的类型兼容交换模型中，为了实现效率，所需的最大交换规模等于类型数量。

abstract.text: We study a one-dimensional Hotelling-Downs model of electoral competition with the following innovation: a fraction of candidates have “character” and are exogenously committed to a campaign platform; this is unobservable to voters. Character is desirable, and a voter's utility is a convex combination of standard policy preferences and her assessment of a candidate's character. This structure induces a signaling game between strategic candidates and voters, since a policy platform affects voters' utilities not only directly, but also indirectly through inferences about a candidate's character. The model generates a number of predictions, starting with a failure of the median voter theorem. (JEL D72, D82)

10.1257/aer.97.3.852.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个一维的Hotelling-Downs选举竞争模型，并引入了以下创新：部分候选人具有“品格”，并且他们的竞选纲领是外生设定的，选民无法观察到这一点。品格是值得追求的，选民的效用是标准政策偏好与对候选人品格评估的凸组合。这种结构导致了战略性候选人与选民之间的信号传递博弈，因为政策纲领不仅直接影响选民的效用，还通过推断候选人的品格间接影响选民的效用。该模型提出了一些预测，其中首先涉及中位选民定理的失效。（JEL D72, D82）

abstract.text: For two districts or countries that try to internalize externalities, I analyze a bargaining game under private information. I derive conditions for when it is efficient with uniform policies across regions—with and without side payments—and when it is efficient to prohibit side payments in the negotiations. While policy differentiation and side payments allow the policy to better reflect local conditions, they create conflicts between the regions and, thus, delay. The results also describe when political centralization outperforms decentralized cooperation, and they provide a theoretical foundation for the controversial “uniformity assumption” traditionally used by the fiscal federalism literature. (JEL C78, D72, D82, H77)

10.1257/aer.97.3.871.abstractZh: 对于两个试图内部化外部性的地区或国家，我分析了一个在私人信息下的讨价还价游戏。我推导出了在区域间实施统一政策时（包括有侧边支付和无侧边支付的情况）是否有效的条件，以及禁止谈判中的侧边支付是否有效的条件。虽然政策差异和侧边支付可以使政策更好地反映当地情况，但它们也会引发地区间的冲突，从而延迟问题的解决。研究结果还描述了政治集权何时优于分散式合作，并为财政联邦主义文献中传统使用的有争议的“一致性假设”提供了理论依据。（JEL C78, D72, D82, H77）

abstract.text: We present a dynamic model of network formation where nodes find other nodes with whom to form links in two ways: some are found uniformly at random, while others are found by searching locally through the current structure of the network (e.g., meeting friends of friends). This combination of meeting processes results in a spectrum of features exhibited by large social networks, including the presence of more high- and low-degree nodes than when links are formed independently at random, having low distances between nodes in the network, and having high clustering of links on a local level. We fit the model to data from six networks and impute the relative ratio of random to network-based meetings in link formation, which turns out to vary dramatically across applications. We show that as the random/network-based meeting ratio varies, the resulting degree distributions can be ordered in the sense of stochastic dominance, which allows us to infer how the formation process affects average utility in the network. (JEL D85, Z13)

10.1257/aer.97.3.890.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态网络形成模型，其中节点以两种方式寻找其他节点来建立联系：一些节点是随机均匀分布的，而另一些则是通过搜索当前网络结构来寻找的（例如，结识朋友的朋友）。这种结合式的寻找过程导致了大型社交网络所展现的一系列特征，包括比独立随机建立联系时更多的高度和低度节点、网络中节点之间的距离较短，以及局部层面上链接的聚集性较高。我们将该模型应用于六个网络的数据，并估算了在链接形成过程中随机与基于网络的寻找比例，结果发现这一比例在不同应用中存在显著差异。我们指出，随着随机/基于网络的寻找比例的变化，得到的度分布可以按照随机优势的顺序进行排序，这使我们能够推断出形成过程如何影响网络中的平均效用。（JEL D85, Z13）

abstract.text: We develop a tractable framework for the analysis of the relationship between contractual incompleteness, technological complementarities, and technology adoption. In our model, a firm chooses its technology and investment levels in contractible activities by suppliers of intermediate inputs. Suppliers then choose investments in noncontractible activities, anticipating payoffs from an ex post bargaining game. We show that greater contractual incompleteness leads to the adoption of less advanced technologies, and that the impact of contractual incompleteness is more pronounced when there is greater complementary among the intermediate inputs. We study a number of applications of the main framework and show that the mechanism proposed in the paper can generate sizable productivity differences across countries with different contracting institutions, and that differences in contracting institutions lead to endogenous comparative advantage differences. (JEL D86, O33)

10.1257/aer.97.3.916.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个易于分析的框架，用于分析合同不完全性、技术互补性与技术采纳之间的关系。在我们的模型中，企业根据中间投入的供应商选择其技术以及可合同化活动中的投资水平。供应商则选择在非可合同化活动中的投资，并预期从事后谈判游戏中获得收益。我们表明，合同不完全性越高，采用的技术就越落后，而当中间投入之间的互补性越强时，合同不完全性的影响更为显著。我们研究了该主要框架的多种应用，并表明本文提出的机制能够在具有不同契约制度的国家之间产生显著的生产力差异，而契约制度的差异会导致内生性比较优势的差异。（JEL D86, O33）

abstract.text: An organization makes collective decisions through neither markets nor contracts. Instead, rational agents voluntarily choose to follow a leader. In many cases, incentive problems are solved: the unique nondegenerate equilibrium achieves the first best, even though every agent has incentives to free ride. The leader has no special talents but is distinguished by getting exclusive access to information. A crucial feature is that the leader reveals part but not all of her information. It is this maintenance of informational asymmetry that permits achieving the first best. (JEL D23, M54)

10.1257/aer.97.3.944.abstractZh: 一个组织通过既不是市场也不是合同的方式做出集体决策。相反，理性的个体自愿选择跟随一个领导者。在许多情况下，激励问题得以解决：独特的非退化均衡实现了最优解，尽管每个个体都有搭便车的动机。领导者并没有特殊才能，但因其能够独家获取信息而显得与众不同。一个关键特征是，领导者只透露部分信息而非全部。正是这种信息不对称性的维持，使得最优解得以实现。（JEL D23, M54）

abstract.text: After an earthquake hit Southern Italy in 1980, young men from certain towns were exempted from compulsory military service. We show that the exemption raised high-school-graduation rates of boys by more than 2 percentage points. We do this by comparing high-school-graduation rates of young exempt men and older nonexempt men from the least damaged areas and men of the same age groups from nearby towns that were not hit by the quake. Similar comparisons show that graduation rates of young women in the affected areas also increased. Since in Italy women are not subject to the draft, the findings suggest the presence of spillover effects. (JEL I21, J13)

10.1257/aer.97.3.948.abstractZh: 1980年，意大利南部发生地震后，某些城镇的年轻男性被免除义务兵役。我们发现，这一免除政策使这些男性的高中毕业率提高了2个百分点以上。我们通过比较受地震影响最小的地区中，被免除兵役的年轻男性的高中毕业率与未受影响的同龄男性，以及附近未受地震影响的城镇的同龄男性，发现这一现象确实存在。类似的比较还表明，受影响地区的年轻女性高中毕业率也有所上升。由于意大利女性不须服兵役，这些发现表明存在溢出效应。（JEL I21, J13）

abstract.text: We develop a survey instrument to measure self-control problems in a sample of highly educated adults. This measure relates in the manner that theory predicts to liquid wealth accumulation and personality measures. Yet while self-control problems are typically seen as resulting in overconsumption and low wealth, we identify a significant group who underconsume and thereby accumulate high levels of wealth. In addition, self-control problems are smaller in scale for older than for younger respondents. Those who put money aside in retirement accounts may be delaying access to a point at which self-control problems are no longer important. (JEL D12, D14)

10.1257/aer.97.3.966.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种调查工具，用于测量高教育水平成年人的自我控制问题。这一测量结果与理论预测的液体财富积累与人格特征之间的关系一致。然而，尽管自我控制问题通常被认为会导致过度消费和财富减少，我们发现有一部分人通过减少消费反而积累了大量财富。此外，与年轻受访者相比，年长受访者的自我控制问题较为轻微。那些将资金存入退休账户的人，可能推迟了自我控制问题不再重要的时刻。（JEL D12, D14）

abstract.text: This paper studies the association between regulation and the organizational form of new life insurers between 1900 and 1949. The mutual form was popular in states with low initial capital requirements for mutual companies and differentially higher requirements for stock companies, but was rarely used elsewhere. This suggests that entrepreneurs took a “path of least resistance” when choosing organizational form and that the mutual's disadvantage in raising capital contributed to its decline–a decline that accelerated as states raised requirements and eliminated the aforementioned differentials. Contrary to previous analysis, the paper finds little evidence connecting other regulations to mutual decline. (JEL G21, L51, N21, N22)

10.1257/aer.97.3.973.abstractZh: 本文研究了1900年至1949年间，新生命保险公司的组织形式与监管措施之间的关联。互助形式在初始资本要求较低的州较为流行，而股票公司的要求则相对较高，但在其他地区很少使用。这表明企业家在选择组织形式时倾向于“阻力最小的路径”，而互助形式在筹集资金方面的劣势导致了其衰落——随着各州提高要求并消除上述差异，这种衰落进一步加速。与以往的分析不同，本文发现几乎没有证据表明其他监管措施与互助形式的衰落之间存在关联。（JEL G21, L51, N21, N22）

abstract.text: The inclusion of a durable goods sector in sticky-price models has strong and unexpected implications. Even if most prices are flexible, a small durable goods sector with sticky prices may be sufficient to make aggregate output react to monetary policy as though most prices were sticky. In contrast, flexibly priced durables with sufficiently long service lives can undo the implications of standard sticky price models. In a limiting case, flexibly priced durables cause monetary policy to have no effect on aggregate output. Our analysis suggests that durable goods prices are the most relevant data for calibrating price rigidity. (JEL E21, E23, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.97.3.984.abstractZh: 在粘性价格模型中纳入耐用消费品部门会产生强烈且意想不到的影响。即使大多数价格都是灵活的，一个具有粘性价格的小型耐用消费品部门也可能足以使总产出对货币政策做出反应，仿佛大多数价格都是粘性的。相比之下，价格灵活的耐用消费品如果具有足够长的使用寿命，则能够消除标准粘性价格模型的影响。在极限情况下，价格灵活的耐用消费品会导致货币政策对总产出没有任何影响。我们的分析表明，耐用消费品的价格是最适合用于校准价格刚性性的数据。（JEL E21, E23, E31, E52）

abstract.text: An explanation for motivation crowding-out phenomena is developed in a social preferences framework. Besides selfish and fair or altruistic types, a third type of agent is introduced. These “conformists” have social preferences if they believe that sufficiently many of the others do as well. When there is asymmetric information about the distribution of preferences (the “social norm”), the incentive scheme offered or autonomy granted can reveal a principal's beliefs about that norm. High-powered incentives may crowd out motivation as pessimism about the norm is conveyed. But by choosing fixed wages or granting autonomy, trust in a favorable norm may be signaled. (JEL D64, D82, J41, Z13)

10.1257/aer.97.3.999.abstractZh: 本文在社会偏好框架内对动机挤出现象进行了解释。除了自私型、公平型或利他型行为者之外，还引入了第三种行为者——“顺从者”。这些顺从者只有在认为其他人的行为也类似时，才会表现出社会偏好。当关于偏好分布的信息不对称时（“社会规范”），所提供的激励方案或授予的自主权可能会揭示出行为者对该规范的看法。高强度的激励可能会因对规范的悲观态度而挤出其他动机。但通过选择固定的工资或授予自主权，也可以向外界传递对有利规范的信任。（JEL D64, D82, J41, Z13）

abstract.text: We use Kőszegi and Rabin's (2006) model of reference-dependent utility, and an extension of it that applies to decisions with delayed consequences, to study preferences over monetary risk. Because our theory equates the reference point with recent probabilistic beliefs about outcomes, it predicts specific ways in which the environment influences attitudes toward modest-scale risk. It replicates “classical” prospect theory—including the prediction of distaste for insuring losses—when exposure to risk is a surprise, but implies first-order risk aversion when a risk, and the possibility of insuring it, are anticipated. A prior expectation to take on risk decreases aversion to both the anticipated and additional risk. For large-scale risk, the model allows for standard “consumption utility” to dominate reference-dependent “gain-loss utility,” generating nearly identical risk aversion across situations. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1047.abstractZh: 我们采用了Kőszegi和Rabin在2006年提出的参考依赖效用模型，并对其进行了扩展，以研究对货币风险的偏好。由于我们的理论将参考点等同于对结果的最新概率信念，因此它能够预测环境如何具体影响人们对适度风险的态度。当风险暴露是意外事件时，该理论能够复制“经典”前景理论的观点——包括对损失保险的不喜欢——而当风险及其保险可能性被预先预期时，则体现出一阶风险厌恶。对于预先预期的风险，人们会减少对预期风险以及额外风险的厌恶。对于大规模风险，该模型允许标准的“消费效用”占据主导地位，从而生成几乎相同的风险厌恶程度。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: This paper develops a dynamic model of mismatch. Workers and jobs are randomly allocated to labor markets. Each market clears, but some have excess (unemployed) workers and some have excess (vacant) jobs. As workers and jobs switch markets, unemployed workers find vacancies and employed workers become unemployed. The model is quantitatively consistent with the business cycle frequency comovement of unemployment, vacancies, and the job finding rate and explains much of these variables' volatility. It can also address cyclicality in the separation rate into unemployment and duration dependence in the job finding rate. The results are robust to some nonrandom mobility. (JEL E24, J41, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1074.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个动态的不匹配模型。工人和职位被随机分配到各个劳动力市场。每个市场都实现了供需平衡，但有些市场存在多余的工人，而有些市场则存在多余的职位。随着工人和职位的流动，失业工人可以找到空缺职位，而就业工人则可能变得失业。该模型在数量上与失业、空缺职位以及求职率的商业周期频率变化一致，并解释了这些变量的大部分波动性。该模型还可以解释失业率的周期性变化以及求职率的持续时间依赖性。这些结果在一定的非随机流动性条件下仍然具有稳健性。（JEL E24, J41, J63, J64）

abstract.text: In textbook expositions of the equity-premium, riskfree-rate and equity-volatility puzzles, agents are sure of the economy's structure while growth rates are normally distributed. But because of parameter uncertainty the thin-tailed normal distribution conditioned on realized data becomes a thick-tailed Student-t distribution, which changes the entire nature of what is considered “puzzling” by reversing every inequality discrepancy needing to be explained. This paper shows that Bayesian updating of unknown structural parameters inevitably adds a permanent tail-thickening effect to posterior expectations. The expected-utility ramifications of this for asset pricing are strong, work against the puzzles, and are very sensitive to subjective prior beliefs—even with asymptotically infinite data. (JEL D84, G12)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1102.abstractZh: 在关于股权溢价、无风险利率和股权波动问题的教科书阐述中，假设经济结构明确，而增长率呈正态分布。但由于参数不确定性，基于实际数据的薄尾正态分布会变成厚尾的Student-t分布，这改变了被视为“谜题”的整个性质，因为需要解释的所有不平等差异都发生了改变。本文表明，对未知结构参数的贝叶斯更新不可避免地会在后验期望中引入一个永久性的尾部增厚效应。这对资产定价的影响非常显著，有助于解决这些谜题，并且对主观先验信念非常敏感——即使数据呈渐进式无限增长。（JEL D84, G12）

abstract.text: Economists have recently argued recessions play a useful role in fostering growth. Yet a major source of growth, R&D, is procyclical. This paper argues one reason for procyclical R&D is a dynamic externality inherent in R&D that makes entrepreneurs short-sighted and concentrate their innovation in booms, even when it is optimal to concentrate it in recessions. Additional forces may imply that procyclical R&D is desirable, but equilibrium R&D is likely to be too procyclical, and macroeconomic shocks are likely to have overly persistent effects on output and make growth more costly than in the absence of such shocks.

10.1257/aer.97.4.1131.abstractZh: 经济学家最近认为，经济衰退在促进增长方面发挥着重要作用。然而，增长的另一个重要来源——研发活动，实际上是顺周期的。本文认为，研发活动具有顺周期性的一个原因是研发过程中固有的动态外部性，这使得企业家在繁荣时期进行创新，即使这种创新在衰退时期进行更为理想。此外，某些因素可能使得顺周期的研发活动具有吸引力，但均衡状态下的研发活动可能过于顺周期，而宏观经济冲击可能会对产出产生长期影响，从而使增长成本高于没有这些冲击的情况。

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium business cycle model where nonconvex delivery costs lead firms to follow (S, s) inventory policies. Calibrated to postwar US data, the model reproduces two-thirds of the cyclical variability of inventory investment. Moreover, it delivers strongly procyclical inventory investment, greater volatility in production than sales, and a countercyclical inventory-to-sales ratio. Our model challenges several prominent claims involving inventories, including the widely held belief that they amplify aggregate fluctuations. Despite the comovement between inventory investment and final sales, GDP volatility is essentially unaltered by inventory accumulation, because procyclical inventory investment diverts resources from final production, thereby dampening fluctuations in sales. (JEL E22, E32).

10.1257/aer.97.4.1165.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个均衡商业周期模型，其中非凸交付成本促使企业遵循(S, s)库存政策。该模型经过校准后，能够再现战后美国数据中的三分之二的库存投资周期性变化。此外，该模型还表现出强烈的顺周期性库存投资特征，即生产的波动性大于销售，并且库存与销售的比例具有逆周期性。我们的模型对涉及库存的几个重要观点提出了挑战，包括普遍认为库存会放大总体波动的观点。尽管库存投资与最终销售之间存在协同效应，但GDP的波动性基本上不受库存积累的影响，因为顺周期的库存投资会将资源从最终生产中转移出去，从而抑制销售的波动。(JEL E22, E32)

abstract.text: Why did Western Europe industrialize first? An influential view holds that its exceptionally well-functioning markets supported with a certain set of institutions provided the incentives to make investments needed to industrialize. This paper examines this hypothesis by comparing the actual performance of markets in terms of market integration in Western Europe and China, two regions that were relatively advanced in the preindustrial period, but would start to industrialize about 150 years apart. We find that the performance of markets in China and Western Europe overall was comparable in the late eighteenth century. Market performance in England was higher than in the Yangzi Delta, and markets in England also performed better than those in continental Western Europe. This suggests strong market performance may be necessary, but it is not sufficient for industrialization. Rather than being a key condition for subsequent growth, improvements in market performance and growth occurred simultaneously. (JEL N13, N15, O47)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1189.abstractZh: 为什么西欧率先实现工业化？一种有影响力的观点认为，其运作异常良好的市场以及一系列有效的制度为工业化所需的投资提供了激励。本文通过比较西欧和中国市场的实际表现来检验这一假设。这两个地区在工业化前期就已经相对发达，但开始工业化的时间相差约150年。我们发现，在18世纪末，中国和西欧市场的表现总体相当。英格兰市场的表现优于长江三角洲地区，而英格兰市场的表现也优于欧洲大陆的西欧地区。这表明，良好的市场表现可能是实现工业化的必要条件，但仅此还不够。市场表现的改善与经济增长并非先后发生，而是同时发生的。（JEL N13, N15, O47）

abstract.text: Evidence suggests that people understand qualitatively how tastes change over time, but underestimate the magnitudes. This evidence is limited, however, to laboratory evidence or surveys of reported happiness. We test for such projection bias in field data. Using data on catalog orders of cold-weather items, we find evidence of projection bias over the weather—specifically, people's decisions are overinfluenced by the current weather. Our estimates suggest that if the order-date temperature declines by 30°F, the return probability increases by 3.95 percent. We also estimate a structural model to measure the magnitude of the bias. (JEL D12, L81)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1217.abstractZh: 有证据表明，人们能够定性地理解品味随时间的变化，但低估了变化的幅度。然而，这些证据仅限于实验室研究或关于幸福感报告的调查。我们试图在实地数据中检验这种预测偏差。通过收集寒冷天气用品的订购数据，我们发现人们对天气的预测存在偏差——具体来说，人们的决策受到当前天气的过度影响。我们的估计表明，如果订购日期的气温下降30华氏度，退货概率将增加3.95%。我们还建立了一个结构模型来测量这种偏差的幅度。（JEL D12, L81）

abstract.text: While neoclassical models assume static cost-minimization by firms, agency models suggest that firms may not minimize costs in less-competitive or regulated environments. We test this using a transition from cost-of-service regulation to market-oriented environments for many US electric generating plants. Our estimates of input demand suggest that publicly owned plants, whose owners were largely insulated from these reforms, experienced the smallest efficiency gains, while investor-owned plants in states that restructured their wholesale electricity markets improved the most. The results suggest modest medium-term efficiency benefits from replacing regulated monopoly with a market-based industry structure. (JEL D24, L11, L51, L94, L98)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1250.abstractZh: 虽然新古典模型假设企业以静态方式最小化成本，但代理模型表明，在竞争较低或监管较弱的环境中，企业可能不会最小化成本。我们通过美国许多发电厂的从服务成本监管向市场导向环境的转变来测试这一假设。我们的输入需求估计表明，那些所有者基本不受这些改革影响的公有发电厂，效率提升最小，而位于重组批发电力市场的州的投资者拥有的发电厂效率提升最大。结果表明，用市场化的行业结构取代受监管的垄断企业，可以在中期带来适度的效率提升。（JEL D24, L11, L51, L94, L98）

abstract.text: Inexperienced women, along with economics and business majors, are much more susceptible to the winner's curse, as are subjects with lower SAT/ACT scores. There are strong selection effects in bid function estimates for inexperienced and experienced subjects due to bankruptcies and bidders who have lower earnings returning less frequently as experienced subjects. These selection effects are not identified using standard econometric techniques but are identified through experimental treatment effects. Ignoring these selection effects leads to misleading estimates of learning. (JEL D44, D83, J16)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1278.abstractZh: 缺乏经验的女性以及经济学和商业专业的学生，更容易受到“赢家诅咒”的影响，SAT/ACT成绩较低的受试者也是如此。在投标函数的估计中，对于缺乏经验和有经验的受试者，由于破产事件以及收入较低的投标者较少出现，存在明显的选择效应。这些选择效应无法通过标准的计量经济学技术识别，但可以通过实验处理效应来识别。忽略这些选择效应会导致对学习效果的误导性估计。（JEL D44, D83, J16）

abstract.text: Previous papers by Eric B. Rasmusen, J. Mark Ramseyer, and John S. Wiley, Jr. (1991) and Ilya R. Segal and Michael D. Whinston (2000) argue that exclusive contracts can inefficiently deter entry in the presence of scale economies and multiple buyers. We first show that these results no longer hold when buyers are final consumers who can breach these contracts and pay expectation damages. We then show, however, that exclusive contracts can inefficiently deter entry if buyers are downstream competitors, even in the absence of scale economies and even if breach is possible. (JEL D86, K21, L11, L13, L14, L40 )

10.1257/aer.97.4.1305.abstractZh: Eric B. Rasmusen、J. Mark Ramseyer和John S. Wiley, Jr. (1991)以及Ilya R. Segal和Michael D. Whinston (2000)的先前研究指出，在规模经济存在且存在多个购买者的情况下，独家合同可能会低效地阻碍新进入者。我们首先证明，当购买者是最终消费者且能够违反这些合同并支付预期损害赔偿时，这些结论不再成立。然而，我们进一步指出，如果购买者是下游竞争对手，即使在没有规模经济的情况下，即使违反合同是可能的，独家合同仍然可能会低效地阻碍新进入者。(JEL D86, K21, L11, L13, L14, L40)

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of vertical mergers on upstream firms' ability to collude when selling to downstream firms in a repeated game. We show that vertical mergers give rise to an outlets effect: the deviation profits of cheating unintegrated firms are reduced as these firms can no longer profitably sell to the downstream affiliates of their integrated rivals. Vertical mergers also result in an opposing punishment effect: integrated firms typically make more profit in the punishment phase than unintegrated upstream firms. The net result of these effects in an unintegrated industry is to facilitate upstream collusion. We provide conditions under which further vertical integration also facilitates collusion. (JEL D43, G34, L12, L13)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1321.abstractZh: 我们研究了纵向合并对上游企业向下游企业销售时勾结行为的影响，通过重复博弈进行研究。我们发现，纵向合并会产生一种“出口效应”：不整合企业的作弊行为所导致的利润减少，因为这些企业无法再向其整合竞争对手的下游企业盈利性地销售产品。纵向合并还会产生一种“相反惩罚效应”：整合企业在惩罚阶段通常能比不整合的上游企业获得更多的利润。这些效应的综合结果，在不整合行业中，会促进上游企业的勾结行为。我们还提出了进一步纵向整合也会促进勾结行为的条件。（JEL D43, G34, L12, L13）

abstract.text: People who are members of a group and identify with it behave differently from people who perceive themselves as isolated individuals. This paper shows that group membership affects preferences over outcomes, and saliency of the group affects the perception of the environment. We manipulate the saliency of group membership by letting a player's own group watch as a passive audience as decisions are made, and/or by making part of the payoff common for members of the group. In contrast to the minimal-group paradigm, minimal groups alone do not affect behavior in our strategic environments. However, salient group membership significantly increases the aggressive stance of the hosts (people who have their group members in the audience), and tends to reduce that of the guests. (JEL D71, Z13)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1340.abstractZh: 属于某个群体并认同该群体的人们，其行为与将自己视为孤立个体的人们不同。本文表明，群体成员身份会影响对结果的偏好，而群体的显著性会影响对环境的感知。我们通过让玩家自己的群体作为被动观众观看决策过程，以及/或使部分收益为群体成员共享，来操纵群体成员身份的显著性。与最小群体范式不同，仅使用最小群体并不能影响我们的战略环境中的行为。然而，显著的群体成员身份显著增加了主人的攻击性（即那些有群体成员在观众席中的人），并倾向于降低客人的攻击性。（JEL D71, Z13）

abstract.text: We examine how countries' incentives to go to war depend on the “political bias” of their pivotal decision makers. This bias is measured by a decision maker's risk/reward ratio from a war compared to that of the country at large. If there is no political bias, then there are mutually acceptable transfers from one country to the other that will avoid a war in the presence of commitment or enforceability of peace treaties. There are cases with a strong enough bias on the part of one or both countries where war cannot be prevented by any transfer payments. Our results shed some new light on the uneven contender paradox and the interpretation of the “democratic peace.” We examine countries' choices of the bias of their leaders and show that when transfers are possible, at least one country will choose a biased leader, as that leads to a strong bargaining position and extraction of transfers. (JEL D72, D74)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1353.abstractZh: 我们研究了各国参战动机如何取决于其关键决策者的“政治偏见”。这种偏见通过决策者从战争中的风险/回报比率与整个国家的比率来衡量。如果没有政治偏见，那么通过相互可接受的转移支付可以避免战争，前提是和平条约具有承诺性和可执行性。然而，如果一方或双方存在足够强的偏见，那么任何转移支付都无法阻止战争的发生。我们的研究结果对“不平等竞争悖论”以及“民主和平”理论的解释提供了新的见解。我们研究了各国对领导人偏见的决策，并发现当转移支付成为可能时，至少会有一国选择有偏见的领导人，因为这样能够带来强大的谈判地位并获取更多转移支付。（JEL D72, D74）

abstract.text: We present a model where trade agreements are motivated by the desire of governments to commit vis-à-vis domestic lobbies, in addition to standard terms-of-trade externalities. The model predicts that trade liberalization is deeper when capital is more mobile across sectors, and when governments are more politically motivated (provided domestic-commitment motives are strong enough). The model also provides a new rationale for the use of tariff ceilings. In a fully dynamic specification of the model, tariffs are reduced in two stages: an immediate cut and a subsequent gradual reduction, with the speed of liberalization increasing in the degree of capital mobility. (JEL D72, F13)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1374.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中贸易协议的动机源于政府为了应对国内游说团体而作出的承诺，而不仅仅是基于标准的贸易条款外部性。该模型预测，当资本在不同行业间流动更加自由，且政府具有更强的政治动机时（前提是国内承诺的动机足够强烈），贸易自由化程度会更高。该模型还为使用关税上限提供了新的理论依据。在模型的完全动态设定中，关税的降低分为两个阶段：立即削减和随后的逐步降低，自由化的速度随着资本流动性的增强而提高。（JEL D72, F13）

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates theoretically and experimentally that in first-price auctions overbidding with respect to the risk neutral Nash equilibrium might be driven from anticipated loser regret (felt when bidders lose at an affordable price). Different information structures are created to elicit regret: bidders know they will learn the winning bid if they lose (loser regret condition); or the second-highest bid if they win (winner regret condition); or they will receive no feedback regarding the other bids. Bidders in loser regret condition anticipated regret and significantly overbid. However, bidders in the winner regret condition did not anticipate regret. (JEL D44)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1407.abstractZh: 本文通过理论和实验表明，在第一价格拍卖中，相对于风险中性纳什均衡的出价过高可能源于预期中的损失后悔（即投标者在可接受的价格下失败时所感受到的遗憾）。为了引发这种遗憾，我们设计了不同的信息结构：投标者知道如果失败，他们将得知获胜的出价；如果获胜，他们将得知第二高的出价；或者他们不会收到关于其他出价的反馈。处于损失后悔条件下的投标者预期会有遗憾，并因此出价过高。然而，处于获胜后悔条件下的投标者并未预期到这种遗憾。（JEL D44）

abstract.text: What role does labor play in firms' market value? We use a production-based asset pricing model with factor adjustment costs and forward-looking agents to explore this question. We posit that the hiring of labor is akin to investment in capital and that the two interact, with the interaction being a crucial determinant of the dynamic behavior of market value. Using aggregate US corporate sector data, we estimate firms' optimal hiring and investment decisions and the consequences for firms' value. (JEL E22, E24, G31, G32, M51)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1419.abstractZh: 劳动力在企业市场价值中扮演什么角色？我们采用基于生产的资产定价模型，并考虑要素调整成本以及具有前瞻性视角的主体，来探讨这一问题。我们认为，雇用劳动力类似于对资本的投入，两者之间存在相互作用，而这种相互作用是市场价值动态行为的重要决定因素。通过利用美国整体企业部门的数据，我们估算了企业的最优招聘和投资决策，以及这些决策对企业价值的影响。（JEL E22, E24, G31, G32, M51）

abstract.text: A repeated moral hazard setting in which the Principal privately observes the Agent's output is studied. The optimal contract for a finite horizon is characterized, and shown to require burning of resources. These are only burnt after the worst possible realization sequence and the amount is independent of both the length of the horizon and the discount factor. For the infinite horizon. it is shown that there is no loss from restricting the analysis to contracts in which the Agent receives a constant efficiency wage and no feedback until he is fired. Furthermore, optimal contracts cannot be replicated by short-term contracts. A family of fixed interval review contracts is characterized. Longer review intervals are preferable but harder to implement. Comparative statics on the review length are carried out. Finally, these contracts are shown approximate first best if players are very patient. (JEL D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1432.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种重复的道德风险情境，其中委托人私下观察代理人的产出。针对有限时间范围的最优契约进行了分析，结果表明契约需要消耗资源。这种消耗仅在最糟糕的实现序列之后才发生，且消耗量与时间范围及折现因子无关。对于无限时间范围，研究表明，将分析限制在代理人获得恒定效率工资且直到被解雇前没有反馈的契约中，不会造成损失。此外，最优契约无法通过短期契约来复制。文中还描述了一类固定间隔审查的契约，较长的审查间隔更优，但实施起来更为困难。对审查长度的比较静态分析也进行了探讨。最后，如果这些参与者非常有耐心，这些契约可以被认为是近似的第一最优解。（JEL D82, D86）

abstract.text: Systematic asymmetries in exchange behavior have been widely interpreted as support for “endowment effect theory,” an application of prospect theory positing that loss aversion and utility function kinks set by entitlements explain observed asymmetries. We experimentally test an alternative explanation, namely, that asymmetries are explained by classical preference theories finding influence through the experimental procedures typically used. Contrary to the predictions of endowment effect theory, we observe no asymmetries when we modify procedures to remove the influence of classical preference theories. When we return to traditional-type procedures, however, the asymmetries reappear. The results support explanations based in classical preference theories and reject endowment effect theory. (JEL D01)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1449.abstractZh: 交换行为中的系统性不对称现象被广泛解释为“禀赋效应理论”的支持，该理论是前景理论的一种应用，认为损失厌恶和由禀赋决定的效用函数弯曲解释了观察到的不对称性。我们通过实验测试了另一种解释，即不对称性可以通过通常使用的实验程序来由经典偏好理论解释。与禀赋效应理论的预测相反，当我们修改程序以排除经典偏好理论的影响时，我们没有观察到不对称性。然而，当我们回到传统类型的实验程序时，不对称性又重新出现。这些结果支持了基于经典偏好理论的解释，并否定了禀赋效应理论。 (JEL D01)

abstract.text: Twenty-seven percent of the Union Army prisoners captured July 1863 or later died in captivity. At Andersonville, the death rate may have been as high as 40 percent. How did men survive such horrific conditions? Using two independent datasets, we find that friends had a statistically significant positive effect on survival probabilities and that the closer the ties between friends as measured by such identifiers as ethnicity, kinship, and the same hometown, the bigger was the impact of friends on survival probabilities. (JEL N41, Z13)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1467.abstractZh: 在1863年7月或之后被俘的联邦军囚犯中，有27%的人在囚禁期间死亡。在安德森维尔，死亡率可能高达40%。人们是如何在如此可怕的条件下存活下来的呢？通过两个独立的数据集分析，我们发现朋友对生存概率有显著的积极影响，而且朋友之间的联系越紧密，比如通过种族、亲属关系或共同的家乡等标识符来衡量，朋友对生存概率的影响就越大。（JEL N41, Z13）

abstract.text: We measure the welfare gain from removing aggregate consumption fluctuations in a model where each individual faces incomplete consumption insurance. We show that, because this welfare gain is a convex function of the overall consumption risk—aggregate plus idiosyncratic—each individual faces, to gauge the magnitude of the gain, it is important to match individuals' overall risk prior to any policy. In an economy calibrated to match individuals' overall risk, even removing 10 percent of aggregate fluctuations can result in a large welfare gain. Further, large gains do not necessarily depend on the countercyclical nature of idiosyncratic risk. (JEL E21, E32)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1488.abstractZh: 我们在一个每个个体面临不完全消费保险的情况下，测量了消除总体消费波动所带来的福利增益。研究表明，由于这种福利增益是总体消费风险——总体风险与特定风险之和——的凸函数，因此为了衡量这种增益的大小，在采取任何政策之前，匹配个体的总体风险是非常重要的。在一个能够匹配个体总体风险的经中，即使消除10%的总体波动，也能带来巨大的福利增益。此外，巨大的增益并不一定依赖于特定风险的逆周期特性。（JEL E21, E32）

abstract.text: Preferences for redistribution, as well as the generosity of welfare states, differ significantly across countries. This paper tests whether there exists a feedback process of the economic regime on individual preferences. We exploit the experiment of German separation and reunification to establish exogeneity of the economic system. We find that, after German reunification, East Germans are more in favor of state intervention than West Germans. This effect is especially strong for older cohorts. We further find that East Germans' preferences converge toward those of West Germans. It will take one to two generations for preferences to converge completely. (JEL D12, D72, H11, H23, P26)

10.1257/aer.97.4.1507.abstractZh: 人们对再分配的态度以及福利国家的慷慨程度在不同国家之间存在显著差异。本文探讨了经济体制是否会对个人偏好产生反馈效应。我们通过德国分裂与统一时期的实验来验证经济体制的外生性。研究发现，德国统一后，东德人比西德人更支持国家干预。这一效应在年龄较大的群体中尤为明显。此外，我们发现东德人的偏好逐渐趋同于西德人的偏好。完全趋同需要一到两代人的时间。（JEL D12, D72, H11, H23, P26）

abstract.text: We use scanner data and time diaries to document how households substitute time for money through shopping and home production. We document substantial heterogeneity in prices paid for identical goods for the same area and time, with older households shopping the most and paying the lowest prices. Doubling shopping frequency lowers a good's price by 7 to 10 percent. We estimate the shopper's price of time and use this series to estimate an elasticity of substitution between time and goods in home production of roughly 1.8. The observed lifecycle time allocation implies a consumption series that differs markedly from expenditures. (JEL D12, D91)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1533.abstractZh: 我们使用扫描数据和时间日记记录家庭如何通过购物和家庭生产来替代货币。我们发现，在同一地区和同一时间下，相同商品的价格存在显著的差异，年龄较大的家庭购物频率最高，支付的价格也最低。购物频率翻倍会使商品价格下降7%到10%。我们估算了消费者的时间成本，并利用这一数据估计家庭生产中时间与商品之间的替代弹性约为1.8。观察到的生命周期时间分配表明，消费序列与支出序列存在显著差异。（JEL D12, D91）

abstract.text: In developing countries lacking legal enforcement, villagers may use implicit contracts to minimize crime. I construct a dynamic limited-commitment model, in which a thief cannot commit to forego stealing, but is induced to steal less by the promise of future gifts. Combining survey data on production, theft, gifts, and trust with experiments measuring trustworthiness, I provide supporting evidence. Farmers living near more relatives or with plots that are difficult to steal from give fewer gifts and trust more, and those living near more relatives also experience less theft. Giving increases when trust is lower and the threat of theft is greater. (JEL D86, K42, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1560.abstractZh: 在缺乏法律强制力的发展中国家，村民可能会利用隐性契约来减少犯罪。我构建了一个动态有限承诺模型，在该模型中，小偷无法承诺放弃偷窃行为，但未来获得的礼物会促使他们减少偷窃行为。通过结合关于生产、偷窃、礼物和信任的调查数据，以及衡量信任度的实验，我提供了支持性证据。居住在亲属较多或土地难以被偷窃的农民，会给予更多的礼物并表现出更高的信任度，而居住在亲属较多的农民也遭遇的偷窃行为较少。当信任度较低且偷窃的威胁较大时，给予行为会增加。（JEL D86, K42, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: Little is known about the effects of placing children who are abused or neglected into foster care. This paper uses the placement tendency of child protection investigators as an instrumental variable to identify causal effects of foster care on long-term outcomes--including juvenile delinquency, teen motherhood, and employment--among children in Illinois where a rotational assignment process effectively randomizes families to investigators. Large marginal treatment effect estimates suggest caution in the interpretation, but the results suggest that children on the margin of placement tend to have better outcomes when they remain at home, especially older children.

10.1257/aer.97.5.1583.abstractZh: 关于将受虐待或忽视的儿童安置到寄养家庭的影响，目前所知甚少。本文以儿童保护调查人员的安置倾向作为工具变量，来识别寄养对伊利诺伊州儿童长期结果的影响——包括青少年犯罪、青少年母亲身份以及就业状况。通过旋转分配机制，家庭被有效随机分配给不同的调查人员。尽管边际处理效应估计值较大，但在解释这些结果时需要谨慎。不过，研究结果表明，处于安置边缘的儿童，尤其是年龄较大的儿童，如果继续留在家中，往往会有更好的发展状况。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the productivity gains from reducing tariffs on final goods and from reducing tariffs on intermediate inputs. Lower output tariffs can increase productivity by inducing tougher import competition, whereas cheaper imported inputs can raise productivity via learning, variety, and quality effects. We use Indonesian manufacturing census data from 1991 to 2001, which include plant-level information on imported inputs. The results show that a 10 percentage point fall in input tariffs leads to a productivity gain of 12 percent for firms that import their inputs, at least twice as high as any gains from reducing output tariffs. (JEL F12, F13, L16, O14, O19, O24)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1611.abstractZh: 本文估计了降低最终商品关税以及降低中间投入关税所带来的生产率提升。较低的产出关税可以通过引发更激烈的进口竞争来提高生产率，而更便宜的进口投入则可以通过学习、多样性和质量效应来提高生产率。我们使用了1991年至2001年的印度尼西亚制造业普查数据，其中包含了关于进口投入的工厂级信息。研究结果表明，输入关税降低10个百分点，对于进口投入的企业来说，生产率提升幅度可达12%，这一提升幅度至少是降低产出关税所带来的收益的两倍。（JEL F12, F13, L16, O14, O19, O24）

abstract.text: This paper presents a theory of establishment size dynamics based on the accumulation of industry-specific human capital that simultaneously rationalizes the economy-wide facts on establishment growth rates, exit rates, and size distributions. The theory predicts that establishment growth and net exit rates should decline faster with size, and that the establishment size distribution should have thinner tails, in sectors that use specific human capital less intensively. We establish that there is substantial cross-sector heterogeneity in US establishment size dynamics and distributions, which is well explained by relative factor intensities. (JEL L11, L16, L25).

10.1257/aer.97.5.1639.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于行业特定人力资本积累的建立规模动态理论，该理论能够合理解释整个经济领域中关于建立机构增长率、退出率以及规模分布的现象。该理论预测，随着规模的增加，建立机构的增长率和净退出率应下降得更快，而在使用特定人力资本较为不密集的行业中，建立机构的规模分布应呈现更薄的尾部。我们证实，美国建立机构的规模动态和分布存在显著的跨行业异质性，这一现象可以通过相对要素强度来很好地解释。（JEL L11, L16, L25）

abstract.text: How do investors respond to predictable shifts in profitability? We consider how demographic shifts affect profits and returns across industries. Cohort size fluctuations produce forecastable demand changes for age-sensitive sectors, such as toys, bicycles, beer, life insurance, and nursing homes. These demand changes are predictable once a specific cohort is born. We use lagged consumption and demographic data to forecast future consumption demand growth induced by changes in age structure. We find that demand forecasts predict profitability by industry. Moreover, forecast demand changes five to ten years in the future predict annual industry stock returns. One additional percentage point of annualized demand growth due to demographics predicts a 5 to 10 percentage point increase in annual abnormal industry stock returns. However, forecasted demand changes over shorter horizons do not predict stock returns. A trading strategy exploiting demographic information earns an annualized risk-adjusted return of approximately 6 percent. We present a model of inattention to information about the distant future that is consistent with the findings. We also discuss alternative explanations, including omitted risk-based factors. (JEL E21, G12, G32, J11, L11, L25)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1667.abstractZh: 投资者如何应对可预测的盈利能力变化？我们探讨了人口结构变化如何影响各个行业的利润和收益。群体规模的波动会导致对特定年龄段行业的需求变化，如玩具、自行车、啤酒、人寿保险和养老院等行业。一旦某个特定群体出生，这些需求变化就是可以预测的。我们利用滞后消费和人口统计数据来预测因年龄结构变化引起的未来消费需求增长。我们发现，需求预测能够反映各个行业的盈利能力。此外，对未来五到十年需求变化的预测能够预测行业的年度股票回报。由于人口结构导致的年度需求增长每增加一个百分点，行业的年度异常股票回报就会增加5到10个百分点。然而，短期内的需求变化并不能预测股票回报。利用人口信息制定的交易策略能够带来约6%的年度风险调整后回报。我们提出了一个模型，说明对遥远未来的信息缺乏关注与我们的研究结果是一致的。我们还讨论了其他可能的解释，包括被忽略的风险因素。（JEL E21, G12, G32, J11, L11, L25）

abstract.text: We study the effects of antitrust policy in industries with continual innovation. Antitrust policies that restrict incumbent behavior toward new entrants may have conflicting effects on innovation incentives, raising the profits of new entrants, but lowering those of continuing incumbents. We show that the direction of the net effect can be determined by analyzing shifts in innovation benefit and supply, holding the innovation rate fixed. We apply this framework to analyze several specific antitrust policies. We also show that, in some cases, the tension does not arise, and policies that protect entrants necessarily raise the rate of innovation. (JEL K21, L13, L14, L40, O30)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1703.abstractZh: 我们研究了反垄断政策在持续创新行业中的影响。限制现有企业对新进入者的行为的反垄断政策可能会对创新激励产生相反的效果，既可能提高新进入者的利润，也可能降低持续存在的现有企业的利润。我们表明，通过分析创新收益和供应的变化，可以在创新率固定的情况下确定净效应的方向。我们将这一框架应用于分析几种具体的反垄断政策。我们还表明，在某些情况下，这种矛盾并不会出现，保护进入者的政策必然会提高创新率。（JEL K21, L13, L14, L40, O30）

abstract.text: “Hide-and-seek” games are zero-sum two-person games in which one player wins by matching the other's decision and the other wins by mismatching. Although such games are often played on cultural or geographic “landscapes” that frame decisions nonneutrally, equilibrium ignores such framing. This paper reconsiders the results of experiments by Rubinstein, Tversky, and others whose designs model nonneutral landscapes, in which subjects deviate systematically from equilibrium in response to them. Comparing alternative explanations theoretically and econometrically suggests that the deviations are well explained by a structural nonequilibrium model of initial responses based on “level-k” thinking, suitably adapted to nonneutral landscapes. (JEL C72, C92)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1731.abstractZh: “捉迷藏”游戏是一种零和二人游戏，其中一名玩家通过匹配另一名玩家的决策来获胜，而另一名玩家则通过不匹配来获胜。尽管这类游戏通常在具有非中性决策框架的文化或地理“景观”中进行，但均衡状态忽略了这种框架的影响。本文重新考虑了Rubinstein、Tversky等人实验的结果，他们的实验设计模拟了非中性景观，在这种景观中，受试者会系统性地偏离均衡状态。从理论和计量经济学的角度比较不同的解释表明，这些偏离可以通过基于“水平k”思维的结构性非均衡模型来很好地解释，该模型可以适当适应非中性景观。（JEL C72, C92）

abstract.text: Reputation effects and other-regarding preferences have both been used to predict cooperative outcomes in markets with inefficient equilibria. Existing reputationbuilding models require either infinite time horizons or publicly observed identities, but cooperative outcomes have been observed in several moral hazard experiments with finite horizons and anonymous interactions. This paper introduces a full reputation equilibrium (FRE) with stereotyping (perceived type correlation) in which cooperation is predicted in early periods of a finitely repeated market with anonymous interactions. New experiments generate results in line with the FRE prediction, including final-period reversions to stage-game equilibrium and noncooperative play under unfavorable payoff parameters. (JEL C72, C73, C78, J41)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1751.abstractZh: 声誉效应和其他相关偏好已被用于预测具有低效均衡的市场中的合作结果。现有的声誉构建模型需要无限的时间范围或公开可观察到的身份，但在一些有限时间范围和匿名互动的道德风险实验中，也观察到了合作结果。本文提出了一种完整的声誉均衡模型（FRE），该模型包含刻板印象（感知类型相关性），并预测在有限重复的市场和匿名互动的早期阶段会出现合作。新的实验结果与FRE预测一致，包括最终阶段恢复到阶段博弈均衡以及在不利收益参数下出现非合作行为的情况。（JEL C72, C73, C78, J41）

abstract.text: We conducted a natural field experiment to further our understanding of the economics of charity. Using direct mail solicitations to over 50,000 prior donors of a nonprofit organization, we tested the effectiveness of a matching grant on charitable giving. We find that the match offer increases both the revenue per solicitation and the response rate. Larger match ratios (i.e., $3:$1 and $2:$1) relative to a smaller match ratio ($1:$1) had no additional impact, however. The results provide avenues for future empirical and theoretical work on charitable giving, cost-benefit analysis, and the private provision of public goods. (JEL D64, L31)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1774.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项自然田野实验，以进一步了解慈善事业的经济学原理。通过直接邮寄方式向该非营利组织的前50,000名捐赠者发送邀请，我们测试了匹配捐赠对慈善捐赠行为的影响。研究发现，匹配捐赠不仅提高了每次邀请的收益，还提升了响应率。不过，较大的匹配比例（例如3:1和2:1）与较小的匹配比例（1:1）相比，并没有额外的效果。这些结果为未来关于慈善捐赠、成本效益分析以及公共物品私人供给的实证和理论研究提供了方向。（JEL D64, L31）

abstract.text: We show that it is impossible to achieve collusion in a duopoly when (a) goods are homogenous and firms compete in quantities; (b) new, noisy information arrives continuously, without sudden events; and (c) firms are able to respond to new information quickly. The result holds even if we allow for asymmetric equilibria or monetary transfers. The intuition is that the flexibility to respond quickly to new information unravels any collusive scheme. Our result applies to both a simple stationary model and a more complicated one, with prices following a mean-reverting Markov process, as well as to models of dynamic cooperation in many other settings. (JEL D43, L12, L13)
