10.1257/aer.97.5.1794.abstractZh: 我们证明，在以下情况下，双头垄断中无法实现勾结：(a) 商品是同质的，企业之间以数量竞争；(b) 新的、噪声信息不断出现，且没有突发事件；(c) 企业能够迅速响应新信息。即使考虑到非对称均衡或货币转移的情况，这一结论仍然成立。直觉上，能够迅速响应新信息的灵活性会破坏任何勾结计划。我们的结果适用于简单的静态模型以及更复杂的模型，其中价格遵循均值回归的马尔可夫过程，也适用于许多其他情境下的动态合作模型。(JEL D43, L12, L13)

abstract.text: A sequentially rationalizable choice function is a choice function that can be retrieved by applying sequentially to each choice problem the same fixed set of asymmetric binary relations (rationales) to remove inferior alternatives. These concepts translate into economic language some human choice heuristics studied in psychology and explain cyclical patterns of choice observed in experiments. We study some properties of sequential rationalizability and provide a full characterization of choice functions rationalizable by two and three rationales. (JEL D01).

10.1257/aer.97.5.1824.abstractZh: 一个可依次合理化的选择函数是指可以通过依次对每个选择问题应用相同的固定不对称二元关系（理性标准）来检索出的选择函数，从而排除劣等选项。这些概念可以翻译成经济学术语，反映了心理学中研究的一些人类选择启发式方法，并解释了实验中观察到的选择循环模式。我们研究了可依次合理化的选择函数的一些性质，并对可通过两个和三个理性标准来合理化的选择函数进行了全面的描述。（JEL D01）

abstract.text: This paper offers a simple approach to the theory of decentralizing inventory and pricing decisions along a supply chain. We consider an upstream manufacturer selling to two outlets, which compete as differentiated duopolists and face uncertain demand. Demand spillovers between the outlets arise in the event of stockouts. The price mechanism, in which each outlet pays a two-part price and chooses price and inventory, virtually never coordinates incentives efficiently. Contracts that can elicit first-best decisions include resale price floors or buy-back policies (retailer-held options to sell inventory back to the manufacturers). (JEL D21, L13, L14, M11)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1840.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种简化方法，用于研究供应链中库存和定价决策的分散化问题。我们以一个上游制造商为例，该制造商向两个销售点销售产品，这两个销售点作为差异化双寡头竞争，且面临不确定的需求。当某个销售点缺货时，两个销售点之间的需求会相互影响。在价格机制中，每个销售点都支付两部分费用，并自行决定价格和库存策略，这种机制实际上无法有效协调各方的激励。能够激发最优决策的合同包括转售价格限制或回购政策（零售商拥有将库存回购给制造商的选择权）。（JEL D21, L13, L14, M11）

abstract.text: We utilize graphical representations of Dictator Games which generate rich individual-level data. Our baseline experiment employs budget sets over feasible payoff-pairs. We test these data for consistency with utility maximization, and we recover the underlying preferences for giving (trade-offs between own payoffs and the payoffs of others). Two further experiments augment the analysis. An extensive elaboration employs three-person budget sets to distinguish preferences for giving from social preferences (trade-offs between the payoffs of others). And an intensive elaboration employs step-shaped sets to distinguish between behaviors that are compatible with well-behaved preferences and those compatible only with not well-behaved cases. (JEL C72, D64)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1858.abstractZh: 我们利用独裁游戏的图形化表示方法来生成丰富的个体层面数据。我们的基线实验采用预算集来研究可行的收益对。我们测试这些数据与效用最大化理论的一致性，并揭示了给予行为背后的偏好（即自身收益与他人收益之间的权衡）。另外两项实验进一步丰富了分析内容。一项广泛的实验使用三人预算集来区分给予行为的偏好与社会偏好（即与他人收益之间的权衡）。另一项深入的实验则使用阶梯状预算集来区分那些符合良好偏好行为的行为，以及那些仅适用于不良好偏好情况的行为。（JEL C72, D64）

abstract.text: The paper explores strategies that the sponsor of a proposal may employ to convince a qualified majority of members in a group to approve the proposal. Adopting a mechanism design approach to communication, it emphasizes the need to distill information selectively to key group members and to engineer persuasion cascades in which members who are brought on board sway the opinion of others. The paper shows that higher congruence among group members benefits the sponsor. The extent of congruence between the group and the sponsor, and the size and the governance of the group, are also shown to condition the sponsor's ability to get his project approved. (JEL D71, D72, D83)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1877.abstractZh: 本文探讨了提案的发起者可能采用的策略，以说服团体中足够多的成员批准该提案。采用机制设计方法来研究沟通方式，文章强调需要选择性地向关键成员传递信息，并设计一种说服机制，使新加入的成员能够影响其他成员的观点。研究表明，团体成员之间的一致性越高，对发起者越有利。团体与发起者之间的一致性程度，以及团体的规模和治理结构，也影响着发起者获得项目批准的能力。（JEL D71, D72, D83）

abstract.text: We elicit traders' predictions of future price trajectories in repeated experimental markets for a 15-period-lived asset. We find that individuals' beliefs about prices are adaptive, and primarily based on past trends in the current and previous markets in which they have participated. Most traders do not anticipate market downturns the first time they participate in a market, and, when experienced, they typically overestimate the time remaining before market peaks and downturns occur. When prices deviate from fundamental values, belief data are informative to an observer in predicting the direction of future price movements and the timing of market peaks. (JEL C91, D12, D84, G11)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1901.abstractZh: 我们在重复实验市场中，对一种持续15个周期的资产未来价格走势进行了交易者的预测分析。研究发现，个人对价格的认知具有适应性，并且主要基于他们参与过的当前市场及以往市场中的价格趋势。大多数交易者在进行首次市场参与时并不预期市场会出现下跌，而当经历这种情况时，他们通常会高估市场达到峰值和下跌前剩余的时间。当价格偏离基本价值时，交易者的认知数据能够为观察者预测未来价格走势的方向以及市场峰值的出现时间提供有用的信息。（JEL C91, D12, D84, G11）

abstract.text: By using graphical representations of simple portfolio choice problems, we generate a very rich dataset to study behavior under uncertainty at the level of the individual subject. We test the data for consistency with the maximization hypothesis, and we estimate preferences using a two-parameter utility function based on Faruk Gul (1991). This specification provides a good interpretation of the data at the individual level and can account for the highly heterogeneous behaviors observed in the laboratory. The parameter estimates jointly describe attitudes toward risk and allow us to characterize the distribution of risk preferences in the population. (JEL D11, D14, D81, G11)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1921.abstractZh: 通过运用简单的投资组合选择问题的图形表示，我们生成了一个非常丰富的数据集，用于研究个体在不确定性下的行为。我们对这些数据进行了一致性测试，并基于Faruk Gul（1991年）提出的双参数效用函数来估计偏好。这种模型能够很好地解释个体层面的数据，并能够解释在实验室中观察到的高度异质性行为。参数估计共同描述了人们对风险的态度，并使我们能够描述人群中风险偏好的分布。（JEL D11, D14, D81, G11）

abstract.text: We demonstrate that aggregate employment and consumption can increase without a corresponding movement in productivity in a model with heterogeneous agents where the only aggregate disturbance is a productivity shock. The interaction between incomplete capital markets and indivisible labor results in a low employment-productivity correlation and creates a time-varying wedge between the marginal rate of substitution (for commodity consumption and hours) and productivity. Our results caution against viewing the measured wedge as an inefficiency due to a failure of labor-market clearing or as a fundamental driving force behind business cycles. (JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1939.abstractZh: 我们证明，在一个具有异质代理人的模型中，总就业和总消费的增加可以在不伴随生产率相应提升的情况下实现，其中唯一的整体扰动是生产率冲击。不完全资本市场与不可分割的劳动力之间的相互作用导致就业与生产率之间的相关性较低，并形成了边际替代率（对于商品消费和工作时间）与生产率之间的时变差异。我们的研究结果提醒人们不要将这种差异视为由于劳动力市场清算失败而导致的低效率，也不应将其视为商业周期的基本驱动力。（JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Following the recently dismissed antitrust lawsuit against the National Residency Matching Program (NRMP), Jeremy Bulow and Jonathan Levin (2006) propose a simple matching model in which firms set impersonal salaries simultaneously before matching with workers, which leads to lower aggregate wages than any competitive outcome. I model a feature of the NRMP, ordered contracts, that allows firms to set several contracts while determining the order in which they try to fill them, which has different properties than standard models with multiple contracts. Furthermore, the low wages of Bulow and Levin are no longer an equilibrium, but competitive wages are. (JEL D86, J31, J41)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1957.abstractZh: 在最近被驳回的反垄断诉讼之后，Jeremy Bulow和Jonathan Levin（2006年）提出了一个简单的匹配模型。该模型认为，企业在与工人匹配之前会同时设定非个人化的薪资标准，这会导致总体工资水平低于竞争环境下的水平。我对该模型中的一项特性进行了建模：有序合同机制，即企业可以在确定合同顺序的同时设定多个合同，这一特性与具有多个合同的标准模型有所不同。此外，Bulow和Levin提出的低工资水平已不再是一个均衡状态，而是竞争性的工资水平。（JEL D86, J31, J41）

abstract.text: We study alternate approaches to implement congestion pricing at US airports. Conventional formulations toll all aircraft without determining whether a plane operated by a given airline delays other planes that it operates or planes operated by other airlines. Recent work points out optimal pricing calls for carriers to be charged only for the delay they impose on other airlines. We find a small difference between the net benefits generated by the two congestion-pricing policies because the bulk of airport delays are not internalized and because the efficiency loss from pricing internalized congestion is small. (JEL L11, L93, R41)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1970.abstractZh: 我们研究了在美国机场实施拥堵收费的替代方法。传统的定价方式会对所有飞机进行收费，而不考虑某家航空公司运营的飞机是否会延误其他该航空公司运营的飞机，或是其他航空公司运营的飞机。最近的研究指出，最优的定价方式应该是只对航空公司对其他航空公司造成的延误进行收费。我们发现，两种拥堵收费政策所产生的净收益存在微小差异，这是因为大部分机场的延误并未被内部化，而且由于将拥堵内部化所带来的效率损失很小。（JEL L11, L93, R41）

abstract.text: This paper studies the relationship between civil war and the value of firms in a poor, resource-abundant country using microeconomic data for Angola. We focus on diamond mining firms and conduct an event study on the sudden end of the conflict, marked by the death of the rebel movement leader in 2002. We find that the stock market perceived this event as “bad news” rather than “good news” for companies holding concessions in Angola, as their abnormal returns declined by 4 percentage points. The event had no effect on a control portfolio of otherwise similar diamond mining companies. This finding is corroborated by other events and by the adoption of alternative methodologies. We interpret our findings in light of conflict-generated entry barriers, government bargaining power, and transparency in the licensing process. (JEL D74, G32, O13, O17, Q34)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1978.abstractZh: 本文利用安哥拉的微观经济数据，研究内战与资源丰富的贫困国家企业价值之间的关系。我们重点关注钻石开采企业，并对2002年叛军领袖死亡这一冲突突然结束的事件进行了事件研究。研究发现，对于在安哥拉持有特许权的企业而言，股市将这一事件视为“坏消息”，而非“好消息”，导致其异常回报下降了4个百分点。这一事件对其他类似钻石开采企业的对照投资组合没有产生影响。这一发现得到了其他事件的验证，并得到了替代方法的支持。我们根据冲突引发的进入壁垒、政府谈判能力以及许可流程的透明度来解释我们的研究结果。（JEL D74, G32, O13, O17, Q34）

abstract.text: It is well known that when agents are fully rational, compulsory public insurance may make all agents better off in the Rothschild and Stiglitz (1976) model of insurance markets. We find that when sufficiently many agents underestimate their personal risks, compulsory insurance makes low-risk agents worse off. Hence, behavioral biases may weaken some of the well-established rationales for government intervention based on asymmetric information. (JEL D82, G22)

10.1257/aer.97.5.1994.abstractZh: 众所周知，当代理人完全理性时，强制性的公共保险可能会使所有代理人的状况得到改善，正如Rothschild和Stiglitz在1976年的保险市场模型中所述。我们发现，当足够多的代理人低估自己的风险时，强制性保险会使低风险代理人的状况恶化。因此，行为偏差可能会削弱基于信息不对称而提出的政府干预的一些合理依据。（JEL D82, G22）

abstract.text: Economic Review 2004.I used a bilateral "gravity" model of trade and showed that dummy variables for membership by either one or two countries in the GATT had only small effects on trade.In essence, TGR point out that a lot of countries were not formal members of the GATT but still participated in it as colonies, de facto, or provisional members.TGR argue that if one includes these other types of more informal membership, you get large positive effects.

10.1257/aer.97.5.2019.abstractZh: 《经济评论》2004年。我使用了一个双边“引力”贸易模型，并发现仅包含一个或两个国家属于GATT的虚拟变量对贸易的影响很小。实际上，TGR指出，许多国家并非GATT的正式成员，而是以殖民地、事实上的成员或临时成员的身份参与其中的。TGR认为，如果包含这些更为非正式的成员类型，将会产生较大的正面影响。

abstract.text: School choice policies promise to align the incentives of school administrators with the demands of parents, and may therefore lead to more efficient educational production (Milton Friedman 1962; Geoffrey Brennan and James Buchanan 1980; John Chubb and Terry M. Moe 1990). Absent a large-scale school voucher program in the United States, however, this prediction has been difficult to test. Several authors (e.g., Melvin V. Borland and Roy M. Howsen 1992; Clive R. Belfield and Henry M. Levin 2002) have suggested studying the effects of choice, the use of the residential location decision to select among local monopoly education providers. The idea here is that fragmented governance induces competition among school districts analogous to that which would occur among schools with nonresidential choice. In an influential paper, Caroline M. Hoxby (2000) points out that current governance structures are potentially endogenous to school productivity, and proposes that variation in topography, which may have influenced optimal jurisdiction size before modern transportation technologies, provides a source of exogenous variation. She estimates instrumental variables regressions of individual test scores and school spending on a metropolitan-level Tiebout choice index, defined as one minus a Herfindahl concentration index with districts' enrollments as their market shares, using as excluded instruments the number of larger and smaller streams in the area. She reports substantial positive effects of district fragmentation on student test scores and negative effects on spending. This Comment presents a reanalysis of Hoxby's test score results, which form the core of her empirical analysis. These results turn out to be quite sensitive to plausible alterations to Hoxby's specification. In particular, the large, significant effect of choice on achievement obtains

10.1257/aer.97.5.2026.abstractZh: 学校选择政策有望使学校管理者的激励与家长的需求相一致，因此可能会带来更高效的教育产出（Milton Friedman 1962；Geoffrey Brennan和James Buchanan 1980；John Chubb和Terry M. Moe 1990）。然而，在美国没有大规模的学校代金券计划的情况下，这一预测难以验证。一些学者（例如Melvin V. Borland和Roy M. Howsen 1992；Clive R. Belfield和Henry M. Levin 2002）建议研究选择效应，即利用居住地点选择来挑选当地垄断教育提供者所带来的影响。这里的想法是，分散的治理结构会引发学区之间的竞争，类似于有非居住地点选择情况下的学校之间的竞争。在一篇有影响力的论文中，Caroline M. Hoxby（2000）指出，当前的治理结构可能受到学校生产力的影响，并提出地形差异可能是影响最佳管辖范围大小的因素，这为外生变量提供了来源。她通过回归分析，将个人考试成绩和学校支出与都市级Tiebout选择指数联系起来，该指数定义为1减去赫芬达尔集中度指数，其中学区的入学人数作为市场份额，并使用该地区较大和较小的溪流数量作为排除变量。她报告称，学区分散对学生考试成绩有显著的正面影响，而对学校支出则有负面影响。这篇评论重新分析了Hoxby的考试成绩结果，这些结果构成了她的实证分析的核心。这些结果对Hoxby的模型参数进行合理调整时表现出相当大的敏感性。特别是，选择对成绩的巨大且显著的影响是显而易见的。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVES: To compare the distances travelled for inpatient treatment in England between electoral wards prior to the introduction of a policy to extend patient choice and to consider the impact of patients' socio-economic status. METHODS: Using Hospital Episode Statistics for 2003-04, the distance from a patient's residence to a National Health Service hospital was calculated for each admission. Distances were summed to electoral ward level to give the distribution of distances travelled at ward level. These were analysed to show the distance travelled for different admission types, ages of patient, rural/urban location, and the socioeconomic deprivation of the population of the ward. RESULTS: There is considerable variation in the distances travelled for hospital admission between electoral wards. Some of this is explained by geographical location: individuals living in more rural areas travel further for elective (median 27.2 versus 15.0 km), emergency (25.3 versus 13.9 km) and maternity (25.0 versus 13.9 km) admissions. But individuals located in highly deprived wards travel less far, and this shorter distance is not explained simply by the closer location of hospitals to these wards. CONCLUSIONS: Before the introduction of more patient choice, there were considerable differences between individuals in the distances they travelled for hospital care. An increase in patient choice may disproportionately benefit people from less deprived areas.

10.1258/135581907781543049.abstractZh:
研究目的：比较英格兰在引入患者选择政策之前，不同选区居民在住院治疗期间所行驶的距离，并探讨患者社会经济地位对其的影响。  
研究方法：利用2003-04年的医院病例统计数据，计算每位患者从居住地到国家卫生服务医院的距离。将各选区的距离总和，得出各选区在病房层面的距离分布。通过分析这些数据，了解不同入院类型、患者年龄、城乡位置以及选区居民的社会经济状况对距离的影响。  
研究结果：不同选区居民在住院治疗期间的行驶距离存在显著差异。部分差异与地理位置有关：居住在更偏远地区的居民，在择期手术（中位数27.2公里 vs 15.0公里）、急诊（25.3公里 vs 13.9公里）和产科手术（25.0公里 vs 13.9公里）中的行驶距离更长。而位于社会经济条件较差的选区居民，行驶距离较短，这种差异并非仅仅由于医院距离这些选区的更近。  
结论：在引入更多患者选择政策之前，不同居民在住院治疗期间的行驶距离存在较大差异。患者选择的增加可能会不成比例地惠及社会经济条件较差的地区的人们。

abstract.text: The Hospital Quality Alliance (HQA) program gives us the opportunity to systematically monitor the quality of hospital care nationwide. To gauge the importance of the HQA indicators, we examined the relationship between hospitals' performance on HQA quality indicators and mortality for Medicare enrollees admitted for acute myocardial infarction, congestive heart failure, and pneumonia. We found that higher condition-specific performance on this national quality reporting program is associated with lower risk-adjusted mortality for each of the three conditions. The relationship between high HQA performance and lower risk-adjusted mortality is an important validation for this national hospital quality rating program.

10.1377/hlthaff.26.4.1104.abstractZh: 医院质量联盟（HQA）项目为我们提供了系统地监测全国医院护理质量的机会。为了评估HQA指标的重要性，我们研究了医院在HQA质量指标方面的表现与接受治疗的医疗保险参保患者因急性心肌梗死、充血性心力衰竭和肺炎而发生的死亡率之间的关系。我们发现，在这一全国质量报告项目中，针对特定疾病的表现越高，这三种疾病的危险调整死亡率就越低。高HQA表现与较低的危险调整死亡率之间的关系，是对这一全国医院质量评级项目的重要验证。

abstract.text: During the last two decades, the treatment of infertility has improved dramatically. These treatments, however, are expensive and rarely covered by insurance, leading many states to adopt regulations mandating that health insurers cover them. In this paper, we explore the effects of benefit mandates on the utilization and outcomes of infertility treatments. We find that use of infertility treatments is significantly greater in states adopting comprehensive versions of these mandates. While greater utilization had little impact on the number of deliveries, mandated coverage was associated with a relatively large increase in the probability of a multiple birth. For relatively low fertility patients who responded to the expanded insurance coverage, treatment was often unsuccessful and did not result in a live birth. For relatively high fertility patients, in contrast, treatment often led to a multiple, rather than a singleton, birth. We also find evidence that the beneficial effects on the intensive treatment margin that have been proposed in other studies are relatively small. We conclude that, while benefit mandates potentially solve a problem of adverse selection in this market, these benefits must be weighed against the costs of the significant moral hazard in utilization they induce.

10.3386/w12820.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，不孕症治疗取得了显著的进步。然而，这些治疗费用高昂，且很少被保险覆盖，因此许多州制定了规定，要求健康保险公司为其提供保险。在本文中，我们探讨了福利强制规定对不孕症治疗使用率和治疗效果的影响。我们发现，在采用全面强制规定的州，不孕症治疗的利用率明显更高。虽然较高的利用率对分娩数量的影响不大，但强制保险覆盖与多胎妊娠的概率显著增加有关。对于对扩大保险覆盖有反应的低生育率患者来说，治疗往往未能成功，且无法实现活产。相反，对于高生育率患者，治疗往往会导致多胎妊娠，而非单胎妊娠。我们还发现，其他研究提出的对强化治疗效果的有益影响相对较小。我们得出结论，虽然福利强制规定可能解决了该市场中的逆向选择问题，但这些好处必须与它们引发的显著道德风险成本进行权衡。

abstract.text: This paper investigates to what extent and through which channels that health and educational attainment are interdependent. A dynamic model of schooling, work, health expenditure, and savings is developed. The structural framework explicitly models two existing hypotheses on the correlation between health and education. The estimation results strongly support the interdependence between health and education. In particular, the estimated model indicates that an individual's education, health expenditure, and previous health status all affect his health status. Moreover, the individual's health status affects his mortality rate, wage, home production, and academic success. On average, having been sick before age 21 decreases the individual's education by 1.4 years. Policy experiments indicate that a health expenditure subsidy would have a larger impact on educational attainment than a tuition subsidy.

10.3386/w12830.abstractZh: 本文探讨了健康与教育成就在多大程度上以及通过哪些渠道相互依赖。文中构建了一个关于教育、工作、健康支出和储蓄的动态模型。该模型明确模拟了关于健康与教育之间关系的两个现有假设。估计结果强烈支持健康与教育之间的相互依赖性。具体而言，模型表明个人的教育水平、健康支出以及以往的健康状况都会影响其健康状况。此外，个人的健康状况还会影响其死亡率、工资、家庭收入和学业成就。平均而言，在21岁之前患病会使个人的教育水平降低1.4年。政策实验表明，与健康支出补贴相比，学费补贴对教育成就的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Building on an idea in Abadie and Gardeazabal (2003), this article investigates the application of synthetic control methods to comparative case studies. We discuss the advantages of these methods and apply them to study the effects of Proposition 99, a large-scale tobacco control program that California implemented in 1988. We demonstrate that following Proposition 99 tobacco consumption fell markedly in California relative to a comparable synthetic control region. We estimate that by the year 2000 annual per-capita cigarette sales in California were about 26 packs lower than what they would have been in the absence of Proposition 99. Given that many policy interventions and events of interest in social sciences take place at an aggregate level (countries, regions, cities, etc.) and affect a small number of aggregate units, the potential applicability of synthetic control methods to comparative case studies is very large, especially in situations where traditional regression methods are not appropriate. The methods proposed in this article produce informative inference regardless of the number of available comparison units, the number of available time periods, and whether the data are individual (micro) or aggregate (macro). Software to compute the estimators proposed in this article is available at the authors' web-pages.

10.3386/w12831.abstractZh: 本文基于Abadie和Gardeazabal（2003）的构想，探讨了合成控制方法在比较案例研究中的应用。我们讨论了这些方法的优势，并将其应用于研究1988年加州实施的《第99号提案》对烟草消费的影响。研究表明，在《第99号提案》实施之后，加州烟草消费量显著下降，与对照组相比有显著减少。据估计，到2000年时，加州人均香烟销量比没有实施《第99号提案》的情况减少了约26包。鉴于许多社会科学的政策干预和社会事件都是发生在总体层面（如国家、地区、城市等），并且只影响少数总体单位，合成控制方法在比较案例研究中的潜在应用非常广泛，尤其是在传统回归方法不适用的情况下。本文提出的方法无论比较单位的数量、时间周期的数量以及数据是个体还是总体，都能产生有信息量的推断结果。本文提出的估计器软件可在作者的网页上获取。

abstract.text: This paper accounts for the value of children and future generations in the evaluation of health policies. This is achieved through the incorporation of altruism and fertility in "value of life" type of framework. We are able to express adults' willingness to pay for changes in child mortality and also to incorporate the welfare of future generations in the evaluation of current policies. Our model clarifies a series of puzzles from the literature on the "value of life" and on intergenerational welfare comparisons. We show that, by incorporating altruism and fertility into the analysis, the estimated welfare gain from recent reductions in mortality in the U.S. easily doubles.

10.3386/w12836.abstractZh: 本文阐述了在评估健康政策时，儿童和未来世代的价值。这一目标的实现是通过将利他主义和生育能力纳入“生命价值”类型的框架中来实现的。我们能够表达成年人对于降低儿童死亡率的支付意愿，并且能够将未来世代的福利纳入对当前政策的评估中。我们的模型解决了一系列关于“生命价值”和代际福利比较的文献中的难题。我们表明，通过将利他主义和生育能力纳入分析，美国近期降低死亡率所带来的福利增益可以轻松翻倍。

abstract.text: This paper presents and critically discusses a vast array of evidence on the determinants of mortality reductions in developing countries. We argue that increases in life expectancy between 1960 and 2000 were largely independent from improvements in income and nutrition. We then characterize the age and cause of death profile of changes in mortality and ask what can be learned about the determinants of these changes from the international evidence and from country-specific studies. Public health infrastructure, immunization, targeted programs, and the spread of less palpable forms of knowledge all seem to have been important factors. Much of the recent debate has revolved around antagonistic approaches, which are not supported by the evidence discussed here. Finally, the paper suggests that the evolution of health inequality across and within countries is intrinsically related to the process of diffusion of new technologies and to the nature of these new technologies (public or private).

10.3386/w12837.abstractZh: 本文对关于发展中国家死亡率降低因素的大量证据进行了呈现和批判性讨论。我们认为，1960年至2000年间预期寿命的增加在很大程度上与收入和营养的改善无关。随后，我们描述了死亡率变化的年龄和死亡原因，并探讨了从国际数据和具体国家的研究中能够了解到哪些关于这些变化的决定因素。公共卫生基础设施、免疫接种、有针对性的项目以及知识传播的普及似乎都是重要因素。最近的许多讨论都围绕对立的方法展开，但这些方法并未得到本文所讨论的证据的支持。最后，本文指出，国家之间及国家内部健康不平等的演变与新技术传播的进程以及这些新技术的性质（公共或私人）密切相关。

abstract.text: This paper presents a theory where increases in female labor force participation and reductions in the gender wage-gap are generated as part of a single process of demographic transition, characterized by reductions in mortality and fertility. The paper suggests a link between changes in mortality and transformations in the role of women in society that has not been identified before in the literature. Mortality reductions affect the incentives of individuals to invest in human capital and to have children. Particularly, gains in adult longevity reduce fertility, increase investments in market human capital, increase female labor force participation, and reduce the wage differential between men and women. Child mortality reductions, though reducing fertility, do not generate this same pattern of changes. The model reconciles the increase in female labor market participation with the timing of age-specific mortality reductions observed during the demographic transition. It generates changes in fertility, labor market attachment, and the gender wage-gap as part of a single process of social transformation, triggered by reductions in mortality.

10.3386/w12838.abstractZh: 本文提出一种理论，认为女性劳动力参与率的提高和性别工资差距的缩小是人口转型过程中的单一现象，而人口转型的特点就是死亡率和生育率的下降。该理论揭示了死亡率变化与女性在社会中角色转变之间存在的联系，这一联系在现有文献中尚未被充分探讨。死亡率的下降会影响个人对人力资本投资和生育行为的激励。具体而言，成年人寿命的延长会减少生育率，增加市场人力资本的投资，提高女性劳动力参与率，并缩小男女之间的工资差距。虽然儿童死亡率的下降也会减少生育率，但不会产生同样的效应。该模型将女性劳动力市场的参与率增加与人口转型过程中特定年龄段的死亡率下降的时间安排联系起来。它认为，生育率、劳动力市场参与度以及性别工资差距的变化都是人口转型过程中的单一现象，而这些变化是由死亡率的下降所引发的。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of skill formation that explains a variety of findings established in the child development and child intervention literatures. At its core is a technology that is stage-specific and that features self productivity, dynamic complementarity and skill multipliers. Lessons are drawn for the design of new policies to alleviate the consequences of the accident of birth that is a major source of human inequality.

10.3386/w12840.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个技能形成模型，该模型能够解释儿童发展及儿童干预领域中的多种研究结果。该模型的核心是一种具有阶段特定性的技术，具备自我生产力、动态互补性和技能倍增效应等特点。本文为制定新政策以缓解因出生机会不平等所导致的人类不平等问题提供了启示。

abstract.text: The Medicare Modernization Act was recently established, to provide limited drug coverage to the elderly. However, there is limited evidence on how drug coverage might affect health. The goal of this paper is to obtain "causal effects" of prescription drug coverage on drug use, use of other medical services and health of the elderly. We use fixed-effects analysis to control for unmeasured person-specific effects that may confound the relationships of interest. Results show prescription drug coverage, particularly public coverage, significantly increased the utilization of prescription drugs, but had no discernable effect on hospital admissions or health.

10.3386/w12848.abstractZh: 《医疗保险现代化法案》最近被制定出来，旨在为老年人提供有限的药品覆盖。然而，关于药品覆盖如何影响健康的证据非常有限。本文的目的是探讨处方药覆盖对老年人用药、其他医疗服务使用以及健康状况的“因果效应”。我们采用固定效应分析方法来控制可能干扰研究关系的个体特定因素。结果显示，特别是公共提供的药品覆盖显著增加了处方药的使用，但对住院率或健康状况没有明显影响。

abstract.text: I use changes in immigrant eligibility for food stamps under the 1996 federal law and heterogeneous state responses to set up a natural experiment research design to study the effect of food stamps on Body Mass Index (BMI) of adults in immigrant families. I find that in the post-1996 period food stamps use by foreign-born unmarried mothers with a high school or lower education was 10 percentage points higher in states with substitute programs than in states that implemented the federal ban. However, this increase in FSP participation was not associated with any statistically significant difference in BMI. I find that FSP participation was associated a statistically insignificant 0.3 percent increase in BMI among low-educated unmarried mothers.

10.3386/w12849.abstractZh: 我利用1996年联邦法律中关于移民资格变更对食品券发放的影响，以及各州对政策的不同反应，构建了一个自然实验研究设计，来探讨食品券对移民家庭成年人体重指数（BMI）的影响。研究发现，在1996年之后，拥有高中或更低学历的外国出生未婚母亲在实行替代性计划的州，使用食品券的比例比实施联邦禁令的州高出10个百分点。然而，这种食品券使用率的上升并未与体重指数的任何统计学意义上的差异相关。此外，我还发现，在受教育程度较低的未婚母亲中，食品券的使用率与体重指数增加了0.3个百分点，但这种关联并不显著。

abstract.text: This research note combines two national Taiwanese datasets to investigate the relationship between low birth weight (LBW) babies, their family background and their future academic outcomes. We find that LBW is negatively correlated with the probability of such children attending university at the age of 18; however, when both parents are college or senior high school graduates, such negative effects may be partially offset. We also show that discrimination against daughters does occur, but only in those cases where the daughters were LBW babies. Moreover, high parental education (HPE) can only buffer the LBW shock among moderately-LBW children (as compared to very-LBW children) and full term-LBW children (as compared to preterm-LBW children).

10.3386/w12857.abstractZh: 本研究结合了两个台湾全国性的数据集，探讨低出生体重婴儿、其家庭背景与未来学业成绩之间的关系。我们发现，低出生体重与这些儿童在18岁时上大学的概率呈负相关；然而，当父母双方都拥有大学或高中学历时，这种负面影响可能会部分被抵消。我们还发现，确实存在对女儿的歧视现象，但仅限于那些低出生体重的女孩。此外，高父母教育水平只能缓解中度低出生体重儿童（与极低出生体重儿童相比）和足月低出生体重儿童（与早产低出生体重儿童相比）的负面影响。

abstract.text: The continued interest in public insurance expansions as a means of covering the uninsured highlights the importance of estimates of "crowd-out", or the extent to which such expansions reduce private insurance coverage. Ten years ago, Cutler and Gruber (1996) suggested that such crowd-out might be quite large, but much subsequent research has questioned this conclusion. We revisit this issue by using improved data and incorporating the research approaches that have led to varying estimates. We focus in particular on the public insurance expansions of the 1996-2002 period. Our results clearly show that crowd-out is significant; the central tendency in our results is a crowd-out rate of about 60%. This finding emerges most strongly when we consider family-level measures of public insurance eligibility. We also find that recent anti-crowd-out provisions in public expansions may have had the opposite effect, lowering take-up by the uninsured faster than they lower crowd-out of private insurance.

10.3386/w12858.abstractZh: 对于公共保险扩展作为覆盖未投保人群的手段的持续关注，凸显了“挤出效应”估计的重要性，即这种扩展在多大程度上减少了私人保险的覆盖范围。十年前，Cutler和Gruber（1996）认为这种挤出效应可能相当大，但后续许多研究对这一结论提出了质疑。我们通过使用改进的数据并结合各种研究方法来重新审视这个问题。我们特别关注1996至2002年期间公共保险扩展的情况。我们的结果清楚地表明，挤出效应是显著的；我们的结果显示，挤出率约为60%。当我们考虑家庭层面的公共保险资格衡量指标时，这一发现尤为明显。我们还发现，最近在公共保险扩展中采取的防止挤出的措施可能产生了相反的效果，即未投保人群的使用率下降速度比减少私人保险的挤出效应更快。

abstract.text: Governments are known for procrastinating when it comes to resolving painful policy problems. Whatever the political motives for waiting to decide, procrastination distorts economic decisions relative to what would arise with early policy resolution. In so doing, it engenders excess burden. This paper posits, calibrates, and simulates a life cycle model with earnings, lifespan, investment return, and future policy uncertainty. It then measures the excess burden from delayed resolution of policy uncertainty. The first uncertain policy we consider concerns the level of future Social Security benefits. Specifically, we examine how an agent would respond to learning in advance whether she will experience a major Social Security benefit cut starting at age 65. We show that having to wait to learn materially affects consumption, saving, and portfolio decisions. It also reduces welfare. Indeed, we show that the excess burden of government indecision can, in this instance, range as high as 0.6 percent of the agent's economic resources. This is a significant distortion in of itself. It's also significant when compared to other distortions measured in the literature. The second uncertain policy we consider concerns marginal tax rates. We obtain similar results once we adjust for the impact of tax rates on income.

10.3386/w12859.abstractZh: 政府在解决棘手政策问题时常常表现出拖延的倾向。无论出于何种政治动机而推迟决策，拖延都会使经济决策偏离通过早期政策解决方案所能达到的最佳状态，从而带来额外的负担。本文构建了一个包含收入、寿命、投资回报和未来政策不确定性等变量的生命周期模型，并对其进行校准与模拟。随后，我们测量了政策不确定性延迟解决所带来的额外负担。我们首先考虑的第一个不确定政策涉及未来社会保障福利的水平。具体来说，我们研究了当个体提前得知自己从65岁开始将面临大幅削减社会保障福利时，其消费、储蓄和投资组合决策会受到怎样的影响。结果显示，等待决策的过程会对这些决策产生实质性影响，同时也会降低整体福利水平。事实上，我们指出，政府决策不果断所带来的额外负担可能高达个体经济资源的0.6%。这一影响本身就已经相当显著，与其他文献中测量的其他扭曲相比，其重要性更为突出。我们接下来考虑的第二个不确定政策涉及边际税率。在调整了税率对收入的影响后，我们获得了类似的结果。

abstract.text: The effect of new health information on individuals' expectations about their longevity is examined using a Bayesian learning model. Using two-period panel-structured survey data from Taiwan, we find that subjective probabilities of living to age 75 and 85 are significantly smaller for respondents with more abnormal medical test outcomes and for those receiving more extensive advice on health behavior from their physicians. The subjective probability of survival declines with health shocks such as developing heart disease. Using pooled cross-sectional data, we find that males and married persons are more optimistic about their longevity expectations than females and single persons, and that income is strongly correlated with the subjective probability of living to age 75. Consistent with previous studies, the longevity of the same-sex parent is strongly associated with an individual's own expectation of living to age 75.

10.3386/w12864.abstractZh: 本研究使用贝叶斯学习模型，探讨了新的健康信息对个体寿命预期的影响。通过对台湾的两期面板结构调查数据进行分析，我们发现，那些医疗检查结果异常较多以及从医生那里获得更多健康行为建议的受访者，其期望活到75岁和85岁的主观概率明显较低。随着健康问题的出现，如心脏病的发生，个体存活的主观概率会下降。利用合并的横向数据，我们发现男性、已婚人士比女性、单身人士更乐观地看待自己的寿命预期，同时收入与活到75岁的主观概率存在强烈相关性。与以往研究一致，同性父母的生活寿命与个体自己期望活到75岁的寿命预期之间存在密切关联。

abstract.text: This paper offers a thesis as to why the US overtook the UK and other European countries in the 20th century in both aggregate and per-capita GDP, as a case study of recent models of endogenous growth where human capital is the "engine of growth". The conjecture is that the ascendancy of the US as an economic superpower owes in large measure to its relatively faster human capital formation. Whether the thesis has legs to stand on is assessed through stylized facts indicating that the US led other OECD countries in schooling attainments per adult population over the 20 century, especially at the secondary and tertiary levels. While human capital is viewed as the direct facilitator of growth, the underlying factors driving the US ascendancy are linked to the superior returns the political-economic system in the US has so far offered individual human capital attainments, both home-produced and imported.

10.3386/w12868.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种论点，解释为何美国在20世纪在总体GDP和人均GDP方面超越了英国及其他欧洲国家。这一论点以内生增长模型为案例研究，其中人力资本被视为“增长的引擎”。作者推测，美国作为经济超级大国的崛起在很大程度上归功于其相对较快的人力资本形成速度。本文通过一些典型事实来评估这一论点的合理性，这些事实表明，在20世纪期间，美国在人均教育水平方面领先于其他经合组织国家，尤其是在中等教育和高等教育领域。虽然人力资本被视为增长的直接推动因素，但推动美国崛起的根本因素则与美国政治-经济体系为个人人力资本发展所提供的更高回报有关，无论是国内培养还是引进的人才。

abstract.text: There is growing concern about a decline in the total fertility rate worldwide, but nowhere is the concern greater than in OECD countries, some of which already face the prospect of population decline as well. While the trend is largely the result of structural economic and social changes, our paper indicates that it is partly influenced by the scale of the defined-benefits, pay-as-you-go (PAYG) social security systems operating in most countries. Through a dynamic, overlapping-generations model where the generations are linked by parental altruism, we show analytically that social security tax and benefit rates generate incentives for individuals to reduce not just the fertility rate within families, but also the incentive to form families, which we capture empirically by the fraction of adults married. We conduct calibrated simulations as well as regression analyses that measure the quantitative importance of social security tax rates in lowering both net marriage and total fertility rates. Our results show that the impact of social security on these variables has been non-trivial. Our calibrated simulations also enable us to study the effects of changes in the structure of social security on family formation and fertility.

10.3386/w12869.abstractZh: 全球范围内，总生育率下降的担忧日益加剧，但在经合组织国家，这种担忧尤为严重，其中一些国家甚至面临人口减少的前景。虽然这一趋势主要是由结构性经济和社会变化引起的，但我们的论文指出，这一趋势在一定程度上也受到大多数国家所实行的福利型、现收现付型社会保障体系规模的影响。通过动态的多代重叠模型，该模型以父母的无私行为为基础，我们分析表明，社会保障税和福利税率不仅促使个人降低家庭内部的生育率，还抑制了组建家庭的动力，我们通过已婚成年人的比例来实证验证这一点。我们进行了校准后的模拟实验以及回归分析，以衡量社会保障税率在降低净结婚率和总生育率方面的定量影响。我们的结果显示，社会保障对这些变量的影响并非微不足道。我们的校准模拟还使我们能够研究社会保障结构变化对家庭形成和生育率的影响。

abstract.text: The classic theory of moral hazard concerns the insurance of a single good and predicts that co-insurance is larger when the elasticity of demand is higher and when small risks are insured. We extend this analysis to the insurance of multiple goods; for example, the simultaneous insurance of medical services and prescription drugs. We show that when multiple goods are either complements or substitutes--so that a change in co-insurance for one service affects the demand of others--the classic moral hazard results do not hold. For example, the single good model would predict high co-payments for prescription drugs since drug demand is elastic and of modest financial risk. However, a model of multi-good insurance suggests such drug coverage may optimally involve zero or even negative co-insurance when it is a substitute to other services insured such as hospital care or physician services. We summarize some of the empirical evidence in support of markets adopting optimal integrated pricing structures rather than individually optimal pricing structures.

10.3386/w12870.abstractZh: 经典的道德风险理论关注的是单一商品的保险问题，并预测当需求弹性较高且保险风险较小时，共同保险的金额会更大。我们将这一分析扩展到多商品的保险领域，例如医疗服务和处方药的同步保险。我们发现，当多商品是互补品或替代品时——即一种服务的共同保险变化会影响其他商品的需求——经典的道德风险结论并不成立。例如，单一商品模型预测处方药的共同支付额会较高，因为药品需求具有弹性且财务风险较低。然而，多商品保险模型表明，当药品作为其他服务（如医院护理或医生服务）的替代品时，这种保险可能最优地涉及零甚至负的共同保险。我们总结了一些支持市场采用最优综合定价结构而非单独最优定价结构的实证证据。

abstract.text: Much of Africa has not yet gone through a "demographic transition" to reduced mortality and fertility rates. The fact that the continent's countries remain mired in a Malthusian crisis of high mortality, high fertility, and rapid population growth (with an accompanying state of chronic extreme poverty) has been attributed to many factors ranging from the status of women, pro-natalist policies, poverty itself, and social institutions. There remains, however, a large degree of uncertainty among demographers as to the relative importance of these factors on a comparative or historical basis. Moreover, econometric estimation is complicated by endogeneity among fertility and other variables of interest. We attempt to improve estimation (particularly of the effect of the child mortality variable) by deploying exogenous variation in the ecology of malaria transmission and in agricultural productivity through the staggered introduction of Green Revolution, high-yield seed varieties. Results show that child mortality (proxied by infant mortality) is by far the most important factor among those explaining aggregate total fertility rates, followed by farm productivity. Female literacy (or schooling) and aggregate income do not seem to matter as much, comparatively.

10.3386/w12892.abstractZh: 非洲大部分地区尚未经历“人口转型”，即死亡率和生育率下降的过程。非洲各国仍陷入马尔萨斯式的危机：高死亡率、高生育率以及人口快速增长（同时伴随着长期极端贫困），这一状况归因于多种因素，包括妇女地位、生育政策、贫困本身以及社会制度等。然而，人口学家对于这些因素在比较或历史基础上的相对重要性仍存在很大不确定性。此外，计量经济学估计因生育率与其他变量之间的内生性问题而变得复杂。我们试图通过引入疟疾传播生态和农业生产力的外生变化来改进估计方法，例如通过分阶段实施绿色革命和高产种子品种。研究结果表明，儿童死亡率（以婴儿死亡率为代理指标）是解释总体生育率的最重要因素，其次是农场生产力。相比之下，女性识字率（或教育水平）和总收入似乎并不那么重要。

abstract.text: We evaluate the consequences of prosecuting HIV+ people who expose others to the risk of infection. We show that the effect of aggressive prosecutions on the spread of HIV is a priori ambiguous. Aggressive prosecutions tax risky behavior and thus deter unsafe sex and limit the number of sexual partners. However, such penalties might also create unique incentives for having sex with more promiscuous partners such as prostitutes and consequently increase the spread of HIV. We test these predictions using unique nationally representative data on the sexual activity and prosecutions of HIV+ persons. We find that more aggressive prosecutions are associated with a reduction in the number of sexual partners and increased likelihood of safe sex. However, they are also associated with increased likelihood of having sex with prostitutes and not disclosing HIV+ status. Overall, our estimates imply that doubling the prosecution rate could decrease the number of new HIV infections by 12% over a ten-year period.

10.3386/w12903.abstractZh: 我们评估了对HIV阳性者进行严厉起诉所带来的后果，这些起诉会使他人面临感染风险。我们发现，严厉起诉对HIV传播的影响具有不确定性。严厉起诉会抑制高风险行为，从而减少不安全的性行为，并限制性伴侣的数量。然而，这样的惩罚措施也可能为与更随意的性伴侣发生性行为创造机会，比如妓女，从而加剧HIV的传播。我们使用关于HIV阳性者性行为和起诉行为的独特、具有全国代表性的数据来验证这些预测。研究发现，更严厉的起诉措施与性伴侣数量的减少以及安全性行为概率的增加有关。然而，它们也增加了与妓女发生性行为以及不披露HIV感染状态的可能性。总体而言，我们的估计表明，将起诉率翻倍可以在十年内使新的HIV感染人数减少12%。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the salient diabetes prevalence patterns across key SES indicators, and how they changed over time. The investigation spans both the conventional concept of diagnosed diabetes and a more comprehensive measure including those whose diabetes is undiagnosed. By doing so, I separate the distinct impact of covariates on disease onset, better self-management, and the probability of disease diagnosis. Emphasis is given to SES correlates of undiagnosed diabetes and how these changed as those with undiagnosed diabetes plummeted over the last 25 years. I estimate the differential ability by education to successful self-manage diabetes, especially when disease self-management became more complicated.

10.3386/w12905.abstractZh: 本文研究了不同社会经济地位指标下糖尿病患病率的显著变化，以及这些趋势随时间的变化情况。研究涵盖了传统意义上的确诊糖尿病情况，以及更为全面的测量方式，包括那些未被诊断出糖尿病的情况。通过这种分类，我们能够区分不同因素对疾病发病、更好的自我管理能力以及疾病诊断概率的影响。本文重点关注未被诊断出糖尿病的社会经济相关因素，以及这些因素在过去25年中的变化。我们估算了教育程度对成功自我管理糖尿病能力的差异影响，尤其是在自我管理能力变得更加复杂的情况下。

abstract.text: Beginning in the mid 1980s and extending through the early to mid 1990s, a substantial number of women and children gained eligibility for Medicaid through a series of income-based expansions. Using natality data from the National Center for Health Statistics, we estimate fertility responses to these eligibility expansions. We measure changes in state Medicaid eligibility policy by simulating the fraction of a standard population that would qualify for benefits. From 1985 to 1996, the fraction of women aged 15 to 44 who were eligible for Medicaid coverage for a pregnancy increased on average by 24 percentage points. However, contrary to findings in the extant literature, our results do not indicate that this expansion in coverage had a statistically discernible effect on fertility.

10.3386/w12907.abstractZh: 从20世纪80年代中期开始，到90年代初，大量妇女和儿童通过一系列基于收入的扩展政策获得了Medicaid的资格。我们利用国家健康统计中心的出生数据，估算了这些资格扩展对生育率的影响。我们通过模拟标准人口中符合资格条件的比例来衡量各州Medicaid资格政策的变化。从1985年到1996年，15至44岁妇女在怀孕期间获得Medicaid覆盖的资格比例平均增加了24个百分点。然而，与现有文献的研究结果不同，我们的研究并未表明这种覆盖范围的扩展对生育率产生了统计学上可辨别的影响。

abstract.text: Cost savings associated with increased gasoline prices and lower levels of urban sprawl have been cited in terms of personal savings, environmental awareness, reduced costs through lower travel times and congestion, and reduced income inequality. Cost savings in terms of improved health, however, are often not cited yet represent another dimension of savings associated with reduced urban sprawl and gas prices. Cycling is a form of exercise that can also be used as a mode of transportation if the surrounding environment facilitates such use. According to the United States Department of Transportation, 73 percent of adults want new bicycle facilities such as bike lanes, trails, and traffic signals. Using data from the 1990, 1995, and 2001 waves of the Nationwide Personal Transportation Survey, in addition to data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (1996-2000), I propose to analyze the effects of variations in the built environment in the form of urban sprawl and in real gasoline prices on cycling as a form of physical activity. Using bivariate probit and propensity score methods, I show how cycling can lead to improved physical health outcomes. This is turn may carry policy implications in terms of improved public awareness and city planning.

10.3386/w12929.abstractZh: 随着汽油价格上升和城市扩张减少，人们可以节省开支，这体现在个人储蓄、环境意识、通过减少出行时间和拥堵带来的成本降低以及收入不平等的减少等方面。然而，与改善健康相关的成本节省往往没有被提及，但这实际上也是减少城市扩张和汽油价格所带来的另一类节省。骑自行车是一种锻炼方式，如果周围环境条件允许，它也可以作为一种交通方式。根据美国交通部的数据，73%的成年人希望看到新的自行车设施，如自行车道、步道和交通信号灯。利用1990年、1995年和2001年的全国个人交通调查数据，以及1996-2000年的行为风险因素监测系统数据，我提出分析城市扩张和实际汽油价格变化对骑自行车这种体育活动的影响。通过双变量Probit模型和倾向得分方法，我展示了骑自行车如何改善身体健康状况。这反过来可能带来政策上的启示，有助于提高公众意识和城市规划。

abstract.text: A modern statistical literature argues that countries such as Denmark are particularly happy while nations like East Germany are not. Are such claims credible? The paper explores this by building on two ideas. The first is that psychological well-being and high blood-pressure are thought by clinicians to be inversely correlated. The second is that blood-pressure problems can be reported more objectively than mental well-being. Using data on 16 countries, the paper finds that happier nations report lower levels of hypertension. The paper's results are consistent with, and seem to offer a step towards the validation of, cross-national estimates of well-being.

10.3386/w12934.abstractZh: 现代统计文献认为，像丹麦这样的国家特别幸福，而像东德这样的国家则不然。这样的说法可信吗？本文基于两个观点来探讨这一问题。第一个观点是，临床医生认为心理幸福感和高血压之间存在负相关关系。第二个观点是，高血压问题比心理幸福感更容易被客观测量。本文利用16个国家的数据发现，更幸福的国家高血压水平较低。本文的结果与这一观点一致，并且似乎为跨国幸福感估计的验证提供了支持。

abstract.text: Recent research has argued that psychological well-being is U-shaped through the life cycle. The difficulty with such a claim is that there are likely to be omitted cohort effects (earlier generations may have been born in, say, particularly good or bad times). Hence the apparent U may be an artifact. Using data on approximately 500,000 Americans and Europeans, this paper designs a test that makes it possible to allow for different birth-cohorts. A robust U-shape of happiness in age is found. Ceteris paribus, well-being reaches a minimum, on both sides of the Atlantic, in people's mid to late 40s. The paper also shows that in the United States the well-being of successive birth-cohorts has gradually fallen through time. In Europe, newer birth-cohorts are happier.

10.3386/w12935.abstractZh: 最近的研究指出，心理幸福感在生命周期中呈现U形变化。但这一结论存在困难，因为可能存在遗漏的队列效应（例如，早期一代可能出生在特别好的或特别糟糕的时代）。因此，这种明显的U形可能只是人为造成的现象。本文利用约50万美国人和欧洲人的数据，设计了一种测试方法，可以考虑到不同的出生队列。研究发现，幸福感在年龄上呈现出明显的U形变化。在其他条件相同的情况下，大西洋两岸的人们在40多岁中期到晚期时幸福感达到最低点。此外，研究还表明，在美国，不同出生队列的幸福感随时间逐渐下降；而在欧洲，较新的出生队列则更幸福。

abstract.text: This article introduces an empirical strategy to the compensating differentials literature that i) allows both individual observed and unobserved characteristics to be rewarded differently in firms based on health insurance provision, and ii) selection to jobs that provide benefits to operate on both sides of the labor market. Estimates of this model are used to directly test empirical assumptions that are made with popular econometric strategies in the health economics literature. Our estimates reject the assumptions underlying numerous cross sectional and longitudinal estimators. We find that the provision of health insurance has influenced wage inequality. Finally, our results suggest there have been substantial changes in how displaced workers sort to firms that offer health insurance benefits over the past two decades. We discuss the implications of our findings for the compensating differentials literature.

10.3386/w12951.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种针对补偿差异文献的实证策略，该策略能够：i) 根据健康保险提供情况，对个体观察到的及未观察到的特征给予不同的奖励；ii) 选择能够带来利益的工作岗位，从而在劳动力市场的双方都获得优势。通过对该模型的估计，我们可以直接检验健康经济学文献中常用的计量经济策略所提出的假设。我们的估计结果否定了众多横截面和纵向估计方法所依据的假设。我们发现，健康保险提供情况对工资不平等产生了影响。最后，我们的研究结果表明，在过去二十年里，被取代的工人选择提供健康保险福利的公司的方式发生了显著变化。我们讨论了这些发现对补偿差异文献的意义。

abstract.text: Obesity has risen dramatically in the past few decades. However, the relative contribution of energy intake and energy expenditure to rising obesity is not known. Moreover, the extent to which social and economic factors tip the energy balance is not well understood. In this longitudinal analysis of developed countries, we estimate the relative contribution of increased caloric intake and reduced physical activity to obesity using two methods of energy accounting. Results show that rising obesity is primarily the result of consuming more calories. We estimate multivariate regression models and use simulation analysis to explore technological and sociodemographic determinants of this dietary excess. Results indicate that the increase in caloric intake is associated with technological innovations such as reduced food prices as well as changing sociodemographic factors such as increased urbanization and increased female labor force participation. The study findings offer useful insights to future research concerned with the etiology of obesity and may help inform the development of obesity-related policy. In particular, our results suggest that policies to encourage less caloric intake may help reverse past trends in increased consumption.

10.3386/w12954.abstractZh: 过去几十年里，肥胖现象急剧上升。然而，能量摄入与能量消耗对肥胖增加的相对贡献尚不清楚。此外，社会和经济因素在调节能量平衡中的影响程度也尚未得到充分理解。在这项针对发达国家的纵向分析中，我们采用两种能量核算方法，估算了热量摄入增加和体力活动减少对肥胖的相对影响。结果显示，肥胖的增加主要源于热量摄入的增加。我们通过多元回归模型以及模拟分析，探讨了这种饮食过量背后的技术和社会人口学因素。研究结果表明，热量摄入的增加与技术创新（如食品价格下降）以及社会人口学因素的变化（如城市化程度的提高和女性劳动力参与率的上升）有关。这些研究发现为未来关于肥胖病因的研究提供了重要启示，并有助于制定与肥胖相关的政策。特别是，我们的研究结果表明，鼓励减少热量摄入的政策可能有助于扭转过去消费增加的趋势。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) advertising on youth smoking. NRT advertising could decrease smoking by informing smokers that the product can make quitting easier and thus inducing more smokers to try and quit. However, a moral hazard is created because NRT advertising increases the expectation that cessation is relatively easy. NRT advertising could thus induce youth to smoke, to smoke more and/or to delay quit attempts. Data from Nielsen Media Research (Nielsen) and the Monitoring the Future Surveys (MTF) have been used in the empirical work. The Nielsen data are matched to the MTF data by month, year and market. The availability of lagged advertising data allow for calculation of an advertising stock variable. The Nielsen data also measure exposure to national advertising on a local level which allows for use of national advertising data. An exogenous shock allows for bypassing problems of endogeneity. The results indicate that NRT advertising has no effect on participation but increases smoking by youth who do smoke. The elasticity of smoking with respect to NRT advertising is about .10 and the elasticity of smoking with respect to price is about -1.03. Since average youth smoking is about 5.77 cigarettes per day, an increase of 10 percent in NRT advertising would increase this average to about 5.82 cigarettes per day. It is also estimated that a ban on NRT advertising would be equivalent to a 10 percent increase in cigarette prices.

10.3386/w12964.abstractZh: 本文探讨了尼古丁替代疗法广告对青少年吸烟的影响。尼古丁替代疗法广告可以通过向吸烟者传达该产品能够简化戒烟过程的信息，从而促使更多吸烟者尝试戒烟。然而，这种广告方式也带来了道德风险，因为它增加了吸烟者认为戒烟相对容易的预期。因此，尼古丁替代疗法广告可能会促使青少年继续吸烟，或者增加吸烟量，并延迟戒烟尝试。本文采用了Nielsen Media Research和Monitoring the Future调查的数据进行实证研究。Nielsen的数据按月份、年份和市场区域与MTF数据进行了匹配。通过滞后广告数据的分析，可以计算出广告投放量指标。Nielsen的数据还记录了当地范围内对全国性广告的暴露情况，从而可以利用全国性广告数据。通过引入外生冲击变量，可以解决内生性问题。研究结果表明，尼古丁替代疗法广告对青少年吸烟的参与率没有影响，但会增加已经吸烟的青少年的吸烟量。尼古丁替代疗法广告对吸烟行为的弹性约为0.10，而对价格变化的弹性约为-1.03。由于平均青少年每天吸烟约5.77支，尼古丁替代疗法广告增加10%会导致平均每天吸烟量增加到约5.82支。此外，估计禁止尼古丁替代疗法广告将相当于使香烟价格增加10%。

abstract.text: We investigate the childhood determinants of adult height in populations, focusing on the respective roles of income and of disease. We develop a model of selection and scarring, in which the early life burden of nutrition and disease is not only responsible for mortality in childhood but also leaves a residue of long-term health risks for survivors, risks that express themselves in adult height, as well as in late-life disease. Across a range of European countries and the United States, we find a strong inverse relationship between postneonatal (one month to one year) mortality, interpreted as a measure of the disease and nutritional burden in childhood, and the mean height of those children as adults. In pooled birth-cohort data over 30 years for the United States and eleven European countries, postneonatal mortality in the year of birth accounts for more than 60 percent of the combined cross-country and cross-cohort variation in adult heights. The estimated effects are smaller but remain significant once we allow for country and birth-cohort effects. In the poorest and highest mortality countries of the world, there is evidence that child mortality is positively associated with adult height. That selection should dominate scarring at high mortality levels, and scarring dominate selection at low mortality levels, is consistent with the model for reasonable values of its parameters.

10.3386/w12966.abstractZh: 我们研究了人群中儿童时期因素对成年身高的影响，重点关注收入和疾病各自的作用。我们建立了一个选择效应和疤痕效应的模型，其中早期生活中的营养和疾病负担不仅导致儿童时期的死亡率，还会给幸存者留下长期的健康风险，这些风险体现在成年身高以及晚年疾病中。在多个欧洲国家和美国，我们发现新生儿期（一个月到一岁）的死亡率与这些儿童成年后的平均身高之间存在强烈的负相关关系。在30年间的美国与11个欧洲国家的出生队列数据中，出生当年的新生儿期死亡率占全国和队列间成年身高变异的60%以上。即使考虑到国家和出生队列的影响，估计的效应仍然较小，但依然显著。在世界上死亡率最高和最低的国家，有证据表明儿童死亡率与成年身高呈正相关。选择效应在高死亡率水平下应占主导地位，而疤痕效应在低死亡率水平下则起主导作用，这与模型对参数合理取值的假设是一致的。

abstract.text: Patient cost-sharing for primary care and prescription drugs is designed to reduce the prevalence of moral hazard in medical utilization. Yet the success of this strategy depends on two factors: the elasticity of demand for those medical goods, and the risk of downstream hospitalizations by reducing access to beneficial health care. Surprisingly, we know little about either of these factors for the elderly, the most intensive consumers of health care in our country. We remedy both of these deficiencies by studying a policy change that raised patient cost-sharing for retired public employees in California. We find that physician office visits and prescription drug utilization are price sensitive, with implied arc-elasticities that are similar to those of the famous RAND Health Insurance Experiment (HIE). However, unlike the HIE, we find substantial "offset" effects in terms of increased hospital utilization in response to the combination of higher copayments for physicians and prescription drugs. These offset effects are concentrated in patients for whom medical care is presumably efficacious: those with a chronic disease. Finally, we find that the savings from increased cost-sharing accrue mostly to the supplemental insurer, while the costs of increased hospitalization accrue mostly to Medicare; thus, there is a fiscal externality associated with cost-sharing increases by supplemental insurers. Our findings suggest that health insurance should be tied to underlying health status, with chronically ill patients facing lower cost-sharing. We also conclude that the externalities to Medicare from supplemental insurance coverage may be more modest than previously suggested due to these offsets.

10.3386/w12972.abstractZh: 初级医疗和处方药的患者费用分担旨在减少医疗使用中的道德风险。然而，这一策略的成功取决于两个因素：这些医疗商品的需求弹性，以及通过减少获得有益医疗服务的机会而带来的医院住院风险。令人惊讶的是，我们对这些因素在老年人中的情况知之甚少，而老年人是我国最依赖医疗服务的群体。我们通过研究加州退休公务员患者费用分担政策的变化来弥补这两个方面的不足。我们发现，医生门诊服务和处方药的利用对价格非常敏感，其价格弹性与著名的RAND健康保险实验的结果相似。然而，与RAND实验不同的是，我们发现由于医生费用和处方药费用的增加，患者出现了显著的“抵消效应”，即医院住院率上升。这些抵消效应主要集中在那些认为医疗护理有效的患者身上，即患有慢性疾病的患者。最后，我们发现，增加费用分担所带来的节省主要归给补充保险机构，而增加的住院费用则主要归给Medicare；因此，费用分担的增加对补充保险机构产生了财政外部性。我们的研究结果表明，健康保险应该与患者的健康状况挂钩，患有慢性疾病的患者应该面临较低的费用分担。我们还得出结论，由于这些抵消效应，补充保险对Medicare的外部影响可能比之前认为的要小。

abstract.text: Many observers believe current aging baby boomers are woefully unprepared for retirement. Others raise the prospect that Americans are saving too much for retirement. This paper attempts to reconcile these contrasting views using a simple life cycle model and a more sophisticated retirement program, ESPlanner, with special reference to retirement prospects for economists. I find most households with post-graduate degrees fall short of the wealth needed to smooth spending through retirement. Of course, there are ways to economize during retirement: stepping up household production (cooking at home rather than eating out), selling one's house, or maintaining the modest individual consumption levels from when children still roamed the house. But ultimately, I argue these laudable strategies to reduce retirement expenses will be dwarfed by rapidly growing out-of-pocket medical expenses. The combination of eroding retiree health benefits and the risk of catastrophic future out-of-pocket health spending suggests that even conventional retirement planning recommendations could be too low.

10.3386/w12981.abstractZh: 许多观察人士认为，当前的退休年龄临近的婴儿潮一代在退休准备方面严重不足。另一些人则指出，美国人为退休储蓄过多。本文试图通过一个简单的生活周期模型和一个更为复杂的退休规划工具ESPlanner来调和这些不同的观点，特别关注经济学家对退休前景的看法。我发现，大多数拥有研究生学位的家庭在退休期间的支出需求上还存在不足。当然，在退休期间有一些方法可以节省开支：比如在家做饭而不是外出就餐、出售房产，或者保持孩子还小时的那种适度的个人消费水平。但最终，我认为这些减少退休开支的策略会被迅速增长的医疗费用所抵消。随着退休人员的健康福利逐渐消失，未来可能出现的巨额医疗费用风险表明，即使是传统的退休规划建议也可能不够充分。

abstract.text: The Millennium Development Goals call for reducing by half the proportion of people without sustainable access to safe drinking water. This goal was adopted in large part because clean water was seen as critical to fighting diarrheal disease, which kills 2 million children annually. There is compelling evidence that provision of piped water and sanitation can substantially reduce child mortality. However, in dispersed rural settlements, providing complete piped water and sanitation infrastructure to households is expensive. Many poor countries have therefore focused instead on providing community-level water infrastructure, such as wells. Various traditional child health interventions have been shown to be effective in fighting diarrhea. Among environmental interventions, handwashing and point-of-use water treatment both reduce diarrhea, although more needs to be learned about ways to encourage households to take up these behavior changes. In contrast, there is little evidence that providing community-level rural water infrastructure substantially reduces diarrheal disease or that this infrastructure can be effectively maintained. Investments in communal water infrastructure short of piped water may serve other needs and may reduce diarrhea in particular circumstances, but the case for prioritizing communal infrastructure provision needs to be made rather than assumed.

10.3386/w12987.abstractZh: 千年发展目标要求将无法获得可持续安全饮用水的人口比例减少一半。这一目标之所以被采纳，很大程度上是因为清洁水源对于预防腹泻病至关重要，而腹泻病每年导致200万名儿童死亡。有充分证据表明，提供管道供水和卫生设施可以显著降低儿童死亡率。然而，在分散的农村定居点中，为家庭提供完整的管道供水和卫生设施基础设施成本很高。因此，许多贫困国家转而专注于提供社区级的水资源基础设施，如井。各种传统的儿童健康干预措施已被证明在预防腹泻方面有效。在环境干预措施中，洗手和现场水处理都能减少腹泻，不过还需要进一步了解如何鼓励家庭采取这些行为改变。相比之下，几乎没有证据表明提供社区级农村水资源基础设施能够显著减少腹泻病，且这种基础设施难以有效维护。在缺乏管道供水的情况下，对社区水资源基础设施的投资可能满足其他需求，并可能在特定情况下减少腹泻，但必须明确优先考虑社区基础设施的提供，而不是假设其重要性。

abstract.text: In the past few decades, some measures of population risk have improved, while others have deteriorated. Understanding the health of the population requires integrating these different trends. We compare the risk factor profile of the population in the early 1970s with that of the population in the early 2000s and consider the impact of a continuation of recent trends. Despite substantial increases in obesity in the past three decades, the overall population risk profile is healthier now than it was formerly. For the population aged 25-74, the 10 year probability of death fell from 9.8 percent in 1971-75 to 8.4 percent in 1999-2002. Among the population aged 55-74, the 10 year risk of death fell from 25.7 percent to 21.7 percent. The largest contributors to these changes were the reduction in smoking and better control of blood pressure. Increased obesity increased risk, but not by as large a quantitative amount. In the future, however, increased obesity may play a larger role than continued reductions in smoking. We estimate that a continuation of trends over the past three decades to the next three decades might offset about a third of the behavioral improvements witnessed in recent years.

10.3386/w13013.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，一些人口风险指标有所改善，而另一些则有所恶化。了解人口健康状况需要综合考虑这些不同的趋势。我们将1970年代初的人口风险因素与2000年代初的人口风险因素进行比较，并考虑近期趋势持续下去的影响。尽管过去三十年中肥胖率显著上升，但总体而言，当前的人口风险状况比以往更为健康。对于25-74岁的人群来说，10年内的死亡概率从1971-75年的9.8%下降到1999-2002年的8.4%。在55-74岁的人群中，10年内的死亡风险从25.7%下降到21.7%。这些变化的主要贡献因素是吸烟率的降低和血压控制的改善。肥胖程度的增加确实增加了风险，但增加的幅度并不大。然而，在未来，肥胖的加剧可能会比吸烟率的持续降低发挥更大的作用。我们估计，如果过去三十年中的趋势持续下去，那么近年来所见证的行为改善效果可能会减少约三分之一。

abstract.text: In this paper, I examine the role of household income in determining who bribes and how much they bribe in health care in Peru and Uganda. I find that rich patients are more likely than other patients to bribe in public health care: doubling household consumption increases the bribery probability by 0.2-0.4 percentage points in Peru, compared to a bribery rate of 0.8%; doubling household expenditure in Uganda increases the bribery probability by 1.2 percentage points compared to a bribery rate of 17%. The income elasticity of the bribe amount cannot be precisely estimated in Peru, but is about 0.37 in Uganda. Bribes in the Ugandan public sector appear to be fees-for-service extorted from the richer patients amongst those exempted by government policy from paying the official fees. Bribes in the private sector appear to be flat-rate fees paid by patients who do not pay official fees. I do not find evidence that the public health care sector in either Peru or Uganda is able to price-discriminate less effectively than public institutions with less competition from the private sector.

10.3386/w13034.abstractZh: 在本文中，我探讨了家庭收入在决定谁会在秘鲁和乌干达的医疗保健领域行贿以及行贿金额方面的作用。研究发现，与其他患者相比，富裕患者在公共医疗保健领域更有可能行贿：在秘鲁，家庭消费翻倍会使行贿概率增加0.2-0.4个百分点，而行贿率为0.8%；在乌干达，家庭支出翻倍会使行贿概率增加1.2个百分点，而行贿率为17%。在秘鲁，行贿金额的收入弹性无法精确估计，但在乌干达约为0.37。乌干达公共部门的行贿行为似乎是对那些因政府政策而免除支付官方费用的高收入患者征收的服务费。而私营部门的行贿行为则似乎是由那些不支付官方费用的患者支付的固定费用。我没有发现证据表明，无论是秘鲁还是乌干达的公共卫生部门在价格歧视方面能比那些没有来自私营部门竞争的公共机构表现得更好。

abstract.text: The conventional theory of optimal coinsurance rates in health insurance in the presence of moral hazard indicates that, in situations of equal risk characteristics, coinsurance should vary if the price-responsiveness or price-elasticity of demand for different medical services varies, and should be larger for the more price responsive services. An alternative theory called "value-based cost sharing" indicates that coinsurance should be lower for services with higher (marginal) benefits relative to costs. This paper reconciles the two views. It shows that, if patient demands are based on correct information on benefits and costs, the conclusion of the conventional view is identical to the conclusion from the value-based approach. If patient demands differ from correct demands, it is shown that optimal coinsurance depends both on the extent and direction of information imperfection and on price-responsiveness or price elasticity. The paper also shows, as an alternative to adjusting coinsurance to deal with information imperfection, that providing better information which affects patient demands can be superior if uninformed patient demands exceed informed patient demands, but value based cost sharing can be superior to providing information (even if the cost of information is minimal) when patient demands fall short of informed demands. An extended numerical example illustrates these points.

10.3386/w13044.abstractZh: 关于在道德风险存在的情况下，健康保险中最佳共保率的传统理论指出，在风险特征相同的情况下，如果不同医疗服务的价格响应性或需求价格弹性不同，共保率应该有所变化，且对于价格响应性较高的服务，共保率应该更高。另一种被称为“基于价值的成本分摊”的理论则认为，对于相对于成本具有更高（边际）效益的服务，共保率应该更低。本文对这两种观点进行了调和。研究表明，如果患者的需求基于关于效益和成本的正确信息，那么传统观点的结论与基于价值的方法得出的结论是一致的。如果患者的需求与正确需求不同，那么最佳共保率取决于信息不完美程度和方向，以及价格响应性或价格弹性。此外，本文还指出，作为调整共保率以应对信息不完美的替代方案，提供能够影响患者需求的信息可能更为有效，尤其是在患者需求缺乏信息的情况下；而当患者需求低于有信息指导的需求时，基于价值的成本分摊可能比提供信息更为有效，即使信息的成本很低。文中还通过一个扩展的数值示例来说明这些观点。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of recent state-level Medicaid policy changes that expanded eligibility for family planning services to higher income women and to Medicaid clients whose benefits would expire otherwise. We begin by establishing that the income-based policy change led to a substantial increase in the number of program recipients. We then examine Vital Statistics birth data from 1990 to 2003 and determine that it also reduced overall births to non-teens by about two percent and to teens by over four percent. Our estimates suggest a nearly nine percent reduction in births to women age 20-44 made eligible by the policy change. We supplement our state-level analysis with an investigation of individual-level data from the 1988, 1995, and 2002 National Surveys of Family Growth (NSFG) to examine the impact of these policies on sexual behavior and contraceptive use. Evidence from this analysis suggests that the reduction in fertility associated with raising income thresholds for eligibility was accomplished via greater use of contraception. Our calculations indicate that allowing higher income women to receive federally-funded family planning cost on the order of $6,800 for each averted birth.

10.3386/w13045.abstractZh: 本文探讨了最近州级医疗补助政策的变化对计划生育服务的影响，这些变化将资格范围扩大至收入较高的女性以及那些原本可能失去补助资格但重新纳入该计划的客户。我们首先确认，基于收入的政策变化导致计划接受者的数量显著增加。随后，我们分析了1990年至2003年的生命统计数据，发现这一政策变化使非青少年的总出生率下降了约2%，而青少年的出生率则下降了超过4%。我们的估计表明，由于政策变化，20-44岁女性的出生率减少了近9%。为了进一步分析这些政策对性行为及避孕使用的影响，我们还使用了1988年、1995年和2002年的全国家庭成长调查数据。分析结果表明，通过提高收入门槛来降低生育率，主要是通过增加避孕措施的使用来实现的。我们的计算表明，允许收入较高的女性获得联邦资助的计划生育费用，每避免一个新生儿的出生，可节省约6,800美元。

abstract.text: Several studies have examined the effects of state cigarette tax increases on youth substance use over the 1990s, with most -- but not all -- finding that higher taxes reduce youth consumption of tobacco. We advance the literature by using data from the 1991-2005 waves of the national Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS), providing information on over 100,000 high school age youths. We also are the first to make use of hundreds of independently fielded state and local versions of the YRBS, reflecting data from over 750,000 youths. Importantly, these data are to our knowledge the only sources of relevant information on youth smoking that were explicitly designed to be representative of the sampled state or locality. We estimate two-way fixed effects models of the effect of state cigarette taxes on youth smoking, controlling for survey demographics and area and year fixed effects. Our most consistent finding is that -- contrary to some recent research -- the large state tobacco tax increases of the past 15 years were associated with significant reductions in smoking participation and frequent smoking by youths. Our price elasticity estimates for smoking participation by high school youths are generally smaller than previous cross-sectional approaches but are similar to recent quasi-experimental estimates.

10.3386/w13046.abstractZh: 多项研究探讨了20世纪90年代州级香烟税增加对青少年物质使用的影响，其中大多数研究（但并非全部）都发现，更高的税收会减少青少年的烟草消费。我们通过使用1991-2005年间的全国青少年风险行为调查数据，对现有研究进行了补充。这些数据涵盖了超过10万名高中年龄段的青少年。我们也是首次利用数百个独立进行的州级和地区级青少年风险行为调查数据，这些数据涵盖了超过75万名青少年。重要的是，据我们所知，这些数据是唯一专门设计用于反映所抽样州或地区情况的青少年吸烟相关信息的来源。我们建立了双向固定效应模型，以控制调查人口统计信息以及地区和时间固定效应，来研究州级香烟税对青少年吸烟的影响。我们最一致的发现是——与一些近期研究相反——过去15年中州级烟草税的大幅增加与青少年吸烟参与率和频繁吸烟行为的显著减少有关。我们对高中青少年吸烟参与率的价格弹性估计值通常比之前的横断面研究方法要小，但与最近的准实验研究估计值相似。

abstract.text: The response of sexual behavior to HIV in Africa is an important input to predicting the path of the epidemic and to focusing prevention efforts. Existing estimates suggest limited behavioral response, but fail to take into account possible differences across individuals. A simple model of sexual behavior choice among forward-looking individuals implies that behavioral response should be larger for those with lower non-HIV mortality risks and those who are richer. I estimate behavioral response using a new instrumental variables strategy, instrumenting for HIV prevalence with distance to the origin of the virus. I find low response on average, consistent with existing literature, but larger responses for those who face lower non-HIV mortality and for those who are richer. I also show suggestive evidence, based on a very simple calibration, that the magnitude of behavioral response in Africa is of a similar order of magnitude to that among gay men in the United States, once differences in income and life expectancy are taken into account.

10.3386/w13049.abstractZh: 性行为对HIV的反应在非洲是一个重要的因素，有助于预测疫情的发展路径并指导预防工作。现有的估计表明，行为反应有限，但未能考虑到个体之间的差异。一个简单的关于前瞻性个体性行为选择的模型表明，那些非HIV死亡风险较低且收入较高的人，其行为反应应该更大。我采用一种新的工具变量策略来估计行为反应，即用病毒起源地的距离作为工具变量来估计HIV流行率。我发现平均而言，行为反应较低，这与现有文献一致，但那些面临较低非HIV死亡风险且收入较高的人，其行为反应更大。我还基于一个非常简单的校准方法，展示了一些有启发性的证据，即一旦考虑到收入和预期寿命的差异，非洲的行为反应幅度与美国同性恋者相当。

abstract.text: We develop a model in which firms hire heterogeneous workers but must offer all workers insurance benefits under similar terms. In equilibrium, some firms offer free health insurance, some require an employee premium payment and some do not offer insurance. Making the employee contribution pre-tax lowers the cost to workers of a given employee premium and encourages more firms to charge. This increases the offer rate, lowers the take-up rate, increases (decreases) coverage among high (low) demand groups, with an indeterminate overall effect. We test the model using the expansion of section 125 plans between 1987 and 1996. The results are generally supportive.

10.3386/w13066.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个模型，其中企业雇佣的是不同特征的工人，但必须向所有工人提供相同条件的保险福利。在均衡状态下，一些企业提供免费健康保险，一些要求员工支付保费，还有一些则不提供保险。让员工在税前就进行保险缴费可以降低工人因支付保费而产生的成本，从而促使更多企业提供保险服务。这会增加保险服务的提供率，降低接受率，同时增加（减少）高需求群体和低需求群体的保险覆盖率，整体效果尚不确定。我们通过1987年至1996年间第125条计划的扩展来检验该模型，结果基本支持我们的假设。

abstract.text: Unlike the widespread adoption of information and communications technology (ICT) in much of the economy, adoption of ICT in clinical care is limited. We examine how a number of not previously emphasized features of the health care and ICT markets interact and exacerbate each other to create barriers for adoption. We also examine how standards can address these barriers and the key issues to consider before investing in ICT. We conclude that the ICT market exhibits a number of unique features that may delay or completely prevent adoption, including low product differentiation, high switching costs, and lack of technical compatibility. These barriers are compounded by the many interlinked markets in health care, which substantially blunt the use of market forces to influence adoption. Patient heterogeneity also exacerbates the barriers by wide variation in needs and ability for using ICT, by high demands for interoperability, and by higher replacement costs. Technical standards are critical for ensuring optimal use of the technology. Careful consideration of the socially optimal time to invest is needed. The value of waiting in health care is likely to be so much greater than in other sectors because the costs of adopting the wrong type of ICT are so much higher.

10.3386/w13078.abstractZh: 与信息和通信技术（ICT）在大部分经济领域的广泛应用不同，ICT在临床护理领域的应用仍然有限。我们研究了医疗保健和ICT市场中的一些先前未被重视的特征如何相互作用，从而加剧采用障碍。我们还探讨了标准如何能够解决这些障碍，以及在投资ICT之前需要考虑的关键问题。研究结论表明，ICT市场存在一些独特的特征，这些特征可能会延迟或完全阻止ICT的采用，包括产品差异化低、切换成本高以及技术兼容性不足。这些障碍因医疗保健领域众多相互关联的市场而变得更加复杂，这大大削弱了市场力量对采用的影响。患者异质性也加剧了这些障碍，因为患者在使用ICT方面的需求和能力存在很大差异，对互操作性的需求很高，且更换设备的成本也较高。技术标准对于确保技术的最佳使用至关重要。需要仔细考虑在何时进行投资才是最符合社会最优的时机。在医疗保健领域，等待的价值可能比其他行业要高得多，因为采用错误类型的ICT的成本要高得多。

abstract.text: This paper describes the pattern of reductions in mortality across Brazilian municipalities between 1970 and 2000, and analyzes its causes and consequences. It shows that, as in the international context, the relationship between income and life expectancy has shifted consistently in the recent past. But reductions in mortality within Brazil have been more homogeneously distributed than across countries. We use a compensating differentials approach to estimate the value of the observed reductions in mortality. The results suggest that gains in life expectancy had a welfare value equivalent to 39% of the growth in income per capita, being therefore responsible for 28% of the overall improvement in welfare. We then use a dynamic panel to conduct a preliminary assessment of the potential determinants of these gains. We show that improvements in education, access to water, and sanitation seem to be important determinants of the dimension of changes in life expectancy not correlated with income.

10.3386/w13087.abstractZh: 本文描述了1970年至2000年间巴西各市镇死亡率下降的格局，并分析了其成因与影响。研究表明，与国际形势类似，近年来巴西的收入与预期寿命之间的关系发生了持续变化。不过，巴西境内死亡率的下降分布更为均匀。我们采用补偿差异法来估算观察到的死亡率下降所带来的福利收益。研究结果表明，预期寿命的延长所带来的福利收益相当于人均收入增长的39%，因此占整体福利改善的28%。随后，我们通过动态面板模型对影响这些福利收益的因素进行了初步分析。结果显示，教育水平的提高、水与卫生设施的普及似乎是影响预期寿命变化的重要因素，而这些变化与收入无关。

abstract.text: Childhood lead exposure can lead to psychological deficits that are strongly associated with aggressive and criminal behavior. In the late 1970s in the United States, lead was removed from gasoline under the Clean Air Act. Using the sharp state-specific reductions in lead exposure resulting from this removal, this article finds that the reduction in childhood lead exposure in the late 1970s and early 1980s is responsible for significant declines in violent crime in the 1990s, and may cause further declines into the future. The elasticity of violent crime with respect to lead is estimated to be approximately 0.8.

10.3386/w13097.abstractZh: 儿童时期接触铅会导致与攻击性和犯罪行为密切相关的心理缺陷。在20世纪70年代末，美国根据《清洁空气法》从汽油中去除了铅。本文利用这一政策导致各州铅暴露量显著减少的情况，发现20世纪70年代末和80年代初儿童铅暴露量的减少是20世纪90年代暴力犯罪显著下降的原因，并且这种下降趋势可能会持续下去。暴力犯罪与铅暴露量的关系弹性估计约为0.8。

abstract.text: Strong bequest motives can explain low retirement spending, but so equally can strong precautionary motives. Given this identification problem, the recent tradition has been largely to ignore bequest motives. We develop a rich model of spending in retirement that allows for both motives, and introduce a "Medicaid aversion" parameter that plays a key role in determining precautionary savings. We implement a "strategic" survey to resolve the identification problem between bequest and precautionary motives. We find that strong bequest motives are too prevalent to be ignored. Moreover, Medicaid aversion is widespread, and helps explain the low spending of many middle class retirees.

10.3386/w13105.abstractZh: 强烈的遗赠动机可以解释较低的退休支出，但强烈的预防性动机同样可以解释这一现象。鉴于这种识别问题，传统做法往往忽视遗赠动机。我们构建了一个包含两种动机的退休支出模型，并引入了一个“医疗补助厌恶”参数，该参数在决定预防性储蓄方面起着关键作用。我们通过一项“战略性”调查来解决遗赠动机与预防性动机之间的识别问题。我们发现，强烈的遗赠动机过于普遍，不容忽视。此外，“医疗补助厌恶”现象普遍存在，这有助于解释许多中产阶级退休人员的低支出情况。

abstract.text: The obesity rate in the United States has risen significantly in the past few decades. While a number of economic causes for the rise in obesity have been explored, little attention has been on the role of health insurance per se. This paper examines obesity in the context of a model where health insurance status can influence body weight. We attempt to isolate the effects of ex ante moral hazard, where people with health insurance may change their behaviors towards weight control. We use data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System from 1993 to 2002 to determine the potential effect of having health insurance on measures of body weight. In our analyses, we control for a variety of confounding factors that may influence body weight and address the endogenous nature of health insurance. Our results show evidence that having insurance is associated with higher body mass (particularly for those above the poverty threshold) and an increased probability of being overweight. However, we find no evidence that having insurance affects the probability of being obese.

10.3386/w13113.abstractZh: 过去几十年里，美国的肥胖率显著上升。虽然已经探讨了导致肥胖率上升的多种经济因素，但关于健康保险本身的作用却鲜有关注。本文从健康保险状况可能影响体重的模型出发，研究肥胖问题。我们试图分离出事前道德风险的影响，即拥有健康保险的人可能会改变他们的体重控制行为。我们利用了1993年至2002年的行为风险因素监测系统的数据，来研究拥有健康保险对体重指标的影响。在分析中，我们控制了可能影响体重的各种混杂因素，并探讨了健康保险的内生性。研究结果表明，拥有保险与较高的体重相关（尤其是那些超过贫困线的人群），并且超重的概率也较高。然而，我们没有发现拥有保险会影响肥胖的概率。

abstract.text: End-stage renal disease (ESRD), or kidney failure, is a debilitating, costly, and increasingly common medical condition. Little is known about how different financing approaches affect ESRD outcomes and delivery of care. This paper presents results from a comparative review of 12 countries with alternative models of incentives and benefits, collected under the International Study of Health Care Organization and Financing, a substudy within the Dialysis Outcomes and Practice Patterns Study. Variation in spending per ESRD patient is relatively small and is correlated with overall per capita health care spending. Between-country variations in spending are reduced using an input price parity index constructed for this study. Remaining differences in costs and outcomes do not seem strongly linked to differences in incentives embedded in national programs.

10.3386/w13125.abstractZh: 终末期肾病（ESRD），或称肾衰竭，是一种使人衰弱、成本高昂且日益常见的疾病。目前对于不同融资方式如何影响ESRD的治疗效果和护理服务知之甚少。本文基于“国际医疗保健组织与融资研究”项目中的一项子研究——透析治疗效果与实践模式研究，对12个采用不同激励和福利模式的国家的数据进行了比较分析。每个ESRD患者的人均支出差异相对较小，且与整体人均医疗保健支出呈正相关。通过使用本研究构建的投入价格平价指数，可以缩小各国之间的支出差异。剩余的成本和效果差异似乎与各国国家计划中存在的激励措施差异并无显著关联。

abstract.text: There are very large literatures in public health and economics on the effects of workplace smoking bans, with most studies relying on cross-sectional variation. We provide new quasi-experimental evidence on the effects of workplace bans by using the differential timing of adoption of over 100 very strong local smoking by-laws in Ontario, Canada over the period 1997-2004. We employ restricted-use repeated cross section geocoded outcome data to estimate reduced form models that control for demographic characteristics, year fixed effects, and county fixed effects. We first show that the effects of the local laws on actual worksite smoking policy (i.e. the "first stage") were not uniform; specifically, local laws were only effective at increasing ban presence among blue collar workers. Among blue collar workers, adoption of a local by-law significantly reduced the fraction of worksites without any smoking restrictions (i.e. where smoking is allowed anywhere at work) by over half. The differential effect of local policies also improved health outcomes: we find that adoption of a local by-law significantly reduced SHS exposure among blue collar workers by 25-30 percent, and we confirm that workplace smoking laws reduce smoking. We find plausibly smaller and insignificant estimates for white collar and sales/service workers -- the vast majority of whom worked in workplaces with privately initiated smoking bans well before local by-laws were adopted. Overall our findings advance the literature by confirming that workplace smoking bans reduce smoking, documenting the underlying mechanisms through which local smoking by-laws improve health outcomes, and showing that the effects of these laws are strongly heterogeneous with respect to occupation.

10.3386/w13133.abstractZh: 在公共卫生和经济学领域，已有大量文献研究工作场所禁烟令的效果，大多数研究依赖于横断面数据。我们通过使用加拿大安大略省1997-2004年间超过100项严格地方禁烟法规的采纳时间差异，提供了关于工作场所禁烟令效果的新准实验性证据。我们采用受限使用的重复横截面地理编码结果数据，建立控制人口特征、年度固定效应和县固定效应的简化模型。首先，我们发现地方法规对实际工作场所禁烟政策的影响并非一致；具体来说，地方法规仅在蓝领工人中有效提高了禁烟令的普及率。在蓝领工人中，采纳地方法规显著减少了没有任何禁烟限制的工作场所比例，即在工作场所任何地方都可以吸烟的情况。地方政策的不同效果还改善了健康结果：我们发现采纳地方法规使蓝领工人的二手烟暴露减少了25-30%，并确认工作场所禁烟法规确实减少了吸烟行为。对于白领和销售/服务行业工人，我们发现估计值较小且不显著——这些行业的大多数人在地方法规采纳之前就已经在具有私人发起的禁烟场所工作。总体而言，我们的发现通过证实工作场所禁烟令可以减少吸烟行为，记录地方禁烟法规改善健康结果的机制，并表明这些法规的效果在不同职业中表现出强烈的异质性，从而推进了相关领域的研究。

abstract.text: Few studies have addressed how use of care may vary over the course of an episode of being uninsured or across uninsured episodes of varying duration. This research models the probability that an uninsured individual has (a) any medical expenditures or charges, and (b) any office-based visit during each month of an uninsured episode. We find that the ultimate length of an individual's episode of being uninsured bears relatively little on individuals' use of healthcare in any particular month and that the probability of health care utilization rises during the first year of the episode, with more use in the second six months of the year compared to the first six months.

10.3386/w13137.abstractZh: 很少有研究探讨在缺乏保险的情况下，某一时期内的护理使用情况如何变化，以及不同持续时间的无保险时期对护理使用的影响。本研究模拟了无保险个体在某一无保险时期内的每个月份内发生医疗支出或就诊的概率。我们发现，个体在无保险时期内的总持续时间对其在特定月份内的医疗使用情况影响较小，且医疗使用的可能性在无保险时期的头一年会上升，在之后的六个月内的使用频率比头六个月更高。

abstract.text: This paper produces the first large-scale estimates of the US health related welfare costs due to climate change.
