Using the presumably random year-to-year variation in temperature and two state of the art climate models, the analysis suggests that under a "business as usual" scenario climate change will lead to an increase in the overall US annual mortality rate ranging from 0.5% to 1.7% by the end of the 21st century. These overall estimates are statistically indistinguishable from zero, although there is evidence of statistically significant increases in mortality rates for some subpopulations, particularly infants. As the canonical Becker-Grossman health production function model highlights, the full welfare impact will be reflected in health outcomes and increased consumption of goods that preserve individuals' health. Individuals' likely first compensatory response is increased use of air conditioning; the analysis indicates that climate change would increase US annual residential energy consumption by a statistically significant 15% to 30% ($15 to $35 billion in 2006 dollars) at the end of the century. It seems reasonable to assume that the mortality impacts would be larger without the increased energy consumption. Further, the estimated mortality and energy impacts likely overstate the long-run impacts on these outcomes, since individuals can engage in a wider set of adaptations in the longer run to mitigate costs. Overall, the analysis suggests that the health related welfare costs of higher temperatures due to climate change are likely to be quite modest in the US.

10.3386/w13178.abstractZh: 本文首次对气候变化对美国健康相关福利成本进行了大规模估算。通过利用假设为随机变化的气温数据以及两种先进的气候模型，分析表明，在“一切照旧”的情景下，到21世纪末，气候变化将导致美国年度死亡率增加0.5%至1.7%。这些总体估计在统计上与零无显著差异，尽管有证据表明某些子群体的死亡率会显著增加，尤其是婴儿群体。正如经典的Becker-Grossman健康生产函数模型所强调的，整体福利影响将体现在健康结果上，以及人们为保持健康而增加的商品消费上。个体可能的首要补偿反应是增加空调的使用；分析表明，气候变化将使美国年度住宅能源消耗增加15%至30%（以2006年的美元计算，相当于150亿至350亿美元）。在没有增加能源消耗的情况下，死亡率的影响可能会更大。此外，估计的死亡率和能源消耗影响可能高估了这些结果的长期影响，因为个体在更长的时期内可以采取更广泛的适应措施来减轻成本。总体而言，分析表明，由于气候变化导致的更高温度对美国健康相关福利成本的影响可能相当温和。

abstract.text: The prevalence of obesity has increased rapidly since the mid-1970s, following a period of relative stability. This study examines past patterns and projects future prevalence rates of obesity and severe obesity among US adults through 2020. Trends in body mass index (BMI), overweight (BMI 25), obesity (BMI 30), class 2 obesity (BMI 35), class 3 obesity (BMI 40) and class 4 obesity (BMI 45) of 20-74 year olds are obtained using data from the first National Health Examination Survey and the Nutrition Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys. Quantile regression methods are then used to forecast future prevalence rates through 2020. By that year, 77.6% of men are predicted to be overweight and 40.2% obese, with class 2, 3 and 4 obesity prevalence rates projected at 16.4%, 6.3% and 3.1%. The corresponding forecasts for women are 71.1%, 43.3%, 25.3%, 12.8% and 5.8%. The large growth predicted for severe obesity represents a major public health challenge, given the accompanying high medical expenditures and elevated risk of mortality and morbidity. Combating severe obesity is likely to require strategies targeting the particularly large weight gains of the heaviest individuals.

10.3386/w13181.abstractZh: 自20世纪70年代中期以来，肥胖症的发病率迅速上升，此前曾有一段相对稳定的时期。本研究考察了过去肥胖症及其严重程度的流行模式，并预测了到2020年美国成年人肥胖症和严重肥胖症的发病率。通过首次全国健康调查及营养健康与营养检查调查的数据，获得了20至74岁人群的身体质量指数（BMI）、超重（BMI 25）、肥胖（BMI 30）、二级肥胖（BMI 35）、三级肥胖（BMI 40）和四级肥胖（BMI 45）的趋势。随后采用分位数回归方法预测到2020年的发病率。预计到该年，77.6%的男性处于超重状态，40.2%的人患有肥胖症，而二级、三级和四级肥胖症的发病率分别预测为16.4%、6.3%和3.1%。女性的相应预测发病率分别为71.1%、43.3%、25.3%、12.8%和5.8%。对于严重肥胖症而言，其发病率的快速增长是一个重大的公共卫生挑战，因为这将导致高昂的医疗支出以及更高的死亡和患病风险。应对严重肥胖症可能需要采取针对体重增长最显著个体的策略。

abstract.text: Public health agencies around the world have renewed efforts to increase the incidence and duration of breastfeeding. Maternity leave mandates present an economic policy that could help achieve these goals. We study their efficacy focusing on a significant increase in maternity leave mandates in Canada. We find very large increases in mothers' time away from work post-birth and in the attainment of critical breastfeeding duration thresholds. However, we find little impact on the self-reported indicators of maternal and child health captured in our data.

10.3386/w13188.abstractZh: 世界各地的公共卫生机构再次努力提升母乳喂养的发生率和持续时间。产假政策作为一种经济政策，可能有助于实现这些目标。我们研究了该政策的有效性，重点关注加拿大对产假政策的加强。我们发现，母亲产后离开工作的时间以及母乳喂养的持续时间都有显著增长。然而，我们发现这一政策对数据中反映的母亲和儿童健康方面的自我报告指标影响甚微。

abstract.text: This paper begins the synthesis of two currently unrelated literatures: the human capital approach to health economics and the economics of cognitive and noncognitive skill formation. A lifecycle investment framework is the foundation for understanding the origins of human inequality and for devising policies to reduce it.

10.3386/w13195.abstractZh: 本文开始整合两项目前看似不相关的研究：关于健康经济学的人力资本理论，以及认知与非认知技能形成的经济学理论。生命周期投资框架是理解人类不平等起源以及制定减少不平等政策的基础。

abstract.text: Although mental disorders are common among children, we know little about their long term effects on child outcomes. This paper examines U.S. and Canadian children with symptoms of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), depression, conduct disorders, and other behavioral problems. Our work offers a number of innovations. First we use large nationally representative samples of children from both countries. Second, we focus on "screeners" that were administered to all children in our sample, rather than on diagnosed cases. Third, we address omitted variables bias by estimating sibling-fixed effects models. Fourth, we examine a range of outcomes. Fifth, we ask how the effects of mental health conditions are mediated by family income and maternal education. We find that mental health conditions, and especially ADHD, have large negative effects on future test scores and schooling attainment, regardless of family income and maternal education.

10.3386/w13217.abstractZh: 尽管精神障碍在儿童中较为常见，但我们对这些疾病对儿童长期影响的了解却很少。本文研究了美国和加拿大患有注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）、抑郁症、行为障碍及其他行为问题的儿童。我们的研究具有多项创新之处：首先，我们采用了来自两国的大规模、具有全国代表性的儿童样本；其次，我们关注的是所有样本中的儿童所接受的筛查结果，而非已确诊的病例；第三，我们通过估计兄弟姐妹固定效应模型来消除遗漏变量带来的偏差；第四，我们考察了多种结果；第五，我们探讨了心理健康状况的影响如何受到家庭收入和母亲教育水平的调节。研究发现，无论家庭收入和教育水平如何，心理健康状况，尤其是注意力缺陷多动障碍，都会对儿童的未来测试成绩和学业成就产生显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: Increases in the proportion of the working age population can yield a "demographic dividend" that enhances the rate of economic growth. We estimate the parameters of an economic growth model with a cross section of countries over the period 1960 to 1980 and investigate whether the inclusion of age structure improves the model's forecasts for the period 1980 to 2000. We find that including age structure improves the forecast, although there is evidence of parameter instability between periods with an unexplained growth slowdown in the second period. We use the model to generate growth forecasts for the period 2000 to 2020.

10.3386/w13221.abstractZh: 工作年龄人口比例的增加可以带来“人口红利”，从而提升经济增长速度。我们估算了一个包含1960至1980年间各国数据的经济增长模型的参数，并研究加入年龄结构信息是否能改善该模型对1980至2000年期间的预测。研究发现，加入年龄结构信息确实改善了预测结果，尽管在第二个时期存在参数不稳定的现象，导致经济增长速度有所放缓。我们利用该模型对2000至2020年期间的经济增长进行了预测。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of extreme weather on life expectancy in the US. Using high frequency mortality data, we find that both extreme heat and extreme cold result in immediate increases in mortality. However, the increase in mortality following extreme heat appears entirely driven by temporal displacement, while the increase in mortality following extreme cold is long lasting. The aggregate effect of cold on mortality is quantitatively large. We estimate that the number of annual deaths attributable to cold temperature is 27,940 or 1.3% of total deaths in the US. This effect is even larger in low income areas. Because the U.S. population has been moving from cold Northeastern states to the warmer Southwestern states, our findings have implications for understanding the causes of long-term increases in life expectancy. We calculate that every year, 5,400 deaths are delayed by changes in exposure to cold temperature induced by mobility. These longevity gains associated with long term trends in geographical mobility account for 8%-15% of the total gains in life expectancy experienced by the US population over the past 30 years. Thus mobility is an important but previously overlooked determinant of increased longevity in the United States. We also find that the probability of moving to a state that has fewer days of extreme cold is higher for the age groups that are predicted to benefit more in terms of lower mortality compared to the age groups that are predicted to benefit less.

10.3386/w13227.abstractZh: 我们估算了极端天气对美国预期寿命的影响。通过高频死亡数据，我们发现极端高温和极端寒冷都会导致死亡率立即上升。然而，极端高温导致的死亡率上升完全是由时间位移所驱动，而极端寒冷导致的死亡率上升则具有长期性。寒冷对死亡率的总体影响在数量上非常显著。我们估计，每年因寒冷天气导致的死亡人数为27,940人，占美国总死亡人数的1.3%。在低收入地区，这种影响更为明显。由于美国人口从寒冷的东北部州迁移到更温暖的西南部州，我们的研究结果有助于理解长期预期寿命增加的成因。我们计算出，由于气候变化导致的寒冷天气暴露变化，每年有5,400人死亡被推迟。这些与地理迁移长期趋势相关的寿命延长效应，占过去30年美国人口预期寿命总增长的8%-15%。因此，迁移是美国寿命延长的一个重要但之前被忽视的因素。我们还发现，对于那些预计能从较低死亡率中获益的年龄组来说，迁移到寒冷天数较少的州的概率更高。

abstract.text: Much of the extensive empirical literature on insurance markets has focused on whether adverse selection can be detected. Once detected, however, there has been little attempt to quantify its importance. We start by showing theoretically that the efficiency cost of adverse selection cannot be inferred from reduced form evidence of how "adversely selected" an insurance market appears to be. Instead, an explicit model of insurance contract choice is required. We develop and estimate such a model in the context of the U.K. annuity market. The model allows for private information about risk type (mortality) as well as heterogeneity in preferences over different contract options. We focus on the choice of length of guarantee among individuals who are required to buy annuities. The results suggest that asymmetric information along the guarantee margin reduces welfare relative to a first-best, symmetric information benchmark by about £127 million per year, or about 2 percent of annual premiums. We also find that government mandates, the canonical solution to adverse selection problems, do not necessarily improve on the asymmetric information equilibrium. Depending on the contract mandated, mandates could reduce welfare by as much as £107 million annually, or increase it by as much as £127 million. Since determining which mandates would be welfare improving is empirically difficult, our findings suggest that achieving welfare gains through mandatory social insurance may be harder in practice than simple theory may suggest.

10.3386/w13228.abstractZh: 关于保险市场的广泛实证文献大多集中在是否能够检测到逆向选择问题上。然而，一旦检测到逆向选择，很少有人尝试量化其重要性。我们首先从理论上证明，无法从保险市场“逆向选择”的简化形式证据中推断出逆向选择的效率成本。相反，需要建立一个明确的保险合同选择模型。我们在英国年金市场的背景下开发并估计了这样一个模型。该模型考虑了关于风险类型（如死亡风险）的私人信息，以及不同合同选项偏好上的异质性。我们重点关注那些需要购买年金的人在选择保证期限时的行为。研究结果表明，与最优的对称信息基准相比，保证期限的不对称信息会导致福利减少约1.27亿英镑，约占年保费的2%。我们还发现，作为解决逆向选择问题的典型解决方案的政府强制规定，并不一定能改善不对称信息下的均衡状态。根据所强制执行的合同类型，政府强制规定可能会使福利减少多达1.07亿英镑，或者增加多达1.27亿英镑。由于从实证上确定哪些强制规定能够提升福利是困难的，我们的研究结果表明，通过强制性的社会保险来实现福利改善在实践中可能比理论预测要困难。

abstract.text: Conflicting theories of the nonprofit firm have existed for several decades yet empirical research has not resolved these debates, partly because the theories are not easily testable but also because empirical research generally considers organizations in isolation rather than in markets. Here we examine three types of hospitals - nonprofit, for-profit, and government - and their spillover effects. We look at the effect of for-profit ownership share within markets in two ways, on the provision of medical services and on operating margins at the three types of hospitals. We find that nonprofit hospitals' medical service provision systematically varies by market mix. We find no significant effect of for-profit market share on the operating margins of nonprofit hospitals. These results fit best with theories in which hospitals maximize their own output.

10.3386/w13246.abstractZh: 关于非营利企业的理论存在了几十年，但实证研究并未解决这些争论。部分原因是这些理论难以通过实验来验证，另一个原因是实证研究通常将组织视为孤立的实体，而非市场中的参与者。本文研究了三种类型的医院——非营利性医院、营利性医院和政府运营的医院——以及它们之间的溢出效应。我们从两个方面考察了营利性医院在市场上的份额对医疗服务提供和运营利润的影响。研究发现，非营利性医院的医疗服务提供情况随市场类型的不同而有所变化。而营利性医院的市场份额对非营利性医院的运营利润并没有显著影响。这些结果更符合那些认为医院旨在最大化自身产出的理论。

abstract.text: The controversy over whether and how much to charge for health products in the developing world rests, in part, on whether higher prices can increase use, either by targeting distribution to high-use households (a screening effect), or by stimulating use psychologically through a sunk-cost effect. We develop a methodology for separating these two effects. We implement the methodology in a field experiment in Zambia using door-to-door marketing of a home water purification solution. We find that higher prices screen out those who use the product less. By contrast, we find no consistent evidence of sunk-cost effects.

10.3386/w13247.abstractZh: 关于在发展中国家是否以及如何对健康产品收取费用的问题，争议部分在于：更高的价格是否能够增加产品的使用量，这可以通过将产品定向提供给高使用率的家庭来实现（即筛选效应），或者通过心理效应来刺激使用行为（即沉没成本效应）。我们开发了一种方法来区分这两种效应。我们在赞比亚进行了一项实地实验，采用挨家挨户推销家庭净水解决方案的方式。结果发现，更高的价格确实能够筛选出较少使用该产品的消费者。相比之下，我们没有发现沉没成本效应的证据。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of air pollution on school absences using unique administrative data for elementary and middle school children in the 39 largest school districts in Texas. These data are merged with information from monitors maintained by the Environmental Protection Agency. To control for potentially confounding factors, we adopt a difference-in-difference-in differences strategy, and control for persistent characteristics of schools, years, and attendance periods in order to focus on variations in pollution within school-year-attendance period cells. We find that high levels of carbon monoxide (CO) significantly increase absences, even when they are below federal air quality standards.

10.3386/w13252.abstractZh: 我们研究了空气污染对小学生和初中生缺勤的影响，使用了德克萨斯州39个最大学区的独特行政数据。这些数据与环境保护署监测数据进行了合并。为了控制潜在的混杂因素，我们采用了差异-差异-差异的策略，并控制了学校、年份和出勤期的固定特征，以便专注于学年-出勤期内的污染变化。研究发现，即使一氧化碳浓度低于联邦空气质量标准，高浓度的二氧化碳也会显著增加缺勤率。

abstract.text: The State Children's Health Insurance Program (SCHIP) significantly expanded public insurance eligibility and coverage for children in "working poor" families. Despite this success, it is estimated that over 6 million children who are eligible for public insurance remain uninsured. An important first step for designing strategies to increase enrollment of eligible but uninsured children is to determine how the take-up of public coverage varies within the population. Because of their low rates of insurance coverage and unique enrollment barriers, children of immigrants are an especially important group to consider. We compare the effect of SCHIP eligibility on the insurance coverage of children of foreign-born and native-born parents. In contrast to research on the earlier Medicaid expansions, we find similar take-up rates for the two groups. This suggests that state outreach strategies were not only effective at increasing take-up overall, but were successful in reducing disparities in access to coverage.

10.3386/w13261.abstractZh: 国家儿童健康保险计划（SCHIP）显著扩大了“工作贫困”家庭儿童的公共保险资格和覆盖范围。尽管取得了这一成就，但据估计，仍有超过600万名有资格享受公共保险的儿童尚未投保。为制定增加未投保儿童参保率的策略，首先需要了解不同人群中公共保险覆盖率的差异。由于移民子女在保险覆盖率方面较低，且存在独特的参保障碍，因此移民子女是一个特别需要关注的群体。我们比较了SCHIP资格对外国出生和本地出生父母子女保险覆盖率的影响。与之前关于Medicaid扩展的研究相比，我们发现这两组人群的参保率相似。这表明，各州的推广策略不仅有效提高了整体参保率，还成功减少了不同群体在保险获取方面的差异。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of fraternity and sorority membership on a wide array of drinking outcomes among respondents to four Harvard College Alcohol Study surveys from 1993-2001. Identification is achieved by including proxies for specific types of unobserved heterogeneity expected to influence the relationship. These include high school and parental drinking behaviors to account for time-invariant omitted factors, and assessed importance of drinking-related activities and reasons for drinking to control for changes in preferences since starting college. Self-selection is quantitatively important. But even controlling for variables plausibly affected by fraternity membership, such as current alcohol use categorization (from abstainer to heavy drinker) and time spent socializing, fraternity membership has a large impact on drinking intensity, frequency and recency, as well as various negative drinking consequences that potentially carry negative externalities.

10.3386/w13262.abstractZh: 本文估计了兄弟会和姐妹会会员身份对1993年至2001年间参与四项哈佛大学酒精研究调查的受访者各种饮酒行为的影响。通过纳入代表特定类型未观测异质性的代理变量来实现变量识别，这些变量预计会影响研究结果。这些变量包括高中时期及父母的饮酒行为，以控制时间不变的遗漏因素；同时评估与饮酒相关的活动以及饮酒原因，以控制自大学入学以来的偏好变化。自我选择是一个重要的变量。但即使控制了那些可能受兄弟会会员身份影响的变量，如当前酒精使用类别（从不饮酒到重度饮酒者）以及社交时间，兄弟会会员身份仍然对饮酒强度、频率及近期饮酒行为产生较大影响，同时还会引发各种潜在的负面饮酒后果。

abstract.text: The rapid growth in obesity represents a major public concern. Although body weight tends to increase with age, the evolution of obesity over the lifecycle is not well understood. We use longitudinal data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth to examine how body weight changes with age for a cohort moving through early adulthood. We further investigate how the age-obesity gradient differs with socioeconomic status (SES) and begin to examine channels for these SES disparities. Our analysis uncovers three main findings. First, weight rises with age but is inversely related to SES at given ages. Second, the SES-obesity gradient widens over the lifecycle, a result consistent with research examining other health outcomes such as overall status or specific medical conditions. Third, a substantial portion of the SES "effect" is transmitted through race/ethnicity and the translation of advantaged family backgrounds during childhood into high levels of subsequent education. Conversely, little of the SES difference appears to be propagated through family income, marital status, number of children, or the set of health behaviors we control for. However, approximately half of the SES-weight correlation persists after the inclusion of controls, illustrating the need for further study of mechanisms for the gradient.

10.3386/w13289.abstractZh: 肥胖的迅速增长是一个重大的公共健康问题。虽然体重往往随着年龄的增长而增加，但肥胖在生命周期中的变化过程尚不清楚。我们利用《全国青年纵向调查》的纵向数据，研究了一组人在成年早期体重随年龄的变化情况。我们进一步探讨了年龄与肥胖之间的梯度如何随社会经济地位的变化而变化，并开始研究这些社会经济差异的成因。我们的分析得出了三个主要发现：首先，体重随年龄增长而增加，但在特定年龄阶段与社会经济地位呈负相关；其次，社会经济地位与肥胖之间的梯度在生命周期中逐渐扩大，这一结果与研究其他健康结果（如整体健康状况或特定医疗状况）的结果一致；第三，社会经济地位的影响在很大程度上是通过种族/民族以及童年时期优越的家庭背景转化为后续高水平教育来实现的。相反，社会经济地位差异似乎很少通过家庭收入、婚姻状况、子女数量或我们所控制的健康行为等因素传递。然而，在纳入控制变量后，大约一半的社会经济地位与体重之间的相关性仍然存在，这表明需要进一步研究这种梯度的机制。

abstract.text: Health care spending varies widely across markets, yet there is little evidence that higher spending translates into better health outcomes, possibly due to endogeneity bias. The main innovation in this paper compares outcomes of patients who are exposed to different health care systems that were not designed for them: patients who are far from home when a health emergency strikes. The universe of emergencies in Florida from 1996-2003 is considered, and visitors who become ill in high-spending areas have significantly lower mortality rates compared to similar visitors in lower-spending areas. The results are robust across different types of patients and within groups of destinations that appear to be close demand substitutes.

10.3386/w13301.abstractZh: 不同市场的医疗保健支出差异很大，但几乎没有证据表明更高的支出能带来更好的健康结果，这可能是由于内生性偏差所致。本文的主要创新之处在于比较了那些处于非专业医疗体系下的患者的结果：即当健康紧急情况发生时，这些患者距离家很远。研究考虑了1996年至2003年间佛罗里达州的紧急情况，结果显示，在高支出地区患病的游客的死亡率明显低于低支出地区的类似游客。这些结果在不同类型的患者以及那些看似是需求替代品的旅游目的地中都是稳健的。

abstract.text: This paper examines the pathways by which individuals transition from healthy to disabled. Because of the high prevalence and costs associated with disability, understanding these pathways is critical to developing interventions to prevent or minimize disability. We compare two estimates of disabling conditions: those observed in medical claims and conditions indicated by the disabled individual. A small number of conditions explain about half of incident disability: arthritis, infectious disease, dementia, heart failure, diabetes, and stroke. These conditions show up in medical claims and self reports. A large number of elderly also attribute disability to old age and various symptoms. Because so many of the most disabling conditions do not have clear medical treatments, the outlook for major reductions in disability might be limited.

10.3386/w13304.abstractZh: 本文探讨了个体从健康状态转变为残疾状态的路径。由于残疾的普遍性和相关成本较高，了解这些路径对于制定预防或减轻残疾的干预措施至关重要。我们对比了两种关于残疾状况的估计方法：一种是基于医疗索赔记录，另一种则是基于残疾个体自我报告的状况。少数几种疾病导致了大约一半的残疾病例：关节炎、传染病、痴呆症、心力衰竭、糖尿病和中风。这些疾病既出现在医疗索赔记录中，也出现在自我报告中。许多老年人也将残疾归因于年老和各种症状。由于许多最严重的残疾状况缺乏明确的医疗治疗方法，因此大幅减少残疾的可能性可能有限。

abstract.text: Suppose that there are two treatments for a condition. One is the status quo, whose properties are known from experience and the other is an innovation, whose properties are not known initially. A new cohort of persons presents itself each period and a planner must choose how to treat this cohort. When facing situations of this kind, it has become common to commission randomized trials of limited duration to learn about the innovation. Rather than wait for the outcomes of interest to unfold over time, surrogate outcomes that can be observed early on are used to judge the success of the innovation. A close approximation to this process is institutionalized in the drug approval protocol of the U. S. Food and Drug Administration. This paper brings welfare-economic and decision-theoretic thinking to bear on the problem of treatment choice, with application to drug approval. I introduce the adaptive minimax-regret (AMR) rule, which applies to each cohort the minimax-regret criterion using the knowledge of treatment response available at the time of treatment. The result is a fractional treatment allocation whenever the available knowledge does not suffice to determine which treatment is better. The rule is adaptive because, as knowledge of treatment response accumulates, successive cohorts are allocated differently across the two treatments. I use the AMR idea to suggest an adaptive drug approval process that permits partial marketing of new drugs while scientifically appropriate long-term clinical trials are underway. The stronger the evidence on health outcomes of interest, the more treatment would be permitted, with a definitive approval decision eventually made when sufficient evidence has accumulated.

10.3386/w13312.abstractZh: 假设有一种疾病有两种治疗方法。一种是现状，其特性已通过经验得知；另一种则是创新疗法，其特性在初期并不为人所知。每个时期都会有一批新的人群出现，规划者必须决定如何对待这批人群。面对这类情况，通常会进行为期有限的随机试验来了解创新疗法的效果。与其等待结果随时间显现，不如使用早期可观测的替代指标来评估创新疗法的成功程度。这一做法在美国食品药品监督管理局的药品审批流程中得到了制度化。本文从福利经济学和决策理论的角度探讨了治疗选择问题，并将其应用于药品审批。我提出了自适应最小最大遗憾规则，该规则根据治疗反应的知识，为每个人群应用最小最大遗憾标准。当现有知识不足以确定哪种治疗更优时，就会采用分数分配方案。该规则具有自适应性，因为随着治疗反应知识的积累，后续人群会在两种治疗之间被不同地分配。我利用自适应最小最大遗憾规则，提出了一种自适应药品审批流程，该流程允许在科学上适当的长期临床试验进行的同时，部分新药得以上市销售。关于所关注健康结果的证据越充分，允许使用的治疗种类就越多，最终在积累了足够的证据后才会做出明确的审批决定。

abstract.text: During 2006, the Gallup Organization conducted a World Poll that used an identical questionnaire for national samples of adults from 132 countries. I analyze the data on life satisfaction (happiness) and on health satisfaction and look at their relationships with national income, age, and life-expectancy. Average happiness is strongly related to per capita national income; each doubling of income is associated with a near one point increase in life satisfaction on a scale from 0 to 10. Unlike most previous findings, the effect holds across the range of international incomes; if anything, it is slightly stronger among rich countries. Conditional on national income, recent economic growth makes people unhappier, improvements in life-expectancy make them happier, but life-expectancy itself has little effect. Age has an internationally inconsistent relationship with happiness. National income moderates the effects of aging on self-reported health, and the decline in health satisfaction and rise in disability with age are much stronger in poor countries than in rich countries. In line with earlier findings, people in much of Eastern Europe and in the countries of the former Soviet Union are particularly unhappy and particularly dissatisfied with their health, and older people in those countries are much less satisfied with their lives and with their health than are younger people. HIV prevalence in Africa has little effect on Africans' life or health satisfaction; the fraction of Kenyans who are satisfied with their personal health is the same as the fraction of Britons and higher than the fraction of Americans. The US ranks 81st out of 115 countries in the fraction of people who have confidence in their healthcare system, and has a lower score than countries such as India, Iran, Malawi, or Sierra Leone. While the strong relationship between life-satisfaction and income gives some credence to the measures, as do the low levels of life and health satisfaction in Eastern Europe and the countries of the former Soviet Union, the lack of correlations between life and health satisfaction and health measures shows that happiness (or self-reported health) measures cannot be regarded as useful summary indicators of human welfare in international comparisons.

10.3386/w13317.abstractZh: 在2006年，盖洛普组织进行了一项全球调查，使用了相同的问卷对来自132个国家的成年人群进行了调查。我分析了关于生活满意度（幸福感）和健康状况满意度数据，并研究了它们与国民收入、年龄和预期寿命之间的关系。平均幸福感与人均国民收入有很强的相关性；收入每翻一番，生活满意度在0到10的评分中就会增加近1点。与大多数先前的研究结果不同，这一效应在国际收入范围内都普遍存在；在富裕国家中，这一效应甚至更为显著。在国民收入既定的情况下，近期经济增长使人们更不幸福，而预期寿命的改善则使他们更幸福，但预期寿命本身的影响较小。年龄与幸福感之间的关系在国际上并不一致。国民收入可以缓和老龄化对自我报告健康状况的影响，而健康状况满意度的下降和残疾率的上升在贫穷国家比富裕国家更为明显。与先前的研究结果一致，东欧大部分国家和前苏联国家的人民特别不幸福，对健康状况特别不满意，这些国家的老年人对生活和健康的满意度远低于年轻人。非洲的艾滋病流行率对非洲人的生活或健康满意度几乎没有影响；肯尼亚人对个人健康的满意度与英国人和美国人的满意度相当或更高。美国在115个国家中，对医疗系统的信心排名第81位，其得分低于印度、伊朗、马拉维或塞拉利昂等国家。虽然生活满意度与收入之间存在密切关联，这在一定程度上支持了这些测量方法的有效性，但东欧和前苏联国家的生活与健康满意度水平较低，以及生活与健康满意度与健康指标之间缺乏相关性，表明幸福度（或自我报告的健康状况）指标不能作为国际比较中衡量人类福利的实用指标。

abstract.text: We examine the height of non-Hispanic US-born children born 1942-2002 on the basis of all NHES and NHANES data sets available. We use the CDC 2000 reference values to convert height into Height-for-Age z-scores stratified by gender. We decompose deviations from the reference values into an age-effect and a secular trend effect and find that after an initial increase in the 1940s, heights experienced a downward cycle to reach their early 1950s peak again only c. two decades later. After the early 1970s heights increased almost continuously until the present. Girls born in 2002 are estimated to be 0.35[sigma] and boys are 0.39[sigma] above their 1971 values implying an increase of circa 2.5 cm between birth cohorts 1971 and 2002 as an average of all ages (Table 3). Age effects are also substantial - pointing to faster tempo of growth. Girls are c. 0.23[sigma] taller at age 11 and boys 0.15[sigma] taller at age 13 than reference values (Figure 3). This translates into an age effect of circa 1.7 cm and 1.3 cm respectively. Hence, the combined estimated trend and age-effects are substantially larger than those reported hitherto. The two-decade stagnation in heights and the upward trend beginning in the early 1970s confirm the upswing in adult heights born c. 1975-1983, and implies that adults are likely to continue to increase in height. We find the expected positive correlation between height and family income, but income does not affect the secular trend or the age effects markedly.

10.3386/w13324.abstractZh: 我们基于所有可用的NHES和NHANES数据集，研究了1942年至2002年间出生的非西班牙裔美国儿童的身高情况。我们使用CDC 2000年的参考值将身高转换为按性别分层的年龄别身高z分数。我们将参考值的偏差分解为年龄效应和长期趋势效应，发现自1940年代初期增长后，身高经历了一次下降周期，直到大约20年后才在1950年代初再次达到峰值。自1970年代初以来，身高几乎持续增长，直至现在。2002年出生的女孩比1971年的数值高出0.35[sigma]，男孩则高出0.39[sigma]，这意味着1971年与2002年出生队列之间的平均身高增加了约2.5厘米（表3）。年龄效应也非常显著，表明生长速度更快。女孩在11岁时比参考值高出约0.23[sigma]，男孩在13岁时高出约0.15[sigma]（图3）。这相当于年龄效应分别为约1.7厘米和1.3厘米。因此，综合估计的趋势和年龄效应比以往报道的要大得多。身高在20年内的停滞以及自1970年代初开始的上升趋势，证实了约1975-1983年间成年身高增长的上升趋势，并表明成年身高可能会继续增加。我们发现身高与家庭收入之间存在预期的正相关关系，但收入对长期趋势或年龄效应没有明显影响。

abstract.text: Medical care at the end of life, which is often is estimated to contribute up to a quarter of US health care spending, often encounters skepticism from payers and policy makers who question its high cost and often minimal health benefits. It seems generally agreed upon that medical resources are being wasted on excessive care for end-of-life treatments that often only prolong minimally an already frail life. However, though many observers have claimed that such spending is often irrational and wasteful, little explicit and systematic analysis exists on the incentives that determine end of life health care spending. There exists no positive theory that attempts to explain the high degree of end-of life spending and why differences across individuals, populations, or time occur in such spending. This paper attempts to provide the first rational and systematic analysis of the incentives behind end of life care. The main argument we make is that existing estimates of the value of a life year do not apply to the valuation of life at the end of life. We stress the low opportunity cost of medical spending near ones death, the importance of keeping hope alive in a terminal care setting, the larger social value of a life than estimated in private demand settings, as well as the insignificance in quality of life in lowering its value. We derive how an ex-ante perspective in terms of insurance and R&D alters some of these conclusions.

10.3386/w13333.abstractZh: 临终医疗往往被估计占美国医疗支出的四分之一，但这一领域经常遭到支付方和政策制定者的质疑，他们质疑其高昂的成本以及通常微不足道的健康效益。人们普遍认为，医疗资源被浪费在过度的临终治疗上，而这些治疗往往只能让本已虚弱的生命稍微延长一些。然而，尽管许多观察家认为这种支出往往是非理性的且浪费的，但关于决定临终医疗支出的动机的明确和系统分析却很少。目前还没有任何理论能够解释为何临终医疗支出如此之高，以及为何不同个体、群体或时间段的支出存在差异。本文试图提供对临终医疗背后动机的首次理性与系统分析。我们的主要观点是，现有的对生命年价值的估计并不适用于临终时的生命价值评估。我们强调，在临终时刻，医疗支出的机会成本很低，保持希望的重要性在临终护理环境中尤为关键，生命的社会价值比私人需求环境中的估计要高，而且生活质量对降低生命价值的影响微乎其微。我们还探讨了从保险和研发的角度进行的先验视角如何改变这些结论。

abstract.text: Japanese atomic bomb survivors irradiated 8-25 weeks after ovulation subsequently suffered reduced IQ [Otake and Schull, 1998]. Whether these findings generalize to low doses (less than 10 mGy) has not been established. This paper exploits the natural experiment generated by the Chernobyl nuclear accident in April 1986, which caused a spike in radiation levels in Sweden. In a comprehensive data set of 562,637 Swedes born 1983-1988, we find that the cohort in utero during the Chernobyl accident had worse school outcomes than adjacent birth cohorts, and this deterioration was largest for those exposed approximately 8-25 weeks post conception. Moreover, we find larger damage among students born in regions that received more fallout: students from the eight most affected municipalities were 3.6 percentage points less likely to qualify to high school as a result of the fallout. Our findings suggest that fetal exposure to ionizing radiation damages cognitive ability at radiation levels previously considered safe.

10.3386/w13347.abstractZh: 日本原子弹幸存者在排卵后8-25周受到辐射，随后智商下降 [Otake和Schull, 1998]。这些发现是否适用于低剂量（小于10毫戈瑞）尚未确定。本文利用了1986年4月切尔诺贝利核事故产生的自然实验，该事故导致瑞典的辐射水平急剧上升。通过对1983-1988年间出生的562,637名瑞典人的全面数据分析，我们发现切尔诺贝利事故期间胎儿处于辐射环境中的群体，其学业表现比相邻出生群体的表现更差，且这种下降在受孕后8-25周受到辐射的人群中最为明显。此外，我们发现那些出生在辐射量较高的地区的学生的认知能力下降更为显著：来自八个受影响最严重的市镇的学生，因辐射影响而高中毕业的可能性降低了3.6个百分点。我们的研究结果表明，胎儿在辐射水平被认为安全的条件下，也会受到电离辐射的损害，从而影响认知能力。

abstract.text: The introduction of Medicare Part D has generated interest in the cost of providing drug coverage to the elderly. Of paramount importance -- often unaccounted for in budget estimates -- are the salutary effects that increased prescription drug use might have on other Medicare spending. This paper uses longitudinal data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey (MCBS) to estimate how prescription drug benefits affect Medicare spending. We compare spending and service use for Medigap enrollees with and without drug coverage. Because of concerns about selection, we use variation in supply-side regulations of the individual insurance market -- including guaranteed issue and community rating -- as instruments for prescription drug coverage. We employ a discrete factor model to control for individual-level heterogeneity that might induce bias in the effects of drug coverage. Medigap prescription drug coverage increases drug spending by $170 or 22%, and reduces Medicare Part A spending by $350 or 13% (in 2000 dollars). Medigap prescription drug coverage reduces Medicare Part B spending, but the estimates are not statistically significant. Overall, a $1 increase in prescription drug spending is associated with a $2.06 reduction in Medicare spending. Furthermore, the substitution effect decreases as income rises, and thus provides support for the low-income assistance program of Medicare Part D.

10.3386/w13358.abstractZh: 医疗保险D部分的引入引发了人们对为老年人提供药物保障成本的关注。一个至关重要的因素——往往未在预算估算中予以考虑——是增加处方药使用可能对其他医疗保险支出产生的影响。本文利用医疗保险当前受益人调查的数据，估算了处方药福利对医疗保险支出的影响。我们比较了有药物保障和无药物保障的Medigap参保人的支出和服务使用情况。由于对选择问题的担忧，我们使用个体保险市场供应方面的监管差异作为处方药保障的衡量指标，包括保证承保和社区评级等。我们采用离散因子模型来控制可能引入偏差的个体层面异质性。Medigap处方药保障使药物支出增加170美元或22%，同时使医疗保险A部分的支出减少350美元或13%（以2000年美元计算）。Medigap处方药保障减少了医疗保险B部分的支出，但估计结果并不具有统计学意义。总体而言，处方药支出每增加1美元，医疗保险支出就会减少2.06美元。此外，随着收入的增加，替代效应会减弱，这支持了医疗保险D部分针对低收入人群的援助计划。

abstract.text: We investigate how the employment-based health insurance system in the U.S. affects individuals' life-cycle health-care decisions. We take the viewpoint that health is a form of human capital that affects workers' productivities on the job, and derive implications of employees' turnover on the incentives to undertake health investment. Our model suggests that employee turnovers lead to dynamic inefficiencies in health investment, and particularly, it suggests that employment-based health insurance system in the U.S. might lead to an inefficient low level of individual health during individuals' working ages. Moreover, we show that under-investment in health is positively related to the turnover rate of the workers' industry and increases medical expenditure in retirement. We provide empirical evidence for the predictions of the model using two data sets, the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) and the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). In MEPS, we find that employers in industries with high turnover rates are much less likely to offer health insurance to their workers. When employers offer health insurance, the contracts have higher deductibles and employers' contribution to the insurance premium is lower in high turnover industries. Moreover, workers in high turnover industries have lower medical expenditure and undertake less preventive care. In HRS, instead we find that individuals who were employed in high turnover industries have higher medical expenditure when retired. The magnitude of our estimates suggests significant degree of intertemporal inefficiencies in health investment in the U.S. as a result of the employment-based health insurance system. We also evaluate and cast doubt on alternative explanations.

10.3386/w13371.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国的基于就业的医疗保险制度如何影响个人的生命周期中的医疗保健决策。我们认为健康是一种人力资本，会影响工人的工作效率，并推导出员工流动对进行健康投资动机的影响。我们的模型表明，员工流动会导致健康投资的动态效率低下，特别是，美国的基于就业的医疗保险制度可能导致个体在工作年龄期间的健康水平较低。此外，我们发现对健康投资不足与工人所在行业的流动率呈正相关，并且会增加退休后的医疗支出。我们使用两个数据集——医疗支出面板调查和健康与退休研究——为模型的预测提供了实证证据。在医疗支出面板调查中，我们发现高流动率的行业中的雇主不太可能为工人提供医疗保险。当雇主提供医疗保险时，高流动率的行业的合同中有更高的免赔额，雇主对保险费的贡献也较低。此外，高流动率的行业的工人医疗支出较低，预防性护理也较少。在健康与退休研究中，我们发现曾在高流动率行业工作的个体在退休后会有更高的医疗支出。我们的估计结果表明，由于基于就业的医疗保险制度，美国的健康投资存在显著的跨时期效率低下问题。我们还评估并质疑了其他可能的解释。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of alcohol consumption on mortality using the minimum drinking age in a regression discontinuity design. We find that granting legal access to alcohol at age 21 leads to large and immediate increases in several measures of alcohol consumption, including a 21 percent increase in the number of days on which people drink. This increase in alcohol consumption results in a discrete 9 percent increase in the mortality rate at age 21. The overall increase in deaths is due primarily to a 14 percent increase in deaths due to motor vehicle accidents, a 30 percent increase in alcohol overdoses and alcohol-related deaths, and a 15 percent increase in suicides. Combining the reduced-form estimates reveals that a 1 percent increase in the number of days a young adult drinks or drinks heavily results in a .4 percent increase in total mortality. Given that mortality due to external causes peaks at about age 21 and that young adults report very high levels of alcohol consumption, our results suggest that public policy interventions to reduce youth drinking can have substantial public health benefits.

10.3386/w13374.abstractZh: 本文采用回归不连续设计，利用最低饮酒年龄来估计酒精消费对死亡率的影响。研究发现，在21岁时合法饮酒会导致酒精消费量立即大幅增加，包括饮酒天数的增加，增幅达21%。这种酒精消费量的增加导致21岁人群的死亡率增加9%。总体死亡人数的增加主要归因于机动车事故导致的死亡人数增加14%，酒精过量和酒精相关死亡人数增加30%，以及自杀人数增加15%。综合简化形式的估计结果表明，年轻成年人饮酒或大量饮酒的天数每增加1%，总死亡率将增加0.4%。鉴于外部原因导致的死亡率在21岁左右达到高峰，且年轻成年人报告的酒精消费水平非常高，我们的研究结果表明，减少青少年饮酒的公共政策干预措施能够带来显著的公共卫生效益。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of maternal malnutrition exploiting the 1959-1961 Chinese famine as a natural experiment. In the 1% sample of the 2000 Chinese Census, we find that fetal exposure to acute maternal malnutrition had compromised a range of socioeconomic outcomes, including: literacy, labor market status, wealth and marriage market outcomes. Women married spouses with less education and later, as did men, if at all. In addition, maternal malnutrition reduced the sex ratio (males to females) in two generations -- those prenatally exposed and their children -- presumably through heightened male mortality. This tendency toward female offspring is interpretable in light of the Trivers-Willard (1973) hypothesis, according to which parents in poor condition should skew the offspring sex ratio toward daughters. Hong Kong natality micro data from 1984-2004 further confirm this pattern of female offspring among mainland-born residents exposed to malnutrition in utero.

10.3386/w13384.abstractZh: 本文利用1959-1961年中国饥荒这一自然实验，估计了母体营养不良的影响。在2000年中国人口普查的1%样本中，我们发现胎儿在母体营养不良期间会面临一系列社会经济问题的风险，包括识字率、劳动力市场状况、财富状况以及婚姻市场结果。这些女性嫁给受教育程度较低的配偶，而男性则更晚结婚，甚至根本不会结婚。此外，母体营养不良还导致两代人的性别比例发生变化——那些在胎儿期暴露于营养不良环境中的人及其子女——这可能是由于男性死亡率上升所致。这种女性后代数量增加的趋势可以结合Trivers-Willard（1973）的假设来解释，根据该假设，条件较差的父母会倾向于让后代的性别比例偏向女性。1984-2004年香港的出生数据进一步证实了这一规律，即在大陆出生的居民中，那些在胎儿期暴露于营养不良环境中的人，其后代多为女性。

abstract.text: In the U.S. teen mothers are more likely to give birth to low birth weight babies than non-teen mothers. There is also substantial evidence that smoking is a risk factor correlated with low birth weight. Low birth weight is a costly outcome in both the short and long term for parents, children, and society at large. This paper examines the causal link between teen age smoking behavior and low birth weight. We use a variety of empirical techniques including fixed effects and a matching estimator to identify the impact of smoking on babies of teen and non-teen mothers. We find that both OLS and matching estimator results yield large impacts of smoking on birth weight for teens and adults. However, when we control for unobservables through a fixed effects model, the impact of smoking on birth weight is diminished and there are relatively small differences in the impact of smoking on birth weight between teens and non-teens.

10.3386/w13386.abstractZh: 在美国，青少年母亲生育的婴儿往往体重较低。有大量证据表明，吸烟是导致婴儿体重过轻的一个风险因素。婴儿体重过轻对父母、儿童以及整个社会来说，在短期和长期内都会造成高昂的成本。本文探讨了青少年吸烟行为与婴儿体重过轻之间的因果关系。我们采用了多种实证方法，包括固定效应模型和匹配估计法，来研究吸烟对青少年及非青少年母亲所生育婴儿体重的影响。研究发现，无论是使用普通最小二乘法还是匹配估计法，吸烟对青少年和成年人婴儿体重的影响都较为显著。然而，当通过固定效应模型控制不可观测因素后，吸烟对婴儿体重的影响减弱，且青少年与非青少年母亲之间在吸烟对婴儿体重影响上的差异也相对较小。

abstract.text: Without large increases in the number of health workers to treat HIV/AIDS (HAHW), most developing countries will be unable to achieve universal coverage with antiretroviral treatment (ART), leading to large numbers of potentially avoidable deaths among people living with HIV/AIDS. We use Markov Monte Carlo microsimulation to estimate the expected net present value (eNPV) of a scholarship for health care education that is conditional on the recipient entering into a contract to work for a number of years after graduation delivering ART in sub-Saharan Africa. Such a scholarship could increase the number of health workers educated in the region and decrease the probability of HAHW emigration. "Conditional scholarships" for a team of health workers sufficient to provide ART for 500 patients have an eNPV of 1.23 million year-2000 US dollars, assuming that the scholarship recipients are in addition to the health workers who would have been educated without scholarships and that the scholarships reduce annual HAHW emigration probabilities from 15% to 5% for five years. When individual variable values are varied from this base case within plausible bounds suggested by the literature, eNPV of the "conditional scholarships" never falls below 0.5 million year-2000 US dollars.

10.3386/w13396.abstractZh: 如果不大幅增加治疗艾滋病/艾滋病毒的卫生工作者数量，大多数发展中国家将无法实现抗逆转录病毒治疗普及，导致大量可能避免的艾滋病/艾滋病毒患者死亡。我们使用马尔可夫蒙特卡罗微模拟方法，估算了在受助者毕业后在撒哈拉以南非洲地区从事抗逆转录病毒治疗工作的条件下，提供医疗教育奖学金的预期净现值。这样的奖学金可以增加该地区受过教育的卫生工作者数量，并降低艾滋病/艾滋病毒患者外流的概率。对于一支能够为500名患者提供抗逆转录病毒治疗的卫生工作者团队来说，假设受助者是在原本不会接受奖学金的卫生工作者基础上增加的，且奖学金能将艾滋病/艾滋病毒患者外流的概率在五年内从15%降低到5%，那么“条件性奖学金”的eNPV为123万美元。当个体变量值在文献建议的合理范围内变化时，“条件性奖学金”的eNPV始终不低于50万美元。

abstract.text: Using annual, repeated cross-sections from national household survey data, we estimate how the January 1997 termination of federal disability insurance, Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Disability Insurance (DI), for those with Drug Addiction and Alcoholism affected labor market outcomes among individuals targeted by the legislation. We also examine whether the policy change affected health insurance, health care utilization, and arrests. We employ propensity score methods to address differences in observed characteristics between substance users and others, and we used a difference-in-difference-in-difference approach to mitigate potential omitted variables bias. In the short-run (1997-1999), declines in SSI receipt accompanied appreciable increases in labor force participation and current employment. There was little measurable effect of the policy change on insurance and utilization, but we have limited power to detect effects on these outcomes. In the long-run (1999-2002), the rate of SSI receipt returned to earlier levels, and short-run gains in labor market outcomes waned.

10.3386/w13407.abstractZh: 我们利用全国家庭调查数据的年度重复横截面数据，估计1997年1月联邦残疾保险、补充安全收入（SSI）和残疾保险（DI）终止对患有药物成瘾和酒精中毒的人的劳动力市场结果的影响。我们还研究了这一政策变化是否影响了健康保险、医疗利用和逮捕情况。我们采用倾向得分方法来处理物质使用者与其他人之间观察到的特征差异，并采用差异-差异-差异方法来减轻潜在遗漏变量偏差的影响。在短期内（1997-1999年），SSI领取额的下降伴随着劳动力参与率和当前就业率的显著上升。政策变化对保险和医疗利用的影响较小，但我们检测这些结果的能力有限。在长期内（1999-2002年），SSI领取额恢复到早期水平，短期内劳动力市场成果的增长有所减弱。

abstract.text: We provide the first comprehensive assessment of the effects of mandatory seatbelt laws on self-reported seatbelt use, highway fatalities, and crash-related injuries among high school age youths using data from the Centers for Disease Control's (CDC) national, state, and local Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS) and the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) from 1991 to 2005, a period spanning over 20 changes in state seatbelt laws. Our quasi-experimental approaches isolate the independent effects of seatbelt laws net of demographic characteristics, area and year fixed effects, and smooth area-specific trends. Across all data sources, we find consistent evidence that state mandatory seatbelt laws -- particularly those permitting primary enforcement -- significantly increased seatbelt use among high school age youths by 45-80 percent, primarily at the extensive margin. Unlike previous research for adults, however, we find evidence against the selective recruitment hypothesis: seatbelt laws had consistently larger effects on those most likely to be involved in traffic accidents (drinkers, alcohol-involved drivers). We also find that mandatory seatbelt laws significantly reduced traffic fatalities and serious injuries resulting from fatal crashes by 8 and 9 percent, respectively. Our results suggest that if all states had primary enforcement seatbelt laws then regular youth seatbelt use would be nearly universal and youth fatalities would fall by about 120 per year.

10.3386/w13408.abstractZh: 我们首次全面评估了强制安全带法律对高中生自我报告的安全带使用情况、公路死亡事故以及与交通事故相关的伤害的影响。研究数据来自疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）在1991至2005年间进行的全国、州和当地青少年风险行为调查（YRBS）以及致命事故分析报告系统（FARS）。这一时间段内，各州的安全带法律发生了20多次变化。通过准实验方法，我们排除了人口统计特征、地区及年份固定效应的影响，并平滑了地区特定的趋势。所有数据来源均显示，州级强制安全带法律——尤其是那些允许主要强制执行的法规——显著提高了高中生的安全带使用率，增幅在45%至80%之间，且这种提升主要体现在广泛范围内。然而，与以往针对成年人的研究不同，我们发现强制安全带法律对最有可能参与交通事故的人群（如饮酒者、涉酒驾驶者）产生了更大的影响，这与选择性招募假设相悖。此外，我们进一步发现，强制安全带法律使致命交通事故导致的死亡人数和严重伤害人数分别减少了8%和9%。我们的研究结果表明，如果所有州都实施主要强制执行的安全带法律，那么青少年的安全带使用率将几乎达到普遍水平，每年因交通事故导致的青少年死亡人数将减少约120人。

abstract.text: This paper uses the 2000 Census 1-in-6 sample to look at the long-term impact of Vietnam-era military service. Instrumental Variables estimates using draft-lottery instruments show post-service earnings losses close to zero in 2000, in contrast with earlier results showing substantial earnings losses for white veterans in the 1970s and 1980s. The estimates also point to a marked increase in schooling that appears to be attributable to the Vietnam-era GI Bill. The net wage effects observed in the 2000 data can be explained by a flattening of the experience profile in middle age and a modest return to the increased schooling generated by the GI Bill. Evidence on disability effects is mixed but seems inconsistent with a long-term effect of Vietnam-era military service on health.

10.3386/w13411.abstractZh: 本文采用2000年人口普查的六分之一样本，研究越南时期兵役对长期影响的效应。使用抽签机制进行工具变量估计的结果显示，2000年退伍后的收入损失接近于零，这与1970年代和1980年代白人退伍军人出现显著收入损失的早期研究结果形成对比。估计结果还表明，接受教育的比例显著增加，这似乎可以归因于越南时期军人福利计划的影响。2000年数据中所观察到的净工资效应，可以通过中年时期经历曲线的平坦化以及由军人福利计划带来的教育投入所带来的适度回报来解释。关于残疾影响的证据并不一致，但似乎与越南时期兵役对健康的长期影响相矛盾。

abstract.text: User sanctions influence the legal risk for participants in illegal drug markets. A change in user sanctions may change retail drug prices, depending on how it changes the legal risk to users, how it changes the legal risk to dealers, and the slope of the supply curve. Using a novel dataset with rich transaction-level information, this paper evaluates the impact of recent changes in user sanctions for marijuana on marijuana prices. The results suggest that lower legal risks for users are associated with higher marijuana prices in the short-run, which ceteris paribus, implies higher profits for drug dealers. Additionally, the findings have important implications for thinking about the slope of the supply curve and interpreting previous research on the effect of drug laws on demand for marijuana.

10.3386/w13415.abstractZh: 用户制裁会影响非法毒品市场参与者的法律风险。用户制裁的变化可能会改变零售毒品的价格，这取决于它如何改变用户的法律风险、改变毒贩的法律风险，以及供应曲线的斜率。本文利用一个包含丰富交易级信息的新数据集，评估了最近对大麻用户制裁变化对大麻价格的影响。研究结果表明，短期内，用户法律风险降低与高大麻价格相关，在其他条件相同的情况下，这意味着毒贩的利润更高。此外，这些发现对于思考供应曲线的斜率以及解释以往关于毒品法律对大麻需求影响的研究具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Does Canada's publicly funded, single payer health care system deliver better health outcomes and distribute health resources more equitably than the multi-payer heavily private U.S. system? We show that the efficacy of health care systems cannot be usefully evaluated by comparisons of infant mortality and life expectancy. We analyze several alternative measures of health status using JCUSH (The Joint Canada/U.S. Survey of Health) and other surveys. We find a somewhat higher incidence of chronic health conditions in the U.S. than in Canada but somewhat greater U.S. access to treatment for these conditions. Moreover, a significantly higher percentage of U.S. women and men are screened for major forms of cancer. Although health status, measured in various ways is similar in both countries, mortality/incidence ratios for various cancers tend to be higher in Canada. The need to ration resources in Canada, where care is delivered "free", ultimately leads to long waits. In the U.S., costs are more often a source of unmet needs. We also find that Canada has no more abolished the tendency for health status to improve with income than have other countries. Indeed, the health-income gradient is slightly steeper in Canada than it is in the U.S.

10.3386/w13429.abstractZh: 加拿大的公共资助、单一支付者医疗体系是否比美国的多支付者、高度私营的医疗体系更能提供更好的健康结果，并更公平地分配医疗资源？我们发现，通过比较婴儿死亡率和预期寿命来评估医疗体系的有效性并不准确。我们使用JCUSH（加拿大/美国联合健康调查）和其他调查数据，分析了几种不同的健康状况衡量指标。结果发现，美国的慢性健康状况发生率略高于加拿大，但美国在这些疾病的治疗方面有着更好的获取途径。此外，美国有更高比例的男女接受主要癌症的筛查。尽管以不同方式衡量的健康状况在两国相似，但各种癌症的死亡率/发病率比率在加拿大更高。在加拿大，由于医疗是“免费”的，资源分配问题导致患者等待时间延长。而在美国，费用往往成为无法满足需求的原因。我们还发现，加拿大并没有像其他国家那样消除健康状况随收入提高而改善的趋势。事实上，加拿大的健康与收入之间的梯度比美国更为陡峭。

abstract.text: We examine the empirical relationship between socioeconomic disadvantage and rates of early childbearing. First, we use data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) to confirm a strong correlation at the individual level - women who grow up "disadvantaged" are much more likely to give birth as teens. Then we aggregate Vital Statistics microdata from 1968 through 2003 to conduct a cohort-based analysis of the relationship between rates of socioeconomic disadvantage of a birth cohort and the cohort's subsequent early childbearing experiences. Our cohort level analysis implies an even tighter intergenerational correlation between rates of background disadvantage and early childbearing. But, when our analysis econometrically controls for fixed state and year of birth effects in the model to account for cultural and other differences across cohorts, the relationship between rates of disadvantage and early childbearing is found to be quite modest. For example, the elasticity of early childbearing rates by age 18 with respect to the probability of being born to a mother under age 18 is only 0.05. This suggests that broader, societal forces are far more important in determining rates of early childbearing than rates of socioeconomic disadvantage per se.

10.3386/w13436.abstractZh: 我们研究了社会经济劣势与早育率之间的实证关系。首先，我们利用收入动态面板研究的数据，确认了个体层面的强烈相关性——成长于“劣势环境”的女性在青少年时期生育的可能性要大得多。然后，我们整合了1968年至2003年的生命统计微观数据，进行基于队列的分析，以研究出生队列的社会经济劣势程度与其后续早育经历之间的关系。我们的队列级分析表明，背景劣势与早育率之间的代际相关性更为紧密。但是，当我们在模型中通过计量经济学方法控制了固定状态和出生年份的影响，以考虑不同队列之间的文化和其它差异后，发现劣势程度与早育率之间的关系相当温和。例如，18岁时早育率与母亲年龄小于18岁的概率之间的弹性仅为0.05。这表明，在决定早育率方面，更广泛的社会力量远比单纯的社会经济劣势更为重要。

abstract.text: Recent analyses differ on how effective the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants and Children (WIC) is at improving infant health. We use data from nine states that participate in the Pregnancy Nutrition Surveillance System to address limitations in previous work. With information on the mother's timing of WIC enrollment, we test whether greater exposure to WIC is associated with less smoking, improved weight gain during pregnancy, better birth outcomes, and greater likelihood of breastfeeding. Our results suggest that much of the often-reported association between WIC and lower rates of preterm birth is likely spurious, the result of gestational age bias. We find modest effects of WIC on fetal growth, inconsistent associations between WIC and smoking, limited associations with gestational weight gain, and some relationship with breast feeding. A WIC effect exists, but on fewer margins and with less impact than has been claimed by policy analysts and advocates.

10.3386/w13441.abstractZh: 近期的研究对于“妇女、婴儿和儿童特殊补充营养计划”在改善婴儿健康方面的效果存在不同看法。我们利用九个参与妊娠营养监测系统的州的数据来弥补以往研究的局限性。通过了解母亲参与WIC计划的时机，我们测试了更多接触WIC计划是否与吸烟减少、孕期体重增长改善、更好的出生结果以及更高的母乳喂养率相关。我们的研究结果表明，关于WIC计划与早产率降低之间通常所报告的关联，很可能是虚假的，这是由于妊娠年龄的偏差所致。我们发现WIC计划对胎儿生长有轻微的影响，WIC计划与吸烟之间关联不一致，与妊娠体重增长的关系有限，与母乳喂养之间也存在一定的关联。虽然WIC计划确实存在一定效果，但其影响程度远不如政策分析师和倡导者所声称的那么显著。

abstract.text: To customize treatments to individual patients entails costs of coordination and cognition. Thus, providers sometimes choose treatments based on norms for broad classes of patients. We develop behavioral hypotheses explaining when and why doctors customize to the particular patient, and when instead they employ "ready-to-wear" treatments. Our empirical studies examining length of office visits and physician prescribing behavior find evidence of norm-following behavior. Some such behavior, from our studies and from the literature, proves sensible; but other behavior seems far from optimal.

10.3386/w13445.abstractZh: 为每位患者定制治疗方案需要协调工作和认知努力。因此，医生有时会根据针对广泛患者群体的规范来选择治疗方案。我们提出了行为假设，以解释医生为何会在特定情况下为个别患者定制治疗方案，而何时则采用“现成”的治疗方案。我们的实证研究考察了门诊就诊时间和医生处方行为，发现存在遵循规范的倾向。其中一些行为在我们的研究和文献中被认为是合理的；但另一些行为似乎远非最优选择。

abstract.text: This research explores social networks and their relationship to access to health care among adult Mexican-Americans. We use data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) linked to data from the 2000 U.S. Census and other data sources. We analyze multiple measures of access to health care. Measures of social networks are constructed at the ZCTA level and include percent of the population that is Hispanic, percent of the population that speaks Spanish, and percent of the population that is foreign-born and Spanish-speaking. Regressions are stratified by insurance status and social network measures are interacted with individual-level measures of acculturation. For insured Mexican-American immigrants, living in an area populated by relatively more Hispanics, more immigrants, or more Spanish-speakers increases access to care. The social network effects are generally stronger for more recent immigrants compared to those who are better established. We find no effects of these characteristics of the local population on access to care for U.S. born Mexican-Americans, suggesting that similarities in race and language may contribute more to the formation of social ties among individuals who are less acculturated to the U.S. Among the uninsured, we find evidence suggesting that social networks defined by ethnicity improve access to care among recent immigrants. A finding particular to the uninsured is the negative influence of percent of the population that is Hispanic and the percent that is Spanish-speaking on access to care among U.S. born Mexican-Americans. The results provide evidence that social networks play an important role in access to health care among Mexican-Americans. The results also suggest the need for further study using additional measures of social networks, analyzing other racial and ethnic groups, and exploring social networks defined by characteristics other than race, language and ethnicity.

10.3386/w13460.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了社会网络与墨西哥裔美国人获取医疗保健之间的关系。我们使用了医疗支出面板调查的数据，并结合了2000年美国人口普查数据及其他数据来源。我们分析了多种关于医疗保健获取情况的指标。社会网络的指标在ZCTA级别进行构建，包括西班牙裔人口比例、说西班牙语的人口比例，以及外国出生且说西班牙语的人口比例。回归分析按保险状态进行分层，同时还将社会网络指标与个体层面的文化适应指标相结合。对于投保的墨西哥裔美国移民来说，居住在西班牙裔人口较多、移民数量较多或说西班牙语的人口较多的地区，其获得医疗保健的机会会增加。与那些已经定居较久的移民相比，社会网络效应对于新移民更为显著。我们发现，当地人口这些特征对美国出生的墨西哥裔美国人获取医疗保健并无影响，这表明种族和语言的相似性可能更多地促进了那些对美国文化适应程度较低的个体之间的社会联系。对于未投保的墨西哥裔美国移民来说，我们发现社会网络对获取医疗保健有积极影响，尤其是由种族定义的网络。特别值得注意的是，西班牙裔人口比例和说西班牙语的人口比例对美国出生的墨西哥裔美国人获取医疗保健有负面影响。研究结果表明，社会网络在墨西哥裔美国人获取医疗保健方面发挥着重要作用。研究结果还表明，需要进一步研究，采用更多关于社交网络的方法，分析其他种族和族裔群体，并探索由种族、语言和族裔以外的特征所定义的社交网络。

abstract.text: Background: Family structure is known to influence children's behavioral, educational, and cognitive outcomes, and recent studies suggest that family structure affects children's access to health care as well. However, no study has addressed whether family structure is associated with the care children receive for particular conditions or with their physical health outcomes. Objective: To assess the effects of family structure on the treatment and outcomes of children with asthma. Methods: Our data sources were the 1996-2003 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) and the 2003 National Survey of Children's Health (NSCH). The study samples consisted of children 2-17 years of age with asthma who lived in single-mother or two-parent families. We assessed the effect of number of parents and number of other children in the household on office visits for asthma and use of asthma medications using negative binomial regression, and we assessed the effect of family structure on the severity of asthma symptoms using binary and ordinal logistic regression. Our regression models adjusted for sociodemographic characteristics, parental experience in child-rearing and in caring for an asthmatic child and, when appropriate, measures of children's health status. Results: Asthmatic children in single-mother families had fewer office visits for asthma and filled fewer prescriptions for controller medications than children with two parents. In addition, children living in families with three or more other children had fewer office visits and filled fewer prescriptions for reliever and controller medications than children living with no other children. Children from single-mother families had more health difficulties from asthma than children with two parents, and children living with two or more other children were more likely to have an asthma attack in the past 12 months than children living with no other children. Conclusions: For children with asthma, living with a single mother and the presence of additional children in the household are associated with less treatment for asthma and worse asthma outcomes.

10.3386/w13461.abstractZh:
背景：已知家庭结构会影响儿童的行为、教育和认知发展，最近的研究表明，家庭结构还会影响儿童获得医疗保健的机会。然而，尚未有研究探讨家庭结构是否与儿童在特定疾病治疗或身体健康状况方面的影响相关。  
目的：评估家庭结构对哮喘儿童治疗及结果的影响。  
方法：我们的数据来源为1996-2003年的医疗支出调查以及2003年的全国儿童健康调查。研究样本包括2-17岁患有哮喘且生活在单亲或双亲家庭中的儿童。我们使用负二项回归模型评估了家庭中有多少父母以及家庭中其他儿童数量对哮喘就诊次数和哮喘药物使用的影响，同时利用二元和有序逻辑回归模型评估了家庭结构对哮喘症状严重程度的影响。我们的回归模型还考虑了社会人口学特征、父母在育儿和照顾哮喘儿童方面的经验，以及适当的儿童健康状况指标。  
结果：在单亲家庭中生活的哮喘儿童，其哮喘就诊次数和控制器药物的处方数量均少于有双亲家庭中的儿童。此外，生活在有三个或更多其他儿童家庭中的儿童，其哮喘就诊次数和缓解药及控制器药物的处方数量均少于没有其他儿童的家庭中的儿童。单亲家庭中的儿童比有双亲的家庭中的儿童更容易出现哮喘健康问题，而与其他两个或更多孩子一起生活的儿童在过去12个月内发生哮喘发作的可能性也更高。结论：对于患有哮喘的儿童来说，与单亲母亲生活以及家庭中还有其他孩子存在，会导致哮喘治疗效果较差，哮喘病情恶化。

abstract.text: This paper exploits a natural experiment to estimate the causal impact of parental education on child health in Taiwan. In 1968, the Taiwanese government extended compulsory education from six to nine years. From that year through 1973, the government opened 254 new junior high schools, an 80 percent increase, at a differential rate among regions. We form treatment and control groups of women or men who were age 12 or under on the one hand and between the ages of 13 and 20 or 25 on the other hand in 1968. Within each region, we exploit variations across cohorts in new junior high school openings to construct an instrument for schooling. We employ this instrument to estimate the causal effects of mother's or father's schooling on the incidence of low birthweight and mortality of infants born to women in the treatment and control groups or the wives of men in these groups in the period from 1978 through 1999. Parents' schooling, especially mother's schooling, does indeed cause favorable infant health outcomes. The increase in schooling associated with the reform saved almost 1 infant life in 1,000 live births, resulting in a decline in infant mortality of approximately 11 percent.

10.3386/w13466.abstractZh: 本文通过一项自然实验来估计父母教育水平对台湾儿童健康的因果影响。1968年，台湾政府将义务教育年限从六年延长至九年。从那一年到1973年，政府新建了254所初中学校，增幅达80%，且各地区之间的实施速度存在差异。我们在1968年将女性或男性分为两个对照组：一组为12岁或以下的人群，另一组为13至20岁或25岁的人群。在每个地区内，我们利用初中学校新建数量的变化来构建教育水平的测量工具。利用这一工具，我们估计了母亲或父亲的教育水平对1978年至1999年间两组人群中婴儿低出生体重和死亡率的影响。结果显示，父母的教育水平，尤其是母亲的教育水平，确实能够改善婴儿的健康状况。与改革相关的教育水平的提高使得每1000个活产婴儿中约有1个婴儿的生命得以挽救，从而使婴儿死亡率降低了约11%。

abstract.text: Recently, Currie and Stabile (2006) made a significant contribution to our understanding of the influence of ADHD symptoms on a variety of school outcomes including participation in special education, grade repetition and test scores. Their contributions include using a broad sample of children and estimating sibling fixed effects models to control for unobserved family effects. In this paper we look at a sample of older children and confirm and extend many of the JCMS findings in terms of a broader set of measures of human capital and additional specifications.

10.3386/w13474.abstractZh: 最近，Currie和Stabile（2006）对理解ADHD症状对各种学校表现的影响做出了重要贡献，这些表现包括参与特殊教育、留级以及考试成绩。他们的研究包括使用广泛的样本，并采用兄弟姐妹固定效应模型来控制未观察到的家庭效应。在本文中，我们研究了一组年龄较大的儿童，并确认并扩展了JCMS在人力资本衡量指标方面的许多发现，以及额外的分析框架。

abstract.text: Are individuals more likely to smoke when they are surrounded by smokers? In this paper, we examine the evidence for peer effects in smoking. We address the endogeneity of peers by looking at the impact of workplace smoking bans on spousal and peer group smoking. Using these bans as an instrument, we find that individuals whose spouses smoke are 40 percent more likely to smoke themselves. We also find evidence for the existence of a social multiplier in that the impact of smoking bans and individual income becomes stronger at higher levels of aggregation. This social multiplier could explain the large time series drop in smoking among some demographic groups.

10.3386/w13477.abstractZh: 当个体处于吸烟者周围时，他们是否更有可能吸烟？在本文中，我们研究了同伴效应在吸烟行为中的影响。我们通过研究工作场所禁烟令对配偶和同伴群体吸烟行为的影响，来探讨同伴的内生性。利用这些禁烟令作为工具变量，我们发现配偶吸烟的个体自己吸烟的可能性增加了40%。我们还发现了一种社会乘数效应，即禁烟令对个人收入的影响在更高层次上更为显著。这种社会乘数效应可以解释某些人口群体中吸烟率出现大幅下降的现象。

abstract.text: Measuring the lifetime costs and benefits of medical technologies is essential in evaluating technological change and determining the productivity of medical care. Using data on Medicare beneficiaries with a heart attack in the late 1980s and 17 years of follow up data, I evaluate the long-term costs and benefits of revascularization after a heart attack. I account for non-random selection into treatment with instrumental variables; following McClellan, McNeil, and Newhouse, the instrument is the differential distance to a hospital capable of providing revascularization. The results show that revascularization is associated with over 1 year of additional life expectancy, at a cost of about $40,000. Revascularization, or other treatments correlated with it, appears to be highly cost-effective.

10.3386/w13478.abstractZh: 衡量医疗技术的终身成本和收益对于评估技术变革和确定医疗服务的生产力至关重要。本研究基于1980年代末心脏病发作的医疗保险受益人数据以及17年的随访数据，评估了心脏病发作后血管再通治疗的长期成本和收益。我们通过工具变量考虑了治疗选择的非随机性；根据McClellan、McNeil和Newhouse的研究，工具变量是指能够提供血管再通治疗的医院的距离差异。研究结果表明，血管再通治疗可带来超过1年的额外预期寿命，成本约为40,000美元。血管再通治疗或其他相关治疗似乎具有极高的成本效益。

abstract.text: This study has two primary goals. These are the examination of the effect of risk tolerance on individuals' demand for alcohol and second, the examination of the demand for alcohol by older adults over the age of 55. The data sets employed are multiple waves from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). While risk tolerance can impact the level of alcohol consumption, it may also affect the sensitivity of demand to prices. There are parallels between the economist's and the psychologist's concept of risk tolerance. Research on attitudes towards risk by psychologists is part of a larger theoretical and empirical literature on personality traits. Psychologists have found risk tolerance to be an important determinant of alcohol consumption. The empirical results indicate that risk aversion has a significant negative effect on alcohol consumption, with the prevalence and consumption among risk-tolerant individuals being six to eight percent higher. Furthermore, the tax elasticity is similar across both risk-averse and risk-tolerant individuals. This suggests that tax policies may be effective in deterring alcohol consumption even among those who have a higher propensity for alcohol use. The significance of research on alcohol demand by individuals ages 55 and older is highlighted by the increased potential for alcohol-related adverse consequences among this demographic group. Comparing younger adults (ages 21-54) with older adults, responses to taxes and prices are higher among the older sub-population. The tax elasticity is estimated at -0.05 for younger adults, compared to -0.20 for older adults.

10.3386/w13482.abstractZh: 本研究有两个主要目标。一是探讨风险承受能力对个体酒精需求的影响；二是研究55岁以上老年人的酒精需求情况。所使用的数据来自“收入动态面板研究”和“健康与退休研究”的多轮调查数据。虽然风险承受能力会影响酒精消费水平，但它也可能影响需求对价格的敏感性。经济学家和心理学家对风险承受能力的概念存在相似之处。心理学家对风险态度的研究属于关于人格特质的理论和实证文献的一部分。心理学家发现，风险承受能力是酒精消费的重要决定因素。实证结果表明，风险厌恶对酒精消费有显著的负面影响，具有较高风险承受能力的个体的饮酒率高出6%至8%。此外，税收弹性在风险厌恶者和风险承受能力者之间相似，这表明税收政策可能对抑制酒精消费有效，即使是对酒精使用有较高倾向的人群也是如此。55岁及以上人群的酒精需求研究具有重要意义，因为这一群体面临更高的酒精相关不良后果风险。与21至54岁的年轻人相比，老年人对税收和价格的反应更为敏感。年轻人的税收弹性估计为-0.05，而老年人的则为-0.20。

abstract.text: We consider two compelling research questions raised by the increased prevalence of overweight among adolescents. First, what factors explain variation in adolescent bodyweight and the likelihood of being overweight? Next, do overweight adolescents incur greater health care expenditures compared to those of normal weight? We address the former question by examining the contribution of individual characteristics, economic factors, parental and family attributes, and neighborhood characteristics to variation in these bodyweight outcomes. For the second question, we estimate a two-part, generalized linear model of health spending. Using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, our econometric analyses indicate that adolescent bodyweight and the likelihood of being overweight are strongly associated with parental bodyweight, parental education, parental smoking behavior, and neighborhood attributes such as the availability of fresh food markets and convenience/snack food outlets, and neighborhood safety and material deprivation. Our expenditure model indicates that overweight females have annual expenditures that exceed those of normal weight by nearly $800 with part of the disparity explained by differences in mental health expenditures. We use both sets of empirical results to draw implications for policies to address adolescent overweight.

10.3386/w13488.abstractZh: 我们考虑了青少年超重现象日益普遍所引发的两个引人关注的研究问题。首先，哪些因素解释了青少年体重的差异以及超重的可能性？其次，与正常体重的青少年相比，超重的青少年是否会产生更高的医疗保健支出？针对第一个问题，我们通过研究个体特征、经济因素、父母和家庭属性以及社区特征对这些体重差异的影响来探讨。对于第二个问题，我们建立了一个两部分广义线性模型来估算医疗保健支出。利用医疗支出面板调查的数据，我们的计量分析表明，青少年的体重和超重的可能性与父母的体重、父母的教育水平、父母的吸烟行为以及社区属性（如新鲜食品市场的可获得性、便利食品店、社区安全程度以及物质匮乏程度）有显著关联。我们的支出模型显示，超重的女性每年的支出比正常体重的青少年高出近800美元，其中部分差异是由于心理健康支出的不同造成的。我们利用这两组实证结果来为应对青少年超重问题的政策提供启示。

abstract.text: Many violent relationships are characterized by a high degree of cyclicality: women who are the victims of domestic violence often leave and return multiple times. To explain this we develop a model of time inconsistent preferences in the context of domestic violence. This time inconsistency generates a demand for commitment. We present supporting evidence that women in violent relationships display time inconsistent preferences by examining their demand for commitment devices. We find that "no-drop" policies -- which compel the prosecutor to continue with prosecution even if the victim expresses a desire to drop the charges -- result in an increase in reporting. No-drop policies also result in a decrease in the number of men murdered by intimates suggesting that some women in violent relationships move away from an extreme type of commitment device when a less costly one is offered.

10.3386/w13492.abstractZh: 许多暴力关系都具有高度的周期性特征：成为家庭暴力受害者的女性常常多次离开又回来。为了解释这一现象，我们构建了一个关于家庭暴力背景下时间不一致偏好的模型。这种时间不一致性会引发对承诺的需求。我们通过研究女性在暴力关系中对承诺手段的需求，提供了支持性证据，证明她们表现出时间不一致的偏好。我们发现，“不撤诉”政策——即使受害者表示希望撤销指控，也强制检察官继续起诉——会导致报案数量的增加。此外，“不撤诉”政策还导致被亲密伴侣杀害的男性数量减少，这表明一些处于暴力关系中的女性，在面临成本较低的替代承诺手段时，会放弃极端类型的承诺手段。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of a decision support tool designed to help physicians detect and correct medical "missteps". The data comes from a randomized trial of the technology on a population of commercial HMO patients. The key findings are that the new information technology lowers average charges by 6% relative to the control group. This reduction in resource utilization was the result of reduced in-patient charges (and associated professional charges) for the most costly patients. The rate at which identified issues were resolved was generally higher in the study group than in the control group, suggesting the possibility of improvements in care quality along measured dimensions and enhanced diffusion of new protocols based on new clinical evidence.

10.3386/w13493.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种旨在帮助医生发现和纠正医疗“错误”的决策支持工具的效果。数据来自一项针对商业健康保险计划患者群体的随机试验。主要发现是，新的信息技术使平均费用比对照组降低了6%。这种资源利用的减少是由于对最昂贵患者的住院费用及相关专业费用进行了降低。在研究组中，已识别问题的解决速度通常比对照组更快，这表明有可能在护理质量方面取得改进，并基于新的临床证据推广新的治疗方案。

abstract.text: Three quarters of all violence against women is perpetrated by domestic partners. I study both the economic causes and consequences of domestic violence. I find that decreases in the male-female wage gap reduce violence against women, consistent with a household bargaining model. The relationship between the wage gap and violence suggests that reductions in violence may provide an alternative explanation for the well-established finding that child health improves when mothers control a greater share of the household resources. Using instrumental variable and propsensity score techniques to control for selection into violent relationships, I find that violence against pregnant women negatively affects the health of their children at birth. This work sheds new light on the health production process as well as observed income gradients in health and suggests that in addition to addressing concerns of equity, pay parity can also improve the health of American women and children via reductions in violence.

10.3386/w13494.abstractZh: 四分之三针对女性的暴力行为是由家庭伴侣实施的。我研究了家庭暴力的经济原因和后果。我发现，缩小男女工资差距可以减少针对女性的暴力行为，这与家庭议价模型相符。工资差距与暴力行为之间的关系表明，减少暴力行为可能为这样一个普遍存在的现象提供另一种解释：当母亲掌控更多家庭资源时，儿童的健康状况会得到改善。通过使用工具变量和概率得分技术来控制暴力关系中的选择偏差，我发现针对孕妇的暴力行为会对她们孩子的出生健康产生负面影响。这项工作为健康生产过程以及观察到的健康收入梯度提供了新的见解，并表明除了解决公平问题外，薪酬平等还可以通过减少暴力行为来改善美国妇女和儿童的健康状况。

abstract.text: This paper reexamines differences found between income gradients in American and English children's health, in results originally published by Case, Lubotsky and Paxson (2002) for the US, and by Currie, Shields and Wheatley Price (2007) for England. We find that, when the English sample is expanded by adding three years of data, and is compared to American data from the same time period, the income gradient in children's health increases with age by the same amount in the two countries. In addition, we find that Currie, Shields and Wheatley Price's measures of chronic conditions from the Health Survey of England were incorrectly coded. Using correctly coded data, we find that the effects of chronic conditions on health status are larger in the English sample than in the American sample, and that income plays a larger role in buffering children's health from the effects of chronic conditions in England. We find no evidence that the British National Health Service, with its focus on free services and equal access, prevents the association between health and income from becoming more pronounced as children grow older.

10.3386/w13495.abstractZh: 本文重新分析了美国儿童与英国儿童在收入梯度对健康状况影响方面的差异。这些差异最初由Case、Lubotsky和Paxson在2002年针对美国的研究，以及Currie、Shields和Wheatley Price在2007年针对英国的研究所提出。研究发现，当将英国样本的数据延长三年，并与同一时期美国的样本数据进行比较时，两国儿童健康方面的收入梯度随年龄增长的变化幅度是相同的。此外，我们发现Currie、Shields和Wheatley Price在英格兰健康调查中测量慢性疾病的指标存在编码错误。使用正确编码的数据后，我们发现英国样本中的慢性疾病对健康状况的影响比美国样本更为显著，而且收入在缓冲儿童健康受慢性疾病影响方面在英格兰的作用更大。我们没有发现英国国家医疗服务体系通过提供免费服务和平等服务，能够阻止儿童随着年龄增长，健康与收入之间的关联变得更加明显。

abstract.text: Objective: We evaluated the impact of Seguro Popular (SP), a program introduced in 2001 in Mexico primarily to finance health care for the poor. We studied the effect of SP on pregnant women's access to obstetrical services. Data: We analyzed the cross-sectional 2006 National Health and Nutrition Survey (ENSANUT), focusing on the responses of 3,890 women who delivered babies during 2001-2006 and whose households lacked employer-based health care coverage. Methods: We formulated a multinomial probit model that distinguished between three mutually exclusive sites for delivering a baby: a health unit accredited by SP; a clinic run by the Department of Health (Secretaria de Salud, or SSA); and private obstetrical care. Our model accounted for the endogeneity of the household's binary decision to enroll in the SP program. Results: Women in households that participated in the SP program had a much stronger preference for having a baby in a SP-sponsored unit rather than paying out of pocket for a private delivery. At the same time, participation in SP was associated with a stronger preference for delivering in the private sector rather than at a state-run SSA clinic. On balance, the Seguro Popular program reduced pregnant women's attendance at an SSA clinic much more than it reduced the probability of delivering a baby in the private sector. The impacts of the SP program at the individual and population levels varied with the woman's education and health, as well as the assets and location (rural versus urban) of the household. Conclusions: The SP program had a robust, significantly positive impact on access to obstetrical services. Our finding that women enrolled in SP switched from non-SP state-run facilities, rather than from out-of-pocket private services, is important for public policy and requires further exploration.

10.3386/w13498.abstractZh: 目的：我们评估了2001年在墨西哥推出的Seguro Popular（SP）计划对贫困人群医疗保健影响的效果。我们研究了SP对孕妇获得产科服务的影响。数据来源：我们分析了2006年的全国健康与营养调查（ENSANUT），重点关注2001至2006年间分娩的3,890名妇女的情况，这些妇女的家庭缺乏雇主提供的医疗保健服务。方法：我们构建了一个多项概率模型，区分了三种不同的分娩地点：由SP认证的健康机构、由卫生部门运营的诊所以及私人产科护理机构。我们的模型考虑了家庭决定参加SP计划这一二元决策的内生性。结果：参与SP计划的家庭中的妇女更倾向于在SP赞助的机构分娩，而不是自费选择私人诊所分娩。同时，参与SP计划还与更倾向于在私人部门分娩而不是在公立卫生部门诊所分娩的态度相关。总体而言，Seguro Popular计划减少了孕妇前往公立卫生部门诊所分娩的情况，但并未减少在私人部门分娩的概率。SP计划在个体和群体层面的影响因女性的教育水平、健康状况、家庭资产以及家庭所在地（农村与城市）而异。结论：SP计划对获得产科服务有着显著的正面影响。我们发现，参与SP计划的妇女是从非SP公立机构转向该计划，而非自费选择私人服务，这一发现对公共政策具有重要意义，需要进一步研究。

abstract.text: Rewarding inventors with inefficient monopoly power has long been regarded as the price of encouraging innovation. Public prescription drug insurance escapes that trade-off and achieves an elusive goal: lowering static deadweight loss, while simultaneously encouraging dynamic investments in innovation. As a result of this feature, the public provision of drug insurance can be welfare-improving, even for risk-neutral and purely self-interested consumers. In spite of its relatively low benefit levels, the Medicare Part D benefit generate $3.5 billion of annual static deadweight loss reduction, and at least $2.8 billion of annual value from extra innovation. These two components alone cover 87% of the social cost of publicly financing the benefit. The analysis of static and dynamic efficiency also has implications for policies complementary to a drug benefit: in the context of public monopsony power, some degree of price-negotiation by the government is always strictly welfare-improving, but this should often be coupled with extensions in patent length.

10.3386/w13501.abstractZh: 长期以来，给予创新者无效的垄断权力一直被视为鼓励创新的代价。而公共处方药保险则避免了这种权衡，实现了一个难以捉摸的目标：在降低静态无谓损失的同时，同时促进创新的动态投资。由于这一特点，公共提供的药物保险能够提升福利，即使对于风险中性且完全以自身利益为重的消费者也是如此。尽管其福利水平相对较低，但Medicare Part D的福利每年可减少35亿美元的静态无谓损失，并带来至少28亿美元的额外创新价值。仅这两部分就涵盖了公共资助该福利的社会成本的87%。对静态和动态效率的分析也对补充药物福利的政策具有启示意义：在公共垄断力量的背景下，政府进行一定程度的价格谈判总是能够提升福利，但这通常应该与延长专利期限相结合。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate the impact of receiving an NIH grant on subsequent publications and citations. Our sample consists of all applications (unsuccessful as well as successful) to the NIH from 1980 to 2000 for postdoctoral training grants (F32s) and standard research grants (R01s). Both OLS and regression discontinuity estimates show that receipt of either an NIH postdoctoral fellowship or research grant leads to about one additional publication over the next five years. The estimates represent about 20 and 7 percent increases in research productivity for F32 and R01 recipients respectively. The limited research impact of NIH grants may be explained in part by a model in which the market for research funding is competitive, so that the loss of an NIH grant simply causes researchers to shift to another source of funding.

10.3386/w13519.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们估计了获得NIH资助对后续出版物和引用次数的影响。我们的样本包括1980年至2000年间所有向NIH申请的博士后培训资助（F32s）和常规研究资助（R01s），无论申请是否成功。OLS回归和回归不连续估计均表明，获得NIH博士后奖学金或研究资助后，在接下来的五年中大约会多出一份出版物。这些估计结果显示，F32和R01资助者的研究生产力分别增加了约20%和7%。NIH资助的研究影响有限，部分原因可能是研究资金市场具有竞争性，因此失去NIH资助只会促使研究人员转向其他资金来源。

abstract.text: Employer health insurance mandates form the basis of many health care reform proposals. Proponents make the case that they will increase insurance, while opponents raise the concern that low-wage workers will see offsetting reductions in their wages and that in the presence of minimum wage laws some of the lowest wage workers will become unemployed. We construct an estimate of the number of workers whose wages are so close to the minimum wage that they cannot be lowered to absorb the cost of health insurance, using detailed data on wages, health insurance, and demographics from the Current Population Survey. We find that 33 percent of uninsured workers earn within $3 of the minimum wage, putting them at risk of unemployment if their employers were required to offer insurance. Assuming an elasticity of employment with respect to minimum wage increase of -0.10, we estimate that 0.2 percent of all full-time workers and 1.4 percent of uninsured full-time workers would lose their jobs because of a health insurance mandate. Workers who would lose their jobs are disproportionately likely to be high school dropouts, minority, and female. This risk of unemployment should be a crucial component in the evaluation of both the effectiveness and distributional implications of these policies relative to alternatives such as tax credits, Medicaid expansions, and individual mandates, and their broader effects on the well-being of low-wage workers.

10.3386/w13528.abstractZh: 雇主健康保险强制规定是许多医疗保健改革提案的基础。支持者认为这将增加保险需求，而反对者则担心低薪工人将面临工资减少的问题，并且在最低工资法律存在的情况下，一些收入最低的工人可能会失业。我们利用《当前人口调查》中关于工资、健康保险和人口统计数据的详细数据，估算出那些工资接近最低工资以至于无法降低以承担健康保险成本的工人数量。研究发现，有33%的未投保工人其工资与最低工资相差仅3美元，如果雇主必须提供保险，这些工人将面临失业的风险。假设就业对最低工资增加的弹性为-0.10，我们估计有0.2%的全职工人和1.4%的未投保全职工人会因健康保险强制规定而失去工作。失去工作的工人中，高中辍学者、少数族裔和女性占比较高。这种失业风险应成为评估这些政策相对于税收抵免、医疗补助扩展和个人强制规定等替代方案的有效性及分配影响的重要考量因素，同时还应考虑这些政策对低薪工人福祉的更广泛影响。

abstract.text: New gastroenterologists participated in a labor market clearinghouse (a "match") from 1986 through the late 1990's, after which the match was abandoned. This provides an opportunity to study the effects of a match, by observing the differences in the outcomes and organization of the market when a match was operating, and when it was not. After the GI match ended, the market unraveled. Contracts were signed earlier each year, at diffuse times, often with exploding offers. The market became less national, more local. This allows us to discern the effect of the clearinghouse: it coordinated the timing of the market, in a way that increased its thickness and scope. The clearinghouse does not seem to have had an effect on wages. As this became known among gastroenterologists, an opportunity arose to reorganize the market to once again use a centralized clearinghouse. However it proved necessary to adopt policies that would allow employers to safely delay hiring and coordinate on using the clearinghouse. The market for gastroenterologists provides a case study of market failures, the way a centralized clearinghouse can fix them, and the effects on market outcomes. In the conclusion we discuss aspects of the experience of the gastroenterology labor market that seem to generalize fairly widely.

10.3386/w13529.abstractZh: 新的胃肠病学家从1986年到1990年代末参与了一个劳动力市场清算所（即“匹配机制”），之后该机制被废止。通过观察在匹配机制运作期间与非运作期间市场的表现和运作方式差异，我们可以研究该机制的影响。在胃肠病学家匹配机制结束后，市场逐渐瓦解。合同每年都在不同的时间签订，而且报价往往呈爆炸性增长。市场变得不那么全国性的，而更地方化。这让我们能够看出清算所的作用：它以一种增加市场厚度和范围的方式，协调了市场的时机。清算所似乎并没有对工资产生影响。随着这一情况在胃肠病学家中广为人知，人们有机会重新组织市场，再次使用集中式的清算所。然而，事实证明，需要采取一些政策，让雇主能够安全地推迟招聘，并协调使用清算所。胃肠病学家市场为研究市场失灵、集中式清算所如何解决这些问题以及其对市场结果的影响提供了一个案例研究。在结论部分，我们讨论了胃肠病学家劳动力市场经验中的一些方面，这些经验似乎具有广泛的普遍性。

abstract.text: This essay discusses some things we have learned about markets, in the process of designing marketplaces to fix market failures.
