To work well, marketplaces have to provide thickness, i.e. they need to attract a large enough proportion of the potential participants in the market; they have to overcome the congestion that thickness can bring, by making it possible to consider enough alternative transactions to arrive at good ones; and they need to make it safe and sufficiently simple to participate in the market, as opposed to transacting outside of the market, or having to engage in costly and risky strategic behavior. I'll draw on recent examples of market design ranging from labor markets for doctors and new economists, to kidney exchange, and school choice in New York City and Boston.

10.3386/w13530.abstractZh: 本文探讨了我们在设计市场以解决市场失灵过程中所了解到的一些问题。要有效运作，市场必须具备足够的吸引力，即需要吸引足够比例的潜在参与者；同时，市场还需克服因参与者众多可能带来的拥堵问题，通过提供足够多的替代交易选择来选出最优方案；此外，市场还需要使参与交易变得安全且简单，避免参与者在市场中之外进行交易，或者不得不采取成本高昂且风险较大的策略性行为。我将以最近的一些市场设计案例为例，这些案例涉及医生劳动力市场、新经济学家的职业选择，以及纽约市和波士顿的择校问题。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of malaria on educational attainment and income by exploiting geographic variation in malaria prevalence in India prior to a nationwide eradication program in the 1950s. We find that the program led to modest increases in income for prime age men. This finding is robust to using very localized sources of geographic variation and to instrumenting for pre-eradication prevalence with climate factors. We do not observe improvements in income for women, suggesting that observed effects are likely driven by increased labor market productivity. We find no evidence of increased educational attainment for men, and mixed evidence for women.

10.3386/w13539.abstractZh: 我们通过利用20世纪50年代印度全国灭疟计划之前疟疾流行率的地理差异，来研究疟疾对教育水平和收入的影响。研究发现，该计划使得壮年男性的收入有所提升。这一结论在采用非常局部的地理变异数据来源以及用气候因素来替代灭疟前的流行率时依然成立。我们没有观察到女性收入方面的改善，这表明观察到的效果可能主要由劳动力市场的生产率提高所驱动。对于男性，我们没有发现教育水平提升的证据；对于女性，则存在混合性的证据。

abstract.text: Globally, men and women face markedly different risks of obesity. In all but of handful of (primarily Western European) countries, obesity is more prevalent among women than men. In this paper, we examine several potential explanations for this phenomenon. We analyze differences between men and women in reports and effects of the proximate causes of obesity -- physical exertion and food intake -- and the underlying causes of obesity -- childhood and adult poverty, depression, and attitudes about obesity. We evaluate the evidence for each explanation using data collected in an African township outside of Cape Town. Three factors explain the greater obesity rates we find among women. Women who were nutritionally deprived as children are significantly more likely to be obese as adults, while men who were deprived as children face no greater risk. In addition, women of higher adult socioeconomic status are significantly more likely to be obese, which is not true for men. These two factors can fully explain the difference in obesity rates we find in our sample. Finally (and more speculatively), women's perceptions of an 'ideal' female body are larger than men's perceptions of the 'ideal' male body, and individuals with larger 'ideal' body images are significantly more likely to be obese.

10.3386/w13541.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，男性和女性面临肥胖风险存在显著差异。在几乎所有国家（主要是西欧国家），女性的肥胖率高于男性。本文探讨了这一现象的几种可能解释。我们分析了男性和女性在肥胖的直接原因——体力活动与食物摄入——以及肥胖的根本原因——儿童期与成年期的贫困、抑郁以及对肥胖的态度等方面的差异。我们使用开普敦附近一个非洲乡镇收集的数据来评估这些解释的合理性。我们发现，有三个因素解释了女性更高的肥胖率：在儿童时期营养不足的女性成年后肥胖的可能性显著更高，而儿童时期营养不足的男性则没有更高的肥胖风险。此外，成年后社会经济地位较高的女性肥胖的可能性也显著更高，而男性则并非如此。这两个因素可以完全解释我们样本中女性与男性肥胖率之间的差异。最后（更具推测性的是），女性对“理想”女性身体的认知比男性对“理想”男性身体的认知更为强烈，而那些拥有更“理想”身体形象的人肥胖的可能性也显著更高。

abstract.text: In the United States, drug safety and efficacy are primarily regulated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the legal system, which gives manufacturers large incentives to produce safe drugs and provide proper warnings for side effects, since patients can sue manufacturers that provide unsafe drugs and/or insufficient warnings. In this paper, we begin by examining the efficiency implications of this joint regulation of drug safety. We find that joint regulation of drug safety can be inefficient when the regulatory authority mandates a binding and well enforced level of safety investment. In this case, product liability has no effect on a firm's safety investment, but affects welfare by raising a firm's costs and therefore prices. Using these results, we calibrate a model of the pharmaceutical market and find that, depending on the share of liability costs in marginal costs, a product liability exemption for activities that are well regulated by the FDA could increase consumer welfare by $47.8-$754.7 billion annually (4-66 percent of sales) and producer welfare by $11.9-$173.9 billion annually (1-15 percent of sales). In addition, we summarize the welfare effects of recent legislation, the Prescription Drug User Fee Acts (PDUFA), which mandated faster FDA review times in exchange for user fees levied on the pharmaceutical industry. Overall, we find that the faster review times mandated by PDUFA raised social surplus by $18-31 billion, and that at most, the concomitant cost of reduced drug safety was $5.6-$16.6 billion.

10.3386/w13561.abstractZh: 在美国，药品的安全性和有效性主要由食品药品监督管理局（FDA）和法律体系进行监管，这给制造商提供了巨大的激励，促使他们生产安全的药品并提供适当的副作用警示。因为患者可以起诉提供不安全药品和/或警示不足的制造商。在本文中，我们首先探讨了这种药品安全联合监管的效率影响。我们发现，当监管机构要求制造商投入足够的安全投资时，联合监管可能会变得低效。在这种情况下，产品责任对公司的安全投资没有影响，但会通过增加公司的成本和价格来影响福利。基于这些结果，我们构建了一个药品市场模型，并发现，根据责任成本在边际成本中的占比，对于由FDA严格监管的活动，产品责任的豁免每年可以增加478亿至7547亿美元的消费福利（占销售额的4%至66%），以及119亿至1739亿美元的生产者福利（占销售额的1%至15%）。此外，我们还总结了最近立法——处方药品用户费用法案（PDUFA）的福利效应。该法案要求FDA加快审查速度，以换取向制药行业收取用户费用。总体而言，PDUFA规定的更快审查速度使社会剩余增加了180亿至310亿美元，而降低药品安全性的相应成本最多为56亿至166亿美元。

abstract.text: Critics of pay or play mandates, borrowing from the large empirical minimum wage literature, provide evidence that they reduce employment. Borrowing from a smaller empirical minimum wage literature, we provide evidence that they also are a blunt instrument for funding health insurance for the working poor. The vast majority of those who benefit from pay or play mandates which require employers to either provide appropriate health insurance for their workers or pay a flat per hour tax to offset the cost of health care live in families with incomes twice the poverty line or more and, depending on how coverage is determined, the mandate will leave a significant share of the working poor ineligible for such benefits either because their hourly wage rate is too high or they work for smaller exempt firms.

10.3386/w13578.abstractZh: 批评“薪酬或保险强制规定”的人，借鉴了大量关于最低工资的经验性研究，指出这些规定会减少就业。而通过较小规模的经验性最低工资研究，我们发现这些规定还会成为为贫困劳动者提供健康保险的无效手段。绝大多数受益于“薪酬或保险强制规定”的人，其家庭收入至少是贫困线的两倍以上。而且，根据保险覆盖范围的确定方式，这些规定会导致相当一部分贫困劳动者无法获得此类福利，要么是因为他们的时薪过高，要么是因为他们在较小的、不受该规定约束的企业工作。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of fertility on female labor force participation in a cross-country panel data set using abortion legislation as an instrument for fertility. We find a large negative effect of the fertility rate on female labor force participation. The direct effect is concentrated among those aged 20-39, but we find that cohort participation is persistent over time giving an effect among older women. We present a simulation model of the effect of fertility reduction on income per capita, taking into account these changes in female labor force participation as well as population numbers and age structure.

10.3386/w13583.abstractZh: 我们使用一个跨国面板数据集，以堕胎立法作为生育率的工具变量，来估计生育率对女性劳动力参与率的影响。研究发现，生育率对女性劳动力参与率有显著的负效应。这一效应主要集中在对20-39岁年龄段的女性身上，但我们发现，这一影响在较长时间内具有持续性，对年龄较大的女性同样具有影响。我们还提出了一个模拟模型，用于分析生育率降低对人均收入的影响，该模型考虑了女性劳动力参与率的变化以及人口数量和年龄结构的变化。

abstract.text: The magnitude of provider uncompensated care has become an important public policy issue. Yet existing measures of uncompensated care are flawed because they compare uninsured payments to list prices, not to the prices actually paid by the insured. We address this issue using a novel source of data from a vendor that processes financial data for almost 4000 physicians. We measure uncompensated care as the net amount that physicians lose by lower payments from the uninsured than from the insured. Our best estimate is that physicians provide negative uncompensated care to the uninsured, earning more on uninsured patients than on insured patients with comparable treatments. Even our most conservative estimates suggest that uncompensated care amounts to only 0.8% of revenues, or at most $3.2 billion nationally. These results highlight the important distinction between charges and payments, and point to the need for a re-definition of uncompensated care in the health sector going forward.

10.3386/w13585.abstractZh: 提供方未获补偿的医疗服务规模已成为一个重要的公共政策问题。然而，现有的未补偿医疗服务衡量方法存在缺陷，因为它们是将未投保患者的支付金额与标价进行比较，而不是与投保患者实际支付的金额进行比较。我们借助一家处理近4000名医生财务数据的供应商提供的新数据来源来解决这个问题。我们将未补偿医疗服务定义为医生因从未投保患者处获得的支付金额低于从投保患者处获得的支付金额而损失的净金额。我们的最佳估计是，医生对未投保患者提供的未补偿医疗服务为负值，即在未投保患者身上获得的收益高于在投保患者身上获得的收益，即使是在类似的治疗情况下也是如此。即使是我们最保守的估计也表明，未补偿医疗服务的金额仅占总收入的0.8%，全国范围内最多为32亿美元。这些结果凸显了收费与支付之间的重要区别，并指出了未来需要在医疗领域重新定义未补偿医疗服务的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of body composition on wages. We develop measures of body composition - body fat (BF) and fat-free mass (FFM) - using data on bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) that are available in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey III and estimate wage models for white respondents in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979. Previous research used body size or BMI for measuring obesity despite the growing concern in the medical literature that BMI-based measures do not distinguish between body fat and fat-free body mass and that BMI does not adequately control for non-homogeneity inside human body. Therefore, measures used in this paper represent a useful alternative to BMI-based proxies of obesity. This paper also contributes to the growing literature on the role of non-cognitive skills on wage determination. Our results indicate that calculated BF is unambiguously associated with decreased wages for both males and females among whites We also present evidence indicating that FFM is consistently associated with increased wages. We show that these results are not the artifacts of unobserved heterogeneity. Finally, our findings are robust to numerous specification checks and to a large number of alternative BIA prediction equations from which the body composition measures are derived.

10.3386/w13595.abstractZh: 本文探讨了身体成分对工资的影响。我们基于《国家健康与营养调查III》中的生物电阻抗分析数据，开发了身体成分的测量指标——体脂和去脂质量。同时，我们估算了1979年青年纵向调查中对白人受访者的工资模型。以往的研究使用身体尺寸或BMI来衡量肥胖问题，尽管医学文献中越来越关注BMI并不能有效区分体脂和去脂体重，且BMI无法充分控制人体内部的非均匀性。因此，本文使用的测量指标为基于BMI的肥胖指标提供了一种有用的替代方案。此外，本文还为关于非认知技能对工资决定影响的研究做出了贡献。我们的研究结果表明，计算出的体脂与白人男女的工资降低之间存在明确关联；而去脂质量则与工资增加存在一致关联。这些结果并非由于未观察到的异质性造成的。最后，我们的发现经多次规格检验验证，并且适用于多种不同的生物电阻抗预测方程。

abstract.text: This article estimates the mortality cost of smoking based on the first labor market estimates of the value of statistical life by smoking status. Using these values in conjunction with the increase in the mortality risk over the life cycle due to smoking, the value of statistical life by age and gender, and information on the number of packs smoked over the life cycle, produces an estimate of the private mortality cost of smoking of $222 per pack for men and $94 per pack for women in 2006 dollars, based on a 3 percent discount rate. At discount rates of 15 percent or more, the cost decreases to under $25 per pack.

10.3386/w13599.abstractZh: 本文基于首次对吸烟状态对生命价值的影响的劳动力市场估算，计算了吸烟的死亡成本。结合吸烟导致生命周期内死亡风险的增加、按年龄和性别划分的生命价值，以及吸烟者在生命周期内吸烟包数的信息，估算出2006年男性吸烟的私人死亡成本为每包222美元，女性为每包94美元，折现率为3%。当折现率达到15%或更高时，这一成本降至每包25美元以下。

abstract.text: Recent research has found that maternal employment is associated with an increased risk of childhood obesity. This paper explores mechanisms for that correlation. We estimate models of instrumental variables using a unique dataset, the American Time Use Survey, that measure the effect of maternal employment on the mother's allocation of time to activities related to child diet and physical activity. We find that employed women spend significantly less time cooking, eating with their children, and playing with their children, and are more likely to purchase prepared foods. We find suggestive evidence that these decreases in time are only partly offset by husbands and partners. These findings offer plausible mechanisms for the association of maternal employment with childhood obesity.

10.3386/w13600.abstractZh: 近期的研究发现，母亲就业与儿童肥胖风险增加之间存在关联。本文探讨了这种关联的机制。我们利用美国时间使用调查这一独特数据集，建立了工具变量模型，以分析母亲就业对母亲用于与儿童饮食和体育活动相关活动的時間分配的影响。研究发现，就业的母亲在烹饪、与子女共进餐食以及与孩子玩耍方面的時間显著减少，且更有可能购买即食食品。我们还发现了一些有启发性的证据，表明这些時間的减少仅被丈夫和伴侣的参与部分抵消。这些发现为母亲就业与儿童肥胖之间的关联提供了合理的机制解释。

abstract.text: The biotechnology industry has been an engine of innovation for the U.S. healthcare system and, more generally, the U.S. economy. It is by far the most research intensive industry in the U.S. In our analyses in the current paper, for example, we find that, over the past 25 years, average R&D intensity (R&D spending to total firm assets) for this industry was 38 percent. Consider that over this same period average R&D intensity for all industries was only about 3 percent. In the current paper we examine this industry along a number of dimensions and estimate its average financial risk. Specifically, we use Compustat and Center for Research in Securities Prices (CRSP) data from 1982 to 2005 for firms defined by the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) as biotechnology firms to estimate several Fama-French three factor return models. The finance literature has established this model as the gold standard. Single factor models like the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) do not capture all of the types of systematic risk that influence firm cost of capital. In particular, the CAPM does not reflect the empirical evidence that supports both a size-related and a book-to-market related systematic risk factor . Both of these factors, based on biotech industry characteristics, will exert a greater influence on biotech firms, on average. Another implication is, of course, that cost of capital estimates for the industry will be underestimated when a single factor model, like the CAPM, is used. This also implies that the cost estimates of bringing a new drug and/or biologic to market will be understated if financial risk and cost of capital are measured using a single-factor model. In the current study we find that biotechnology firms are exposed to greater financial risk than other industries and are also more sensitive to policy shocks that affect, or could affect, industry profitability. Average nominal costs of capital over the 1982-2005 time period were 16.25 percent for biotechnology firms. Of course, these average estimates obscure significant variation in financial risk at the firm level, but nonetheless shed light on some interesting aggregate differences in risk. In the current paper we discuss the theoretical links between financial risk, stock prices and returns, and R&D spending. Several caveats are also discussed.

10.3386/w13604.abstractZh: 生物技术产业一直是美国医疗保健系统乃至整个美国经济创新的引擎。它无疑是美国研究投入最多的行业。例如，在本文的分析中，我们发现过去25年间，该行业的平均研发强度（研发支出与总资产之比）达到了38%。相比之下，同期所有行业的平均研发强度仅约为3%。本文从多个维度对生物技术产业进行了研究，并估算了其平均财务风险。具体来说，我们使用了1982至2005年的Compustat数据和Center for Research in Securities Prices（CRSP）的数据，以北美行业分类系统（NAICS）定义为生物技术企业的公司作为样本，来估算多个Fama-French三因素回报模型。金融文献已将这一模型视为黄金标准。像资本资产定价模型这样的单因素模型无法捕捉所有影响企业资本成本的系统性风险类型。特别是，CAPM并未反映支持与规模相关的系统性风险以及与市净率相关的系统性风险因素的实证证据。基于生物技术产业的特点，这两种因素将对生物技术企业产生更大的影响。当然，这也意味着，当使用像CAPM这样的单因素模型时，对该行业的资本成本估算将会被低估。同样，如果使用单因素模型来衡量财务风险与资本成本，那么将新药物和/或生物制品推向市场的成本估算也会被低估。在本研究中，我们发现生物技术企业面临的财务风险比其他行业更高，并且对可能影响行业盈利能力的政策变动更为敏感。1982年至2005年期间，生物技术企业的平均资本名义成本为16.25%。当然，这些平均数值掩盖了企业层面财务风险存在的显著差异，但依然揭示了一些有趣的总体风险差异。本文还探讨了财务风险、股票价格与回报以及研发支出之间的理论联系，并提出了一些注意事项。

abstract.text: I generate new data on HIV incidence and prevalence in Africa based on inference from mortality rates. I use these data to relate economic activity (specifically, exports) to new HIV infections in Africa and argue there is a significant and large positive relationship between the two: a doubling of exports leads to as much as a quadrupling in new HIV infections. This relationship is consistent with a model of the epidemic in which truckers and other migrants have higher rates of risky behavior, and their numbers increase in periods with greater exports. I present evidence suggesting that the relationship between exports and HIV is causal and works, at least in part, through increased transit. The result has important policy implications, suggesting (for example) that there is significant value in prevention focused on these transit oriented groups. I apply this result to study the case of Uganda, and argue that a decline in exports in the early 1990s in that country appears to explain between 30% and 60% of the decline in HIV infections. This suggests that the success of the Ugandan anti-HIV education campaign, which encouraged changes in sexual behavior, has been overstated.

10.3386/w13610.abstractZh: 我基于死亡率的推断，生成了关于非洲HIV发病率和流行率的新数据。我利用这些数据将经济活动（特别是出口）与非洲的新HIV感染情况联系起来，并发现两者之间存在显著且强烈的正相关关系：出口额翻倍会导致新HIV感染病例增加四倍。这种关系与一种流行病模型相符，该模型认为卡车司机和其他移民具有较高的风险行为率，而在出口量较大的时期，他们的数量也会增加。我提供了证据表明，出口与HIV之间的关系是因果关系，并且这种关系至少部分是通过增加运输活动实现的。这一结果具有重要的政策意义，例如表明针对这些运输群体的预防工作具有显著的价值。我将这一结果应用于乌干达的案例研究，认为该国在20世纪90年代初出口的下降似乎解释了30%到60%的新HIV感染病例减少。这表明，乌干达反HIV教育活动的成功，该活动鼓励了性行为的变化，其实际效果可能被高估了。

abstract.text: Medicare Part D provides prescription drug coverage through Medicare approved plans offered by private insurance companies and HMOs. In this paper, we study the role of current prescription drug use and health risks, related expectations, and subjective factors in the demand for prescription drug insurance. To characterize rational behavior in the complex Part D environment, we develop an intertemporal optimization model of enrollment decisions. We generally find that seniors' choices respond to the incentives provided by their own health status and the market environment as predicted by the optimization model. The proportion of individuals who do not attain the optimal choice is small, but the margin for error is also small since enrollment is transparently optimal for most eligible seniors. Further, there is also evidence that seniors over-react to some salient features of the choice situation, do not take full account of the future benefit and cost consequences of their decisions, or the expected net benefits and risk properties of alternative plans.

10.3386/w13627.abstractZh: Medicare Part D通过Medicare批准的计划和私人保险公司及HMO提供的计划，为处方药提供保险覆盖。在本文中，我们研究了当前处方药使用状况、健康风险、相关预期以及主观因素在处方药保险需求中的作用。为了描述在复杂的Part D环境中的理性行为，我们建立了一个关于参保决策的跨期优化模型。我们普遍发现，老年人的选择会响应他们自身健康状况和市场环境所提供的激励，这与优化模型预测的结果一致。没有做出最优选择的个体比例很小，但由于大多数符合条件的老年人参保决策显然是最优的，因此出错的空间也很小。此外，还有证据表明，老年人对某些选择特征反应过激，没有充分考虑到决策的未来收益和成本后果，或者没有充分考虑到不同计划预期净收益和风险特性。

abstract.text: We construct a life-cycle model in which retirement occurs at the end of life as a result of declining health. We show that improvements in life expectancy, coupled with a delay in the onset of disability, increases both the optimal consumption level and the proportion of life spent in leisure. The retirement age increases proportionally less than the increase in life expectancy.

10.3386/w13630.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个生命周期模型，其中退休发生在生命末期，由于健康状况的下降。研究表明，预期寿命的延长以及残疾发病时间的推迟，都会增加最优消费水平以及在闲暇时间中的生活比例。退休年龄的增加幅度比预期寿命的增加幅度要小得多。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether increased background mortality risks induce households to make differential health investments in their high- versus low-endowment children. We argue that increases in background mortality risks may disproportionately affect the survival of the low-endowment sibling, consequently increasing the mortality gap between the high- and low-endowment siblings. This increase in mortality gap may induce households to investment more in their high endowment children. We test this hypothesis using nationally representative data from rural India. We use birth size as a measure of initial health endowment, immunization & breastfeeding as measures of childhood investments and infant mortality rate in the child's village as a measure of mortality risks. We find that in villages with high mortality risks, small-at-birth children in a family are 6 - 17 percent less likely to be breastfed or immunized compared to their large-at-birth siblings. In contrast, we find no significant within family differences in investments in villages with low mortality risks.

10.3386/w13649.abstractZh: 本文探讨了背景死亡率的增加是否会导致家庭在拥有高禀赋与低禀赋的孩子之间做出不同的健康投资。我们认为，背景死亡率的增加可能会不成比例地影响低禀赋兄弟姐妹的存活率，从而加剧高禀赋与低禀赋兄弟姐妹之间的死亡率差距。这种死亡率差距的增加可能会促使家庭在拥有高禀赋的孩子身上进行更多的投资。我们使用来自印度农村的全国代表性数据来检验这一假设。我们将出生体重作为初始健康禀赋的衡量标准，将免疫接种和母乳喂养作为儿童期投资的衡量标准，将儿童所在村庄的婴儿死亡率作为死亡率风险的衡量标准。研究发现，在死亡率较高的村庄中，家庭中的小体重婴儿与体重较大的兄弟姐妹相比，接受母乳喂养或免疫接种的可能性低6%至17%。相比之下，在死亡率较低的村庄中，家庭内部在投资方面并没有显著的差异。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the number of people at risk of contracting malaria in Africa using GIS methods and the disease's epidemiologic characteristics. It then estimates yearly costs of covering the population at risk with the package of interventions (differing by level of malaria endemicity and differing for rural and urban populations) for malaria as recommended by the UN Millennium Project. These projected costs are calculated assuming a ramp-up of coverage to full coverage by 2008, and then projected out through 2015 to give a year-by-year cost of meeting the Millennium Development Goal for reducing the burden of malaria by 75% We conclude that the cost of comprehensive malaria control for Africa is US$3.0 billion per year on average, or around US$4.02 per African at risk.

10.3386/w13664.abstractZh: 本文利用地理信息系统方法和疾病的流行病学特征，估算了非洲面临疟疾感染风险的人口数量。随后，本文估算了采用联合国千年计划推荐的干预措施后，覆盖这些风险人群所需的年度成本（不同疟疾流行程度以及农村和城市人口的需求有所不同）。这些预测成本基于到2008年覆盖率达到全面覆盖的假设，并预测至2015年，以计算出实现减少疟疾负担75%的千年发展目标的年度成本。研究结论表明，对非洲进行全面的疟疾控制，平均每年所需的成本为30亿美元，即每个面临疟疾风险的非洲人需承担约4.02美元的成本。

abstract.text: The health insurance characteristics of the population changes sharply at age 65 as most people become eligible for Medicare. But do these changes matter for health? We address this question using data on over 400,000 hospital admissions for people who are admitted through the emergency room for "non-deferrable" conditions -- diagnoses with the same daily admission rates on weekends and weekdays. Among this subset of patients there is no discernible rise in the number of admissions at age 65, suggesting that the severity of illness is similar for patients on either side of the Medicare threshold. The insurance characteristics of the two groups are much different, however, with a large jump at 65 in the fraction who have Medicare as their primary insurer, and a reduction in the fraction with no coverage. These changes are associated with significant increases in hospital list chargers, in the number of procedures performed in hospital, and in the rate that patients are transferred to other care units in the hospital. We estimate a nearly 1 percentage point drop in 7-day mortality for patients at age 65, implying that Medicare eligibility reduces the death rate of this severely ill patient group by 20 percent. The mortality gap persists for at least two years following the initial hospital admission.

10.3386/w13668.abstractZh: 65岁时，人口的医疗保险特征发生了显著变化，因为大多数人获得了医疗保险的资格。但这些变化对健康是否有影响呢？我们使用超过400,000份医院入院数据来研究这个问题，这些数据涵盖了因“不可延期”病症而通过急诊室入院的患者。在这些患者中，65岁年龄段的入院数量并没有明显增加，这表明无论处于医疗保险门槛的哪一端，患者的疾病严重程度都是相似的。然而，这两组患者的医疗保险特征却大相径庭：拥有医疗保险作为主要保险来源的比例在65岁时大幅上升，而没有保险的比例则有所下降。这些变化伴随着医院费用的增加、在医院进行的手术数量的增加，以及患者被转至其他护理单位的频率的增加。我们估计，65岁患者的7天死亡率下降了近1个百分点，这意味着医疗保险资格使这一严重疾病患者的死亡率降低了20%。这种死亡率的差距在初次住院后至少持续两年。

abstract.text: The Barro-Becker model is a simple intuitive model of fertility choice. In its original formulation, however, it has not been very successful at reproducing the changes in fertility choice in response to decreased mortality and increased income growth that demographers have emphasized in explaining the demographic transition. In this paper we show that this is due to an implicit assumption that number and utility of children are complements, which is a byproduct of the high intertemporal elasticity of substitution (IES) typically assumed in the fertility literature. We show that, not only is this assumption not necessary, but both the qualitative and quantitative properties of the model in terms of fertility choice change dramatically when substitutability and high curvature are assumed. To do so, we first derive analytical comparative statics and perform quantitative experiments. We find that if IES is less than one, model predictions of changes in fertility amount to about two-thirds of those observed in U.S. data since 1800. There are two major sources to these predicted changes, the increase in the growth rate of productivity which accounts for about 90 percent of the predicted fall in fertility before 1880, and changes in mortality which account for 90 percent of the predicted change from 1880 to 1950.

10.3386/w13680.abstractZh: Barro-Becker模型是一个简单的直观的生育选择模型。然而，在其原始表述中，该模型在再现因死亡率下降和收入增长而引发的生育选择变化方面并不十分成功，而人口学家在解释人口转型时强调了这些因素的作用。本文指出，这一不足源于一个隐含的假设，即子女数量和效用是互补的，这是生育文献中通常假设的高时间替代弹性（IES）的副产品。我们证明，这一假设不仅是不必要的，而且当假设可替代性和高曲率时，该模型的生育选择方面的定性和定量特性会发生显著变化。为此，我们首先推导了分析性比较静态模型，并进行了定量实验。研究发现，如果时间替代弹性小于1，那么模型对生育变化预测的结果大约只有自1800年以来美国数据观测结果的三分之二。这些预测变化主要有两个来源：一是生产率增长率的提高，这解释了1880年之前生育率下降约90%的原因；二是死亡率的变化，这解释了1880年至1950年间生育率变化的90%。

abstract.text: Occupation is discussed as a social determinant of health. Occupation has received little attention in this light in the economics literature. We examine occupation in a life-course framework and use measures of first-occupation, initial health, and mother's education. We contend that first occupation is a choice made relatively early in life that affects health outcomes at later ages. We examine first-occupation for two reasons: 1) there is growing evidence that early determinants affect later health and occupation has received little attention in this regard and 2) first occupation is predetermined in analysis of later health, which helps to address the issue of potential simultaneity. Using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) we estimate the impact of initial occupation on two measures of health later in life: respondent-reported fair/poor health and ever suffering a heart attack. The PSID offers the opportunity to examine a lifecycle perspective as we can examine the impact of early occupation on later health while controlling for several predetermined conditions such as mother's education and health in youth. Estimates suggest that first-occupation has a durable impact on later health, ceteris paribus, but that the impact varies by health measure and the set of control variables in regression specifications. Early choice of occupation could be a critical factor in successful aging and this information may pave the way to developing more effective workplace and public policies to improve health in older ages.

10.3386/w13715.abstractZh: 本文探讨了职业作为健康的社会决定因素。在经济学文献中，职业这一因素受到的关注相对较少。我们从生命周期的角度研究职业，并使用初次职业、初始健康状况以及母亲教育水平等指标进行分析。我们认为，初次职业是在生命早期做出的选择，会对以后的健康结果产生影响。我们之所以关注初次职业，有两个原因：1）越来越多的证据表明，早期的生活环境会影响后期健康，而职业这一因素在这方面受到的关注较少；2）在分析后期健康时，初次职业是预先确定的，这有助于解决潜在的同时性问题。我们利用收入动态面板研究的数据，估计了初次职业对后期健康的两个指标的影响：受访者报告的公平/不良健康状况以及是否曾经遭受过心脏病发作。该研究提供了从生命周期角度进行分析的机会，因为我们可以在控制诸如母亲在青少年时期的教育和健康状况等预先确定的条件的情况下，研究早期职业对后期健康的影响。研究结果表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，初次职业对后期健康具有持久的影响，但这种影响因健康指标和回归模型中的控制变量而有所不同。早期职业的选择可能是成功老化的关键因素，这些信息可能为制定更有效的职场和公共政策以改善老年人的健康状况提供思路。

abstract.text: This chapter returns to a forty-year-old debate between Griliches and sociologists who emphasized the structure of organizations, informal networks, and “change agents” as forces affecting the diffusion of hybrid corn. It considers state-level factors associated with the adoption of a variety of technological innovations over the last seventy-five years: hybrid corn and farm tractors in the first half of the twentieth century, computers in the 1990s, and treatment following heart attacks with beta-blockers during the last decade. It shows that some states consistently adopted new effective technology, whether it be hybrid corn, farm tractors, or effective treatments for prevention of recurrent heart attacks, such as beta-blockers. The adoption of these new highly effective technologies was closely associated with social capital and state-level 1928 high school graduation rates. The chapter suggests that economic models may be useful in identifying why some regions are more likely to adopt early, but sociological barriers—perhaps related to lack of social capital or informational networks—can potentially explain why other regions lag far behind.

10.7208/chicago/9780226044507.003.0019.abstractZh: 本章再次回顾了格里利切斯与社会学家之间长达四十年的争论，这些争论主要围绕组织结构、非正式网络以及“变革推动者”作为影响杂交玉米传播的力量。文章探讨了过去七十五年间与各种技术创新采纳相关的国家层面因素：二十世纪上半叶的杂交玉米和农用拖拉机、1990年代的计算机技术，以及过去十年中使用β阻滞剂治疗心脏病的情况。研究表明，一些国家始终能够持续采纳新的有效技术，无论是杂交玉米、农用拖拉机，还是用于预防心脏病复发的有效治疗方法，如β阻滞剂。这些新技术的采纳与社会资本以及1928年的高中毕业率密切相关。本章认为，经济模型有助于解释为何某些地区更有可能采纳早期的技术，而社会障碍——可能与缺乏社会资本或信息网络有关——则可能解释为何其他地区的发展远远滞后。

abstract.text: We consider settings in which skilled experts have private, heterogeneous types. Contracts that evaluate experts based on outcomes are used to differentiate between types. However, experts can take unobservable actions to manipulate their outcomes, which may harm consumers. For example, surgeons may privately engage in harmful selection behavior to avoid risky patients and hence improve observed performance. In this paper we solve for optimal evaluation contracts that maximize consumer welfare. We find that an optimal contract takes the form of a scoring rule, typically characterized by four regions: (1) high score sensitivity to outcomes, (2) low score sensitivity to outcomes, (3) tenure, and (4) firing or license revocation. When improvement is possible, an optimal contract for the low quality expert is a fixed-length mentorship program. In terms of methods, we draw upon continuous-time techniques, as introduced in Sannikov (2007b). Since our problem involves both adverse selection and moral hazard, this paper features novel applications of continuous-time methods in contract design.

https://openalex.org/W2161868224.abstractZh: 我们考虑了这样一种情况：熟练的专家拥有私有的、异质性的类型。基于结果来评估专家的合同被用来区分这些类型。然而，专家可能会采取不可观测的行为来操纵他们的结果，这可能会损害消费者利益。例如，外科医生可能会私下进行有害的选择行为，以避开风险患者，从而提高观察到的表现。在本文中，我们解决了能够最大化消费者福利的最优评估合同问题。我们发现，最优合同的形式是一个评分规则，通常包含四个区域：（1）对结果的评分敏感度较高；（2）对结果的评分敏感度较低；（3）任期问题；（4）解雇或吊销执照。当改进是可能的时，针对低质量专家的最优合同是一个固定长度的指导计划。在方法上，我们借鉴了Sannikov（2007b）提出的连续时间技术。由于我们的问题涉及逆向选择和道德风险，本文还展示了连续时间方法在合同设计中的新颖应用。

abstract.text: Introducao O Brasil tem feito progressos significativos no desenvolvimento humano durante a ultima decada, gracas a uma serie de inovacoes em politicas e acoes sociais, e a equidade de acesso melhorou consideravelmente. Na saude, a consolidacao do financiamento publico organizacao do setor num sistema nacional (SUS – Sistema Unico de Saude) e uma enfase maior na atencao basica tem sido muito importantes para essas melhorias. Contudo, persistem desafios significativos relacionados a ineficiencias e baixa qualidade dos servicos prestados. Dado o alto nivel da divida publica e da carga tributaria, a viabilidade economica e sustentabilidade do sistema podem ser prejudicadas, enquanto que os ganhos em equidade obtidos nos anos recentes podem se tornar dificeis de sustentar. As autoridades financeiras demonstram preocupacao crescente com o aumento dos gastos na area de saude, que ja representam em torno de 11% do gasto publico. Considerando os atuais niveis de ineficiencia no sistema de saude, em 2025 o gasto total com saude pode aumentar de 8 para 12% do PIB, enquanto que o gasto das familias em saude pode subir de 5 para 11% em relacao a renda. Aumentar a eficiencia e a efetividade na utilizacao de recursos de saude para conter a escalada de custos talvez seja o maior desafio enfrentado pelo sistema de saude brasileiro.

https://openalex.org/W2887019125.abstractZh: 巴西在过去十年中在人类发展方面取得了显著进展，这得益于一系列政策和社会行动的创新，以及获取服务的公平性得到了显著改善。在医疗保健领域，公共资金的支持、医疗体系的国家化组织（SUS——单一卫生系统）以及对基层医疗服务的重视对于这些改善至关重要。然而，仍然存在一些与服务效率低下和服务质量差相关的重大挑战。鉴于公共债务和税收负担的高水平，医疗系统的经济可行性和可持续性可能会受到威胁，而近年来在公平性方面取得的成果也可能难以持续。金融当局对医疗保健领域的支出增加表现出越来越大的担忧，目前医疗保健支出约占公共支出的11%。考虑到当前医疗体系中的效率问题，到2025年，医疗保健的总支出可能从GDP的8%增加到12%，而家庭在医疗保健上的支出则可能从收入的5%增加到11%。提高医疗资源的利用效率，以控制成本上升，或许是巴西医疗体系面临的最大挑战。

abstract.text: We examine how firms respond to third-party ratings of their corporate environmental activities. Using insights from institutional theory, we hypothesize that ratings are particularly likely to spur responses from firms whose legitimacy is threatened and thus are shamed by these ratings. We extend existing theory by drawing on the strategic choice perspective to hypothesize that the greatest performance improvements will be exhibited by those shamed firms that face lower-cost opportunities to improve and thus are particularly able to respond. We tike advantage of a natural experiment, when a major social rating agency expanded the scope of its ratings, to empirically test these hypotheses in the context of environmental ratings and environmental performance of more than 650 firms in the United States. We find empirical evidence that supports our hypotheses, and present implications for theory and public policy.

https://openalex.org/W7112377123.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业如何回应第三方对其企业环境活动的评级。基于制度理论的见解，我们假设那些合法性受到威胁、因此会因这些评级而感到羞愧的企业，更有可能做出回应。我们进一步运用战略选择视角，假设那些面临低成本改进机会、因而能够特别有效回应的企业，将会表现出最大的绩效提升。我们利用一个自然实验，即一家主要的社会评级机构扩大了其评级范围，来实证检验这些假设，研究对象是美国650多家企业的环境评级及其环境绩效。我们发现有实证证据支持我们的假设，并提出了对理论和公共政策的启示。
